title: Associate Director - Business Finance (Category)
description:
**Designation: Associate Director - Business Finance (Category)**

**Bangalore, Karnataka, India**

**Responsibilities, aka, what we’d like you to deliver :**

Associate Director – Business Finance | Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Planning & Analysis

Own AOP, QOP, MOP, forecasting, and long-term financial planning in partnership with business leadership.

Provide strategic insights, scenario analysis, and recommendations to drive growth, profitability, and informed decision-making.

Lead performance reviews, highlighting key risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.

2. Strategic Business Partnering

Act as a strategic finance partner to senior business leaders, co-owning business targets and outcomes.

Drive a deep understanding of business operations and key value drivers to identify growth, profitability, and productivity opportunities.

Challenge assumptions and influence decisions through strong commercial and financial insights.

3. Category & Commercial Finance

Lead financial strategy across categories, with ownership of profitability, pricing, margins, inventory, and supplier economics.

Partner with Commercial, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams to optimize margins, inventory, and working capital.

Drive initiatives to improve category profitability, cash conversion, and overall capital efficiency.

4. Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing finance team with strong commercial and analytical capabilities.

Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and business ownership.

Drive process simplification, automation, and finance transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications:**

● CA or MBA with relevant experience of 4-6 years

● Strong experience in the business finance domain including budgeting, ROI, variance analysis, stakeholder & team management.

● Demonstrated experience in revenue planning, pricing, supply chain finance and category management.

● Excellent analytical and problem solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.

**Preferred Skills:**

● Leadership and team management

● Strategic thinking and business partnering

● Financial acumen and analytical skills

● Communication and interpersonal skills

● Problem Solving and decision making

● Adaptability, agility and resilience

**Why Join Us?**

● Zepto is on a blitzscaling path unlike any other startup today. Be the flagbearer for the financial process in this journey.

● The opportunity to join India’s next Unicorn is rare. So, we’re giving our team strong equity to create lasting wealth as our company grows.

title: Finance Shared Services Manager (India)
description:
**We are searching for an individual with strong communication skills and a true passion for making a positive impact, whilst delivering exceptional customer service to finance and non-finance stakeholders. The Finance Shared Services Manager (India) will be responsible for establishing, developing and leading a high-performing offshore finance operations team (to be based in Bangalore) that will in turn support a global Finance Shared Services function.**
This role sits within the Global Finance Shared Services (FSS) team, which has recently been established to support Buro Happold’s Future Finance Strategy, facilitating ongoing growth, and enabling the wider 5-year business plan. The Global FSS team provides essential support to the Regional Finance teams, which are spread across five regions (UK+, Europe, India, Middle East and US), comprising a workforce of over 140 finance professionals.
  
  
**Here at Buro Happold, expect the exceptional.**
From the projects you will work on to the clients we work with. From career-defining opportunities to an inclusive and diverse practice where we all contribute to a more equitable world. From our reputation to our relationships. Wherever your Buro Happold career takes you, it’ll be anything but ordinary.
  
  
**Your next role**
The role will initially focus on building the offshore capability, which will include recruiting, transitioning processes, creating a governance framework and establishing operational readiness. Following set-up of the offshore delivery team, the Finance Shared Services Manager (India) will oversee the delivery of transactional finance activities spanning the key finance processes (Purchase to Pay (P2P), Order to Cash (O2C) and Record to Report (R2R) and will be critical in driving process standardisation, service excellence, operational efficiency and continuous improvement whilst ensuring delivery of the agreed service levels and compliance with global policies and controls.
  
  
**Offshore Team Establishment & Recruitment**

* Lead the establishment and expansion of the offshore Finance Shared Services capability in India.
* Develop resource plans aligned to global business requirements.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop finance professionals across P2P, O2C, and R2R process towers.
* Partner with internal HR and Talent Acquisition teams to build a strong talent pipeline.
* Establish an engaging, high-performance team culture
* Support the knowledge transfer and transition activities from onshore and regional finance teams.

**Finance Operations Management -**
oversee and manage the service delivery of those financial activities undertaken by the offshore Finance Shared Services team for all regions and across the three process towers, to include the following:
  
  

* P2P - supplier onboarding, invoice processing, payment processing, housekeeping, enquiries and employee expenses.
* O2C – processing and allocating cash payments received from customers.
* R2R – processing timesheet movements, preparing balance sheet reconciliations, fixed asset accounting, supporting month-end close activities, processing/reconciling intercompany transactions and delivering all in-scope general ledger accounting work for the Group.

**Service Delivery & Performance Management**

* Deliver services in accordance with agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Monitor operational performance and productivity metrics.
* Produce regular performance dashboards and management reporting.
* Ensure service delivery meets global stakeholder expectations.
* Escalate risks and issues appropriately.

**Process Transition & Continuous Improvement**

* Support the migration of finance activities from global locations into the offshore team.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
* Promote automation opportunities, including ERP workflows and robotics.
* Contribute to transformation and finance modernisation initiatives.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Maintain a robust internal control environment.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, delegated authorities, and financial controls.
* Support internal and external audit activities.
* Ensure adherence to local and global regulatory requirements.
* Promote strong data governance and confidentiality standards.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build effective working relationships with Finance Shared Services, Central Finance, Regional Finance and operational stakeholders.
* Act as a key contact point between offshore and onshore teams.
* Participate in governance meetings and operational reviews.
* Promote a customer-focused service culture across the team.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Lead, coach, and motivate a growing finance operations team.
* Conduct performance reviews and development planning.
* Create individual learning and career progression plans.
* Drive employee engagement initiatives.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and accountability.
* Ensure adequate workforce planning and resource management.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* 7-10+ years of progressive finance operations or shared services experience.
* Minimum 3-5 years of team leadership experience.
* Experience managing one or more of the core finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R)
* Demonstrated experience working within a global Finance Shared Services or Global Business Services (GBS) environment.
* Proven experience managing SLAs, KPIs, and operational performance.
* Experience supporting process transitions and service migrations.
* Experience working across multiple countries and cultures.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Essential – bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration.
* Desirable – fully qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA).
* Experience establishing or scaling offshore finance teams.
* Experience managing finance transformation programmes.
* Exposure to automation, robotics, AI, and process digitisation initiatives.

**Leadership Skills**

* Strong people leadership and coaching capability.
* Experience building and developing offshore teams.
* Ability to manage teams through periods of growth and transformation.
* Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to influence stakeholders across multiple regions and cultures.

**Technical Skills**

* Deep understanding of Shared Services operating models.
* Strong knowledge of P2P, O2C, and R2R processes.
* Experience working within global ERP platforms.
* Knowledge of internal controls and financial governance frameworks.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting skills.
* Familiarity with automation and digital finance tools.

**Communication Skills**

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder management capability.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior leaders and operational teams globally.

**What We Offer You**
Bring your knowledge and expertise to one of the world’s most respected consultancies.
  
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package including Annual Discretionary Bonus, Comprehensive Health Insurance Scheme for both you and your family, Group Personal Accident Cover
* Our 5-day workweek policy supports work-life balance, ensuring you have time to relax and recharge.
* A strong commitment to your continuous development. Whatever stage in your career, we have a learning and development programme that will enable and empower you
* Benefit from our Employee Referral Bonus, rewarding you for bringing talented candidates into our fold
* A commitment to your wellbeing through a comprehensive Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellness initiatives designed to support your mental and physical health
* Back to Work Program for Women - Swam Siddha - We're committed to empowering women, facilitating seamless re-entry into the workforce through our dedicated program
* Engage with our vibrant community through the Young Employees Forum, Diversity and Inclusion Forum, and BH Women's Network, fostering a supportive and diverse workplace culture
* Make a difference in the world with our Share Our Skills (SOS) program, offering opportunities to support local communities and those in need globally.
* An International Culture that wherever your career takes you at Buro Happold, you won’t be far from the exceptional.

**A place for everyone**
Buro Happold values an individual's flexible approaches to working patterns as an important part of the way you work and achieve balance. We welcome applications from those who are seeking flexibility in their careers.
  
  
Our exceptional portfolio of projects is the result of the diversity of thought, identities, backgrounds, and experiences that shape us. Appreciating each other’s differences is key, we want employees to feel they don’t have to mask elements of their identity to thrive.
  
  
We are working to change the lack of representation of marginalised groups in the built environment and are particularly keen to hear from anyone who feels they are underrepresented in the industry. We have much to learn from one another. Embracing differences allows us to develop the most innovative and elegant solutions.
  
  
Please let us know if there are any adjustments, we could make to the application process to make it easier and more comfortable for you. Contact IndiaHR@burohappold.com so we can work with you to support you throughout your application.

title: Group Manager Finance & Administration Delivery - Operations
description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting embraces long-term relationships and close collaboration with clients across the globe. In this role, you will work for IBM BPO, part of Consulting that, accelerates digital transformation using agile methodologies, process mining, and AI-powered workflows.
  
  
You'll work with visionaries across multiple industries to improve the hybrid cloud and AI journey for the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Your ability to accelerate impact and make meaningful change for your clients is enabled by our strategic partner ecosystem and our robust technology platforms across the IBM portfolio, including IBM Software and Red Hat.
  
  
Curiosity and a constant quest for knowledge serve as the foundation to success in IBM Consulting. In your role, you'll be supported by mentors and coaches who will encourage you to challenge the norm, investigate ideas outside of your role, and come up with creative solutions resulting in groundbreaking impact for a wide network of clients. Our culture of evolution and empathy centers on long-term career growth and learning opportunities in an environment that embraces your unique skills and experience.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Group Manager, you are responsible for handling finance clients in different industries and across Finance and Accounts.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Include**

* You will own client engagements/contracts across geographies- Operations support for establishing processes, metrics identifications and reporting.
* Establish and maintain a robust tracking mechanism for key indicators of the operations to support decision-making.
* Responsible for achieving transformation at a high level of change management experience, including challenging, inspiring and leading the team.
* Responsible for tracking and driving all process parameters ‘critical to quality’ for process delivery.
* Assist management with career development activities for team members, team leaders and managers, including performance management, feedback, and training.
* Ensure adequate mentorship & training of team members to ensure process objectives & Customer requirements are met.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Minimum 16+ years of experience in Finance and Accounting Delivery & Transformations
* Proven experience creating and developing value propositions, business cases, and industry-specific offerings.
* Ability to ideate strategic direction and initiatives through designing of business outcome models, contracting structures and identification of new opportunities and business lines.
* Proficient in supporting the sales team in building a compelling business case for prospective clients to the offshore business and working closely with Process Delivery leaders in identifying improvement opportunities and implementing the same across all processes.
* Expertise in leading efforts on continuous process improvements and transformation along with carrying out maturity assessments.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* A certified Chartered Accountant/Company Secretaryship/Certified Management Accountant.
* Proven experience in end-to-end Record to Report, Procure to Pay & Order to Cash process.
* In-depth process knowledge in central finance reporting, management reporting and reports.
* Ability to influence people internal/external customers, Operations and Finance partners.
* Ambitious individual who can work under their direction towards agreed targets/goals and with a creative approach to work.
* Intuitive individual with an ability to manage change and proven time management.
* Proven interpersonal skills while contributing to team effort by accomplishing related results as needed.
* Up-to-date technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing publications.

title: Manager, Enterprise Business Systems-Finance, Legal and Compliance
description:
Be an essential element to a brighter future.
  
  
We work together to transform essential resources into critical ingredients for mobility, energy, connectivity and health. Join our values-led organization committed to building a more resilient world with people and planet in mind. Our core values are the foundation that make us successful for ourselves, our customers and the planet.
  
  
**Job Description**
Manager, Enterprise Business Systems – Finance Legal and Compliance
  
  
**Location**
India
  
  
**Function**
Information Technology
  
  
**Position Overview**
The Manager, Enterprise Systems, is responsible for the operational performance, support delivery, and continuous improvement of enterprise systems within an assigned business process domain. This role leads a team of business systems analysts and third-party application management services (AMS) resources to ensure systems are stable, compliant, and aligned with business operating needs.
  
  
The Manager serves as the primary operational leader for their business process tower, with accountability for day-to-day system support, issue resolution, service quality, minor enhancements, and release readiness. This role ensures that enterprise systems are not only functioning reliably but are continuously improving to meet evolving business demands and performance expectations.
  
  
In addition to core operational responsibilities, this role plays a key part in advancing AI, automation, and data-driven capabilities within its domain. The Manager identifies opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve system usability, and enhance operational insight through intelligent automation and improved monitoring.
  
  
The Manager works in close partnership with the Vice President, Enterprise Business Systems Digital Business Partners (DBPs) to ensure alignment between operations, roadmap priorities, and business needs.
  
  
**Operational Ownership**

* Own end-to-end operational performance of enterprise systems within the assigned business process domain
* Manage and prioritize workload across incidents, requests, and enhancements
* Maintain visibility into backlog, demand, and recurring issues
* Ensure consistent and reliable support outcomes

**Service Delivery & Support Management**

* Lead incident, problem, and request management processes
* Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions
* Monitor service performance against SLAs
* Maintain documentation and knowledge base
* Leverage automation to improve support efficiency

**AI, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify and implement automation opportunities
* Reduce manual effort and incident recurrence
* Support AI-enabled monitoring and predictive capabilities
* Ensure automation is governed and documented

**Financy Legal And Compliance Domain Responsibility Summary**
 Leads delivery, support, and continuous improvement of technology capabilities across the Finance, Legal, and Compliance value streams.
  
  
 Supports business processes including record-to-report, treasury, tax, planning and forecasting, financial reporting, legal operations, internal controls, and ethics and compliance.
  
  
 Ensures business systems are secure, reliable, compliant, and aligned with regulatory requirements, corporate governance standards, and business objectives.
  
  
 Drives process standardization, data quality, automation, and operational efficiency to improve financial integrity, transparency, risk management, and decision making.
  
  
**People Leadership**

* Lead and develop business systems analysts
* Define clear roles and expectations
* Drive accountability and performance
* Build team capabilities and succession

**Vendor & Partner Management**

* Manage AMS providers and performance
* Track SLAs and service quality
* Ensure knowledge transfer and documentation
* Align vendor capacity to demand

**Release, Change & Improvement Management**

* Coordinate releases and changes
* Ensure operational readiness
* Improve efficiency and reduce risk
* Support lifecycle and upgrades

**Business Process & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Build relationships with business stakeholders
* Provide operational insights to DBPs
* Report on performance, risks, and backlog
* Act as operational contact

**Controls, Risk & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with policies and controls
* Support audit and documentation
* Maintain change discipline
* Escalate risks

**Success Measures**

* Improved support responsiveness and satisfaction
* Reduced recurring incidents
* Increased automation and efficiency
* Strong alignment with DBPs

**Success Measures**

* Improved support responsiveness and satisfaction
* Reduced recurring incidents
* Increased automation and efficiency
* Strong alignment with DBPs

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business, finance, accounting, or a related field
* 10+ years of experience in a global company, including 5+ years leading teams
* Progressive experience supporting enterprise business systems in Finance, Legal, Compliance, or a closely related domain
* Demonstrated leadership of business systems analysts, managed service providers, or cross-functional delivery teams
* Strong knowledge of incident, problem, change, release, and service-level management practices
* Ability to translate business process needs into practical system support, enhancement, and automation priorities
* Experience managing risk, controls, audit requirements, data quality, and documentation in a regulated environment
* Strong stakeholder communication, vendor management, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP S/4HANA and related Finance, Governance, Risk, Compliance, or enterprise reporting capabilities
* Familiarity with legal operations, ethics and compliance, treasury, tax, planning, forecasting, or record-to-report processes
* Experience applying AI, workflow automation, monitoring, or analytics to improve support quality and operational efficiency
* Working knowledge of SOX controls, data privacy requirements, and enterprise security practices
* Experience operating in a global, matrixed organization and coordinating resources across regions and time zones
* ITIL, SAP, project management, agile, or other relevant professional certification

**Benefits Of Joining Albemarle**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits package
* A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally.

We are partners to one another in pioneering new ways to be better for ourselves, our teams, and our communities. When you join Albemarle, you become our most essential element and you can anticipate competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and resources that foster your well-being and fuel your personal growth. Help us shape the future, build with purpose and grow together.

title: Senior Analyst-FP&A
description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Principal Data Analyst - FP&A – will be responsible for leading financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and business performance analytics processes across the organization. This role serves as a key partner to Finance leadership, Business Controllers, and Operating Companies by delivering accurate, timely, and actionable insights through OneStream, Power BI, Excel-based models, and executive reporting packages.
  
  
The role is accountable for managing monthly, quarterly, and annual FP&A reporting cycles, developing management reporting packages, ensuring data integrity across multiple reporting platforms, and supporting strategic decision-making through advanced financial analysis and visualization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Financial Reporting & Performance Analytics
  
  
Lead the preparation and maintenance of monthly financial reporting and forecasting workbooks in OneStream and Excel.
  
  
Manage reporting processes for P&L Reporting, Segment Forecasting, Revenue Growth Outlook, Backlog Analysis, SG&A Analysis, Gross Margin (GM) Performance, Service and Non-Service Reporting
  
  
Ensure reporting accuracy through reconciliation and validation across OneStream, Power BI, and source financial systems.
  
  
Perform variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior-year performance.
  
  
Provide financial insights and recommendations to FP&A leadership and business stakeholders.
  
  
Develop and maintain Monthly Business Review (MBR) reporting packages.
  
  
Prepare executive dashboards, financial scorecards, and performance reports.
  
  
Create management-level visualizations, charts, and KPI summaries, including : Inspection Growth, Backlog Progression, Revenue Trends, Price/Volume Analysis, Organic vs. Acquisition Performance, New Business Performance
  
  
Support leadership reviews by identifying business trends, risks, and opportunities.
  
  
Acquisition & Operational Performance Reporting
  
  
Lead acquisition performance tracking and analysis.
  
  
Develop YTD Acquisition Performance reports and Organic/M&A growth analyses.
  
  
Monitor branch and operating company performance through standardized reporting frameworks.
  
  
Ensure consistency of operational metrics and financial results across reporting sources.
  
  
Forecasting, Planning & Budgeting
  
  
Support monthly forecast cycles and annual budgeting processes.
  
  
Update and manage budget reporting models within OneStream and Excel.
  
  
Consolidate forecasts, downturn plans, and capital expenditure requests.
  
  
Prepare planning presentations and supporting financial analyses.
  
  
Support scenario modeling and performance projections for leadership decision-making.
  
  
Quarterly Reporting & Color Book Management
  
  
Coordinate quarterly reporting packages and Color Book preparation.
  
  
Roll forward and maintain reporting templates, linked workbooks, and presentations.
  
  
Consolidate financial, operational, and performance reporting from multiple business units.
  
  
Prepare executive summaries and dashboard reporting for leadership reviews.
  
  
Compile consolidated analyses for: Underbillings, Margin Fade, Loss Jobs, CapEx Forecasts, Branch Comparisons, Accounts Receivable Performance
  
  
Data Governance & Reporting Automation
  
  
Maintain reporting standards, governance controls, and data quality processes.
  
  
Optimize reporting workflows utilizing: OneStream, Power BI, Excel Power QueryAdvanced Excel Modeling
  
  
Partner with finance, IT, and business stakeholders to improve reporting capabilities.
  
  
Collaborate with Finance Directors, Controllers, Business Leaders, and Operating Companies.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or related field with 8 to 10 yrs of experience in FP&A, financial reporting, business analytics, or management reporting.
  
  
Strong experience supporting executive-level financial reporting and forecasting processes.
  
  
Experience working in large multinational or shared services environments.
  
  
Advanced understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.
  
  
Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI
  
  
Success Measures
  
  
Reporting accuracy and data integrity
  
  
Timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting cycles
  
  
Reduction in manual reporting effort through automation
  
  
Executive stakeholder satisfaction
  
  
Forecast accuracy and business insight quality
  
  
Standardization and scalability of reporting processes
  
  
**Additional Information**
**About Us, Our Culture & What We Can Offer You**
Established over 200 years ago, Chubb Fire & Security are a global business driven by keeping people and the world safe. We provide essential systems, equipment and services, from digital CCTV surveillance and intruder alarms, to fire detection and suppression systems. Offering a full range of innovative products and services to a broad range of customers, from local independent business, to many of the FTSE 100 companies
  
  
We believe we offer a unique working culture, where you are as important to us as our customers, and we want you to feel that everyday. We are proud to offer extensive training to all of our new Advisors, fully supporting, and enabling you to thrive in your new role and beyond, with ongoing career development opportunities throughout your career journey with us.

title: Deputy Manager - Finance
description:

* Analyse performance vs AOP and latest forecasts across countries, highlighting leading and lagging KPIs and actionable insights

At VIATRIS, we see healthcare not as it is but as it should be. We act courageously and are uniquely positioned to be a source of stability in a world of evolving healthcare needs.

Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here is how this role will make an impact:

**Role Purpose**

Act as the
**Finance Business Partner to Sterile Vertical and Global 3P Operations**
, providing strategic financial insights, commercial support and robust financial controls across third-party sourced sterile products. Partner closely with Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Commercial, Legal and Hub Finance teams to drive cost competitiveness, profitability, working-capital optimization and financial discipline.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning**

* Lead the annual budgeting process and periodic forecast updates
* Develop and monitor budgets, forecasts and financial performance, ensuring alignment with business plans and strategic objectives.
* Prepare and review monthly MIS, quarterly management packs, departmental expenses and key financial performance indicators.

**2. Costing, COGS & Transfer Pricing**

* Support the calculation and validation of
  **Cost of Goods, standard costs and transfer prices**
  for third-party products.
* Provide costing support for annual budgeting, new product launches and commercial/business cases.
* Analyze cost drivers and identify opportunities for cost optimization and margin improvement.

**3. PPV, Variance Analysis & Cost Control**

* Lead the calculation, reporting and analysis of
  **Purchase Price Variances (PPV)**
  and other operating variances related to third-party products.
* Analyze actual versus standard cost, identify root causes and drive corrective actions with Sourcing and Operations.
* Review PPV accruals, commercial COGS accruals and vendor debit/credit notes to identify and resolve mismatches.

**4. Inventory & Working Capital Management**

* Support the monthly inventory reporting and control process for third-party contract manufacturers, particularly injectable CMO partners.
* Review inventory movements, provisions, write-offs and working-capital performance.
* Partner with Operations and Hub Finance to strengthen inventory controls and improve working-capital efficiency.

**5. Commercial & Contract Finance**

* Support the development, establishment and maintenance of complex third-party contracts, with specific focus on cost-control mechanisms and bespoke financial clauses.
* Review commercial agreements and amendments from a financial and business-impact perspective prior to execution.
* Partner with Sourcing to evaluate and pursue vendor claims in accordance with contractual terms.

* Support preparation of
  **Technical Transfer business cases**
  , including cost evaluation, project budgets, forecasts, actuals and project cost control.
* Provide financial evaluation and decision support for new products, sourcing opportunities and strategic initiatives.

**7. Freight & Supplier Cost Analysis**

* Review YTD freight actuals through Trax/BI reports and investigate discrepancies against accruals or expectations.
* Analyze freight and other supplier-related costs to identify financial leakage and improvement opportunities.

Work closely with:

* Sterile Operations Teams / Site Heads
* Global Sourcing Leadership
* Supply Chain / SCM / Procurement / Commercial
* Commercial Finance, Legal
* Technical Transfer / Project Teams
* Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs)
* Senior Business Leadership

**Core Requirements**

**Qualifications, Experience and Skills**

Here are the minimum qualifications for this position:

* **CA with minimum 8 years of post-qualification experience**
  , preferably within a large global organization.
* Strong experience in
  **Operations Finance, Sourcing/Procurement Finance, Costing, PPV, COGS and Budgeting/Forecasting**
  .
* Strong analytical capability with the ability to interpret and manage large, complex datasets.
* Hands-on
  **SAP experience**

* Proven ability to lead
  **process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives**
  .

* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure and deliver within tight deadlines.

  **India, Europe and US time zones**
  .

  **leadership presence, ownership, tenacity and determination to deliver results**

description:
**Job Title:**
Analyst/Associate/AM
  
  
**Department**

**About Business line/Function:**
Global Market Operations also known as COE (Center of Excellence) is further divided into multiple departments i.e. Listed Derivatives Transaction Processing, Securities Transaction Processing, Prime and US Markets Transaction Processing, FXMM & OTCD Transaction Processing, Transversal Lifecycle Support, Collateral & TFLM and Valuations & Transversal Services.
  
  
Within Valuations & Transversal Services, Valuation Controls (VC) is a global function whose main missions are articulated around second level control hubs in Europe, Asia and the Americas.
  
  
Valuation Controls, in conjunction with RISK MFI, is in charge of independently verifying, analyzing and reporting on the market parameters used in the valuation, as well as analyzing the impact of the use of independent market parameters in the valuation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**

* To support and control the accurate and independent marking of all parameters as required by regulators along with the derivation, analyze and reporting of results.
* To work on improving IPV (independent price verification) set up with the aim of increasing the accuracy of the figures and the efficiency of the processes.

**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure the daily IPV (aka independent price verification) of prices for the respective businesses.
* Ensure the monthly independent price verification of prices for the respective scope.
* Analyze the drivers of the IPV and communicate clearly the IPV impact and any IPV issues to the appropriate teams.
* Ensure accurate submission to external consensus provider (if necessary).
* Perform second level of control in application of RISK guidelines in the valuation calibrations.
* Be the face of the VC team on questions related to IPV processes and be able to decompose, descript and explain the process front to back.
* Maintain accurate and clear SOPs (Standard operating procedure) on the allocated IPVs.
* Show initiative to review, challenge, identify and recommend improvements on processes that will benefit control and efficiency. Once approved ensure accurate implementation and update SOPs.
* Work on the automation of manual processes launched via Excel/VBA/Python spreadsheets and/or Access databases.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Gradually be a participant in discussions with Risk, FO, Finance, Auditors and management for issues/improvements/challenges related to IPV.
* Gradually build and maintain relationships with other Product Control teams, Front Office, Middle Office, Finance and Risk-GM based on trust, respect and professionalism.
* Contribute to the Cross Risk dashboard by feeding IPV indicator.

title: Senior Manager - Commercial Finance & Revenue Operations
description:
**Title:**
Senior Manager - Commercial Finance & Revenue Operations

**Location:**
Bengaluru, India

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Reports To:**
Founder

**About the Company:**

We are a high-growth, global B2B MarTech SaaS company with active operations across the US, Europe, and APAC. Our platform empowers enterprise marketing teams to execute campaigns at scale by combining AI, advanced automation, rich data integration, and cutting-edge tech infrastructure. As we rapidly expand our global footprint and introduce complex, usage-based pricing models, we are strengthening our commercial finance engine to ensure scalable, compliant, and highly profitable growth.

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a proactive, execution-focused Senior Manager - Commercial Finance & Revenue Operations to own the end-to-end Order-to-Cash (O2C) lifecycle, customer unit economics, and cross-border financial compliance. In this role, you will sit at the intersection of GTM (Sales & Customer Success), Product/Engineering, and Core Finance. You will act as a strategic deal partner to GTM teams - ensuring enterprise contracts translate into precise multi-currency billing, cloud and API delivery costs remain strictly controlled, and multi-jurisdictional tax obligations stay audit-ready.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Revenue Operations & Order-to-Cash (O2C) Engine:**

- Contract-to-Cash Leadership: Own the complete O2C engine across global entities (US, EU, APAC, India), ensuring revenue recognition compliance under ASC 606 / IFRS 15.

- Deal Desk & Commercial Structuring: Partner with Sales Ops and GTM leaders to review non-standard enterprise contracts, validating payment terms, multi-year discounts, SLAs, and hybrid billing mechanics (fixed base subscriptions + usage tiers).

- Billing Stack Automation: Administer and optimize data flows connecting CRM, and subscription billing to eliminate manual interventions and revenue leakage.

- Collections & Cash Acceleration: Enforce corporate credit policies, manage multi-currency AR aging, oversee global payment gateway reconciliations, and actively drive down Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).

**2. Margin Defense & COGS Control:**

- Unit Economics & COGS Optimization: Work alongside Infrastructure and Engineering leads to track, analyze, and optimize SaaS delivery costs - specifically AWS/GCP cloud compute, third-party data enrichment APIs, and LLM token/inference spend.

- Commercial Spend Guardrails: Institute clear procurement approval matrixes, spend policies, and vendor management workflows to manage operating burn without throttling GTM velocity.

- Budget vs. Actual (BvA) Analysis: Lead monthly departmental spend reviews and variance analyses across Sales, Marketing, and Operations, driving vendor rationalization and margin expansion.

**3. Cross-Border Tax, Regulatory & Audit Governance:**

- Global Indirect Tax Strategy: Oversee multi-jurisdictional indirect tax compliance.

- Cross-Border Tax & WHT: Manage intercompany transfer pricing mechanics between India operating/R&D entities and overseas subsidiaries, maximizing Withholding Tax (WHT) credits and Tax Residency Certificates (TRC).

- Statutory Audits & Controls: Prepare schedules and documentation for annual statutory audits, direct tax compliance, and internal financial controls supporting enterprise SOC 1 / SOC 2 Type II readiness.

**Candidate Profile & Qualifications:**

- Experience: 8 - 10 years of progressive leadership experience combining commercial finance, revenue operations, SaaS billing execution, and tax compliance.

- SaaS / Tech Context: Direct experience in B2B SaaS, MarTech/AdTech, or API-first platforms handling cross-border enterprise invoicing, electronic billing portals (such as The Trade Desk), Deal Desk support, and usage-based monetization.

- Systems Proficiency: Hands-on operational experience with modern SaaS finance technology stacks:

1. Billing & Revenue: Stripe Billing, Chargebee, Maxio, Zuora, or Zoho Billing

2. CRM / CPQ: Salesforce, FreshSales or HubSpot

3. ERP / Accounting: Zoho Books, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, or QuickBooks Online

4. Customer Billing & Procurement Platforms: Experience with customer-mandated electronic invoicing and procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, or equivalent enterprise vendor portals.

5. Global Tax: Avalara, Anrok, or TaxJar

- Financial & Analytical Rigor: Deep knowledge of ASC 606 / IFRS 15 principles, working capital dynamics, and cloud vendor billing formats. Advanced quantitative modeling skills (Excel / SQL) to reconcile high-volume usage metering logs against customer invoices.

- Education / Credentials: Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA, or MBA in Finance from a top-tier institution.

**Why Join Us?:**

- Direct Business Ownership: Lead a high-visibility function that directly impacts liquidity, enterprise valuation, and gross margins.

- Cross-Functional Influence: Work closely with executive leadership across Sales, Engineering, and Finance.

- Scalable Career Path: Clear growth trajectory toward Director-level leadership as the company expands globally.

title: Global Market Analyst and Trading Intern
description:
Job Title: Global Market Analyst Intern
  
Location: Remote
  
Organization: PipRaisers
  
Stipend: Up to ₹20,000 per month
  
Duration: 2 Months
  
Opportunities: Letter of Recommendation (LOR) & Pre-Placement Offer (PPO)
  
  
About PipRaisers
  
PipRaisers is a high-performance trading research firm focused on macro-driven markets, cross-asset analysis, and global trading strategies. With an edge in economic forecasting, sentiment research, and live market intelligence, we help traders and institutions align with major global moves across forex, commodities, and digital assets.
  
  
Role Overview
  
As a Global Market Analyst Intern at PipRaisers, you'll work closely with our strategy and research team to interpret macroeconomic signals, analyze intermarket dynamics, and identify tradeable global trends. From daily market updates to institutional-style research notes, you’ll develop the mindset and skills of a global strategist.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Track macroeconomic events, central bank moves, and geopolitical developments (FOMC, ECB, CPI, GDP, NFP)
  
2. Analyse inter-asset relationships—USD vs. Gold, Oil, Crypto, and Risk-on/Risk-off sentiment shifts
  
3. Contribute to daily/weekly market outlooks, strategy notes, and trading calendars
  
4. Perform sentiment tracking using heatmaps, positioning data, and risk metrics
  
5. Research major FX pairs, commodity contracts, and crypto pairs from a macro perspective
  
6. Assist in backtesting macro-based trade ideas using historical data
  
7. Build concise, data-rich presentation decks and visual summaries for team briefings and client insights
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
1. Students or graduates in Finance, Economics, International Business, or MBA (Finance)
  
2. Passion for global macroeconomics, central bank policy, and cross-asset trading
  
3. Strong grasp of economic data, market narratives, and trend interpretation
  
4. Experience with TradingView, economic calendars, Investing.com, or Bloomberg tools
  
5. Skill in transforming complex data into simplified actionable analysis
  
6. Knowledge of FX, commodities, and crypto instruments is highly preferred
  
  
What You’ll Gain
  
1. Real-world exposure to macroeconomic-driven global markets and research workflows
  
2. Learn to craft institutional-style research reports and market updates
  
3. Monthly stipend up to ₹20,000 based on your deliverables and performance
  
4. Letter of Recommendation and internship certification on successful completion
  
5. Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) opportunity for high-potential interns
  
6. 1-on-1 mentorship from macro strategists, traders, and portfolio analysts
  
  
  
Start Date: Immediate preferred

title: Asset & Wealth Management, Investment Grade Private Credit / Structured Corporate Credit – Analyst - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**GOLDMAN SACHS ALTERNATIVES**
Goldman Sachs Asset Management is one of the world’s leading asset managers with over $3.6 trillion in assets under supervision. As the primary investment area within Goldman Sachs, we provide investment and advisory services for pension plans, sovereign wealth funds, insurance companies, endowments, foundations, financial advisors, and individuals.
  
  
GSAM invests both the firm's own capital and capital raised from outside investors in corporate equity and debt, real estate equity and debt, asset-based equity and debt, growth equity and infrastructure assets world-wide. Our business operates on a global platform, and we are one of the largest managers of private capital globally.
  
  
GSAM Private Credit is one of the world’s largest alternative credit investing platforms with approximately $160bn of AUM and investment professionals based in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia. GSAM Private Credit is a dynamic platform with significant cross-pollination across strategies – Direct Lending (middle market and large cap performing credit), Hybrid Capital, Asset Finance, Structured Corporate Credit and IG Corporate & Infrastructure Credit
  
  
**INVESTMENT GRADE PRIVATE CREDIT / STRCUTURED CORPORATE CREDIT**
Goldman Sachs is seeking a Associate / Analyst to join our Investment Grade Corporate Private Credit team in the Bengaluru office.
  
  
IGPC / SCC invests across corporate, infrastructure debt & JV structures for global public and private companies with investment-grade profiles, with this role focused primarily on corporate credit opportunities.
  
  
We are seeking Associates / Analysts to specialize in asset management across our large, diverse and dynamic portfolio. Team members will play an integral role in ongoing portfolio company monitoring, which is a critical element of the investing process, as well as portfolio management. Team members will be aligned by Private Credit strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Produce and present periodic portfolio company monitoring, including but not limited to company performance, comparison of actual results to company projections and the GS Private Credit underwriting case, ESG metrics and key company developments, particularly those with implications for investment performance
* Maintain portfolio company models as part of the asset management process
* Track company ratings on a periodic basis
* Prepare and maintain portfolio analytics for portfolio management purposes
* Participate in strategic projects regarding portfolio management, portfolio monitoring and performance tracking.
* Prepare and maintain investment and fund level statistics used for internal tracking, investor reporting as well as marketing materials
* Liaise across internal business teams and external counterparties to service investment level requests

**Qualifications**

* Strong academic background with an MBA (Tier 1 or 2) or Chartered Accountant or equivalent
* Relevant 4-6 years of experience
* Accounting knowledge, valuation and financial modeling aptitude (required)
* Solid analytical / logical mindset and attention to detail
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong project planning, organization, and time management skills
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Experience in Investment Grade corporate business, ratings and knowledge of Infrastructure Business (bonus)

At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital, and ideas to help our clients, shareholders, and the communities we serve to grow. title: GBM - Loan Management & Due Diligence - CRE - Associate - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.
  
  
**Global Banking & Markets**
Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team with a passion for the markets, with individuals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.
  
  
**Business Unit Overview**
Loan Management primarily supports the Global Banking and Markets Segment within Goldman Sachs. Loan Management, amongst other things, is responsible for directing and facilitating due diligence (at both, the deal and asset levels) for the acquisitions, asset management and sales/securitizations of various types of loan portfolios in the US, EMEA and APAC.
  
  
The EMEA Mortgage desk makes markets in EMEA loan business (CRE/Resi/consumer) and Asset Backed securities, and increasingly places a large amount of focus on purchasing whole loan pools, originating/ financing new loan assets (CRE/Resi/consumer) or create new securities backed by loan assets which can be distributed to our clients. In this way the desk / structurers/ Loan management, in particular, are very much at the heart of a changing banking / capital-markets landscape, and designing ways in which Goldman can be a long-term participant in these new flows of capital.
  
  
Loan Management is currently seeking an Associate to support the EMEA mortgage desk in its asset management activities. The Associate will be primarily responsible for ongoing asset/loan management of EMEA commercial real estate loans, facilitating the acquisition, monitoring, reporting and disposition / securitization of loans purchased, financed and/or originated from different business platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Managing commercial real estate loans secured against a variety of property types: multifamily, hospitality, retail, industrial, office, self-storage, data centers, etc.
* Reviewing legal documentation, financial models, business plans, and covenants to assess the loan and asset level risk.
* Ongoing monitoring of the asset and loan performance, preparing asset summary reports and internal business plan presentations, valuation analysis, market analysis.
* Supporting on critical workstreams including modification, restructuring, extensions, waivers etc. throughout the loan life cycle.
* Managing client relationships and interacting with property managers, legal counsel, servicers, co-lenders, institutional borrowers, etc . to ensure smooth / high-quality execution/monitoring of CRE deals.
* Data management of the CRE trades, including data setup, database management, ETL and data validations.
* Tracking and confirmation of collateral adequacy for funding and margining (collateral covenants, eligibility, concentration limits), monitoring of key deliverables and financial covenants under the legal documents.
* Ensure the flow of data underneath all of the analytics is accurate and correct. Working with mortgage desk, technology, and cash operations to achieve the same.
* Manage and create data related quality control checks for internal databases and provide resolution through analytic research.
* Develop reporting solutions through multiple tools as needed. Ability to produce interactive graphs, pivot tables, etc. for reporting.
* Maintains systems for tracking projects and communicate results to different business groups

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5-6 years of experience in mortgages or commercial real estate portfolios / collateral analytics / asset management, Data Management/ Modeling and handling ETL processes.
* Strong academic background – in finance, business, math, or accounting degree with a minimum 3.5 GPA equivalent / candidates pursuing CFA.
* Strong communication skills (clear, concise, and confident) with the ability to manage internal and external relationships.
* Solid analytical/logical mindset and attention to detail
* Technical skills required include SQL, RDBMS Databases (SQL Server or Sybase ASE preferred), Data Reporting and Data Visualizations. Tableau experience is a plus.
* Strong project management skills that include Stakeholder Management skills, program management experience and ability to translate requirements to deliverables.
* Commercial focus and interest in financial and RE markets
* Mortgage banking or other financial industry experience preferred
* Able to work under tight time constraints and extended hours as required
* Ability to prioritize workload, manage expectations and is a team player.

title: Sr Analyst Accounting
description:
About us:
  
  
As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.
  
  
Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and you'll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.
  
  
**Overview About TII**
At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn’t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target’s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company’s global strategy and operations.
  
  
**Primary Function**
Responsible for maintaining the integrity of balance sheet accounts through timely reconciliations, financial analysis, and month-end close activities. The role is accountable for ensuring accurate financial reporting, identifying and resolving reconciliation differences, strengthening internal controls, and driving process improvements to enhance the overall control environment. The Senior Analyst serves as a subject matter expert (SME) and partners with Headquarters and cross-functional business teams to support accounting governance, process standardization, automation initiatives, and continuous improvement.
  
  
**Principal Duties And Responsibilities**
**Maintain Financial Integrity**

* Perform timely and accurate preparation, review, and certification of Balance Sheet reconciliations for the assigned accounts.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, including preparation and review of journal entries, accruals, reclasses, and supporting documentation.
* Investigate, analyze, and resolve reconciliation variances by partnering with upstream and downstream business partners to ensure timely resolution.
* Ensure compliance with US GAAP, Target accounting policies, and corporate financial reporting requirements.
* Prepare supporting schedules and account analyses for internal management reporting and external financial reporting requirements.

**Internal Controls & Risk Management**

* Analyze balance sheet accounts to identify financial risks, unusual trends, and control gaps while recommending corrective actions.
* Maintain a strong SOX-compliant control environment by executing key financial controls and documenting evidence in accordance with corporate policies.
* Identify process control deficiencies and partner with stakeholders to implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure reconciliation standards, certification timelines, and documentation requirements are consistently met.

**Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare reconciliation metrics, aging analysis, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for leadership reporting.
* Identify automation opportunities and process improvements to reduce manual effort, improve reconciliation quality, and enhance operational efficiency.
* Leverage system capabilities and analytical tools to improve reporting accuracy and reconciliation effectiveness.
* Standardize reconciliation templates, documentation, and best practices across the accounting team.
* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), process documentation, and knowledge repositories.
* Train, mentor, and support team members to strengthen technical accounting knowledge and reconciliation expertise.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for internal, external, and SOX audit requests related to assigned balance sheet accounts.
* Ensure timely preparation of audit schedules, reconciliation support, and documentation while addressing audit inquiries effectively.
* Support remediation of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions where required.

**Problem Solving & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the subject matter expert for assigned reconciliation processes and provide guidance to accounting team members.
* Lead discussions with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve complex accounting and reconciliation issues.
* Drive root cause analysis of recurring reconciliation differences and recommend long-term process improvements.
* Support leadership with financial insights, issue resolution, and decision-making through data-driven analysis.

**Projects & Transitions**

* Lead or participate in cross-functional projects involving process transitions, system implementations, reconciliation optimization, and accounting transformations.
* Support transition of new accounting activities into the team while ensuring strong governance, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives focused on strengthening financial controls, automation, and operational excellence.

**REPORTING / WORKING RELATIONSHIPS**
Reports to the Sr Manager. Maintains strong working relationships with Headquarters Finance, Financial Reporting, Technology and Internal Audit.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
**Minimum Requirements**

* B.Com with CA / ACCA / CPA / CMA / CIMA qualification.
* Minimum 8 years of accounting experience with at least 5 years of General Ledger and Balance Sheet Reconciliation experience.
* Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP (preferred) and financial reporting tools.

**Finrep AI is Looking for:******
**Senior Domain Expert - SEC Reporting**
**About The Job**
Finrep builds AI-powered tools for SEC reporting, technical accounting, and financial disclosure workflows. Our AI assistant, Fina, reads SEC filings, accounting codifications, comment letters, and proxies, and answers with citations. Public-company finance teams and professional services firms
  
  
use Finrep to produce regulatory filings, financial analyses, and compliance work faster and more accurately.
  
  
**About The Role**
Fina is only as good as the domain knowledge it''''s grounded in and the standard it''''s held to. As a Senior Domain Expert, you own both. You decide what a correct, practitioner-grade answer looks like, test Fina against that bar, find where it falls short, and build the capabilities that close the gap. This is a hands-on, generalist role. You''''ll work across accuracy review, evaluation design, capability building, and knowledge coverage rather than one narrow slice of a pipeline. You''''re expected to notice what needs fixing and go build it, not wait to be assigned it. You''''ll work daily with engineering, product, design, and go-to-market, and what you learn from Fina''''s real-world reasoning will shape what we build next.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Define what good output looks like. Write the standards, evaluation rubrics, and scoring criteria Fina is judged against. Work with engineering to turn them into automated graders and test sets, and help decide when a capability is ready to ship.
* Maintain and improve Finrep''''s accuracy. Review Fina''''s answers to real customer questions and verify them against the underlying filing or standard. Log what went wrong and why. Don''''t stop at what customers happen to ask: test Fina against harder scenarios before a customer runs into them.
* Build Fina''''s technical capabilities. Turn what review and evaluation reveal into new or improved AI skills and multi-step workflows. Areas include revenue recognition, leases, business combinations, non-GAAP measures, SEC disclosure drafting, and filing-readiness checks, across US GAAP, IFRS, and Ind AS. This is a long-term build, not a one-time project.
* Keep Fina''''s knowledge current. Decide which accounting standards, auditing standards, and filings Fina needs to know. Get them into its knowledge base and monitor them so nothing goes out of date, across US, UK, and Indian companies. Periodically audit existing skills and prompts against current standards.
* Own real projects end to end. Examples include mapping specific disclosure requirements into the product, or building tools that show customers how peer companies disclosed similar items. Document your work well enough that someone else could pick it up.
* Shape the product and support customers. Bring gaps you observe in Fina''''s reasoning to the roadmap. Act as the domain voice in customer conversations and give engineering, product, and go-to-market the domain input they need.

**Required Qualifications**

* Deep working knowledge of technical accounting or SEC reporting, enough to verify a claim against the primary standard or filing yourself rather than accept a plausible-sounding answer
* Handson experience in technical accounting, audit, SEC reporting, or financial advisory
* Working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC filings (10K, 10Q, 8K, proxy, S1)
* Ability to turn complex accounting and regulatory concepts into clear, structured logic a product can implement
* Regular, handson use of generative AI tools, and a strong interest in how to instruct and evaluate them
* A track record of owning work end to end, and comfort defining your own scope in a fast-moving startup
* Strong written communication: you can produce rubrics, specs, and technical writeups that others can act on
* Experience working with engineering, product, or customerfacing teams
* Based in Bengaluru, fulltime

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IFRS or Ind AS knowledge alongside US GAAP
* CA, CPA, or equivalent professional accounting certification
* Big 4 or professionalservices audit, technical accounting, or SEC reporting background
* Familiarity with EDGAR, XBRL, and the SEC commentletter process
* Experience reviewing, grading, or building evaluations for AI output

* Background in financial data analysis, peer benchmarking, or equity research

title: SENIOR ANALYST, FINANCE
description:
Position Summary
  
  
The Senior Analyst, FP&A will support Walmart US FP&A CoE through high-quality planning, forecasting, reporting and business analysis. The role partners closely with U.S.-based finance stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver accurate and timely financial outputs, translate data into actionable insights, and continuously improve FP&A processes. The position requires strong analytical capability, ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to operate effectively in a global, matrixed environment.
  
  
**About The Team**

* This role is part of the Walmart US FP&A Center of Excellence (CoE), based out of Walmart’s Bangalore office. The team partners with Walmart US Finance to support core FP&A activities, decision support, reporting, analytics and continuous improvement across finance processes.
* This is an individual contributor role for a finance professional with strong FP&A fundamentals and analytical skills. The Senior Analyst will own defined deliverables end-to-end, work directly with U.S. finance partners, and contribute to improving and transforming existing processes through standardization, automation and better use of data and technology.

What you'll do
  
  
Role: Senior Analyst, FP&A
  
  
Experience range: 3-6 years
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  

* Support core FP&A cycles including Annual Operating Plan (AOP), Long Range Plan (LRP), forecasts, month-end close and performance reporting, ensuring deliverables are accurate and completed on time.
* Partner with Walmart US Finance stakeholders to understand business performance, financial drivers, risks and opportunities, and provide analytical support for business decisions.
* Perform variance analysis across actuals, forecast and plan; identify key drivers and develop clear, decision-ready commentary and insights.
* Build and maintain financial models, driver-based forecasts, reporting packages and dashboards to support planning and performance management.
* Conduct deep-dive analysis across relevant P&L areas such as sales, gross profit, operating expenses, headcount, inventory and other business drivers, depending on the supported finance area.
* Prepare recurring management reporting and ad-hoc analyses for finance leadership, with a strong focus on accuracy, timeliness and clear storytelling.
* Own assigned processes and deliverables end-to-end, proactively resolving data, process and reporting issues in partnership with stakeholders and supporting teams.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate FP&A activities, improving process efficiency and shifting capacity toward higher-value analysis.
* Partner with Reporting & Analytics, Data, Technology and other cross-functional teams on reporting enhancements, data requirements and finance transformation initiatives.
* Maintain process documentation, controls and standard operating procedures, and contribute to a strong governance and continuous-improvement culture within the FP&A CoE.
* Leverage finance tools and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities where appropriate, to improve analysis, reporting and decision support.

What You’ll Bring
  
  

* BCom, Pursuing CA / CPA / CMA / ACCA or MBA (Finance) or equivalent finance qualification.
* 3-6 years of relevant experience in FP&A, financial planning, management reporting, business finance or a related finance role.
* Understanding of core FP&A processes including planning, forecasting, month-end reporting, variance analysis and financial modelling.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with large datasets, identify key business drivers and translate analysis into meaningful insights.
* Microsoft Excel and financial modelling skills; experience creating clear management reporting and executive-ready outputs.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities and consistently deliver accurate work within tight timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders across geographies and functions.
* Comfort working in a global, matrixed environment and partnering with U.S.-based stakeholders across time zones.
* Experience in retail, eCommerce, consumer businesses or a large multinational organization is preferred.

**Additional Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise planning and finance systems such as OneStream, SAP, HFM or similar tools preferred.
* Working knowledge of visualization/reporting tools is preferred.
* Knowledge of AI-enabled finance solutions will be an added advantage.
* Understanding of data models, reporting structures and finance process transformation is desirable.
* Demonstrated curiosity, learning agility and a continuous-improvement mindset.

**About Walmart Global Tech**

description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will join our Planning & Forecasting team in India to support financial and demand forecasting. You will prepare and maintain forecasts, produce clear management reports, and work closely with finance, commercial and supply partners. You will learn quickly, influence decisions, and help improve forecasting using practical problem solving and new technology. We value curiosity, clear communication and collaboration. title: Mergers and Acquisitions Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**

**ROLE SUMMARY**

A senior analyst role in a lean, in-house M&A team that evaluates a large number of ideas and executes only a few — well. You will work across the full life of a transaction: sourcing, screening, business and financial evaluation, due diligence, structuring, Board approval, closing and the early years after the deal.
*This is not an advisory role and not a modelling-only role*
. The work is deeper than a DCF: understanding how a business actually makes money, whether it should belong to us, what could go wrong after we own it, and whether the price and terms protect us if it does. Most ideas you examine should end in a clear, well-reasoned “no”. Only a few will proceed that will be taken to the Board — and you will be expected to stand behind your analysis.

**WHAT MAKES THIS ROLE DIFFERENT**

Corporate M&A offers fewer deals than a bank, a fund or a Big 4 transaction team — and far greater ownership of each one. You will see a transaction through beyond signing, live with its consequences, and learn how integration, people and culture decide whether a deal creates value. We are looking for the rigour and pace of a Big 4 / investment banking / private equity background, combined with the patience, judgment and long-term commitment that a corporate requires.
If deal count, short tenures or the next exit are your primary drivers, this role will not suit you.

**Work Experience**

**EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION**

· 6–9 years post-qualification experience in M&A / transaction advisory / corporate development — Big 4 Deals / Transaction Services, investment banking, private equity, or a corporate M&A team. Pure audit, Taxation, Research-only or Back-office experience will not be sufficient.

· Chartered Accountant, or MBA (Finance / Strategy) from a premier institute; CFA an advantage.

· Direct, hands-on involvement in at least 2–3 transactions taken through evaluation / diligence to a decision — signing, closing, or a reasoned walk-away.

· Experience on the buy side, or advising buyers, is strongly preferred.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

·
**Sourcing & pipeline:**
Build and maintain relationships with investment bankers, advisors and intermediaries; independently set up and facilitate first meetings, source opportunities aligned to our strategy, and maintain a disciplined, current deal pipeline and tracker.

·
**Evaluate the deal in its entirety:**
Go beyond the information memorandum. Understand the business model, industry, customers, competitors, management quality and unit economics; assess strategic fit, pros and cons, synergies, and risks — financial, commercial, operational, legal, tax and reputational. Form an independent view on whether we should pursue, at what price, and on what terms — and what the business will look like 3–5 years after acquisition.

·
**Due diligence & execution:**
Scope, coordinate and critically review financial, tax, legal, commercial and operational diligence with internal teams and external advisors. Identify dealbreakers and value leaks, test the quality of earnings and cash flows, and translate findings into valuation, structuring and contractual protection. Key attributes are looking beyond a diligence report.

·
**Valuation & modelling:**
Build and own robust, auditable models — operating forecasts, DCF, comparable companies / transactions, accretion–dilution and scenario / sensitivity analysis — triangulated against business reality and not run mechanically. Challenge assumptions, including your own.

·
**Investment memoranda & Board communication:**
Prepare concise, Board-ready investment memoranda and presentations that state the rationale, the case against the deal, the risks and mitigants, valuation and recommendation with clarity. Present and defend the analysis before senior leadership when required.

·
**Closing, integration & post-deal review:**
Support term sheets, transaction documents and closing; work with Legal, Tax, Treasury, Secretarial and business teams; support integration planning and post-deal performance tracking against the original investment thesis.

**SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE**

· Advanced Excel (financial modelling, scenarios, sensitivities) and PowerPoint (structured, executive-ready storytelling). Familiarity with Capital IQ / Tracxn / VCCEdge or similar databases is an advantage.

· Strong grounding in accounting, quality of earnings, cash-flow and working-capital analysis; working knowledge of deal structuring, valuation methods, and key clauses in term sheets, SPAs and SHAs.

· Excellent written and verbal communication — the ability to make a complex deal simple without making it
*simplistic*
.

**THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

·
**Integrity first:**
Uncompromising integrity, ethics and confidentiality. No exceptions, no shades of grey on this.

·
**Independent judgment:**
The practical wisdom to discern right from wrong — in numbers, in people and in situations — and the courage to say “no”, respectfully and with reasons, however attractive a deal looks or whoever is sponsoring it.

·
**Composure:**
Emotionally steady and evidence-led; not swayed by deal excitement, seller narratives or momentum. Calm and dependable under pressure during the intense phases of a live deal — intensity here is episodic, not constant.

·
**Attention to detail:**
Zero-defect mindset on numbers, documents and follow-through; if it goes to the Board with your name on it, it must be right.

·
**Curiosity & foresight:**
Genuinely curious about businesses, eager to keep learning, and able to think ahead to second- and third-order consequences of a decision.

·
**Values & commitment:**
Values-driven, wants to contribute meaningfully to the organisation’s and their own long-term growth, and is looking to build a career with one team — not to collect logos.

**SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE**

In 12–18 months: a trusted pipeline and banker network you run independently; screening notes and memoranda that senior leaders rely on without re-checking; at least one transaction evaluated end-to-end with you as the analytical owner; and a reputation — inside and outside the team — for sound judgment, discretion and work that is right the first time.

title: Controller, Regional IT Finance & Controlling
description:
