****What We Offer:****
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
  
  
****Group Summary:****
Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial-minded team. With 65+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities:****
The Controller, Regional IT Finance & Controlling - India is responsible for financial reporting, controlling, budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial governance for Magna's India IT operations. The role reports to the Manager, Finance & Controlling and works closely with local stakeholders and the Global IT Finance team to maintain a strong local financial control and governance environment, support accurate and timely reporting, and contribute to a range of regional and global finance activities and priorities. The position will also support the finance activities required for the SAP S/4HANA Cloud implementation in India.
  
  
****Your Responsibilities****

* Lead monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial reporting for the India IT organization, ensuring complete, accurate, and timely submissions.
* Prepare management reporting, forecasts, variance analysis, accruals, balance-sheet reviews, and financial commentary, clearly identifying key drivers, risks, and required actions.
* Establish, document, monitor, and continuously improve local financial controls, policies, and procedures, including appropriate review, approval, reconciliation, and supporting-evidence requirements.
* Maintain effective financial governance for the India IT office and ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, Magna finance policies, internal-control requirements, and local obligations in coordination with relevant specialists.
* Support annual budgeting, business planning, forecasting, and IT service pricing activities including data collection, modelling, validation, documentation, and stakeholder follow-up.
* Monitor operating expenses, headcount-related costs, project spending, capital expenditures, and other key cost drivers; identify financial risks, control gaps, trends, and opportunities to improve financial performance and cost management.
* Partner with India business leaders, local finance teams, and the Global IT Finance team to support decision-making and contribute to regional and global reporting, analysis, projects, and continuous-improvement activities.
* Coordinate accounting, audit, tax, treasury, payroll, procurement, and compliance-related activities affecting the India IT office, maintaining clear ownership and timely resolution of issues.
* Prepare ad-hoc financial analysis, business cases, and management presentations, and perform other finance and controlling responsibilities as required.

**SAP S/4HANA Cloud Support**

* Support regional finance activities associated with the SAP S/4HANA Cloud implementation in India.
* Assist with finance process documentation, data validation, testing, reporting requirements, user acceptance, and implementation readiness.
* Work with project teams and business stakeholders to ensure that local financial-control, governance, and reporting requirements are appropriately reflected in the solution.

****Who We Are Looking For****

* A recognized professional accounting designation such as CA, CPA, CMA, ACCA, or equivalent is required, together with a bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.
* 7 or more years of progressive experience in accounting, financial reporting, controlling, or FP&A, preferably within a multinational environment.
* Strong hands-on experience with month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, balance-sheet review, and internal controls.
* Strong understanding of financial governance and control design, including the ability to document processes, identify control gaps, and implement practical improvements.
* Experience with SAP finance and controlling processes is required; exposure to an SAP S/4HANA implementation, migration, testing, or stabilization is an asset.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and strong proficiency with PowerPoint; experience with Power BI, data warehouses, or similar reporting tools is an asset.
* Experience working effectively with global, virtual, and cross-functional teams across time zones.

****What We Offer****
At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.

At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire based on experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity. title: Principal - Tech Finance Analyst
description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Supports the financial management of the Network & Connectivity domain, working for the Tech Finance Manager and applying the standards set by central Technology Business Operations. The role prepares cost analysis and reporting, supports the budget and forecast, processes purchase orders and reconciles invoices and spend, and helps prepare business cases. It provides accurate, timely financial data and analysis that leadership and the Tech Finance Manager rely on to manage the network cost base.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost Analysis and Reporting**

* Prepare network cost analysis and reporting, including carrier, circuit, bandwidth, hardware, software and managed service spend.
* Produce variance analysis against budget and forecast, explaining movements and flagging risks and trends.
* Maintain accurate, current financial data so reporting is repeatable and does not depend on individual effort.
* undefined

**Budget and Forecast Support**

* Support the budget and forecast cycle, gathering inputs, updating models and tracking actuals to the enterprise finance timetable.
* Help maintain connectivity unit cost and consumption views at the level the Tech Finance Manager and leadership need.
* Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end close activities.

**Financial Operations**

* Create and track purchase orders and manage the purchase-order lifecycle for the domain.
* Reconcile invoices and spend against purchase orders and contracts, resolving queries with suppliers and Procurement.
* Process accruals, reclasses and cross charges under the Tech Finance Manager's direction.

**Business Case and Investment Support**

* Prepare business cases and investment analysis, providing the cost and benefit inputs for review.
* Support investment tracking and benefits reporting for network and connectivity initiatives.

**Governance and Data Quality**

* Apply central Technology Business Operations standards, definitions and controls so data is consistent and comparable.
* Maintain financial data quality and reporting accuracy, support audit and control evidence.
* Escalate data gaps, discrepancies and emerging risks to the Tech Finance Manager.

**Professional Qualifications**

* BS or MS degree in Finance, Business, Accounting, Technology Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Professionally qualified accountant (or qualified by experience) with a recognised accounting or cost-management credential e.g., CA/CMA (desirable)

**Area of Specialisation**

* Financial, commercial or business analysis, covering cost analysis, reporting and variance analysis.
* Budget and forecast support, purchase-order processing and supplier spend reconciliation.
* Business-case preparation and investment analysis.

**Experience Required**

* Overall10 years and 6-8 years in finance supporting a technology platform, domain or infrastructure function
* Relevant experience in financial, commercial or business analysis.
* Capability in business case preparation, forecasting, variance analysis, purchase order processing and supplier spend reconciliation.
* Evidence of producing accurate analysis that supported network cost control or investment decisions.
* Experience working to a fixed finance timetable and applying standards set by a central function.

**Related Skills/Background**

* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, since reporting and decisions rest on the accuracy of the data.
* Capable with financial systems and analysis tools, including ERP, procurement and reporting platforms.
* Clear communicator, able to explain financial data to non-finance colleagues.
* Well organised, able to deliver recurring cycles reliably to a fixed timetable.
* Proactive in resolving queries and improving recurring processes.

#AGTech
  
  
**Skills**
Budget Forecasting, Business Forecasting, Business Reporting Tools, Contract Renewals, Cost Analysis, Data Storytelling, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Modeling, Financial Performance Improvement, Influencing Without Authority, Insight Generation, Problem Solving, Process Improvement, Technology Finance
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. title: Senior Analyst - Forecasting
description:
GCL : D1
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to turn complex data into clear, confident decisions that shape the future of life-changing medicines? In this role, you will develop patient, volume, and revenue forecasts for strategic brands and early assets across Global priority markets and the US—work that directly informs brand strategy, investment decisions, and how we reach patients faster!
  
  
Based at Manyata Tech Park, Bangalore on a hybrid schedule (three days a week in office) with a 2 PM - 11 PM IST shift, you will partner closely with forecasting leadership and Commercial teams. You will build and own models that set performance expectations, provide clarity on risk and opportunity, and guide cross-functional teams toward decisive action. Do you thrive in a dynamic environment where your analysis sparks strategy and your point of view earns trust?
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Develop and own forecast models. Build, validate, and maintain strong short-term and long-term models. These models reflect current data, assumptions, and market dynamics for key brands and initial assets.
* Decision Support: Translate insights into clear recommendations, expertly defend methodologies and assumptions, and influence cross-functional collaborators with clear logic and quantified confidence.
* Cross-Functional Alignment: Align forecast assumptions and analytical outputs with partners in Marketing, Sales, Market Access and Pricing, Finance, Analytics, and Sales Operations to ensure a single, trusted view of demand.
* New Product Introduction: Develop volume forecasts for launches to feed strategic and operational planning, informing resourcing, supply, and market activation.
* Data and Methodology Difficulty: Identify and apply the right data sources and industry-leading approaches; integrate primary research and secondary data to ensure objectivity and comprehensive coverage.
* Sensitivity and Scenario Analysis: Conduct simulations and ranges (including Monte Carlo as appropriate) to clarify uncertainty, quantify upside/downside, and support risk management.
* Global Pipeline and Early Assets: Create new forecast frameworks as business needs emerge for pipeline assets, lifecycle management, and business development opportunities.
* US Planning Cadence: For US-focused work, participate in S&OP processes, submit volumes, and build weekly, monthly, and annual models and conversions aligned to commercial rhythms.
* Continuous Improvement: Evolve forecasting capabilities through innovation in methodologies, automation, and tools; champion standard processes that improve speed, reliability, and decision quality.
* Documentation and Communication: Deliver forecasts with clear, accessible documentation of assumptions, confidence levels, and key drivers; proactively surface issues that matter to the business.

**Essential Skills/Experience**

* Bachelor’s Degree in relevant field
* 6+ years of direct Pharmaceutical forecasting experience with an in-depth knowledge of forecasting techniques, models and approaches
* Good understanding of multiple disease areas, with experience in rare diseases/ OBU including how patients move through their respective diagnosis and treatment pathways, including treatment dynamics
* Experience integrating insights from market research and secondary data analysis into forecast assumptions
* Experience using a range of data sources and analytics involving standard data in the Pharmaceutical industry – e.g. IQVIA (MIDAS, DDD NPA, Monthly Xponent), claims data (Truven, Marketscan), epidemiological data, etc. For US forecasting, experience with TRx / NBRx / NRx data and methodologies
* Strong analytical expertise; excellent Excel, financial modelling and forecasting skills
* Ability to build trusted relationships across a range of partner groups including Marketing, Analytics, Operations, and Technology
* Confirmed experience in problem solving and continuous improvement
* Strong written and verbal communication

**Desirable Skills/Experience**

* Advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred (e.g., PhD, MBA, Masters)
* Knowledge and experience in sophisticated statistical forecast methodologies and applied AI / ML / automation
* Experience working with Power Apps, specifically PowerBI
* For US forecasting, confirmed understanding of US Market Access and gross-to-net

**Why AstraZeneca**
Join a high-performing, digitally savvy community where bold thinking is encouraged and supported. Here,unexpected teams come together to ignite bold ideas, using advanced technology and data to accelerate decisions impacting patients. You will have the freedom to think differently, take balanced risks, and see your work drive tangible change across the enterprise. We value persistence alongside ambition, and you will grow your craft by learning from bright minds who challenge and support one another every day.
  
  
**Call To Action**
Bring your forecasting expertise to where it makes a difference—apply today to build models that guide bold decisions and improve patient outcomes!

title: Senior Analyst-Risk Management
description: Job DescriptionOverview of The DepartmentCommercial Rating and Underwriting (CRU) sits within the Credit and Fraud Risk (CFR) division and forms the institutional credit risk management function within American Express. The CRU team plays the critical role of assessing and managing the risk of institutional exposures across all business units within American Express, and in all regions globally. Credit exposures are primarily generated through corporate and small business card programs, via merchant service relationships where non-delivery risk exists, and among the securities portfolio held for firm-wide liquidity. CRU is led from Salt Lake City with regional teams in New York, London, Singapore , Sydney and India.In addition to determining the internal credit rating which drives the probability of default of each exposure, CRU also calculates the loss given default of these obligors while underwriting card programs. As a bank holding company, American Express must comply with the highest global banking standards set by Basel and implemented by the bank’s primarily regulatory, the Federal Reserve.ResponsibilitiesJob ResponsibilitiesAnalyst will be based out of India, and responsible for rating and underwriting credit exposures predominantly for English speaking market,. Fundamental analysis incorporates a thorough review of business, financial, industry and country risk coupled with support from internal and external rating model outputs. Assessment includes understanding of the need for credit extension, profitability of the relationship and program structures.Analysts will have opportunity to interact with various teams across the firm including front office sales, business unit risk partners, and credit administration to perform their critical role.Desired Skills Experience as a credit analyst or underwriter dealing with commercial exposures ranging from small business or middle-market to large, multinational institutions Thorough understanding of fundamental financial analysis including the ability to review corporate financial statements to determine the ability of the obligor to honor its credit obligations Comfort with GAAP/IFRS accounting standards, corporate valuation, and forecasting Familiarity with quantitative credit models (such as Moody’s RiskCalc, CreditEdge, etc) and knowledge of how to interpret the outputs, and when deviation from the model has appropriate defense Comfort with public agency ratings and supporting analysis Understanding of current macroeconomic trends and how to provide recommendations to improve the PD estimation based on the business cycle Experience preparing company-specific and industry-wide credit memorandums Familiarity with global markets (foreign language ability a plus) Qualifications QUALIFICATIONS 3-4 years experience rating and / or underwriting at a leading financial institution or rating agency Bachelor’s degree from a top tier university with high GPA and a degree (or substantial coursework) in finance, accounting, economics, or statistics Chartered Financial Analyst program candidacy a plus About UsAt American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. title: Senior Financial Analyst_OPEX
description:
**Work Location: Bengaluru**

**Short Description:**

Oracle’s Finance organization supports financial planning, performance management, and business decision-making through financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting. The CGOT team delivers centralized finance support to CSS through OPEX planning, forecasting, reporting, and business partnering.

The Specialist Financial Analyst (IC3) is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for end-to-end ownership of Operating Expense forecasting and management for assigned Lines of Business (LOBs) and regions.

**Job Title: Specialist Financial Analyst – Central Global Opex management Team (IC3)**

**Role Summary**

The Specialist Financial Analyst (IC3) is a high-impact individual contributor responsible for end-to-end ownership of Operating Expense forecasting and management for assigned Lines of Business (LOBs) and regions.

This role drives forecasting accuracy, leveraging automation and strategic insights through advanced use of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) systems, analytics and AI-driven tools. The individual acts as a trusted finance partner to business stakeholders and plays a key role in improving forecasting accuracy and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Forecasting & Financial Ownership**

Own OPEX forecasting process for assigned LOBs/regions.

Develop accurate run-rate models and driver-based forecasts.

Lead annual budget cycles.

Analyze variances vs Forecast and Prior Year

Provide actionable insights to business leaders.

**2. Business Partnering**

Partner with business leaders to understand cost drivers and strategic initiatives.

Challenge assumptions constructively and provide financial guidance

Translate financial data into business language for decision-making.

**3. Automation & Process Excellence**

Leverage automation tools to streamline forecasting processes.

Drive standardization across LOBs/regions.

Identify efficiency opportunities and eliminate manual work.

Support continuous improvement initiatives across the OPEX function.

**4. Analytics & AI Enablement**

Utilize advanced analytics to detect trends, anomalies, and risk areas.

Leverage AI-powered forecasting tools to improve accuracy.

Support predictive modeling and scenario planning.

**Required Technical Skills**

1. **Financial & Analytical Skills**

Strong understanding of FP&A principles and OPEX management

Advanced variance analysis and driver-based forecasting

Scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis

Strong Excel skills (advanced formulas, pivot tables, modeling)

1. **Systems Expertise**

Hands-on experience with Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) tools

Oracle EPM / Hyperion / Planning

Experience with Business Intelligence & Analytics tools - Power BI / Tableau / similar

Familiarity with AI-driven forecasting or predictive analytics tools

**Behavioral & Personality Traits**

We are looking for someone who demonstrates:

1. **Ownership Mindset**
2. **Analytical Curiosity**
3. **Structured & Detail-Oriented**
4. **Influencing & Communication Skills**
5. **Continuous Improvement Orientation**
6. **Collaborative & Supportive**

Takes full accountability for numbers

Proactively identifies risks and proposes solutions

Naturally questions trends and anomalies

Goes beyond reporting to uncover insights

High accuracy in financial analysis

Strong discipline in data validation

Confident in engaging with senior stakeholders

Ability to simplify complex financial topics

Passionate about automation and efficiency

Embraces technology and AI adoption

Works effectively in cross-functional teams

Shares knowledge and best practices

**Experience & Qualifications**

1. 6–9 years of experience in FP&A or OPEX management
2. Experience in a multinational / matrixed organization preferred
3. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
4. MBA / CA / CPA (preferred but not mandatory)

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

1. High forecast accuracy and reduced variance volatility
2. Increased automation and reduced manual effort
3. Strong stakeholder confidence and trust
4. Improved transparency through dashboards and analytics
5. Active contribution to AI-enabled forecasting maturity #LI-DNI

**Responsibilities**

As a member of Oracle's finance organization, you will be responsible for providing all aspects of financial support for planning and control. Assist in consolidation and reporting of financial results; preparation of annual budget. Gather, model, analyze, prepare, and summarize information for financial plans, operating forecasts, trended future specifications, etc.; on a weekly, monthly, or quarterly basis. Prepares recommendations based on analyzes. May perform revenue and expense analysis, headcount and headcount driven expense analysis at cost center level, tracking of product and product line revenue, reconciliation of accounts receivable, variance analysis and ad-hoc analysis as needed. You may participate in cross functional programs and projects.

title: Senior Financial Analyst (FP&A) – Global Revenue Finance
description:
**Job Description**
Oracle is seeking a Finance professional to partner with the Global Revenue Finance organization by delivering accurate revenue forecasting, financial analysis, and strategic insights. This role collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders including Revenue Recognition, Field Finance, Business Operations, Product teams, and Corporate Finance to improve forecasting accuracy, drive operational excellence, and support strategic planning across Oracle's cloud business. Leverages advanced analytics, AI-enabled productivity tools, and automation to improve financial planning, reporting efficiency, and business decision support.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue forecasting cycles for assigned global cloud business segments.
* Analyze Cloud revenue performance, consumption trends, bookings, renewals, cancellations, and revenue recognition impacts to provide actionable business insights.
* Develop financial models, scenario analyses, and executive-ready presentations supporting strategic planning and leadership decision-making.
* Partner with Revenue Recognition, Corporate Accounting, Field Finance, Product Revenue, Business Operations, and Corporate Finance teams to improve forecast accuracy and understand key business drivers.
* Monitor and analyze Cloud KPIs including ARR, Consumption, Renewals, Mid-Term Conversions, Ramp Deals, Phased Deployments, backlog, and related operational metrics.
* Support budgeting, Long Range Planning (LRP), quarterly forecasts, month-end close, and financial planning activities.
* Perform journal entry reviews, debit and credit impact analysis, account reconciliations, and ensure proper accounting treatment in accordance with revenue recognition and corporate accounting policies.
* Analyze General Ledger (GL) transactions, investigate accounting variances, and ensure financial data integrity across revenue-related processes.
* Identify forecast variances, business risks, and growth opportunities while recommending mitigation plans and business actions.
* Drive continuous improvement through automation, AI-assisted financial analysis, process standardization, advanced analytics, and compliance with Oracle financial policies and revenue recognition standards.
* Utilize AI-powered tools (such as Oracle AI capabilities, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar GenAI solutions) to improve financial reporting, automate repetitive analyses, generate executive summaries, enhance forecasting insights, and increase operational efficiency while maintaining data governance.

**Qualifications & Skills:**
Mandatory:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.
* Experience in Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Revenue Finance, Corporate Finance, Business Finance, or Accounting.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles including journal entries, debits and credits, General Ledger, reconciliations, and financial controls.
* Strong financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis skills.
* Experience analyzing Cloud business metrics and revenue trends.
* Advanced Excel and financial analysis capabilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
* Knowledge of revenue recognition principles (ASC 606/IFRS 15 preferred) and financial controls.

**Good-to-Have:**

* Experience in SaaS or Cloud business finance.
* Experience supporting global organizations.
* Knowledge of Oracle ERP, Hyperion, Essbase, Smart View, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting tools.
* Experience using AI/GenAI tools (ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Oracle AI, Gemini, etc.) to improve financial analysis, reporting, documentation, forecasting, or productivity.
* Automation, SQL, Python, Power Query, Power Automate, VBA, or advanced analytics experience.
* MBA, CPA, CMA, CA, or related professional certification.

**Preferred Competencies:**

* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* Revenue Forecasting
* Financial Modeling
* Budgeting & Planning
* Variance Analysis
* Revenue Recognition
* Debit & Credit Accounting
* General Ledger (GL)
* Journal Entries
* Account Reconciliation
* Cloud Revenue Analytics
* ARR & Consumption Analytics
* Executive Reporting
* AI for Finance
* Predictive Analytics
* Excel (Advanced)
* Power BI/Tableau
* SQL/Python
* Oracle ERP
* Hyperion
* Essbase
* Smart View

**Self-Assessment Questions:**

* Do I have hands-on experience leading revenue forecasting or FP&A processes?
* Have I built financial models that influenced executive business decisions?
* Do I have experience with accounting fundamentals including journal entries, debit/credit analysis, General Ledger, and reconciliations?
* Am I comfortable analyzing Cloud business metrics such as ARR, renewals, or consumption trends?
* Have I partnered with Finance, Accounting, and Business stakeholders to improve forecast accuracy?
* Have I used AI or GenAI tools to improve financial analysis, reporting, forecasting, or operational efficiency?
* Can I effectively communicate financial insights to senior leadership?

**Qualifications**
Career Level - IC3
  
  
**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. title: Manager-FDI-FINANCE TECH
description:

**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**

You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.
* Skills and Attributes for Success
* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

**WHO WE ARE:**

**Jane Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based aerospace and drone supply chain company. We source aircraft parts, drone components and industrial materials for operators, MROs and manufacturers, and we are building Supply Chain as a Service, a subscription model that takes over procurement for our clients.**

**We operate three legal entities in three jurisdictions — Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd (India), Jane Tech Labs Ltd (Hong Kong) and Jane Aero Tech Supply Chain FZCO (UAE) — in three currencies, with imports and exports.**

**We are bootstrapped. No outside funding, and none being sought. Cash Flow is the constraint that governs everything we do, which is why this role matters more here than the same title would elsewhere.**

**THE ROLE:**

**Today nobody owns the group’s books. The work is absorbed by the Managing Director and by external accountants engaged entity by entity. You would be the first finance hire, and you would own all three sets of books end to end.**

**Three things make this different from most accountant roles at this level:**

**YOU SEE ALL OF IT.**
Three entities, three currencies, imports and customs, two overseas jurisdictions. Most accountants at two to five years see a slice of one company.

**YOU TELL THE FOUNDER WHETHER THE COMPANY IS STABLE.**
Not once a quarter — every week. The cash runway number you produce on a Monday is one of the most important numbers in the business.

**YOU OWN THE COMPLIANCE CALENDAR ACROSS THREE COUNTRIES.**
You will not file overseas returns yourself, but nothing gets missed unless you miss it.

**One thing we want to be honest about-**

**Around one day a week of this role is administration — office upkeep, and support to the Managing Director including travel and calendar. It is genuinely part of the job and we would rather say so now than surprise you in month two.**

**The split is 80% finance, 20% admin, and it is written down for a reason: when the two collide, finance wins. A month-end close has a date; admin always feels more urgent than it is. If you are the kind of person who lets the visible task push out the important one, this role will go badly for you.**

**WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO:**

**The books — the core of the role -**

* **Maintain all three entities’ books in Zoho Books: recorded daily, closed monthly, reconciled to bank and to source documents.**
* **Accounts payable and receivable across the group, including vendor and customer ledgers.**
* **Bank, cash, card and foreign exchange reconciliation, including exchange differences on foreign-currency transactions.**
* **Import documentation and landed cost — customs duty, freight and clearing charges correctly allocated.**
* **Document and evidence control, so any transaction can be traced to its paperwork without a search.**

**Telling us where we stand -**

* **WEEKLY: cash position and a rolling 13-week cash forecast. Receivables and payables ageing. The runway number.**
* **MONTHLY: close pack per entity — trial balance, P&L, balance sheet, cash position — plus a consolidated group view and working-capital metrics.**
* **QUARTERLY: profitability by entity and by business line, trend commentary, and anything you think the Managing Director is not seeing.**
* **That last item is not decoration. You will see things in the numbers before anyone else does, and we expect you to say so.**

**Compliance — you own the calendar, the CA files -**

* **Prepare GST and TDS working papers, computations and returns for India; VAT working papers for the UAE; schedules for the Hong Kong audit.**
* **Review everything before it goes to the CA team, and follow up until it is filed. You are the person who knows what is due and when.**
* **Work with the retained firms in each jurisdiction through audit and assessment, and give them what they ask for first time.**

**Administration — about one day a week -**

* **Small bills and office running costs — utilities, supplies, service vendors. You prepare and process them; the Managing Director approves and releases, exactly as with every other payment.**
* **Travel: flight and hotel bookings, itineraries, and the expense claims that follow.**
* **Bank errands — deposits, documentation, KYC paperwork, and anything that needs someone physically at the branch.**
* **General office upkeep, supplies and visitors.**

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT:**

* **You do not approve or release payments. You prepare; the Managing Director approves and releases. This protects you as much as it protects us.**
* **You do not file overseas returns. Hong Kong audits are legally reserved to a practising CPA there, and the UAE requires a registered tax agent. We retain firms for both.**
* **You are not a CFO, and we will not pretend otherwise. Financial strategy sits with the Managing Director. What we need from you is accurate books and an honest forward view of cash.**
* **You do not buy anything significant. Equipment, inventory and supplier purchases sit with the procurement team. Your admin work is small bills, travel and bank errands — nothing that involves choosing a supplier or committing material money. That separation is deliberate: the person keeping the books should not also be the person deciding who gets paid.**

**WHAT YOU GET PAID:**

**Rs 40,000 to Rs 65,000 per month CTC (Rs 4.8–7.8 lakh per annum), depending on experience and on what you can demonstrate in the assessment. CTC means cost to company; your in-hand figure will be lower after statutory deductions, and we will show you the exact breakdown at offer stage.**

* **Compensation reviewed formally at six months and at twelve months, against evidence.**
* **Support for CA or CMA (Inter) study for the right person, on terms we agree openly.**
* **PF/ESI as per statute.**

**The real compensation here is the exposure. Three jurisdictions, full ownership of the books, and direct access to the founder every week. At two to five years, very few finance roles offer that.**

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* **2 to 5 years in accounting, with real ownership of a set of books — not one slice of a large finance team.**
* **You have closed a month end yourself: done the reconciliation, found the difference, and fixed it.**
* **Working knowledge of Indian GST and TDS, including preparing returns.**
* **Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets to a working standard — you will build the cash forecast yourself.**
* **Zoho Books or a comparable system. If you have not used Zoho Books, say so; it is learnable.**
* **Genuine care about accuracy. In this role a quiet mistake is worse than a loud one.**
* **Willing to do the admin portion properly rather than resentfully — it is small bills, travel bookings and bank errands, not procurement, and it is about one day a week.**
* **Nice to have, not required**
* **Multi-entity, multi-currency or foreign-exchange accounting exposure.**
* **Import, export, customs documentation or landed-cost accounting.**
* **CA or CMA, qualified or Inter.**
* **Experience working alongside external auditors.**

**PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF:**

**We mean this sincerely — it saves everyone time.**

* **You cannot attend an in-person interview in Bengaluru between 20 and 30 November 2026.**
* **You cannot join on 1 December 2026, for any reason, including notice period.**
* **You are not in Bengaluru and are not willing to relocate here at your own arrangement before joining.**
* **You are looking for a work-from-home or hybrid role. This is fully work from office.**
* **You consider administrative work beneath you. Booking a flight and going to the bank are part of this job.**
* **Your experience is a narrow slice of a large finance team and you have never owned a close.**
* **You want to specialise only in audit or only in taxation. This is a hands-on books role first.**

**OUR HIRING PROCESS:**

1. **APPLICATION — a short set of questions. Please answer them properly; one-line answers get filtered out.**
2. **PRACTICAL ACCOUNTING TEST — online, timed, 100 minutes. A real reconciliation with real errors in it, treatment judgement, a cash forecast you build, a set of judgement questions, and a short rapid-fire section. Monitored and copy-paste disabled.**
3. **VIDEO INTERVIEW — recorded, online. We ask you to walk us through your own answers from the test. Short, and not difficult if the work was yours.**
4. **IN-PERSON WITH THE MANAGING DIRECTOR — at our Bengaluru office, 20–30 November.**
5. **We make offers on a rolling basis. If you are strong, you will hear from us quickly.**

**HOW TO APPLY:**

**Apply through the link on this posting and answer the application questions in full. Attach your CV and a short covering note in your own words — not a template.**

**Jane Aerospace Pvt Ltd · Bengaluru, India**

**(We hire on evidence and demonstrated work, and we welcome applications from every background.)**

title: Staff Software Engineer - Accounting Integrations
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR & IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform.
  
  
By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B from the world's top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Bedrock, and Greenoaks—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes (#12 out of 500)
  
  
**About The Team**
At Rippling, the Accounting Integrations team sits at the critical intersection of product innovation and financial infrastructure. Our mission is to empower finance teams to move from traditional month-end closes to real-time accounting by seamlessly connecting Rippling’s platform with the world’s most widely-used ERP systems including NetSuite, QuickBooks, and soon Microsoft Dynamics 365, Oracle, and more.
  
  
We build robust, bi-directional integrations that serve both Rippling’s internal products (like Payroll, Spend Management, Procurement, and Travel) and external ERPs used by our customers. These integrations power complex accounting workflows such as journal syncing, reconciliation, audit readiness, and more, enabling our customers to automate the most repetitive and error-prone financial operations.
  
  
As Rippling expands globally and moves upmarket to serve large enterprises, the Accounting Integrations team is at the forefront of unlocking key use cases and supporting new geographies, integrations, and accounting standards. This team also operates in a high-velocity, continuous delivery environment, tackling a wide surface area of capabilities, systems, and support scenarios.
  
  
If you’re excited by systems design, love working across product boundaries, and want to build foundational infrastructure that finance teams depend on, the Accounting Integrations team is the place to be.
  
  
**About The Role**
Rippling is building the future of accounting and we’re looking for a Staff Engineer to help make that vision a reality.
  
  
In this high-impact role, you’ll be at the center of transforming Rippling’s global accounting system leveraging AI-driven solutions and modern engineering practices to unify and scale accounting operations across multiple countries.
  
  
This is a rare opportunity to influence the architecture and design of one of Rippling’s core product pillars from the ground up. You’ll lead initiatives that span the entire development lifecycle, from defining and scoping new product functionality to rearchitecting critical systems for scale, accuracy, and performance. Whether it’s optimizing for complex, multi-country edge cases or introducing AI/ML-based solutions for intelligent data transformation, your work will directly shape the infrastructure powering one of Rippling’s largest and fastest-growing markets.
  
  
As a Staff Engineer, you’ll be more than just a technical expert. You’ll be a thought partner to product, a mentor to engineers, and a strategic voice in shaping Rippling’s next billion-dollar vertical. You’ll collaborate closely with some of the most talented engineers in the company, working in a fast-moving environment where innovation, autonomy, and ownership are the norm.
  
  
At Rippling, engineers at the Staff level are deeply embedded in product direction. You'll engage directly with users, contribute to go-to-market strategies, and become an expert in the domain. As an early member of this team, you'll also play a vital role in building team culture, process, and technical vision as we scale.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Design and build scalable, data-driven systems that transform, normalize, and reconcile accounting integration across multiple countries, entities, and currencies.
* Drive platform evolution by re-architecting critical systems for scalability, reliability, and internationalization enabling accounting operations at scale.
* Develop AI- and ML-driven solutions to enhance accuracy, detect anomalies, automate workflows, and minimize manual intervention.
* Define and execute a long-term architectural vision for Rippling’s global accounting platform, balancing innovation with compliance, stability, and performance.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product, design, finance, legal, compliance, data, and operations teams to deliver cohesive and compliant solutions.
* Champion customer-focused engineering, ensuring technical solutions directly drive operational excellence and user impact.
* Mentor and lead engineers, fostering high standards of technical quality, thoughtful design, and engineering best practices.
* Influence and align stakeholders across multiple teams and time zones, communicating clearly to drive shared product and technical goals.

**What You Will Need**

* 8+ years of experience building and scaling production systems (Python, Django, React, MongoDB, AWS).
* Proven ability to architect, own, and deliver complex, platform-scale projects end to end.
* Strong background in data modeling, system design, and modern architecture patterns.
* Experience or keen interest in applying AI/ML for automation and intelligent data systems.
* Deep platform sensibility building extensible, compliant solutions for multiple countries.
* Track record of modernizing legacy systems and driving large-scale transformation.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
* Product mindset with focus on impact, reliability, and customer value.
* Proactive, growth-oriented approach with passion for solving complex global challenges.

****Bonus:****
Direct experience or deep interest in accounting workflows (journal entries, reconciliations, book closure).

title: SAP Finance Consultant (any location India)
description:
**SAP Finance Consultant**
**Financial Accounting (FI) | Controlling (CO) | Project Systems / EPPM (PS/EPPM)**
Hybrid role | Based anywhere in India
  
  
As Tenthpin continues to grow, we are looking for experienced SAP Finance Consultants to join our global team. You will work with leading Life Sciences organisations on complex transformation programmes, bringing together deep Finance expertise, SAP S/4HANA and innovative thinking to tackle real business challenges, become a trusted advisor to our clients and shape solutions that deliver lasting value.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an SAP Finance Consultant, you will strategically align technology with business objectives, combining your SAP Finance expertise with strong Management Consulting capability.
  
  
**The opportunity will include, but is not limited to:**

* Collaborating closely with clients, working directly with senior finance stakeholders and business process owners.
* Translating business requirements into clear to-be processes, functional designs and innovative SAP S/4HANA solutions.
* Taking responsibility for your specialist functional area from requirements and design through build and configuration, testing, deployment, cutover and go-live.
* Bringing current and emerging SAP capabilities into conversations with clients and identifying opportunities to solve complex business challenges differently.
* Thriving in an international environment, working across multilingual, multicultural and multidisciplinary teams.
* Actively contributing to your Tenthpin Community as part of a passionate, like-minded group of consultants striving to remain at the forefront of the industry.

**Your Specialism**
We are looking for experienced consultants who have developed a genuine specialism through one of three established SAP Finance career routes:
  
  

* Financial Accounting (FI) – General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Banking and Cash Management, Tax and Financial Close.
* Controlling (CO) – Cost and Profit Centre Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, Margin Analysis / CO-PA and wider management accounting processes.
* Project Systems / EPPM (PS/EPPM) – Project structures and WBS, planning, budgeting, costing, project financial control, settlement and integration with FI/CO.

**You do not need deep expertise across all three areas.**
Your career may have developed through FI, CO or PS/EPPM. What matters is deep, credible expertise in your chosen specialism, supported by broad SAP Finance knowledge and the consulting maturity to understand how your area fits into the wider S/4HANA landscape.
  
  
**Your Experience**
First and foremost, you are a genuine Management Consultant with exceptional communication skills, the ability to see the bigger picture and a collaborative approach to creating exceptional solutions.
  
  
You will also bring:
  
  

* Significant SAP Finance consulting experience gained across complex transformation programmes.
* Deep functional expertise in Financial Accounting (FI), Controlling (CO) or Project Systems / EPPM (PS/EPPM).
* Broad understanding of the wider SAP Finance landscape beyond your core specialism.
* Experience across multiple full end-to-end SAP implementation lifecycles, from early requirements and design through build, testing, deployment and go-live.
* Multiple full project lifecycles in SAP, as well as at least two full end-to-end S/4HANA implementations in which you played a significant functional and consulting role throughout the lifecycle.
* Proven ability to work credibly with senior Finance stakeholders and translate complex business needs into practical SAP solutions.
* Strong workshop facilitation, solution design and stakeholder-management capability, with the confidence to challenge constructively rather than simply take an instruction and configure it.
* A strong understanding of how your specialist area integrates with the wider S/4HANA Finance landscape and adjacent processes, including Sales & Distribution, Supply Chain and Manufacturing.
* A proven track record within a Big Four firm, major systems integrator or specialist SAP consulting firm would be preferred.
* Experience in Life Sciences or process manufacturing, particularly pharmaceuticals, medical devices, medical manufacturing or chemicals, would be advantageous.

**Why Tenthpin**
Tenthpin is a Global Consulting and Technology Boutique for the Life Sciences industry. With over 600 Consultants currently delivering to our projects, we currently operate out of 8 countries: Switzerland, Germany, UK, Portugal, Poland, Japan, USA and India. At least sixteen of the top 20 Life Sciences companies worldwide trust Tenthpin for independent and unbiased advice.
  
  
We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and a collaborative work environment that encourages professional growth and development.
  
  
Are you passionate about digitally transforming Life Sciences companies and enjoy working in an entrepreneurial and innovative team? Then we look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
**Tenthpin is an equal opportunities employer.**

**Job Responsibilities**
We are looking for a Finance & Accounting Lead for India to take ownership of core accounting, controlling, and local finance governance activities as part of a shared services team. The role combines hands-on controllership, local compliance knowledge, stakeholder management, and transition leadership.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as the key finance partner for India operations and the Global Business Service transformation team. This includes ensuring reliable month-end close, statutory and audit readiness, process documentation, system alignment, and clear governance across Finance, HR, Tax, Payroll, Concur, OneStream, and SAP and SAP S/4HANA Cloud interfaces.
  
  
This position requires a pragmatic finance leader who can stabilize current activities, lead a local team, support transformation decisions, and build scalable accounting processes in a cross-border environment.
  
  
***Main Duties***

* Finance leadership & continuity: Lead the India finance / accounting team and secure operational continuity during the replacement and transition phase.
* Accounting & closing: Own or coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities, including reconciliations, accruals, provisions, cost center review, intercompany accounting, and management reporting inputs.
* Local statutory & compliance: Ensure alignment with Indian statutory accounting, Companies Act requirements, GST / TDS related accounting, audit expectations, internal controls, and corporate finance policies.
* Controllership: Provide finance controllership for the India Back Office, including cost tracking, budget / forecast support, variance analysis, capitalization or project accounting topics where applicable, and escalation of financial risks.
* Global Business Service transition support: Support the movement of finance back-office activities under the Global Business Service model, including role clarity, process mapping, RASIC / ownership definition, SLA / KPI setup, reporting cadence, and handover documentation.
* Systems & process readiness: Partner with Finance, IT, HR, and external advisors on SAP S/4HANA Cloud, OneStream account structures, Workday / payroll interfaces, Concur processes, and related local requirements.
* Process harmonization: Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate finance and accounting processes while respecting local statutory and tax requirements.
* Audit & risk management: Coordinate internal and external audit requirements, ensure evidence readiness, monitor open findings, and drive remediation actions.
* Stakeholder management: Act as the key liaison between India local leadership, Corporate Finance, Business Services, Tax, HR, IT, project teams, and external consultants.
* Team development: Coach and develop the local finance / accounting team, clarify responsibilities, build backup structures, and foster accountability and continuous improvement.

***Governance & Performance Management***

* Define and maintain clear accounting ownership across local India finance, Corporate Finance, and Global Business Service.
* Establish practical KPI / SLA tracking for service delivery, closing timelines, open items, reconciliations, audit requests, and issue resolution.
* Create transparent escalation paths and regular reporting for critical finance, tax, payroll, and system readiness topics.

***Education***

* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related field.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), Cost Accountant (CMA), CPA, ACCA, or comparable professional qualification strongly preferred.
* Additional training in Indian tax / statutory compliance, internal controls, finance transformation, Lean Six Sigma, or project management is an advantage.

***Work Experience***

* 8+ years of relevant experience in accounting, controllership, finance operations, or shared services / GBS environments.
* 3+ years in a finance leadership, controller, accounting lead, or team lead role in India.
* Strong experience with India statutory accounting, audit coordination, tax-sensitive accounting topics, and internal control requirements.
* Experience in automotive, engineering, IT services, shared service centers, or multinational matrix organizations is preferred.
* Practical experience with month-end closing, intercompany processes, balance sheet reconciliations, cost center accounting, and management reporting.
* Experience with process transitions, system implementations, or finance transformation projects is a strong advantage.

**Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Indian accounting, statutory reporting, GST / TDS accounting implications, audit practices, and local control requirements.
* Solid understanding of IFRS / US-GAAP or multinational corporate reporting requirements.
* Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC; SAP S/4HANA Cloud experience is preferred.
* Experience with OneStream, Concur, Workday Payroll / HR interfaces, Power BI, workflow tools, or finance automation is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills, high attention to detail, and ability to translate financial data into clear management insights.
* Proven leadership, coaching, and team coordination skills in a multicultural environment.
* Structured working style with a strong sense of ownership, documentation discipline, and follow-through.
* Ability to manage ambiguity, stabilize operations, and drive pragmatic solutions during transformation phases.
* Excellent English communication skills, written and spoken; ability to communicate with senior stakeholders and operational teams.

***Work Environment***

* High-visibility finance leadership role within the India GBS Back Office / Finance transformation context.
* Regular collaboration with international stakeholders.
* Moderate travel may be required during setup, knowledge transfer, audit, or system alignment phases.
* The role requires a combination of hands-on accounting execution, leadership, and transformation mindset.

We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. description:

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

Individual Contributor

title: Finance Executive
description:
Role: Finance Executive
  
  
Employment Type: Full Time
  
  
Educational Qualification: Education: B.Com/M.Com/CA-Inter
  
  
Work Experience: 2–5 years of experience in accounting and compliance, preferably for a US-based company or clients.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are looking for an enthusiastic and self driven individual who is responsible for the general accounting function of the company. Your roles and responsibilities including but not limited to will be maintenance of books of accounts, invoices and relevant reports. As an Finance Executive, you shall be responsible for ensuring that the books are updated on a real time basis and as per relevant accounting standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Duties**

* Post and process the journal entries to make sure that all transactions have been recorded.
* Handle day-to-day accounting activities across general ledger, payables, receivables, and aging analysis to maintain accurate financial records.
* Reconcile ledgers monthly and quarterly.
* Assist in consolidation and intercompany accounting.
* Ensure compliance with US federal and state tax regulations, including sales tax, payroll tax, and other statutory filings.
* Support month-end and year-end close processes.
* Perform ad-hoc financial projects as needed.

**Desirable Skills & Certifications**

* Strong understanding of US GAAP, US tax compliance, and financial reporting standards.
* Experience with SAP S4 Hana.
* Exposure to US payroll, sales tax, and 1099/941 filings.
* Knowledge of transfer pricing and intercompany accounting is a plus.

**Candidate Acumen**

* Excellent analytical, communication, and time-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* High level of attention to detail.

**Benefits**

* Health insurance coverage
* Unlimited leaves & flexible working hours
* Role-based remote work and work-from-home benefit
* Relocation assistance
* Professional Mental Wellness services
* Creche facility for primary caregivers (limited to India)
* Employee Stock Options for all hires

**About Pixxel**
Pixxel is a space data company and spacecraft manufacturer redefining Earth observation with hyperspectral imaging. The company’s first three commercial hyperspectral satellites—Fireflies—deliver imagery at 5-meter resolution and 135+ spectral bands, providing 50x richer detail than traditional Earth observation systems and unlocking insights across agriculture, climate, energy, environment, and more.
  
  
Once fully deployed, Pixxel’s constellation of 18-24 satellites will capture imagery across up to 250 bands in VNIR and SWIR ranges, with a 40 km swath and daily global revisit capability. Pixxel’s most unique strength is its full-stack approach, integrating every layer of the value chain from satellite hardware and manufacturing to AI-powered analytics.
  
  
Pixxel’s satellite constellation is complemented by Aurora, its in-house Earth Observation Studio that simplifies satellite imagery analysis and democratises remote sensing for all. Designed to make hyperspectral data more accessible, Aurora by Pixxel combines high-frequency imagery with AI-powered tools to generate actionable insights, even for users without technical backgrounds. The third pillar of Pixxel’s ecosystem is its in-house satellite manufacturing capability. Beyond building its own spacecraft, Pixxel also provides satellite systems and subsystems to other organisations. This dual capacity sets it apart in a sector where most companies focus on either payload design or data operations, but not both.
  
  
Pixxel’s team is young but deeply mission-aligned, with a culture rooted in curiosity, speed, and long-term thinking. As the company grows its constellation and expands Aurora, the focus remains on making space-based insights practical, scalable, and genuinely helpful so that the health of the planet becomes measurable and action becomes possible.
  
  
Pixxel was the only Indian startup selected for the Techstars Starburst Space Accelerator in Los Angeles and has been recognised in TIME’s Best Inventions of 2023, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Via Satellite’s Top Innovators list.
  
  
For more information, see our Careers page or follow Pixxel on LinkedIn and X/Twitter.
  
  
Culture
  
  
Pixxel is an organization where we enable our employees to work on world-changing problems that they are passionate about, and a place where they can be their best selves day in and day out while ensuring they have fun every day.
  
  
Central to our employee-first ethos is a commitment to ensuring that every team member feels valued and heard. We nurture a healthy and supportive work environment where we prioritise well-being and growth in all aspects of life.

title: Accounting Supervisor
description:
Job Description: Supervisor / Accountant

**Industry:**
Baling Factory / Manufacturing

**Location:**
Nelamangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Working Hours:**
12-hour shift

**Education:**
PUC / Graduate in Commerce or a related field

**Gender:**
Male candidates only

Job Overview

We are looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and experienced Supervisor / Accountant to manage the factory's day-to-day accounting activities, billing, financial records, and operational coordination.

The ideal candidate should have practical knowledge of accounting principles, Tally ERP/Tally Prime, GST compliance, debit and credit entries, and general factory accounting procedures. The candidate should also be comfortable coordinating with workers, suppliers, customers, and management.

Key Responsibilities1. Accounting and Bookkeeping

* Maintain day-to-day accounting records and financial transactions.
* Record debit and credit entries accurately.
* Handle journal entries, ledger maintenance, and general bookkeeping.
* Maintain purchase, sales, cash, and bank books.
* Perform bank reconciliation and verify bank statements.
* Maintain accounts payable and accounts receivable.
* Track outstanding payments from customers and payments due to suppliers.
* Prepare daily cash reports and maintain petty cash records.
* Ensure accurate documentation of all financial transactions.

2. Tally and Accounting Software

* Maintain company accounts using Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime.
* Enter purchase bills, sales invoices, receipts, and payment vouchers.
* Record journal, contra, debit note, and credit note entries.
* Maintain customer and supplier ledgers.
* Generate accounting reports, trial balances, and outstanding statements.
* Verify entries and resolve discrepancies in accounting records.

3. GST and Taxation

* Prepare and verify GST-compliant purchase and sales invoices.
* Check GSTIN details, HSN codes, and applicable GST rates.
* Maintain records of input tax credit (ITC) and output GST.
* Reconcile purchase and sales records with GSTR-2B and GSTR-1 data, as applicable.
* Assist with monthly and quarterly GST documentation and returns.
* Coordinate with the company's CA or tax consultant for GST filings, TDS, and other statutory requirements.
* Maintain proper records of tax invoices, debit notes, credit notes, and related documents.
* Assist with e-way bills and e-invoices wherever applicable.

4. Factory Billing and Inventory Accounting

* Prepare purchase and sales bills for factory transactions.
* Maintain records of raw materials, finished goods, and stock movements.
* Verify material received and dispatched against invoices and delivery documents.
* Maintain daily records of material purchases, production, and dispatches.
* Track stock quantities and reconcile physical stock with recorded inventory.
* Maintain supplier bills, transport bills, freight charges, and loading/unloading expenses.
* Record wastage, shortages, and stock discrepancies.
* Coordinate with the factory team to ensure accurate material and inventory records.

5. Cash, Payments, and Financial Control

* Maintain daily cash inflow and outflow records.
* Record customer receipts and supplier payments.
* Verify payment vouchers, bills, and supporting documents.
* Monitor pending customer payments and follow up on overdue invoices.
* Prepare supplier payment schedules and outstanding reports.
* Maintain records of bank transfers, UPI transactions, and other business payments.
* Report accounting discrepancies or unusual transactions to management.

6. Factory Supervision and Administration

* Coordinate with factory workers, suppliers, transporters, and customers.
* Monitor daily operational activities and material movement.
* Maintain attendance and other operational records, as assigned.
* Ensure invoices, delivery challans, weighment slips, and other documents are properly maintained.
* Prepare daily and monthly reports for management.
* Ensure that factory records are maintained accurately and systematically.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* PUC or a graduate degree; a B.Com degree is preferred.
* Practical knowledge of Tally ERP 9 / Tally Prime.
* Good understanding of debit-credit entries and accounting fundamentals.
* Knowledge of GST, invoicing, purchase and sales accounting, and bank reconciliation.
* Familiarity with inventory accounting and manufacturing or factory accounts.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel and accounting reports.
* Good communication skills in Kannada and English.
* Ability to maintain accurate records and meet deadlines.
* Responsible, trustworthy, organised, and capable of working independently.

Preferred Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in accounting, preferably in a manufacturing unit, factory, trading business, or industrial establishment.
* Experience handling GST, Tally, billing, inventory, and supplier/customer accounts.
* Freshers with strong accounting fundamentals and practical Tally knowledge may also be considered.

Working Conditions

* Full-time, on-site position.
* Location: Nelamangala, Bengaluru.
* 8-hour shift.
* Candidates should be comfortable working in a factory environment.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their resumes to:

**Email:**
shruthinagarajwork@gmail.com

* Candidates should mention their accounting experience, Tally proficiency, GST knowledge, and current location when applying.

description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. This team supports the lifecycle of the firm's global trading strategies and serves as a key link between the front office and operational teams. This desk-coverage role offers the opportunity to support the firm's trading desks day-to-day, build subject matter expertise across the trade lifecycle, and contribute to process improvements in a collaborative, forward-thinking, and inclusive environment. You will support the trade lifecycle from execution through settlement, helping ensure accurate and timely processing of trade events-including trade capture, P&L, security master, settlements, and corporate actions. You will also investigate and resolve discrepancies across internal systems and external data sources, escalating issues as appropriate. Additionally, you will assist in building and maintaining workflows, dashboards, and tools that monitor trading activity and operational health. You will coordinate with front office, back office, and external counterparties to help resolve operational, settlement, or reconciliation issues. Furthermore, you will develop subject matter expertise in internal booking systems and workflows and contribute to process improvement initiatives.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold —
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* A postgraduate degree and 2+ years of experience in fund operations or middle/back-office roles within the financial services sector
* A good understanding of trade lifecycle operations, including trade capture, P&L, security master, and settlement processes
* Exceptional communication, organizational skills, and attention to detail, with a keen desire to grow and take ownership in a dynamic setting
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing front office inquiries and coordinating with internal/external stakeholders to resolve operational issues
* Familiarity with financial software such as Bloomberg or Capital IQ
* Familiarity with business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI) or experience with process automation
