title: SENIOR ANALYST, CONTROLLERSHIP
description:
As a member of the Finance team involved in business-critical decision-making through various accounting and FP&A functions, you will be part of the Controllership team responsible for managing Payroll Processing, Accounting and Compliance.
  
  
About Team: Finance
  
  
A career in finance at Walmart presents limitless opportunities to make a global impact. As the world’s largest retailer, Walmart depends on its finance team to deliver critical insights, strategic analysis, and informed guidance—whether it’s for launching new products or expanding into emerging markets.
  
  
If you're seeking a dynamic and challenging environment, Walmart offers no shortage of possibilities. You'll apply your analytical expertise to evaluate product performance, assess risks, and build robust financial models. You'll also contribute to high-impact strategic initiatives that drive the company’s continued growth.
  
  
No matter what your role within the finance organization, your work will help shape decisions that affect millions of lives around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a member of the Controllership team, you will play a key role in managing end-to-end payroll operations, including payroll processing, payments, compliance and accounting. Your responsibilities will include:
  
  
Payroll administration: Execute end-to-end payroll processes by collating, validating, and processing payroll inputs in accordance with established timelines, regulatory requirements, and internal controls.
  
  
Stakeholder Coordination: Partner with cross-functional teams, payroll service providers, consultants, and key stakeholders to ensure seamless payroll delivery and successful execution of payroll-related initiatives.
  
  
Payroll Governance & Review: Oversee critical payroll activities, including gross-to-net validations, associate recoveries, actuarial accounting, RSU accounting, payroll reconciliations, and variance analysis to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.
  
  
Month-End Close & Financial Reporting: Lead payroll-related month-end and period-end close activities, including journal entry preparation, account reconciliations, and financial reporting deliverables, ensuring adherence to close timelines and accounting standards.
  
  
Controls & Compliance: Maintain a robust controls environment through effective process documentation, control execution, and compliance monitoring. Support internal, external, statutory, and regulatory audits as required.
  
  
Data Integrity & Confidentiality: Manage sensitive payroll and associate information with the highest standards of confidentiality, accuracy, and professional judgment.
  
  
Operational Excellence: Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and flexibility in managing critical deliverables, including support during quarter-end, year-end, and other peak business periods.
  
  
Statutory Compliance Management: Ensure compliance with payroll-related statutory requirements, including TDS, PF, PT, LWF, and other applicable regulations. Oversee timely filings, returns, reconciliations, and issuance of statutory documents such as Form 16.
  
  
Payroll Systems & Technology: Manage payroll systems and related tools to ensure operational effectiveness, data integrity, and compliance. Drive system enhancements and support technology-driven process improvements.
  
  
Business Communication & Collaboration: Communicate effectively with stakeholders across all levels of the organization and present payroll, accounting, and compliance-related insights in a clear, concise, and impactful manner.
  
  
Audit & Reporting Support: Support statutory, tax, internal, and IFC audits through timely preparation of schedules, analyses, reconciliations, and audit documentation.
  
  
Process Transformation & Automation: Identify and implement opportunities to streamline payroll processes, strengthen controls, and drive automation to enhance efficiency, scalability, and accuracy.
  
  
Payroll Analytics & Insights: Leverage payroll and financial data to perform analysis, identify trends, and provide actionable insights that support business decisions and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
A degree in Commerce (BCom), CA-Inter, ICWA, or a fully qualified Chartered Accountant (CA), with 4-6 years of relevant experience.
  
  
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, along with experience using Power BI and other reporting tools.
  
  
Hands-on experience with SAP ERP systems.
  
  
Proven ability to lead and manage payroll-related projects, including implementation of new regulations, process improvements, and automation initiatives.
  
  
Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret payroll data and generate meaningful insights.
  
  
Strong understanding of accounting principles and procedures, with working knowledge of Indian Tax Laws and Labour Laws.
  
  
Familiarity with US GAAP and Ind AS is a plus.

title: Analyst - FP&A
description:
At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling, and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, 80,000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
  
  
Could you be the full-time
**Analyst- FP&A**
in
**Bengaluru, India**
, we’re looking for?
  
  
**Your future role**
Take on a new challenge and apply your financial planning and analysis expertise in a dynamic and evolving industry. You’ll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and results-driven teammates.
  
  
You'll play a pivotal role in providing a fair view of Alstom's performance through consistent data aggregation and insightful financial analyses. Day-to-day, you’ll work closely with teams across the business (Region FP&A teams, site controllers, and operational teams), assist operational and commercial teams with reports and ad hoc analyses, and support management with actionable insights.
  
  
We’ll look to you for:
  
  

* Ensuring all financial data is collected, processed, and analysed in a timely manner.
* Preparing actual financial results, forecasts, and variance analyses to provide early warning signals and insights.
* Improving and simplifying financial processes and reporting content.
* Analysing key cash KPIs such as Free Cash Flow, EBIT to Cash, and Operating Working Capital.
* Managing Forex exposure and hedging relationships.
* Participating in the preparation and presentation of monthly business reviews.
* Controlling indirect cost centres and contract reporting.
* Collaborating with regional finance analysts and functional controllers to align with group strategy.
* Building strong relationships with Treasury, Tax, Accounting, and other teams to ensure process alignment.
* Identifying opportunities for cost savings, margin improvements, and KPI evolution.

**All About You**
We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
  
  

* A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CMA qualification.
* 3+ years of experience in FP&A or Corporate Finance.
* Experience in long-term project accounting is a plus.
* Knowledge of ERP systems, specifically SAP.
* Proficiency in advanced Excel skills.
* Fluent in English.
* Curiosity and a drive to learn and develop.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complexity into simplicity.
* Proficiency in multitasking with efficiency and speed.
* Some IT systems savviness.
* Ability to propose change, lead initiatives, and foster innovation.
* Strong interpersonal skills, including teamwork, integrity, and the ability to navigate a multicultural, matrixed environment.

**Things you’ll enjoy**
- Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
  
  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from routine.
* Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues.
* Contribute to innovative projects that shape the future of mobility.
* Utilise our flexible and inclusive working environment.
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning programs.
* Progress towards leadership roles in IT Finance or other areas of interest.
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).

Important to note
  
  
As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

description:

description:
**About Company:**

r our

**Job Description**

**Title:**
Value Realization Finance Analyst, AI Advisory

**Experience:**
4–9 years in FP&A, benefits realization, business finance or transformation finance

**Type:**
Full Time Employment

**Location:**
India — Mumbai or Bangalore

**Work hours:**
Flexible for overlap with US Eastern time required

**Education:**
Chartered Accountant (CA) or CMA, or an MBA in Finance

**Role Overview**

As part of Quantiphi's AI Advisory practice, you will be the finance specialist behind our AI value realization work. Clients' CFOs, COOs and P&L owners want to know what their AI costs, what it produces, and what has actually reached the P&L. You will build the numbers that answer that.

You'll define how each AI initiative's value is calculated, separate potential value from realized value, and give our engineering and BI team the metric logic, data sources and evidence rules to build Value Bridge and portfolio dashboards.

You'll work with the US engagement team, who lead the client and CFO conversations. Your job is to make every number they present defensible, traceable and ready for Finance certification.

**Role & Responsibilities**

**Build the value case**

* Build pre-AI baselines and counterfactuals from client data: overtime, contractor spend, hiring plans, cycle time, cost-to-serve.
* Model the value equation for each AI solution: eligible volume × adoption × successful assist × time saved × economic rate.
* Tag each initiative with a value type: cost avoidance, capacity, contribution margin, working capital, or risk/SLA.

**Separate created value from realized value**

* Count capacity as realized only when evidence shows what happened to it: overtime cut, contractor spend reduced, approved hires avoided, or extra throughput, etc.
* Build the evidence behind avoided-hiring claims, tied to the approved workforce plan and specific positions not opened.
* Track uncaptured capacity at $0 realized so value leakage stays visible.
* Check for double counting across initiatives, business units and value levers.

**Define the dashboards with engineering**

* Own the calculation logic for the Value Bridge, from investment and adoption through value created, value captured and Finance-validated value.
* Write metric specs engineers can build from: formula, grain, source field, refresh cadence and owner.
* Specify the four dashboard levels: portfolio, Value Bridge, drivers and evidence.
* Build the AI economics view: total cost of ownership, unit cost, ROI, payback, forecast versus realized.
* Test dashboard outputs against finance actuals before anything reaches a client.

**Run the evidence and reporting cycle**

* Maintain the AI Value Ledger for each initiative: owner, baseline, hypothesis, investment, attribution method, evidence grade, forecast, realized value and status.
* Collect and grade evidence from client HR, Procurement, Operations and Engineering data owners.
* Produce the monthly value pack and the quarterly Finance certification pack, flagging exceptions.
* Prepare the analysis behind quarterly Scale / Fix / Hold / Stop recommendations.

**Work across time zones**

* Work day to day with the onshore Senior Manager, who leads the client and CFO conversations.
* Raise weak value claims and data gaps early, so the US team isn't waiting overnight.
* Build the templates, metric library and evidence checklists the practice reuses.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* 4–9 years in FP&A, benefits realization, business finance or transformation finance.
* CA, CMA or MBA in Finance.
* A track record of building business cases and then proving realized benefits against actuals, not just forecasting them.
* Comfort with baselines, counterfactuals and attribution. You can explain why hours saved × salary is capacity, not savings.
* Working knowledge of workforce costs: payroll, overtime, contractor and vendor spend, headcount plans, loaded cost rates.
* Experience writing metric or KPI definitions for data and BI teams, and checking the dashboards they build.
* Strong SQL or advanced Excel modeling; able to read a data model and challenge a calculation.
* Clear written English and the confidence to challenge a number, including a senior colleague's.
* Willingness to be flexible for overlapping with US Eastern time.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience in a global capability center, Big Four or consulting firm supporting US or global clients.
* Prior work in a value realization office, transformation office or PMO.
* Knowledge of US payroll, contractor and hiring-plan practices.
* Exposure to cloud or AI cost management (FinOps): usage costs, unit economics, total cost of ownership.
* Familiarity with A/B tests, control groups or cohort analysis.
* Experience with a BI tool (Power BI, Looker or Tableau) and ERP data (SAP, Oracle, Workday).
* Interest in one of our core industries: financial services and insurance, healthcare and life sciences, or telecom and media.

title: Lead Analyst- Retail Accounting
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.
  
  
**Summary Of The Role**
Levi Strauss & Co. is looking for a detail‑oriented
**Lead Analyst, Retail Accounting**
to support retail accounting operations and broader record‑to‑report (RTR) activities across the Americas. This role partners Retail Operations, Finance, and upstream teams to ensure accurate accounting, timely close, strong controls/SOX compliance, and audit readiness. The ideal candidate is analytical, hands‑on, and comfortable working in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Own and support monthly, quarterly, and year‑end close activities for retail and general ledger areas (accruals, reclasses, and analysis).
* Prepare and review journal entries, ensuring appropriate support, approvals, and compliance with accounting policies.
* Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations (retail and corporate accounts), ensuring reconciling items are investigated and cleared in line with SOX/internal control requirements.
* Perform checks on retail cash variances (POS, deposits, bank matching) and support bank reconciliations, investigating discrepancies and driving timely resolution.
* Analyze P&L and balance sheet fluctuations, prepare variance commentary, and partner with stakeholders to explain results.
* Investigate and resolve reconciling items and close variances (including clearing accounts as applicable) in partnership with upstream and downstream teams.
* Collaborate with Retail Operations, Finance, Shared Services, and global teams to resolve issues, align on timelines, and improve end‑to‑end processes.
* Support internal/external audits and SOX testing by providing documentation, walkthrough support, and timely responses to requests.
* Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation (templates, reporting, system enhancements) to improve close accuracy and cycle time.

**About You**

* CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) with 8+ years’ experience in RTR
* Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals, month‑end close, and RTR processes; exposure to retail cash/POS flows is a plus.
* Experience with SAP / S/4HANA (or similar large ERP) and a strong working knowledge of GL, subledger integrations, and reporting
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI (or similar tools) to build/maintain close and reconciliation reporting
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights for stakeholders
* Proven ability to thrive in a deadline‑driven environment, manage multiple priorities, and drive work to closure with minimal supervision
* Working knowledge of internal controls/SOX, audit support, and documentation standards
* Comfortable working across global time zones and collaborating with geographically distributed teams

**Benefits**
We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.
  
  
**Here's a Small Snapshot**

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best in class leave plan including paternity & family care leaves
* Counselling sessions to prioritize mental well-being
* Exclusive discount vouchers on Levi’s products

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to empowering individuals from all walks of life to achieve their professional goals with us, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, or genetic information. We actively seek and encourage applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities, and offer accommodations throughout the selection process upon request.
  
  
To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.*

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – SD – Senior Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
**Position Summary**

Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As a Senior Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will design, develop, and deploy enterprise-scale software solutions, lead the creation of robust pipelines and manage code deployment across environments. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help identify and realize revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
  

* 1. Develop client deliverables and documentation:

* Develop plans for components of engagements.

* Identify and help manage changes in scope.

Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. * Optimizing the operating model and organization design
* Targeting synergies, developing a roadmap to help realize those synergies and measuring synergies

* Developing communications for culture and change management
* Integrating supply chains, distribution networks, R&D, finance, procurement, real estate and innovation

* Formulating organizational separation and re-alignment strategies
* Optimizing transition services agreement (TSA)
* Identifying and eliminating stranded costs

* 3- 5 years of relevant experience for Senior Consultants

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Consulting Background
* M&A advisory experience
* Commercial/ Operational due diligence experience
* Prior investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side
* Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, IT, Contracts management, procurement etc
* Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics

**Education:**
MBA is mandatory. Engineering undergrad is preferred but not mandatory
  
  
**Location:**
Bengaluru /Hyderabad /Pune

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Senior Strategic Finance Professional
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior Strategic Finance professional with 7-10 years of experience to lead the company’s project-level debt and equity transactions, own project structuring, and provide commercial leadership across all negotiations, while also supporting equity raises at the parent level, investor relations, and strategic projects.
  
  
The role is ideal for a seasoned transaction leader with deep financial modelling, structuring, and negotiation capabilities who wants to own fundraising and corporate finance outcomes, working closely with the CFO and the senior leadership in a fast-growing environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Transaction Leadership - Project Debt & Equity
  
  

* Lead execution of project-level equity transactions including co-investors, preferred equity, private equity, strategic investors, and institutional capital.
* Lead and structure project debt financing including project finance, structured finance, working capital facilities, venture debt, leasing, and acquisition financing, through to financial close.
* Own the structuring of each project, including capital stack, SPV and holding structures, security packages, covenants, and risk allocation.
* Oversee preparation of financial models, valuation analyses, investor presentations, teaser materials, information memorandums, and due diligence materials.
* Lead negotiations with banks, investors, and counterparties, directing financial advisors, legal counsel, and internal teams during financing processes.
* Own financing process timelines, deliverables, and investor interactions, escalating key decisions and risks to the CFO.
* Oversee data room preparation and management for financing transactions.
* Direct benchmarking analysis on comparable companies, transactions, valuation multiples, and financing structures.

Commercial Leadership
  
  

* Provide commercial leadership across all negotiations, including term sheets, financing documents, offtake and customer contracts, and partnership agreements.
* Assess commercial terms for bankability and financing compatibility, and resolve issues with counterparties early.
* Take and defend negotiating positions on behalf of the company, with clear recommendations to leadership.

Parent-Level Equity Raise Support
  
  

* Support the CFO and leadership on equity raises at the parent company, including investor strategy, valuation, materials, and due diligence.
* Ensure alignment between parent-level equity raises and project-level financing structures.

Investor Relations Support
  
  

* Assist in preparation of board materials, investor updates, quarterly reporting packs, and shareholder presentations.
* Support management of investor queries and information requests.
* Help prepare materials for investor meetings, roadshows, and strategic discussions.
* Support ongoing communication with existing investors and lenders.

Strategic Finance & Corporate Development
  
  

* Build and own detailed financial models including operating models, project-level waterfalls, scenario analysis, and liquidity forecasting.
* Lead/ support strategic initiatives including M&A evaluations, partnership analysis, market research, and business case development.
* Partner with leadership on budgeting, long-range planning, and capital allocation decisions.
* Assist with preparation of internal management reporting and KPI tracking.
* Mentor and develop junior finance team members as the function scales.

Candidate Profile
  
  
**Experience**

* 7-10 years of experience in:o Investment bankingo Structured finance/ Project finance / infrastructure financeo Transaction advisoryo Private equity

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
* CA / CFA / MBA preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Expert financial modelling (including project finance models) and valuation skills.
* Deep understanding of debt and equity financing structures, including project finance, preferred equity, and hybrid instruments.
* Command of investor reporting and transaction execution processes.
* Ability to negotiate and mark up term sheets, facility agreements, and security documents.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Ability to analyze complex financial and operational data.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong communication and presentation skills, including at board and investor level.
* Strong negotiation skills and commercial judgement; credible with banks, investors, and senior counterparties.
* High attention to detail and execution capability.
* Ability to work in fast-paced and entrepreneurial environments.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience**

* Track record of leading and closing project debt and equity transactions.
* Exposure to infrastructure, technology, AI, data centers, renewable energy, or digital infrastructure sectors is a plus.
* Experience negotiating with investors, banks, or senior management teams.
* Familiarity with data rooms and transaction documentation.

What the Role Offers
  
  

* Direct access to senior leadership and investors.
* Opportunity to lead high-impact financing and strategic initiatives.
* Broad mandate across project finance, corporate fundraising, and investor relations.
* Fast learning curve in a high-growth environment.

* Handle project-based billing models, including Fixed Cost (FC), Time & Material (T&M), Retainers, and Milestone-based billing

description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. * Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams

* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

Remote-Friendly, Global Team
  
  

* US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location

Move Fast, Ship Real Products
  
  
We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.
  
  
This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.
  
  
What We Value
  
  

* Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.

* Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.

The Ask
  
  
If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.
  
  
We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.
  
  
**Here's Why You Should**

title: Decision Analysis Consultant
description:
**Chevron ENGINE Decision Analysis Consultant (Bengaluru)**
**About Us**
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Position**
Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for
**Decision Analysis Consultant to**
join the ENGINE Innovation team; this role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.
  
  
Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide direct Decision and Economic Analysis consulting to support investment decisions and commercial negotiations across the globe in all parts of our business; ranging from upstream oil and gas to liquified natural gas (LNG), midstream, refining and lower carbon.
* Support globally based Decision Analysis (DAs) Consultants working on investment decisions by helping them frame opportunities, develop and refine decision and economic analysis models (ensuring accuracy & reliability), perform analysis, and develop communication materials.
* Application of DA Principles: Apply key principles, processes, and tools related to Decision Analysis, Investment Analysis, Framing, and Chevron Project Management requirements.
* Economic and Cash Flow Modeling: Conduct detailed economic and cash flow modeling, ensuring robust and insightful financial analyses. Update, adapt and build decision models, with limited assistance, of medium complexity for different fiscal regimes while applying good DA/ economic modeling standards and best practices. Will require modeling of different fiscal and tax regimes such as production sharing contracts (PSC) and Joint Venture Agreements (JV’s); may require engagements with tax and legal departments.
* Framing: Lead framing and decision-structuring sessions, ensuring all relevant factors are considered and integrated into models and decision-making tools. Utilize a variety of framing tools. Actively leads/ supports development, updating and customization of frame to specific opportunity.
* Facilitation: Effectively facilitate complex and vague engagements with multifunctional participants to help shape outputs for understanding and application. Not just framing, but facilitation of any discussions required to help solve a complex challenge. This includes developing appropriate summaries & communication.
* Data Elicitation and Coordination: Perform data elicitation, de-biasing, and coordinate information flow to support the data required for building and incorporating into models. This includes multiple sets of data to account for key uncertainties. Proactively identifies, communicates, obtains, QCs, and facilitates discussions to gain alignment on information needed. Helps coordinate flow of information from various SMEs and departments.
* Analytical Skills: Perform qualitative, deterministic, and probabilistic analyses to generate insights for project teams and decision-makers. Will need to structure a DA evaluation and effectively select from and apply a variety of qualitative, deterministic and probabilistic tools and techniques to generate insights. This may include specialized analytical tools such as cumulative probability curves, tornado diagrams and value of information (VOI) studies.
* Communication of Findings: Extract findings, insights and effectively communicate those insights, including presentations and project documentation, to ensure decision-makers have a clear understanding of the analysis and the tradeoffs important for the decision. Clarify the value of the minimum investment required and the incremental value of the enhancements.
* Decision Quality Assurance: Participate in Decision Quality (DQ) assurance activities, including Model Reviews, to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the analysis. Challenges assumptions, inputs, values & trade-offs, and decisions when needed to ensure high DQ.

**About You**

* Education: Prefer a higher education degree in business, economics or finance with an undergraduate degree in a technical area (such as engineering).
* Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years, 10 years preferred.
* The ideal candidate will have experience in the upstream oil and gas industry.
* Excellent communication skills; including verbal, written and presentation.
* Experience and comfort using AI tools, developing agents is a plus.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word. Prefer experience writing complex formulas and equations into Excel. Basic knowledge of decision tree concepts and software is advantageous.
* High proficiency in Excel, including development of complex formulas and equations. Strong understanding of economics, cash flow modeling, tax, and depreciation. Capability to structure and manipulate data for analyses and apply decision principles and tools effectively. Good understanding of basic framing concepts and consideration of uncertainty and risk in analyses. Exposure to various analytical tools is a plus, such as cumulative probability curves (S-curves), Investment Efficiency Charts, and Tornado Diagrams. Able to synthesize complex analysis and results into clear insights for leadership discussions and decision making. Able to utilize communication tools such as MS PowerPoint to summarize and present insights.
* Able to identify problems, view them from different angles, and figure out possible solutions. Must be able to facilitate discussions and solicit inputs from various technical and business functions to perform the necessary analysis to identify and recommend solutions.
* Team-work is essential for this role. Must be able to work between diverse teams and departments across the organization. This includes engineering, scientists, legal, tax, finance and commercial roles.
* Ability to develop detailed action plans and work independently with minimal supervision. Capability to collect, summarize, and structure information. Competence in developing resolution options within the framework of professional duties.
* Ability to assess personal strengths and weaknesses and take practical steps for personal development.
* Willingness to share work experience and information with colleagues to achieve corporate goals.
* Clear and structured communication, both in written and verbal form, is vital for success in this role. Being comfortable in a dynamic environment where assignments can vary and change on a regular basis.

**What We Can Offer You**
Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
  
  
Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
  
  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

**How To Apply**
To be a part of our success, click APPLY to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.
  
  
**Privacy and Terms and Conditions**
We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice(opens in new window) sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.
  
  
Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.
  
  
“ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.
  
  
This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.

title: Senior Finance Manager - Taxation
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Tax Manager to own the group's indirect and direct tax

compliance, litigation, and advisory functions. The role combines hands-on GST and TDS compliance with

strategic responsibilities such as structuring advisory, tax implementation within products and invoicing systems,

and representation before tax and government authorities. The ideal candidate should be a strong

communicator who can partner with business, product, and other stake holders to embed tax correctness into

processes end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Indirect Taxation (GST)***

• Manage end-to-end GST compliances across the group — timely and accurate filing of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B,

GSTR-9/9C, and reconciliations (GSTR-2A/2B vs. books, ITC reconciliation).

• Handle GST litigation — draft and file replies to notices, SCNs, audit queries, and appeals; coordinate with

consultants and counsel where required.

• Maintain and update litigation trackers for indirect taxation — monitor notices, due dates, hearing

schedules, appeal status, and demand/refund positions.

• Provide structuring and advisory support on GST implications of transactions, contracts, new business

models, and place/time/value of supply issues.

• Manage GST registrations, amendments, refunds, and department correspondence across states.

• Accounting of the GST output and Input in cross functional enterprise structure.

***Direct Taxation (TDS)***

• Working knowledge of direct taxation with hands-on ownership of TDS — correct deduction, timely deposit

to the department, and filing of quarterly TDS returns (Forms 24Q/26Q/27Q).

• Support broader direct tax compliance and assessments as required.

• Working knowledge in litigation and advisory for Direct Tax Matters.

***Product & Systems Implementation***

• Drive tax implementation within products, billing, and invoicing systems — ensure correct GST rates,

HSN/SAC mapping, place-of-supply logic, and e-invoicing / e-way bill compliance.

• Design and validate product logic for TDS deduction and deposit workflows, ensuring accurate computation

and remittance to the department.

• Partner with product and engineering teams to translate tax rules into system requirements, test changes,

and prevent compliance gaps.

***Representation & Advisory***

• Represent the group before GST Officers, Income Tax Officers, and other government authorities on matters

related to these functions.

• Prepare submissions, documentation, and case files for hearings, assessments, and audits.

• Advise internal stakeholders on tax-efficient structuring and the tax impact of business decisions.

Required Skills & Attributes

• Strong technical command of GST law, procedures, and litigation practice.

• Working knowledge of direct taxation and practical TDS compliance.

• Experience implementing tax logic in products, ERP, or invoicing/billing systems.

• Proven ability to draft replies, appeals, and represent before tax authorities.

• Proactive, ownership-driven, and organized — able to manage trackers, deadlines, and multiple matters

simultaneously.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; effective in cross-functional collaboration.

***Qualifications & Experience***

• Chartered Accountant

• 5–8 years of post-qualification experience in indirect and direct taxation.

• Prior exposure to product/tech-driven businesses and system-level tax implementation preferred.

• Prior experience handling taxation related to derivatives transactions is preferred.

• Strong understanding of applicable tax laws, regulatory compliance, and tax reporting requirements.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

title: Finance Associate
description:
Finance Associate - Falconsage LLPAbout the role

Falconsage LLP is hiring a Finance Associate to run end-to-end finance for our US and Indian start-up clients: accounting at the core, with FP&A, start-up finance and corporate finance layered on top. Founded in 2023 by experienced CXOs, Falconsage is a finance, legal and HR consultancy serving 15+ early-stage and cross-border companies across 5 countries in AI, SaaS and software.

Roughly 70% of the role is hands-on accounting: closing books, running compliance and building clean, diligence-ready financials. The remaining 30% is where you grow: budgets, forecasts, financial models, fundraising support and corporate-finance advisory alongside our finance partners. Direct founder exposure and a clear path into controllership and virtual-CFO work.

What you will do

**Accounting and compliance (core)**

* Own monthly close for a portfolio of US and Indian client entities: bank and card postings, accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, intercompany and reconciliations
* Maintain books under US GAAP in QuickBooks Online / Xero, and under Ind AS or Indian GAAP in Tally or Zoho Books
* Run AP and AR cycles: vendor bills, customer invoicing, collections follow-up and ageing reports
* Prepare monthly MIS, provisional financial statements and variance commentary for founders
* Support US compliance: payroll reconciliations (941, W-2, 1099), sales-tax nexus analysis, franchise and estimated tax workings, Form 5471/5472 inputs
* Support Indian compliance: TDS, GST, year-end audit schedules and ITR inputs
* Prepare consolidated US–India financials and transfer-pricing workings with the finance partners
* Clean up and realign historic books ahead of fundraising or M&A diligence
* Build and maintain chart-of-accounts, SOPs and month-end checklists; coordinate with auditors, CPAs and client teams

**FP&A, start-up and corporate finance**

* Build and maintain annual operating plans, budgets, rolling forecasts and budget-vs-actual reviews
* Maintain financial models: revenue, burn, runway, unit economics and scenario analysis for founders and investors
* Track SaaS and start-up KPIs (ARR, churn, CAC, gross margin) and turn them into board and investor reporting
* Support fundraising: data-room preparation, investor Q&A, cap-table and ESOP workings
* Assist on corporate-finance work: transaction advisory, valuation inputs, term-sheet analysis and new-market-entry costing

What we are looking for

**Must have**

* CA, CA Inter, CMA, or M.Com / MBA (Finance) with 4–7 years of hands-on accounting experience
* Strong command of accounting fundamentals: accrual accounting, revenue recognition, reconciliations and full monthly close
* Proven ownership of books for multiple entities, ideally in an outsourced accounting, KPO or CA-firm environment
* Advanced Excel / Google Sheets (lookups, pivots, data cleanup) and fluency in at least one cloud accounting platform (QuickBooks Online, Xero, Zoho Books or Tally)
* Clear written English; comfortable with US client calls in evening IST hours (overlap up to roughly 9 pm IST)

**Strongly preferred**

* 2+ years working on US books under US GAAP for US clients or a US-headquartered employer
* Exposure to US payroll providers (Gusto, Rippling, ADP), sales tax (Avalara, TaxJar) and bill-pay tools (Bill.com, Ramp, Brex)
* Familiarity with US entity structures (Delaware C-Corp with Indian subsidiary), Forms 1099, 5471/5472 and franchise tax
* US CPA / EA (completed or in progress) is a plus

**Who thrives here**

* Detail-obsessed, deadline-driven and comfortable juggling 6–10 client entities
* Proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than at month-end
* Curious about start-ups and keen to grow into controllership and virtual-CFO work

Compensation, location and how to apply

* **CTC:**
  up to INR 12 LPA, depending on experience and depth of US accounting exposure
* **Location:**
  Bengaluru preferred; remote within India considered for strong US-accounting candidates
* **Type:**
  Full-time; evening overlap with US clients expected a few days a week
* **Reports to:**
  Finance Partner, Falconsage LLP
* **Growth:**
  direct path to Controller and virtual-CFO engagements across US and Indian start-ups

**To apply:**
email your CV to info@falconsage.com with the subject line "Finance Associate". Add two lines on the US or multi-entity books you have owned and the tools you used.

Falconsage LLP is an equal-opportunity employer.

**Role: Senior Analyst- Business Insights (Finance)**
**Location: Bangalore**
**Who are we and What do we do?**
InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data, and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.
  
  
**What’s the InMobi family like?**
Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.
  
  
**What do we promise?**
We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training, and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.
  
  
**Why should you join us?**
You will contribute to creating disruptive and innovative consumer experiences using technology. We value autonomy, collaboration, technical innovation, and results-oriented thinking. InMobi’s culture is all about rewarding excellence so there are fantastic opportunities for the right candidates!
  
  
Finance BI team is part of FP&A and is responsible to upscale the organization towards data driven strategic decision making by adding the intelligence layer on top of this data - to unlock the huge potential that the right analytics could provide. This intelligence layer will be consumed towards unlocking productivity, realizing efficiencies, improving RoI for our various Products.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own finance data end to end**

* Act as SME for finance data sources, definitions, and business logic across FP&A, Accounting, Revenue, and Business Units.
* Design and build Python and Spark (PySpark) pipelines that ingest, transform, and reconcile data from ERP, billing, ad platform, and operational systems into a governed analytics layer.
* Model data for finance use cases (P&L, unit economics, forecasting inputs, variance analysis, close reporting) with clear lineage and documented logic.
* Connect disconnected datasets across businesses and tools to create a single version of truth.

**Analyze and find the signal**

* Apply statistical methods to explain performance: regression, time-series forecasting, variance decomposition, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* Explore large, messy datasets to find patterns, explain why numbers move, and turn those findings into recommendations leaders can act on.
* Validate models and metrics rigorously, including back-testing forecasts and quantifying uncertainty.

**Automate reporting and decision support**

* Replace manual reporting with automated, scheduled, and tested data solutions.
* Build interactive dashboards and metrics layers in Rill and Power BI that summarize performance and surface recommended actions, not just charts.
* Define metrics once in a governed semantic layer so every dashboard reports the same numbers.

**Build AI agents and intelligent workflows**

* Design and deploy automations, reporting and insight generation using agents and workflows for tasks such as commentary drafting, anomaly explanation, reconciliation checks, and ad hoc data Q&A.
* Identify where agents create real leverage and where simpler automation is the better answer.

**Work independently and drive outcomes**

* Scope requirements directly with stakeholders, make reasonable trade-offs, and deliver without step-by-step direction.
* Own the full lifecycle: technical design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and issue resolution.
* Write modular, reusable, version-controlled code that others can maintain.

**Tool Stack**

* Python: data processing, automation, statistical analysis, and LLM integration
* Spark / PySpark: large-scale transformation (on Databricks or equivalent)
* SQL: modeling and analysis
* Rill: metrics views and operational dashboards
* Power BI: executive reporting
* Claude / LLM APIs: agent and workflow development
* Git: version control

**What We Are Looking For**
**Must-have**

* 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or finance systems.
* Python: 2+ years, including writing tested, modular code for data pipelines and automation.
* Spark / PySpark: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production jobs on Databricks or a comparable platform.
* SQL: Strong, with experience modeling data for analytics and finance use cases.
* Rill or a comparable BI-as-code tool (Looker LookML, Cube, or similar): 1+ year of hands-on use, or a demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.
* Power BI: Working knowledge of data modeling and DAX (or equivalent).
* Statistics: Applied experience with regression, time-series forecasting, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* ETL/ELT and lakehouse experience: Hands-on with tools such as Databricks, dbt, or Airflow, and familiarity with warehouse and lakehouse architecture.
* LLM APIs: Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude preferred), including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation.
* Finance fundamentals: Solid understanding of accounting, financial statements, and FP&A concepts. Able to build and check financial models.
* End-to-end delivery: A track record of translating a business problem into a sustainable data product and working independently as the go-to person for a domain.
* Communication: Able to document decisions, write clear specs, and explain results to non-technical leaders.
* Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.

**Good to have**

* Experience with agent frameworks (MCP, LangGraph, or similar) and multi-step AI workflow orchestration.
* Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or an equivalent cloud data certification.
* Exposure to ad tech, digital media, or high-volume transactional businesses.

**Key Traits**

* Ownership: You take a problem from vague request to working solution without waiting to be told how.
* Curiosity: You explore data, find patterns in messy datasets, and ask why numbers move.
* Pragmatism: You choose the simplest solution that is reliable, maintainable, and actually used.
* Collaboration: You align Finance, Product, and Tech stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.
* Bias for results: Strategy only matters once it turns into outcomes.

**The InMobi Culture**
At InMobi, culture isn’t a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.
  
  
We believe in nurturing and investing in your development through continuous learning and career progression with our InMobi Live Your Potential program.

title: Business Finance Manager (Solar IPP & EPC)
description:
Business Finance Manager / Controller — Solar IPP & EPC

Sturlite Greentech (ZEOVOLT) | Bengaluru | Full-time

Reports to: Group CFO, Sturlite Group and CEO, Sturlite Greentech

Team: One direct report (Business Finance Analyst)

ABOUT STURLITE GREENTECH

Sturlite Greentech is the clean-energy platform of the Sturlite Group, a ₹700+ Cr FMEG and lighting business with a 16,000+ dealer network across 28 states. Greentech is being built as a standalone C&I solar Independent Power Producer (IPP) with an in-house EPC capability, a group-captive SPV model, and a clear ambition to scale into a listed platform. We develop, build, own and operate solar assets, sign long-term PPAs with commercial and industrial offtakers, and use structured financing (project debt, sale-and-leaseback, land-lease programmes) to recycle capital into the next project.

We are looking for the person who owns the numbers behind every one of those decisions.

THE ROLE

This is the finance brain of the IPP and EPC business. You will sit at the intersection of project evaluation, deal structuring, capital allocation and risk, and you will be the person who tells the CEO and Group CFO whether a project deserves to be built, on what terms, and whether it is delivering once it is.

You will be instrumental in conducting and driving the project Gate Meetings — the forum where every opportunity is approved, re-scoped or killed — and you will be accountable for the quality of the analysis that goes into them. You will be critical to evaluating the risks associated with each project and defining the mitigation strategies, working closely with the project and sales teams throughout.

This is not a bookkeeping or statutory-reporting role. It is a commercial finance role for someone who is comfortable reading a PPA as closely as a cash-flow model.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Project evaluation and capital decisions

* Build and own project financial models for every IPP and EPC opportunity: capex, tariff, generation, degradation, O&M, financing, tax and residual value.
* Compute and defend project and equity IRR, DSCR, payback and NPV; run sensitivity and scenario analysis on tariff, CUF, capex, interest rates, ALMM/duty changes and offtaker credit.
* Drive capital allocation decisions across projects and SPVs — which projects get built, in what sequence, and with what mix of debt, equity and lease finance.
* Drive the Gate Meetings: prepare the case with the project and sales teams, frame the go/no-go criteria, present the analysis, record decisions and follow through on conditions.

Deal structuring and optimisation

* Structure group-captive SPV arrangements (equity splits, offtaker contribution, performance guarantee deposits, buy-back mechanics) and evaluate alternatives.
* Work with lenders, NBFCs and lessors on project debt, sale-and-leaseback and master rental structures; model the economics and negotiate commercial terms alongside the CFO.
* Identify optimisation levers across the project lifecycle — procurement, financing cost, GST/tax treatment, land structures, EPC margin — and quantify them.

Project profitability, tracking and control

* Track budget vs. actual on every project under construction and in operation: capex slippage, schedule slippage, cost overruns, generation vs. P50/P90, collections and receivables.
* Own EPC job costing and margin reporting; flag variances early and drive corrective action with the project, sales and procurement teams.
* Build the management dashboard for the IPP portfolio and EPC pipeline; present monthly to the CEO and Group CFO.

Risk and contracts

* Evaluate the risks associated with each project — commercial, contractual, regulatory, execution and offtaker credit — and define and track the mitigation strategies with the project and sales teams.
* Read and assess PPAs, EPC contracts, lease/rental agreements, land leases, performance bank guarantees and lender term sheets from a risk-and-economics standpoint.
* Identify commercial and legal exposures — termination, change-in-law, curtailment, deemed generation, step-in rights, buy-back and ownership provisions — and ensure they are priced or mitigated before approval.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel, lenders' advisors and technical consultants during diligence and financial close.

Team

* Manage and develop one direct report who supports modelling, data collection and reporting.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

* MBA (Finance) from a Tier 1 institute (IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR or equivalent) or a Chartered Accountant (first-attempt qualifiers preferred), with a minimum of 5 years of post-qualification experience in business finance, project finance, corporate finance or investment roles.
* Prior experience in renewable energy, infrastructure or EPC (IPP, developer, lender or advisory side) is strongly preferred but not mandatory — we value analytical rigour and commercial judgement over sector tenure.
* Hands-on mastery of project financial modelling — you have built models from scratch, not just reviewed them.
* Demonstrated experience with project debt, lease finance or structured transactions; exposure to sale-and-leaseback or group-captive structures is a strong plus.
* A legal bent of mind: you read contracts closely, spot the clause that changes the economics, and are comfortable negotiating commercial terms with counsel and counterparties.
* Working knowledge of the Indian solar regulatory landscape — open access, group captive rules, ALMM, GST on renewable assets, state policy nuances — or the ability to get up to speed on it fast.
* Strong business judgement and the confidence to say no to a project in front of senior leadership, with the analysis to back it.
* Structured communicator who can turn a 40-tab model into a one-page decision.
* Comfortable in an entrepreneurial, fast-moving environment where processes are still being built — and willing to build them.

WHY THIS ROLE

* You will shape the capital-allocation discipline of a platform being built for scale, not maintain one that already exists.
* Direct exposure to the Group CFO and CEO, and to lenders, potential investors, family offices and strategic counterparties.

LOCATION AND COMPENSATION

Bengaluru, with travel to project sites and offtaker locations. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

To apply: Send your CV and a short note on a project you evaluated or structured — and what you would have done differently — to hr2@sturlite.com.

description:
𝗪𝗘'𝗥𝗘 𝗛𝗜𝗥𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝟯 𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗜𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗧 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗚𝗘𝗥𝗦 – 𝗕𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦𝗦 & 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗗𝗨𝗖𝗧 𝗖𝗢𝗡𝗧𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚 (𝗖𝗠𝗔)

Sturlite Electric Private Limited

📍 Bengaluru, Karnataka | On-site | Full-time

Three businesses. Thousands of SKUs. One question: where exactly do we make money?

Sturlite Electric is one of India's established names in lighting and electricals, with a network of 16,000+ dealers across 25 states. We're scaling our lighting manufacturing and building two new businesses from scratch, Wires & Cables and Switches.

New businesses need cost and margin numbers they can trust from day one. We're looking for three Cost Accountants who will build those numbers, keep them honest, and help the people running these businesses act on them.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👥 𝗧𝗛𝗥𝗘𝗘 𝗣𝗢𝗦𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦, 𝗢𝗡𝗘 𝗙𝗢𝗥 𝗘𝗔𝗖𝗛 𝗕𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦𝗦

🔌 𝗪𝗶𝗿𝗲𝘀 & 𝗖𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲𝘀

🔘 𝗦𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗰𝗵𝗲𝘀

💡 𝗟𝗶𝗴𝗵𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝘂𝗳𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘂𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴

Each role owns business and product controlling for one business unit. Experience in a similar category (cables, wiring devices, lighting or consumer electricals) will be a strong advantage for that role but not necessarily a pre-requisite

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🎯 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘

You'll own business and product controlling for your business unit end to end.

You'll report to the Group Finance Controller and work directly with your BU head as their finance partner in decision-making. You'll also work every day with plant teams, procurement and sales.

You'll be part of a team of three controllers working side by side, sharing costing standards, methods and learnings across the group.

This is not a reporting role. You'll be the person who can explain why a SKU's margin moved, what the options are, and what we should do about it.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

📈 𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗦𝗨𝗖𝗖𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗟𝗢𝗢𝗞𝗦 𝗟𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗜𝗡 𝗬𝗢𝗨𝗥 𝗙𝗜𝗥𝗦𝗧 𝗬𝗘𝗔𝗥

▸ 𝗙𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝟵𝟬 𝗱𝗮𝘆𝘀: Validated standard costs and BOM-based cost sheets live for every active SKU in your business

▸ 𝗕𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵 𝟲: A monthly product-level P&L and margin bridge that your BU head uses in reviews, and the first round of plant-level audits completed, with action points closed

▸ 𝗕𝘆 𝗺𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗵 𝟭𝟮: A working variance loop where every material, yield and conversion variance has an owner and a fix, and costing drives pricing, sourcing and investment decisions

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🛠️ 𝗪𝗛𝗔𝗧 𝗬𝗢𝗨'𝗟𝗟 𝗗𝗢

𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗣𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝘆𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗕𝗨 𝗛𝗲𝗮𝗱

• Act as the finance partner to your BU head

• Support decisions on pricing, product mix, sourcing, capacity and channel strategy with clear numbers and scenario analysis

• Bring the margin story to monthly business reviews: what moved, why, and what to do next

• Challenge assumptions constructively and make sure decisions are grounded in cost and profitability data

𝗣𝗿𝗼𝗱𝘂𝗰𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴 & 𝗖𝗼𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴

• Build and maintain standard costs, BOMs and cost sheets for every SKU

• Analyse variances in material price, usage, conversion and overhead absorption, and follow through with plant and procurement teams until each one is fixed

• Track commodity exposure on copper, aluminium, PVC, polycarbonate and electronic components, and show how it affects margins and pricing

• Support new launches with should-cost models, target costing and pricing inputs

• Support make-vs-buy and OEM/job-work evaluations

𝗕𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴

• Prepare monthly P&L reviews: actual vs budget, and contribution by product, channel and region

• Support the annual operating plan, rolling forecasts and capex evaluations

• Track working capital, inventory health, and slow-moving and obsolete stock

• Maintain KPI dashboards for business and leadership reviews

𝗔𝘂𝗱𝗶𝘁𝘀, 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹𝘀 & 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲

• Manage cost audit and cost records compliance under the Companies Act, and act as the point of contact with cost auditors

• Plan and conduct plant-level audits covering inventory, consumption, yield and scrap, process controls, and job-work reconciliations

• Strengthen inventory valuation, costing processes and plant-level controls based on audit findings

• Build costing discipline into the ERP and automate recurring MIS

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

✅ 𝗬𝗢𝗨'𝗟𝗟 𝗧𝗛𝗥𝗜𝗩𝗘 𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗘 𝗜𝗙 𝗬𝗢𝗨

• Are a qualified Cost Accountant (CMA/CWA) with at least 4–5 years of post-qualification experience in costing and business controlling in manufacturing, ideally electricals, FMEG, cables or consumer durables will be an added bonus.

• Have hands-on experience with cost audits (statutory cost audit, cost records and CRA forms) and with plant-level audits (physical verification, consumption and yield audits, and internal control reviews)

• Have worked directly with BU or plant heads as a finance partner, supporting real business decisions, not just producing reports

• Know standard costing, BOM costing and variance analysis well enough to explain them on the shop floor, not just in a spreadsheet

• Work hands-on in an ERP (SAP CO/FICO preferred) and in advanced Excel; Power BI is a plus

• Are comfortable questioning a plant team on yields and presenting options to your BU head with equal clarity

• Are willing to travel to our manufacturing locations

⚠️ 𝗧𝗛𝗜𝗦 𝗥𝗢𝗟𝗘 𝗠𝗔𝗬 𝗡𝗢𝗧 𝗦𝗨𝗜𝗧 𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗜𝗙

You prefer a fully set-up function with every process already in place. Two of these three businesses are new, and you'll be building as much as running.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

🚀 𝗪𝗛𝗬 𝗝𝗢𝗜𝗡 𝗨𝗦

▸ 𝗢𝘄𝗻 𝗮 𝗯𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀: Be the dedicated controller for one BU, not one of many on a shared desk

▸ 𝗕𝘂𝗶𝗹𝗱, 𝗱𝗼𝗻'𝘁 𝗶𝗻𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗶𝘁: Set up controlling for a new business from the ground up, or sharpen it in an established one

▸ 𝗔 𝘀𝗲𝗮𝘁 𝗮𝘁 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲: Work directly with your BU head, and your analysis will feed straight into pricing, sourcing and investment decisions

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions | Valuation & Modeling | Complex Securities Valuation | Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
**Level: Senior or equivalent**
As a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards . You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**The team:**
The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.
  
  
**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**
The key job responsibilities will be to:
  
  

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level - degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 1-4 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* CFA Level II cleared or appeared
* Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse client contacts
* Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.

**Education:**

* Master's level - degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, Business Administration in Finance

title: Treasury Finance - Leading E-Commerce Company - Bangalore
description:
Employer          - Leading E- Commerce Company

Role.                -  Treasury Finance

Job Location    -  Bangalore

Experience  - 6-8 Years

**Role summary:**

We are seeking a Treasury Lead with 6–8 years of hardcore corporate treasury

experience in loan agreement negotiation with banks, cash flow planning, and

endtoend banking operations in a fastpaced ecommerce/retail or allied environment.

The role will independently own the full treasury stack – from WCDL/SBLC and loan

documentation to cashflow forecasting, BRS, compliances, audit support, and

seniormanagement MIS – while leading process improvements and acting as the

primary interface with bankers and internal stakeholders

**Key responsibilities**

1
**. Banking operations ownership**

o Independently oversee and execute daily banking transactions: vendor

payments, marketplace settlements, statutory dues, employee

reimbursements, and interbank fund movements across multiple bank

relationships.

o Ensure strong control on cutoff timings, dual authorization, and

documentation for all treasury payments.

2
**. Loan agreements & WCDL lifecycle management**

o Lead endtoend working capital and term loan processes – from term

sheet evaluation, covenant analysis, and loan agreement negotiation

with banks to documentation closure.

o Own the complete WCDL cycle: drawdown requests, utilization

tracking, repayment scheduling, interest computation, limit renewals,

and covenant compliance, ensuring zero delays or default.

3.
**SBLC / BG management**

o Manage issuance, renewal, amendment, and closure of Standby

Letters of Credit and other bank guarantees.

o Maintain a robust register of all SBLC/BG instruments with validity,

value, and purpose; proactively coordinate with banks and business

teams on expiry and collateral requirements.

**4. Bank reconciliation (BRS)**

o Own daily and monthly BRS across all bank accounts, including

payment gateways and marketplace accounts.

o Set up systematic workflows for openitem identification and closure;

drive a “zerooutstanding beyond agreed SLA” culture.

**5. Cashflow forecasting & fund planning**

o Build and maintain shortterm (daily/weekly) and mediumterm

(monthly/quarterly) cashflow models at entity and group level.

o Monitor daily liquidity, anticipate funding gaps, and recommend

deployment of surplus funds or drawdown of facilities to optimize

interest cost.

**6. Accounting & Tally ERP**

o Ensure accurate and timely posting of all treasuryrelated entries in Tally

ERP – JVs, payment vouchers, contra entries, interest accruals, and

periodend adjustments – with full supporting documentation.

o Coordinate closely with the GL, AP, and tax teams for smooth

monthend and yearend closing.

**7. MIS & treasury analytics**

o Design, publish, and continuously improve weekly and monthly

treasury MIS dashboards, covering: bank balances, fund positions,

payment summaries, WCDL utilization, interest cost trends, covenant

status, and variancetoplan for Finance leadership.

o Provide actionable insights on cost of funds, idle cash, and utilization

efficiency; suggest optimization levers.

**8. Audit management**

o Lead preparation of treasury schedules and evidence for internal,

statutory, and tax audits.

o Proactively close priorperiod audit observations related to treasury and

strengthen controls to target “nil observations” in subsequent audits.

**9. Compliance & risk controls**

o Ensure compliance with internal treasury policies, banking covenants,

RBI guidelines, and statutory payment timelines (TDS, GST, PF, ESIC,

etc.).

o Flag potential covenant breaches, document lapses, or operational

risks in advance to the Finance Head and help implement mitigating

actions.

**10. Banking & stakeholder management**

o Act as the primary treasury interface with banks and financial

institutions for limits, pricing, documentation, and issue resolution.

o Collaborate closely with Accounts Payable, Tax, Legal, and

Marketplace Finance teams to align cashflow planning with business

decisions.

**11. Process improvement & automation**

o Identify bottlenecks in treasury processes (payments, reconciliations,

loan documentation, MIS collation) and propose technology or process

solutions (Tally automation, bank API, Excel models, etc.)

o Lead implementation of approved initiatives to reduce manual effort,

TAT, reconciliation issues, and interest leakage.

**Competencies and skills :**

 Strong understanding of corporate banking products – WCDL, CC/OD, SBLC, BGs, term loans, and trade finance.iimjobs+1

 Handson experience with Tally ERP and internet banking platforms.

 High ownership, attention to detail, and ability to work under tight timelines in a highvelocity environment.
