title: Senior Analyst - Finance Business Insights
description:
**Role: Senior Analyst- Business Insights (Finance)**

**Location: Bangalore**

**Who are we and What do we do?**

InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data, and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.

**What’s the InMobi family like?**

Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.

**What do we promise?**

We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training, and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.

**Why should you join us?**

You will contribute to creating disruptive and innovative consumer experiences using technology. We value autonomy, collaboration, technical innovation, and results-oriented thinking. InMobi’s culture is all about rewarding excellence so there are fantastic opportunities for the right candidates!

Finance BI team is part of FP&A and is responsible to upscale the organization towards data driven strategic decision making by adding the intelligence layer on top of this data - to unlock the huge potential that the right analytics could provide. This intelligence layer will be consumed towards unlocking productivity, realizing efficiencies, improving RoI for our various Products.

**What You Will Do**

**Own finance data end to end**

* Act as SME for finance data sources, definitions, and business logic across FP&A, Accounting, Revenue, and Business Units.
* Design and build Python and Spark (PySpark) pipelines that ingest, transform, and reconcile data from ERP, billing, ad platform, and operational systems into a governed analytics layer.
* Model data for finance use cases (P&L, unit economics, forecasting inputs, variance analysis, close reporting) with clear lineage and documented logic.
* Connect disconnected datasets across businesses and tools to create a single version of truth.

**Analyze and find the signal**

* Apply statistical methods to explain performance: regression, time-series forecasting, variance decomposition, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* Explore large, messy datasets to find patterns, explain why numbers move, and turn those findings into recommendations leaders can act on.
* Validate models and metrics rigorously, including back-testing forecasts and quantifying uncertainty.

**Automate reporting and decision support**

* Replace manual reporting with automated, scheduled, and tested data solutions.
* Build interactive dashboards and metrics layers in Rill and Power BI that summarize performance and surface recommended actions, not just charts.
* Define metrics once in a governed semantic layer so every dashboard reports the same numbers.

**Build AI agents and intelligent workflows**

* Design and deploy automations, reporting and insight generation using agents and workflows for tasks such as commentary drafting, anomaly explanation, reconciliation checks, and ad hoc data Q&A.
* Identify where agents create real leverage and where simpler automation is the better answer.

**Work independently and drive outcomes**

* Scope requirements directly with stakeholders, make reasonable trade-offs, and deliver without step-by-step direction.
* Own the full lifecycle: technical design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and issue resolution.
* Write modular, reusable, version-controlled code that others can maintain.

**Tool Stack**

* **Python:**
  data processing, automation, statistical analysis, and LLM integration
* **Spark / PySpark:**
  large-scale transformation (on Databricks or equivalent)
* **SQL:**
  modeling and analysis
* **Rill:**
  metrics views and operational dashboards
* **Power BI:**
  executive reporting
* **Claude / LLM APIs:**
  agent and workflow development
* **Git:**
  version control

**What We Are Looking For**

**Must-have**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or finance systems.
* **Python:**
  3+ years, including writing tested, modular code for data pipelines and automation.
* **Spark / PySpark:**
  2+ years of hands-on experience building production jobs on Databricks or a comparable platform.
* **SQL:**
  Strong, with experience modeling data for analytics and finance use cases.
* **Rill or a comparable BI-as-code tool**
  (Looker LookML, Cube, or similar): 1+ year of hands-on use, or a demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.
* **Power BI:**
  Working knowledge of data modeling and DAX (or equivalent).
* **Statistics:**
  Applied experience with regression, time-series forecasting, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.
* **ETL/ELT and lakehouse experience:**
  Hands-on with tools such as Databricks, dbt, or Airflow, and familiarity with warehouse and lakehouse architecture.
* **LLM APIs:**
  Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude preferred), including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation.
* **Finance fundamentals:**
  Solid understanding of accounting, financial statements, and FP&A concepts. Able to build and check financial models.
* **End-to-end delivery:**
  A track record of translating a business problem into a sustainable data product and working independently as the go-to person for a domain.
* **Communication:**
  Able to document decisions, write clear specs, and explain results to non-technical leaders.
* Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.

**Good to have**

* Experience with agent frameworks (MCP, LangGraph, or similar) and multi-step AI workflow orchestration.
* Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or an equivalent cloud data certification.
* Exposure to ad tech, digital media, or high-volume transactional businesses.

**Key Traits**

* **Ownership:**
  You take a problem from vague request to working solution without waiting to be told how.
* **Curiosity:**
  You explore data, find patterns in messy datasets, and ask why numbers move.
* **Pragmatism:**
  You choose the simplest solution that is reliable, maintainable, and actually used.
* **Collaboration:**
  You align Finance, Product, and Tech stakeholders on priorities and trade-offs.
* **Bias for results:**
  Strategy only matters once it turns into outcomes.

title: Product Lead, Finance Experience
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.85B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a Product Lead to run the Finance Experience team, a new team that owns shared experiences across the finance suite: forms, permissions, policies, notifications, and APIs. In this role, you will identify how the suite can share common solutions to many customers’ problems, and build towards a consistent admin- and employee-facing UX across our finance suite. You’ll define a vision for the suite’s shared experiences and share that vision with PMs and engineers across the organization. This role will work with a dedicated engineering team and will closely collaborate with all teams in the suite.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Define the vision and roadmap for the Finance Experience team, who are responsible for shared products across the Finance suite.
* Own the admin configuration experience for the suite as we go further upmarket, ensuring that admins can seamlessly configure dynamic policies, workflows, reports, forms, and permissions.
* Own the employee-facing experience for custom forms, approvals, notifications, and tasks within the Finance suite to build a world-class, consumer-grade product.
* Partner with platform teams to ensure that the Rippling platform is evolving in ways that are compatible with the needs of our finance users.
* Partner with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to launch polished features that move the needle with new and existing customers.
* Build for some of Rippling’s largest and most complex customers, and generalize those learnings into products that can serve thousands more.
* Make thoughtful prioritization calls across customer commitments, platform reliability, and strategic AI investments.

**What You Will Need**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally with exposure to finance or spend management systems, enterprise software, no-code automation tools, or other B2B SaaS.
* Systems thinking: You can find the common denominators of 5+ finance products (and understand the customer needs they address), and design solutions that work across the suite.
* AI-pilled: You understand that AI changes the way work happens, for yourself, your team, and your customers. You fold AI into the products you build for customers, and you leverage AI in your day-to-day work to maximize your efficiency.
* Technical judgment: You understand the data models that compose the system, identify where designs will fail, and partner with engineering to build products that are reliable, scalable, and easy for customers to trust.
* Customer empathy and judgment: You can find the root causes for customer issues and understand the underlying flexibility they need, and you can build the product customers will love using.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity, make tradeoffs, and drive alignment across engineering, design, support, implementation, and GTM teams.
* Excellent written and verbal communication: You can convince product and engineering leaders across the suite to adopt your products, and you can distill the needs of customers to make technical arguments in favor of your solutions.
* Bias for ownership and follow-through: You don’t just ship features; you own whether the workflow works in production.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.
  
  
****Nice to have****

* Experience as a product manager on a platform team balancing the needs of multiple downstream product teams
* Experience building products for enterprise or multi-entity customers
* Experience as a software engineer is not required, but can help thinking
* Experience building AI-assisted or automated operational workflows is a plus.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
**Summary**
This role will support global Finance stakeholders and may require periodic overlap with PT working hours for key meetings, stakeholder touchpoints, transition activities, and close or forecast-related support. The candidate should be comfortable flexing selectively when business needs require cross-time-zone coordination. The Finance Center of Excellence (COE) is focused on centralizing, standardizing, and modernizing key financial operations to unlock scale, accuracy, and strategic capacity. The team acts as business process owners, driving design and continuous improvement across high-impact financial workflows. This role will support all core operational workstreams, delivering through a blend of in-house execution, process optimization, and automation and agentic tooling.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Financial Operations & Process Execution:**
  + Support execution of recurring Finance COE processes, including position management, headcount forecasting, expense accruals, general month-end close support, and other related operational workflows.
  + Own assigned process steps end-to-end, ensuring outputs are accurate, complete, timely, and aligned to agreed standards, timelines, and stakeholder expectations.
  + Maintain and update trackers, reconciliations, and reporting files used to support defined scope of work and operational decision-making.
  + Validate source data across systems, stakeholder inputs, and reporting outputs, investigating discrepancies and escalating issues where appropriate.
  + Support weekly, monthly, and quarterly operating cycles by preparing analysis, consolidating inputs, tracking process status, and ensuring deliverables are completed on time.
* **Process Improvement & Domain Expertise:**
  + Build deep expertise in assigned COE workstreams and serve as a knowledgeable execution partner for recurring financial processes.
  + Apply critical thinking to evaluate outputs, pressure test assumptions, and challenge process steps or stakeholder requests when they do not align with the data, process design, or intended business outcome.
  + Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve processes based on recurring pain points, stakeholder feedback, data quality issues, or manual effort.
  + Recommend practical process improvements that improve accuracy, efficiency, consistency, and stakeholder experience.
  + Assist in documenting workflows, process steps, controls, FAQs, and standard operating procedures to support repeatability, onboarding, and business continuity.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:**
  + Partner with Finance stakeholders, systems teams, and COE team members to gather inputs, resolve process questions, and support successful execution of assigned workstreams.
  + Communicate clearly on process status, risks, blockers, and required stakeholder actions.
  + Support cross-time-zone collaboration with India and NAMER-based partners, including periodic NAMER overlap for critical meetings, deliverables, and business-cycle activities.
  + Translate stakeholder feedback and recurring business needs into clear recommendations for process or reporting improvements.
  + Help drive adoption of standardized ways of working by reinforcing process expectations, documentation, and consistent execution.
* **Tools, Systems & Automation:**
  + Use Excel and other financial or reporting tools to maintain models, reporting outputs, reconciliations, and analytical deliverables.
  + Support adoption of new tools, templates, automation, AI-enabled workflows, and process enhancements where applicable.
  + Partner with team members to identify manual steps that could be streamlined, automated, or better controlled.
  + Assist with testing, validation, and documentation for process or tooling changes.
* **Culture & Values:**
  + Contribute to a team culture grounded in ownership, learning, inclusion, curiosity, and continuous improvement.
  + Collaborate effectively with teammates and stakeholders across locations, functions, and time zones.
  + Demonstrate strong judgment, accountability, and professionalism when handling financial data, recurring deliverables, and stakeholder requests.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* Financial Acumen
* Stakeholder Management
* Process Redesign
* Data Analysis
* Experience with Oracle ERP
* Project & Change Management

 
  
**Education & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in FP&A, Finance Operations, Accounting, Business Operations, or a related analytical finance role.
* Experience using Excel to manage, analyze, reconcile, and summarize financial or operational data.
* Experience supporting recurring financial processes, reporting cycles, reconciliations, planning, forecasting, accruals, headcount, expense management, or related workflows.
* Experience supporting financial operations such as headcount forecasting, position management, accruals, month-end close, non-labor expense management, reporting, or planning processes.
* Analytical background working directly in an FP&A environment modeling bookings, revenue, headcount, and expenses.
* Understanding of accounting theory and practice (e.g., basic revenue recognition rules, accruals, company capitalization policies, and proper expense timing).
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and summarize findings clearly.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy, completeness, and timely execution.
* Ability to learn complex processes quickly and develop strong domain expertise over time.
* Demonstrated ability to question outputs, pressure test assumptions, and raise thoughtful challenges when something does not align with the data or process intent.
* Experience documenting processes, workflows, controls, or standard operating procedures.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate across functions and time zones.
* Comfort operating in a global delivery model, including periodic overlap with NAMER hours for key business needs.
* Experience with financial systems and reporting tools such as Oracle, Workday, EPM/Essbase, Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar tools.
* Proactive problem solver with strong ownership, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities with limited supervision.

title: FINANCE OPERATIONS-SCO-Proc-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-GDS: Business Consulting -SC&O (Supply Chain & Operations) – Manager (Procurement Operations)**
As part of our EY‑GDS team, you will play a critical role in shaping and elevating our clients’ Procurement Operations. As a manager, you will lead complex engagements that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen compliance and controls, and embed digital solutions across the end‑to‑end procurement lifecycle. You will guide teams in delivering measurable improvements in service delivery, process performance, and procurement maturity, while developing the next generation of operations talent. Your leadership and operational expertise will directly influence how our clients modernize their procurement function. Additionally, you will contribute to building our procurement operations capability, supporting go‑to‑market initiatives, and leading key operational excellence pursuits.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Manager with 8–10 years of strong procurement and supply chain operations expertise, backed by a solid Managed Service background and deep knowledge across core procurement sub‑functions such as P2P, sourcing operations, supplier management, contract, spend analytics and operational governance. The ideal candidate will be a strategic, operations‑focused leader capable of designing and optimizing procurement operating models, driving process excellence, embedding digital procurement capabilities, and leading large‑scale transformation initiatives. This role requires exceptional stakeholder management, the ability to build trusted relationships at senior levels, and the leadership skills necessary to guide high‑performing teams while delivering measurable, high‑impact improvements in procurement operations.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The Manager will lead end‑to‑end Procurement Operations across PR‑to‑PO processing, Contract Lifecycle Management, Supplier Management, Spend Analytics, and Managed Services Governance. Responsibilities include overseeing the requisition‑to‑order process, ensuring contract activation, amendments, renewals, and compliance, and aligning all transactions with contracts, catalogs, and pricing agreements. The role will also manage transitions through knowledge transfer, documentation, readiness assessments, and stabilization while ensuring SLA performance and continuous improvement. Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following:
  
  

* PR to PO Operations & Contract Management

+ Lead end-to-end PR to PO operations, including requisition processing, approvals, PO creation, amendments, and closures.
+ Oversee Contract Lifecycle Management, including contract activation, amendments, renewals, expiry management, and compliance.
+ Ensure alignment between PR/PO transactions and active contracts, catalogs, and pricing agreements.
+ Govern procurement controls, approval matrices, and audit readiness across operations.

* Transition Management & Service Stabilization

+ Lead transition activities for procurement operations, including knowledge transfer, process documentation, and readiness assessments.
+ Manage transition planning across PR-PO and Contract Management processes, ensuring minimal business disruption.
+ Drive stabilization post-transition, including SLA tracking, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.

* Managed Services & Stakeholder Management

+ Manage managed services engagements, including service governance, SLA/KPI management, and performance reviews.
+ Act as the primary interface with client stakeholders, service providers, and internal teams.
+ Drive effective communication, issue escalation, and resolution across procurement operations.

* Procurement Process Integration & Enablement

+ Apply working knowledge of adjacent procurement areas such as supplier onboarding, sourcing handoffs, spend visibility, and compliance.
+ Ensure smooth integration between procurement operations, contracts, and downstream finance processes (e.g., invoice compliance, accruals).
+ Leverage procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, ERP systems, and supplier portals to enable operational efficiency.

* Continuous Improvement & Governance

+ Identify and implement opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation.
+ Support reporting, governance forums, audits, and internal control reviews.
+ Mentor and guide team members within procurement operations.

* Supplier Management & Governance

+ Lead supplier onboarding, performance management, compliance monitoring, and issue resolution.
+ Establish and manage supplier governance frameworks including KPIs, SLAs, scorecards, and review cadences.
+ Monitor supplier risk, dependency, and compliance, and escalate issues to senior stakeholders as required.
+ Act as the primary interface between suppliers, procurement teams, and business stakeholders.

* Spend Analytics & Optimization

+ Lead spends analytics to identify cost reduction, demand management, and value optimization opportunities.
+ Analyse spends across categories, suppliers, and regions to generate actionable insights.
+ Develop and present dashboards, reports, and management insights to support decision-making.
+ Partner with sourcing and finance teams to track savings and benefits realization.
+ Systems Enablement, Managed Services & Stakeholder Leadership
+ Leverage procurement and analytics platforms such as SAP Ariba, ServiceNow, ERP systems, BI tools, and supplier portals to enable supplier governance and spend visibility.
+ Ensure data accuracy, reporting integrity, and adherence to controls.
+ Lead supplier and managed services governance forums, including SLA and performance reviews.
+ Communicate insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior client and internal stakeholders.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* 8–12 years of experience in Supplier Management, Spend Analytics, Procurement Operations, or related roles.
* Strong experience in supplier governance, spend analysis, and stakeholder management.
* Hands-on exposure to procurement and analytics tools such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, iValua, Jaggaer, ServiceNow, ERP platforms, and BI tools.
* Proven ability to operate in managed services and transformation environments.
* Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills.
* Supply chain consulting experience in Big 4, Supply chain global consulting firms preferred
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30%, depending on project requirements

**To qualify for the role, you should have**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain, Finance, Analytics, or related discipline.
* MBA or professional certifications (CIPS, CPSM) preferred.
* Consulting or global delivery experience is an advantage.

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide
* Opportunities to work with EY SCO practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: FP&A Manager – Revenue Operations
description:
**Position Summary**

The Manager, FP&A – Revenue Operations will support the Director of Finance – Customer Operations and partner closely with the Leasing, Collections, and Customer Care teams. This role is responsible for analyzing key business drivers impacting occupancy, ancillary revenue, and credit loss performance, while delivering actionable insights to improve financial and operational results.

This individual will also support labor forecasting for Customer Care centers, track and report on key performance indicators, and help automate recurring reporting and analysis to improve efficiency and decision-making. The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with the Director of Finance – Customer Operations to support financial planning, forecasting, and performance analysis related to revenue management and national operations.
* Analyze business drivers of occupancy, ancillary revenue, and credit loss performance, identifying trends, risks, and opportunities.
* Develop insights and recommendations to improve business performance across Leasing, Collections, and Customer Care.
* Support labor forecasting and capacity planning for Customer Care centers.
* Create, maintain, and enhance KPI dashboards and recurring performance reporting.
* Automate reporting processes and streamline analysis to improve efficiency, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Build and maintain financial models to support forecasting, budgeting, and scenario analysis.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with finance and operational teams to understand performance drivers and support strategic initiatives.
* Prepare clear and concise presentations for leadership using data-driven analysis and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting frameworks, and analytical tools.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in FP&A, finance, analytics, revenue management, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
* Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, and performance analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with both finance and operational teams.
* Experience with process automation and improving reporting efficiency.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear business insights and recommendations.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple priorities.

title: Credit Analyst
description:
Opening for Investment Banking client.

The individual will be responsible for credit analysis of existing or new financial institution clients/counterparties. Day-to-day responsibilities include:

* Assessing the creditworthiness of counterparties: prepare detailed credit application by capturing relevant information as per internal policies, perform credit outlooks, recommend risk ratings using bank’s internal rating tools, and propose global credit limits based on internal risk appetite.
* Obtain RISQ approvals on the ratings and credit limits within the specified timelines, and ensure that the internal systems are accurately updated.
* Process one-off credit requests in a timely manner to meet business deadlines and maintain the annual review cycle.
* Research and analyze financial data on the counterparty to prepare high-quality analysis in credit applications that addresses both client credit risk and transaction risk.
* Knowledge of capital markets and credit-related products, particularly derivatives, securities lending/repo, and trade finance – preferrable.
* Manage key components of counterparty credit administration such as, negotiating and controlling trading legal documentation (ISDA/CSA, GMRA, GMSLA) – preferrable.
* Perform ongoing monitoring of client credit quality to identify a possible deterioration and propose appropriate actions (changes in risk rating & limits).
* Closely monitor developments related to regulatory, industry, counterparty events, and track external rating changes.
* Assist in performing stress tests on banking sectors, and preparing sectoral research and outlook.
* Coordinate and liaise with several internal stakeholders: Relationship Managers/Bankers, Business Lines/Traders, Legal, Risk, KYC, Operations and others.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions - Mergers & Acquisition – I&D Fin - Senior Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**Level:**
Senior Consultant or equivalent
  
  
As an experienced Sr. Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
We guide M&A initiatives for companies to help expand and accelerate revenue and cost synergies, reduce transaction risk, and retain key talent, even as they make structural changes to their business, operating model, or capital model. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
  
  

* Develop client deliverables and documentations
* Identify and select the most relevant set of tools/techniques to meet client requirements such as business case development, financial modeling, and analysis, etc.
* Analyze and interpret project data, draw conclusions, and develop recommendations based on the result of the specific outputs.

* Define project standards, methodologies, and execute process improvement initiatives
* Engage in client interaction:
* Conduct client interviews to verify and validate assumptions, hypothesis, and analysis.
* Participate in workshops and training sessions.
* Synthesize and present insights and recommendations.
* Develop and maintain working relationships with client counterparts.
* Participate in engagement management including:
* Own and manage specific work threads.
* Develop plans for components of engagements.
* Coordinate activities between different work threads.
* Identify and help manage changes in scope.
* Manage and mentor junior resources.

**The Team:**
The M&A team bring deep industry experience, rigorous analytical capabilities, and a pragmatic mindset to solve clients' most complex business problems. Our operational capabilities address the unique issues faced by manufacturing organizations, service businesses and infrastructure operations. These are combined with capabilities in finance, performance management and business restructuring. Our teams take the lead on delivering all aspects of the people side of transactions to our clients. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes for our clients.
  
  
Capabilities of an M&A I&D Finance & Supply Chain practitioner will include the following:
  
  

* Advising clients on separating/carving out a business unit for divestiture and integrating newly acquired target with buyer’s organization with focus on the Finance and / or Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) workstreams.
* Preparing for Day-One (legal ownership transfer) / Day-Two (focus shifts from deal execution to operational transition / TSA exit) planning, business continuity planning, synergy identification / capture and commercial/ operational due diligence with focus on Finance and / or Operations workstreams.
* Preparing and executing Legal Entity Readiness, Finance Function / Operations (Supply Chain, Procurement and/or Manufacturing) Integration & Carve-Out, Transformation planning, Contracts review, Sourcing Strategy Revamp.
* Mapping and documenting current state and future state processes with a focus on Finance Operating Model and / or Operations Operating Model.
* Understanding the end-to-end finance processes such as Order-to-Cash, Record-to-Report, Procure-to-Pay, Close-Consolidate, Taxation etc.
* Conducting contract metadata extraction, contract separation, supplier negotiation Support, operational benchmarking, supply chain ops cost baselining etc.
* Analyzing financial statements and large financial and non-financial data sets.

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Masters in Business Administration
* Masters Degree in Actuarial
* 3-5 years of relevant experience for Sr. Consultants

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Consulting Background
* M&A advisory experience
* Program/Project Management office experience
* Investment banking experience on the sell/ buy side
* Industry M&A strategy experience
* Specific functional knowledge in areas of Finance, Operations, Procurement etc.
* Demonstrated experience in financial statement and operations analytics

MBA or Master’s Degree (Actuarial)

Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Job Summary**

The Finance Manager is responsible for managing the organization’s overall financial operations, ensuring accurate financial reporting, statutory compliance, budgeting, and cash flow management. This role plays a key part in financial planning, cost control, and supporting leadership with strategic financial insights.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting, finance, and treasury operations
* Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements
* Manage budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Ensure compliance with statutory requirements including GST, TDS, Income Tax, audits, and regulatory filings
* Monitor cash flow, working capital, and fund utilization
* Coordinate with external auditors, banks, tax consultants, and regulatory authorities
* Implement and monitor internal controls and financial policies
* Analyze financial data and provide insights to support business decisions
* Supervise and guide finance and accounting team members
* Support management in strategic planning, cost optimization, and risk management

**Mandatory Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or related field
* Professional qualification such as CA / CMA / MBA (Finance) preferred
* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant experience in finance and accounting roles
* Strong knowledge of accounting standards, taxation, and statutory compliance
* Hands-on experience with budgeting, financial reporting, and audits
* Proficiency in ERP systems and accounting software (SAP, Oracle, Tally, etc.)
* Experience in managing teams and coordinating with external stakeholders
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

**Position Summary**

**We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. title: Corporate Strategy Manager (Consulting & Strategy)
description:
Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

**There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.**

Freshworks Inc. builds uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional employee and customer experiences. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, helping businesses reduce complexity, lower cost-to-serve, and deliver faster, more human support through enterprise-grade yet easy-to-use CX and IT solutions. Nearly 75,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks to power their Employee Experience (EX) and Customer Experience (CX) operations.
  
  
  
  
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Job Description**

Freshworks is looking for a Manager to join our global Corporate Strategy team and help shape some of the most important decisions facing the company.

This is a high-impact strategy role for someone who loves solving complex business problems but wants to get closer to the decisions, the executives making them, and the outcomes that follow.

You'll work directly with Strategy leadership and senior executives on questions spanning AI, product strategy, pricing and monetization, GTM growth, market expansion, and strategic investments. One project might involve evaluating how we monetize a new AI capability; another could focus on where Freshworks should invest to accelerate growth or how we evolve our GTM strategy.

The team operates with the rigor of a top strategy consulting firm, but with one important difference: we don't stop at the recommendation. We partner across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to help turn strategy into action and see the impact of the decisions we help shape.

**What You'll Do**

• Own high-priority strategic initiatives from initial question through recommendation and execution.
  
  
• Tackle ambiguous company-level problems, develop hypotheses, and create the analytical frameworks needed to answer them.
  
  
• Evaluate growth opportunities across AI, product, GTM, pricing, market expansion, and strategic investments.
  
  
• Build business cases, financial models, market assessments, and scenario analyses that inform investment and resource allocation decisions.
  
  
• Partner directly with senior leaders across Product, Sales, Finance, and Operations to shape decisions and drive alignment.
  
  
• Translate strategy into actionable plans and stay close to execution to understand what is working and where we need to adjust.
  
  
• Develop executive and Board-level narratives that distill complex analysis into clear choices and recommendations.
  
  
• Bring an outside-in perspective on the SaaS and AI landscape and help identify the strategic questions Freshworks should be asking next.

**Qualifications**

**What We're Looking For**

• 4-6+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or a combination of consulting and in-house strategy experience;
**experience from a top-tier management consulting firm, particularly MBB (Mckinsey, Bain, BCG) is preferred**
  
• Experience solving growth, product, GTM, pricing, market entry, or investment strategy problems
  
  
• Exposure to SaaS, enterprise software, or technology businesses strongly preferred
  
  
• Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with the ability to turn data into business insights and recommendations
  
  
• Executive-level communication skills and the ability to influence without authority
  
  
• Comfortable moving between high-level strategy and hands-on analysis
  
  
• Curious, low ego, and energized by ambiguity
  
  
• Most importantly, you want to own the outcome, not just deliver the recommendation

**Why This Role**

Freshworks is at an exciting point in its evolution. We're scaling a global SaaS business, expanding our enterprise presence, and navigating how AI changes the products we build, how we monetize them, and how our customers work.

For someone coming from consulting, this is an opportunity to keep the parts of the job you love—complex problems, executive exposure, analytical rigor, and variety—while gaining something that's harder to get as an advisor: ownership.

You'll see the decisions get made. You'll work alongside the teams responsible for executing them. And you'll have the opportunity to see whether the strategy actually worked.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role with exposure to senior executives and the Board, and an opportunity to build a deep understanding of how a global SaaS company operates.

**Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business.
**Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

title: Financial Controller
description:
**About the company**

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising

the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market — economy to

mid-market — to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel

over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price

point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.

We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:

● Itsy (₹1000–1500)

● Treebo and Treebo Premium (₹1500–3000)

● Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (₹3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10

across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

**About the Role**

We are looking for a dynamic and experienced finance leader to head our end-to-end finance function across hotel operations. In this role, you will take full ownership of accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, cash flow management, and internal controls to ensure financial discipline and long-term business sustainability. Beyond core controllership, you will serve as a strategic partner to operational leaders, driving bottom-line profitability, leading cost optimization initiatives, streamlining vendor management, and implementing robust SOPs. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and have a proven track record of building high-performing finance teams, this role offers the platform to make a direct impact on our operational scale and efficiency.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA)**
  with
  **5-8 years**
  of post-qualification experience.
* At least
  **2–3 years**
  of proven leadership experience as a
  **Financial Controller**
  , Head of Finance, or in an equivalent senior controllership role.
* Direct domain exposure in
  **Hospitality, Retail, F&B, or Multi-unit Operations**
  (preferred).
* Strong technical command over accounting, financial reporting, AOP/budgeting, working capital/cash flow management, and internal financial controls (IFC).
* Proven track record of identifying cost leakages, driving operational efficiencies, and boosting unit-level profitability.
* Demonstrated experience in vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations, and contract lifecycle management.
* Strong leadership, analytical problem-solving, and cross-functional stakeholder management capabilities.
* Comfort and agility in navigating fast-paced, dynamic, and high-growth operational setups.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **End-to-End Financial Controllership:**
  Lead the full accounting and financial lifecycle for hotel operations, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting and month-end/year-end closures.
* **Budgeting, Forecasting & AOP:**
  Drive annual operating plans (AOP), monthly rolling forecasts, and variance analyses to provide actionable financial insights to business leadership.
* **Cash Flow & Working Capital Management:**
  Oversee treasury, fund planning, collections, and working capital cycles to optimize liquidity across all operating units.
* **Cost Optimization & Profitability Analysis:**
  Monitor unit-level and consolidated P&Ls, analyze cost drivers, plug revenue leakages, and implement targeted initiatives to enhance overall margins.
* **Internal Controls & SOP Implementation:**
  Design, standardize, and enforce robust internal financial control frameworks and operational SOPs to mitigate operational and financial risks.
* **Vendor & Commercial Management:**
  Oversee vendor payment cycles, conduct periodic supplier audits, and lead commercial negotiations to optimize procurement and operational costs.
* **Audit & Statutory Compliance:**
  Direct and coordinate internal, statutory, and tax audits (Direct & Indirect taxes), ensuring zero-defect compliance with all regulatory standards.
* **Cross-Functional Business Partnering:**
  Collaborate closely with general managers, procurement, operations, and leadership to align financial strategy with overall business growth.
* **Team Building & Leadership:**
  Recruit, mentor, and build a high-performing finance and accounts team capable of scaling with the company's expansion.

title: Category Manager
description:
**About the company**

Treebo Hospitality Ventures (THV) is a hotel group operating with a mission of "democratising

the joy of travel". We focus on the affordable segments of the market — economy to

mid-market — to cater to the next 100 million travellers who will experience the joy of travel

over the next 10 years. We offer these guests a high-quality experience at an affordable price

point, with a portfolio of 800+ hotels across 120+ cities.

We operate through multiple brands catering to different sub-segments:

● Itsy (₹1000–1500)

● Treebo and Treebo Premium (₹1500–3000)

● Medalio, our newly launched affordable luxury brand (₹3000–6000 per night)

We are the most loved hotel chain in the affordable segment, with an average rating of 7.8/10

across independent review platforms — and we are just getting started

**About the Role**

The Category Commercial Manager – Hills is the category's chief strategist: the person who

figures out what actually makes a hill-station hotel perform, codifies it into a playbook, and

builds the knowledge base that lets the rest of the organization act on it consistently. This role is

less about running any single lever day-to-day and more about answering the "why" behind

performance — which factors separate a top-performing hill hotel from a struggling one — and

turning that answer into a repeatable, scalable set of actions.

Pricing execution sits with the central Revenue Management pricing team. Everything else that

drives hill-hotel performance — demand patterns, inventory strategy, positioning, marketing,

and policy — is this role's to understand, document, and turn into playbook guidance, working

closely with the teams who execute against it.

This is a high-visibility, senior individual-contributor role reporting into commercial leadership,

with regular exposure to QBR and senior management reviews.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategy & Playbook Creation (core mandate)

● Diagnose what drives performance in the hills category — pull apart top-performing vs.

underperforming hotels within each cluster (Chikmagalur, Coorg, Ooty, Shimla, Manali,

etc.) and identify the specific, repeatable factors behind the gap

● Translate those findings into a living Hills Category Playbook: a structured, prioritized set

of "what to do" actions — by cluster, by season, by hotel maturity — covering everything

from listing content to demand planning to promotions

● Continuously test and refine the playbook: treat each intervention (a pricing change, a

new cancellation policy, a promotion) as an experiment, and feed results back into the

playbook rather than treating it as one-off

● Own the category's knowledge base — a single source of truth documenting what

works, what doesn't, and why, so that the logic doesn't live only in one person's head

and can be handed off, audited, and built on

● Build decision frameworks (e.g., "when a hotel's occupancy drops below X in season Y, do

Z") that let revenue management, marketing, and ops teams act on the playbook

without needing this role in every conversation

● Benchmark the hills category against comp sets and against Treebo's other categories

(city, business) to pressure-test which "hills-specific" factors are truly unique to the

category

Revenue Management (beyond pricing) — as playbook inputs

● Study demand seasonality by destination (long weekends, festival calendars, school

holidays, wedding/honeymoon seasons) and turn it into a demand-planning framework

the category can reuse year over year

● Define the category's point of view on inventory and availability strategy —

length-of-stay controls, minimum-stay/blackout dates, stop-sells, and overbooking

approach at high-demand properties — and document it in the playbook

● Define the category's channel mix and distribution strategy, and the market/segment

strategy (corporate vs. leisure vs. drive-in) by cluster and season

● Partner with the central pricing team on rate-uplift opportunities (e.g., properties priced

below comp set despite equal or better review scores), feeding them the category insight

behind each opportunity

● Investigate root causes behind Critical No-Show % and other NBV-leakage patterns at

sold-out properties, and codify the intervention playbook (ACQ or otherwise)

Marketing — as playbook inputs

● Determine what marketing actually moves the needle for hill destinations — content

quality, listing photography, promotions, campaigns — and document what works by

cluster and season

● Build the playbook for OTA visibility and content marketing (listing standards,

ranking/boost programs) in coordination with the Listing Intelligence workstream

● Design and run promotion/campaign experiments tied to seasonality, and record which

formats and offers actually lift occupancy and RevPAR

● Track marketing-driven demand signals (e.g., hotel detail view traffic by platform) to

figure out where marketing effort pays off, and build that into the knowledge base

Policy — as playbook inputs

● Determine the right cancellation, refund, and no-show policy stance for the category,

and document the reasoning and trade-offs (guest flexibility vs. NBV protection)

● Define the category's position on rate parity, minimum-stay, blackout, and

booking-window policy for peak-season dates

● Ensure category-level policy recommendations account for OTA platform requirements

and Treebo's broader commercial policy framework

Competitive & Market Intelligence

● Track ARI (Average Rate Index) and Review Index against comp sets for each cluster

● Turn competitive patterns into playbook guidance — e.g., what a competitor is doing

that consistently correlates with better performance, and whether it's worth adopting

Portfolio & P&L Management

● Own the regional P&L narrative for the hills category — revenue, cost-to-serve, and NBV

— and present waterfall/variance analysis in QBRs, tying performance back to playbook

adoption

● Prioritize which playbook interventions to push into which hotels, based on

impact-to-effort

● Partner with acquisition/onboarding teams to apply category learnings to new hotel

signings in high-potential hill destinations

Cross-functional Execution

● Work closely with central Pricing, Distribution, Marketing, OTA/Listing, Operations, and

Category teams — both to gather the inputs the playbook needs and to get playbook

guidance actually adopted

● Represent the hills category in AMJ/quarterly business reviews — own the narrative,

data, and playbook evolution

● Maintain the knowledge base and playbook as living documents, versioned and updated

as new evidence comes in

**What We're Looking For**

● 4–8 years of experience in revenue management, commercial strategy, or program

management in hospitality/ travel, or a marketplace/platform business preferred

● Strong analytical instincts: comfortable moving from raw performance data to "here's

the underlying reason" rather than stopping at the dashboard

● Demonstrated experience building frameworks, playbooks, or SOPs that other teams

adopted and used — not just one-off analyses

● Strong quantitative fluency: comfortable working with RevPAR, ARR, NBV, occupancy,

and P&L waterfalls without hand-holding

● Working knowledge of revenue management levers beyond pricing, OTA distribution

dynamics, and hospitality marketing/policy — enough to know what questions to ask,

even without owning execution of each

● Demonstrated ability to translate data into a clear commercial narrative for senior

stakeholders

● Advanced Excel/Sheets skills; comfort with dashboards (Mixpanel or similar) is a plus

● Willingness to travel periodically to hill-station clusters to validate playbook assumptions

on the ground

● Curious and rigorous by disposition — treats every intervention as something to be

tested and documented, not just executed

**What Success Looks Like (First 2 Quarters)**

● A first version of the Hills Category Playbook live and shared with commercial

leadership, covering demand planning, inventory strategy, marketing, and policy by

cluster

● A knowledge base documenting the specific factors that separate top- and

bottom-performing Hill hotels, with evidence behind each claim

● At least 2–3 playbook recommendations piloted with a measurable before/after read

(e.g., a promotion format, a policy change, a listing fix)

● A repeatable, cluster-level QBR reporting structure adopted by commercial leadership,

framed around playbook adoption and impact

description:

**Senior**
**Financial Analyst**

The Senior Financial Analyst will serve as a strategic finance partner supporting program financial health, forecasting, reporting, governance, and cross-functional decision-making. This role will partner closely with Program Managers, Finance Business Partners, P&L Owners, and site leadership to provide clear financial insight, identify risks and opportunities, and drive disciplined program execution.

Together, we leverage deep industry expertise, data-driven decision-making, and a commitment to quality to support the development and commercialization of lifesaving medical devices and technologies.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Support audits, financial reviews, and process control activities while improving the accuracy and integrity of financial data.

* Experience with project management or tools such as Planisware, CoCo, Claude, Streamlit, Power BI, or similar platforms.
* Experience supporting monthly invoicing, financial status reporting, program reviews, or cross-functional governance routines.
* Demonstrated ability to improve processes, automate manual reporting, strengthen controls, and translate financial data into actionable business insights.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and proactively address issues in a dynamic environment

title: Finance Manager- Digital & IT
description:
**About Us**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Role Overview**

The Finance Manager is the finance partner to the Digital & IT leadership team. The role connects financial stewardship with technology strategy, translating plans, delivery choices and supplier commitments into clear financial outcomes. It combines FP&A, investment appraisal, cost management, management reporting and business partnering, with a strong focus on forward-looking insight and constructive challenge.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic finance partnership**

· Advise the CDIO and Digital & IT leadership on financial implications, trade-offs, risks and opportunities across the technology portfolio.

· Translate functional strategy and roadmaps into integrated financial plans, resource choices and measurable outcomes.

· Provide clear, concise and decision-oriented insight for senior leadership and relevant governance forums.

**Planning, forecasting and performance management**

· Lead the annual budget, rolling forecast and periodic outlook processes for Digital & IT, aligned with enterprise planning requirements.

· Coordinate inputs from capability or COE leads, regional finance partners and relevant business stakeholders; challenge assumptions and eliminate unsupported cost carry-over through zero-based thinking.

· Develop driver-based forecasts, scenarios and sensitivity analyses covering demand, capacity, inflation, foreign exchange, supplier commitments and delivery timing.

· Monitor actuals, commitments and forecasts; explain variances, identify corrective actions and maintain a reliable view of the full-year position.

**Technology cost transparency and control**

· Own a coherent view of Digital & IT run, change and transformation costs, including internal resources, software, cloud, infrastructure, managed services and professional services.

· Develop and maintain cost allocation, showback or chargeback logic where required, with transparent drivers and clear ownership.

· Establish robust controls for purchase orders, accruals, prepayments, capitalization inputs, intercompany charges and supplier invoices in partnership with Accounting, Procurement and other control owners.

· Identify structural savings and productivity opportunities while protecting service resilience and strategic priorities.

**Investment governance and value realization**

· Partner with initiative sponsors and delivery teams to build credible business cases, including baseline, benefits, costs, cash flow, risk, dependencies and alternative scenarios.

· Assess project and portfolio proposals using appropriate financial measures and provide an independent recommendation to decision makers.

· Maintain financial oversight from approval through delivery, including stage-gate reviews, forecast-at-completion, benefits tracking and post-implementation review.

· Challenge scope, sequencing and solution economics to improve return on investment and portfolio affordability.

**Vendor and commercial finance**

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, service owners and vendor managers on sourcing strategies, contract economics, indexation, consumption commitments, renewals and commercial negotiations.

· Maintain visibility of committed and contingent supplier spend, unit rates, volume drivers, contractual milestones and termination or transition implications.

· Support fact-based vendor performance and cost reviews and verify that negotiated benefits are reflected in plans and actual results.

**Reporting, analytics and data stewardship**

· Design a concise management reporting suite covering financial performance, portfolio economics, cost drivers, risks, opportunities and benefits.

· Automate recurring reporting and improve self-service insight using approved ERP, planning and business intelligence tools.

· Apply predictive analytics, scenario modelling and, where appropriate, AI-enabled methods to forecasting and cost insight, within applicable governance standards.

· Maintain clear definitions, reconciliations, controls and ownership so that management information is trusted and auditable.

**Teamwork and continuous improvement**

· Build effective partnerships across Digital & IT, Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, regions and business units.

· Simplify finance processes, standardize ways of working and document key controls and decision rights.

· Coach budget owners and delivery leads to strengthen financial literacy, accountability and commercial discipline.

· Contribute to an inclusive, high-performing culture based on integrity, collaboration and constructive challenge.

**Measures of success**

· Accurate, timely and decision-useful plans, forecasts and management reporting.

· Improved visibility and ownership of run, change, committed and forecast technology costs.

· Investment proposals supported by transparent assumptions, options and value measures.

· Early identification of financial risks and opportunities, with clear corrective actions.

· Demonstrable tracking of approved benefits, savings and productivity outcomes.

· Strong stakeholder confidence in the quality, independence and commercial relevance of finance support.

**Qualifications and Experience**

· Chartered Accountant, CPA, CMA or equivalent recognized professional finance qualification.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**About Simplismart**

Simplismart is a GenAI inference platform to deploy, scale, and monitor any GenAI model (LLMs, speech, vision, or diffusion) across cloud or on-prem. Built for strict SLAs, enterprise-grade security, and full observability. Its modular design lets you optimize for cost or latency or auto-select the best topology per workload.

**About the role-**

You will own the finance function at Simplismart, covering everything from monthly payment runs and financial reporting to consolidated financials across our India parent and US subsidiary.

This is a hands-on role combining financial control, compliance, treasury, and strategic decision support. You will work closely with the founders and business teams to manage cross-border financial operations, build financial models, and understand the economics of GPU infrastructure, cloud costs, customer commitments, and business growth.

**What is expected from you-**

* Financial Close & Reporting: Own monthly closing, MIS, consolidated reporting, intercompany reconciliations, foreign exchange translation, and annual statutory audits across India and the US. Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
* Revenue Recognition: Establish and manage revenue recognition for consumption-based and committed contracts, including prepaid credits, deferred and unbilled revenue, overages, and multi-year commitments.
* AI Compute Economics: Build financial models for GPU and cloud infrastructure covering capacity, utilisation, pricing, costs, gross margins, payback periods, and cash requirements.
* Financial Planning & Analysis:Own annual operating plans, rolling forecasts, integrated financial models, and scenario planning. Translate infrastructure commitments, demand changes, and pricing decisions into profitability and cash-flow implications.
* Treasury & Working Capital: Manage accounts receivable, collections, DSO, accounts payable, vendor terms, payment calendars, banking relationships, multi-currency accounts, cash management, and working capital.
* Foreign Exchange Management: Track USD inflows against USD cloud and GPU costs, assess natural hedges, manage residual FX exposure, and establish a documented FX management policy.
* Cross-border Finance: Design and manage invoicing and payment flows between India and US entities, including entity-level contracting, withholding tax, tax treaty positions, and remittance documentation.
* Tax & Statutory Compliance: Own India compliance covering GST, LUT, TDS, advance tax, ROC/MCA filings, transfer pricing, FEMA, and RBI reporting. Manage US federal and state taxes, sales tax, franchise tax, and payroll compliance.
* Audit, Fundraising & Investor Reporting: Lead finance due diligence, maintain the data room, prepare investor and board reporting packs, manage financial schedules and reconciliations, and respond directly to diligence queries.
* Controls & Systems: Establish financial controls, approval workflows, delegation of authority, payment authorisation protocols, vendor onboarding checks, and segregation of duties.
* Unit Economics & Cost Attribution: Build visibility into GPU-level, workload-level, and customer-level economics. Track infrastructure utilisation, provider costs, gross margins, and profitability across customers and deployment models.
* Infrastructure Investment Decisions: Support management in evaluating whether to buy, reserve, lease, or commit to GPU capacity based on expected demand, utilisation, returns, and cash-flow requirements.
* External Stakeholder Management: Coordinate with auditors, chartered accountants, tax advisors, banks, and other financial partners to ensure accurate reporting and timely compliance.

**What We're Looking For-**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in finance, accounting, controllership, or a similar role.
* CA or MBA in Finance preferred; CS qualification is an added advantage.
* Experience in a startup or technology/SaaS company, preferably in a multi-entity environment.
* Strong understanding of Indian accounting, taxation, statutory compliance, and cross-border transactions.
* Working knowledge of US accounting, taxation, and compliance requirements.
* Hands-on experience with monthly financial close, audits, MIS, accounts receivable/payable, treasury, and working capital management.
* Familiarity with revenue recognition for SaaS and consumption-based business models.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, FEMA, RBI regulations, transfer pricing, and international taxation.
* Strong financial modelling, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to build finance processes and controls from the ground up and work independently.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work directly with founders, investors, auditors, banks, and advisors.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and comfort working in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

**Good to have-**

* Experience with GPU infrastructure, cloud computing, data centres, or infrastructure-heavy business models.
* Understanding of capacity utilisation, infrastructure commitments, unit economics, and gross margin analysis.
* Experience with multi-currency treasury, FX exposure management, and cross-border payment structures.
* Experience supporting fundraising, investor reporting, and financial due diligence.
* Familiarity with financial automation, reporting tools, and scalable finance systems.

**Why Join Simplismart?**

* Opportunity to define and lead the brand identity of a fast-growing GenAI company.
* Work closely with leadership on high-impact initiatives from global event campaigns to overall storytelling.
* Be part of a team that values design as a strategic lever, not just execution.
* Competitive compensation and growth opportunities in a high-energy startup environment.

description:

The Assistant Manager Accounts will oversee day-to-day financial operations, including managing accounts payable and receivable, maintaining ledgers, vendor payments and ensuring timely invoicing and collections. description:

**Senior Fund Administrator – Financial Reporting.**
**In This Role, You Will**

* The traditional Accounting & Valuations team has daily, monthly and weekly Net Asset Value valuations with stringent timelines. The team is responsible for performing capital activity bookings, accruals, amortization, yields leading to final generation and validation of Net Asset Value through diagnostic checks, Financial Mainframe Report and post Net Asset Value activities. The team also performs other Monthly & Reporting activities which includes Fee Reviews. Ex Dividend Distribution, Trustee Packs and Queries, Regulatory & Client Reporting. The Accounting & Valuations team is responsible functionally across multiple jurisdictions (where applicable) serviced out of Markets and Securities Services Bangalore.

Responsible for core processing/reviewing activities and will require strong technical knowledge to achieve target deliverables. The role will demand a daily balance of delivering an excellent client service within the standard Net Asset Value model of promoting continuous improvement of Net Asset Value processes and of identifying and capitalizing opportunities to create capacity and generate efficiencies. The role would also require the individual to ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved, and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal control and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level. Initiatives to demonstrate the application of principles in the day-to-day work environment Participation and support provided to initiatives taken by other teams. Being proactive in identifying root cause for process related challenges and share qualitative resolution. Be flexible to adopt in different working environment with counterparts across the globe.
* Maintains HSBC internal control standards, overseeing the timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators. Proactively be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure escalation process is in place and is effective. Ensure Gross Asset Value / Net Asset Value operating procedure is followed with management of risks (if any).
* Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures. Additional review of Job-Aid Matrix, Standard Operating Procedures, process notes, checklists and other internal process related documents periodically. Undertake any additional responsibilities that may be required by the manager in support of specific projects, on-going management and development of the process. Undertake the fund’s activities correctly as per the Standard Operating Procedures. Ensure timely and accurate publishing of Management Reports / Reports. Ensure completion of all mandatory training on time.

**To Be Successful, You Will**

* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications related to accounting / finance industry or relevant experience.

* Decent knowledge in Accounting & Valuations process with clear understanding of the end-to-end Fund Accounting Model. Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds, Corporate Actions, Financial Instruments and reconciliations.
* Ability to speak and understand English. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding. Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Proactive in implementing and driving solutions. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
