title: Business Intelligence Engineer, Amazon
description:
**Description**
Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds the systems that host and run the comprehensive e-commerce product catalog. We power the online shopping experience for customers worldwide, enabling them to find, discover, and purchase anything they desire. Our scaled, distributed systems process hundreds of millions of updates across billions of products, including physical, digital, and service offerings.
  
  
You will be part of Catalog Support Programs (CSP) team under Catalog Support Operations (CSO) in ASCS Org. CSP provides program management, technical support, and strategic initiatives to enhance the customer experience, owning the implementation of business logic and configurations for ASCS. We are establishing a new centralized Business Intelligence team to build self-service analytical products for ASCS that provide relevant insights and data deep dives across the business. By leveraging advanced analytics and AI/ML, we will transform catalog data into predictive insights, helping prevent customer issues before they arise. Real-time intelligence will support proactive decision-making, enabling faster, data-driven decisions across the organization and driving long-term growth and an enhanced customer experience.
  
  
We are looking for a creative and goal-oriented BI Engineer to join our team to harness the full potential of data-driven insights to make informed decisions, identify business opportunities and drive business growth.
  
  
This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities, knowledge of business intelligence solutions, as well as business acumen and the ability to work with various tech/product teams across ASCS. This BI Engineer will support ASCS org by owning complex reporting and automating reporting solutions, and ultimately provide insights and drivers for decision making.
  
  
You must be a self-starter and be able to learn on the go. You should have excellent written and verbal communication skills to be able to work with business owners to develop and define key business questions, and to build data sets that answer those questions.
  
  
As a Business Intelligence Engineer in the CSP team, you will be responsible for analyzing petabytes of data to identify business trends and points of customer friction, and developing scalable solutions to enhance customer experience and safety. You will work closely with internal stakeholders to define key performance indicators (KPIs), implement them into dashboards and reports, and present insights in a concise and effective manner. This role will involve collaborating with business and tech leaders within ASCS and cross-functional teams to solve problems, create operational efficiencies, and deliver against high organizational standards. You should be able to apply a breadth of tools, data sources, and analytical techniques to answer a wide range of high-impact business questions and proactively uncover new insights that drive decision-making by senior leadership. As a key member of the CSP team, you will continually raise the bar on both quality and performance. You will bring innovation, a strategic perspective, a passionate voice, and an ability to prioritize and execute on a fast-moving set of priorities, competitive pressures, and operational initiatives. There will be a steep learning curve, adding a fair amount of business skills to the individual.

* Work closely with BIEs, Data Engineers, and Scientists in the team to collaborate effectively with product managers and create scalable solutions for business problems

title: Finance Manager
description:
**About Helium**

After chasing brokers, navigating fake listings, and locking up lakhs in deposits, most renters

settle because the system leaves them no real choice. Helium is rebuilding rentals in India

from the ground up with a discovery platform of exclusive, gated homes that are actually

available and require just a one-month deposit. Under the hood, we run two fintech

products: a rent guarantee for homeowners and a credit-led deposit solution for tenants.

We are backed by founders and operators from Blinkit, CRED, Zomato, and Stanza Living.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, high-ownership Finance Manager to join our team in Bangalore.

You will work directly with the founder on finance strategy, planning, and fundraising, while

owning the systems that keep money moving accurately across Helium.

From building budgets and unit economics models to preparing investor reports and

fundraising decks, you will help shape the decisions that drive how Helium grows. This role is

perfect for someone who loves numbers, enjoys turning manual work into automated flows,

and wants to build a finance function from the ground up at a fast-growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Finance Strategy: Work directly with the founder on finance strategy, capital allocation, and key business decisions.
* Budgeting & Planning: Prepare budgets for upcoming quarters and monitor actuals against budgets, flagging variances and their drivers.
* Unit Economics: Build and maintain unit economics and financial models across our rental and fintech products.
* Investor Reporting: Prepare and share regular investor updates and MIS reports on business and financial performance.
* Fundraising: Work on fundraising decks, financial projections, and data rooms, and support the founder through investor conversations.
* Payouts & Collections: Own monthly rental payouts to homeowners, ensuring payment files are accurate and released only after the necessary approvals, and drive follow-ups on pending payments.
* Statutory Compliance: Work with our CA consultant on statutory filings (GST, TDS and other compliances) and keep records audit-ready.
* Process Automation & Systems: Break finance workflows into simple processes, automate manual work, and build systems that scale with Helium.

**Requirements**

* BBA, BCom, or MBA (Finance preferred).
* 2–5 years of experience in finance, FP&A, strategy, investment banking, or a finance role at a startup.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, with hands-on experience in financial modelling, budgeting, and MIS.
* Strong grasp of unit economics and the ability to turn numbers into clear business insights.
* Comfort building crisp decks and reports for founders and investors.
* Ability to break complex processes into simpler, repeatable flows.
* Strong stakeholder management and coordination skills across teams.
* A builder’s mindset: curious, proactive, and keen to automate manual work.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, unstructured startup environment.

**What You’ll Get**

* Direct work with the founder on strategy, fundraising, and investor relationships.
* The chance to build Helium’s finance function from the ground up.
* Real ownership from day one, with room to grow as Helium scales

title: Assistant Finance Controller - WFO
description:
**Role: Assistant Finance Controller**

**Location: HSR Layout, Bangalore**

**About BrightCHAMPS**

BrightCHAMPS is a holistic skill-building and learning platform on a mission to bridge the gap between traditional education and the real-world skills kids need to thrive, offering expert-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, and Communication. Founded in 2020 by Ravi Bhushan, the company has rapidly expanded to over 30 countries, delivering 200,000+ live classes every month, and is one of the fastest-growing EdTech companies in the world, teaching coding, robotics, financial literacy, and STEM skills to over a million children.BrightCHAMPS is backed by $63M in funding at a $650M valuation, with investors including Premji Invest, GSV Ventures, 021 Capital, Beenext, and Binny Bansal. The company operates across four core learning verticals — CodeCHAMPS (coding), RoboCHAMPS (robotics and artificial intelligence), FinCHAMPS (financial literacy), and LingoCHAMPS (communications) —

and has grown to a team of 700+ employees across five continents.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Finance Controller to join our Finance & Controllership team. This role is central to strengthening our financial reporting, statutory compliance, and internal control framework as we grow. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, auditors, and leadership to ensure accurate financial records, timely audit closures, and robust governance — while also contributing to cash flow management, budgeting, and business decision support.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Reporting & Accounting**

● Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring they are

accurate, complete, and delivered within defined timelines

● Assist in the consolidation of group financials across multiple entities and geographies, ensuring

alignment with group accounting policies

● Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records by reviewing ledgers, journal entries, and

supporting documentation on an ongoing basis

● Perform periodic account reconciliations and variance analysis, investigating discrepancies and ensuring

corrective actions are taken in a timely manner

**Audit & Compliance**

● Coordinate with statutory, internal, and tax auditors by acting as the primary point of contact, facilitating

data requests, and resolving audit queries

● Ensure timely closure of audits and submission of required documentation, minimizing delays and audit

observations

● Monitor compliance with the Companies Act, Income Tax Act, GST, and other applicable regulatory

requirements, keeping track of regulatory changes and their impact on the business

● Maintain audit schedules, trackers, and supporting documentation in an organized manner to enable

smooth and efficient audit processes

**Taxation**

● Assist in the timely and accurate filing of GST returns, TDS returns, and Income Tax compliances in line

with statutory due dates

● Support tax audit processes and respond to tax queries and notices from authorities, coordinating with

consultants where required

**Internal Controls & Process Improvement**

● Strengthen internal controls and financial governance by identifying control gaps and implementing

corrective measures

● Monitor process adherence across finance operations and proactively highlight gaps, inefficiencies, or

risks to management

● Support the implementation of SOPs and automation initiatives (ERP/Zoho, etc.) to improve process

efficiency, accuracy, and scalability

**Treasury & Cash Management**

● Assist in cash flow planning and preparation to ensure adequate liquidity for business operations

● Track and optimize the utilization of funds, identifying opportunities to improve working capital

efficiency

● Support banking operations, payment approvals, and bank reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timely

resolution of discrepancies

**Business Support & Planning**

● Support the budgeting and forecasting processes by providing accurate inputs, tracking actuals against

budgets, and flagging variances

● Provide analysis of P&L performance and support cost optimization initiatives to improve overall

profitability

● Assist in management reporting and business decision support by preparing insightful reports and

dashboards for leadership

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

● Qualified or Semi-qualified CA / CMA / MBA Finance / CA Inter

● 3–6 years of relevant experience in Finance/Controllership

● Strong understanding of accounting standards, compliance, and audit processes

● Hands-on experience with ERP systems (Zoho, SAP, Oracle, etc.)

● Good knowledge of GST, Income Tax, and Companies Act compliance

● Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

● High attention to detail and ownership mindset

**Preferred Skills**

● Experience in startup / high-growth environment

● Exposure to group consolidation & international reporting

● Understanding of automation tools and finance system integration

● Strong ownership and accountability

● Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight deadlines

● Collaborative approach with cross-functional teams

● Focus on confidentiality and internal controls

description:

The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

WHAT WE OFFER

\* Direct mentorship from the Founder.

\* Hands-on exposure to the restaurant, apparel, and commercial real estate industries.

title: Specialist - Commercial Standards Claims & Contract
description: Job DescriptionSpecialist — Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts is a Business Analyst and SME on the Customer Operations Transformation programme. The outcome is a clear, governed set of commercial policies — credit, claims, pricing and trade terms — and customer agreements that are standard, compliant and correctly executed in the systems; fewer and cleaner customer claims; lower invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage; and <1 Day Resolution wherever the process allows: fewer claims arising in the first place, and faster, controlled settlement for those that remain. Everything this role does serves that outcome.The scope spans Commercial Standards, Claims and Contracts end to end — formulation and governance of credit, claims, pricing and trade-terms policies, policy exceptions and delegation of authority, the customer agreement and contract lifecycle (drafting, approval, activation, amendment and renewal), pricing, rebate, discount and promotion setup, accruals, claims intake, validation and settlement, proof of performance, and the controls that link agreed terms to what is invoiced and paid. The role designs across this scope as one process rather than as separate contract, promotion and claims solutions. It works with market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service and Collections teams, GBO, D&T, the SAP and Control Tower (Claims and Deduction platform) teams and third-party vendors.The role combines 5 capabilities in one person. As an SME, they formulate, document the global commercial policies — credit policy (credit limits, payment terms, risk categories, blocks and releases), claims policy (eligibility, evidence, time limits, approval and write-off thresholds), and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount and rebate guardrails, price-change control) — and the standards and controls that make them work in practice. As a business analyst, they interrogate contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data, document current and target process, and write requirements to standard. As a subject matter expert, they bring the functional depth to act as design authority for the fragment and to challenge solutions that would not work in the markets. As a sprint or project owner, they take a scope fragment through design, test and deployment on a two to four week value drop cadence. As a process and technology expert, they translate commercial policy, contract terms and controls into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction capability, and the contract and trade promotion management toolset.The defining discipline of this role is designing claims out at source, not processing them faster. A quicker claim approval is a smaller prize than a contract term clear enough never to be disputed; a faster settlement is a smaller prize than a promotion set up correctly in the system so the customer never needs to claim. The postholder is expected to use the data to find where in the commercial process claims are created — an ambiguous contract clause, a non-standard trade term, a late or incorrect pricing or promotion setup, an accrual gap, a weak approval control — and design the fix upstream into commercial policy, standards, contract templates, deal approval and master data, as well as into the claims and settlement design.Understanding of markets and of upstream and downstream impact is central to the role. A claim usually starts life as a commercial negotiation; a contract term becomes a pricing condition, an accrual, an invoice and, if anything is misaligned, a deduction in Collections. The postholder is expected to know what happens on either side of their own process — from deal negotiation through to cash and the P&L — and to design accordingly.This is a transformation design and delivery role, not an operational one. The postholder does not negotiate customer deals, draft or approve individual contracts, validate or settle individual claims, or manage customer relationships; that stays with market Commercial, Legal, GBO and BPO run teams. The role changes how that work is done — including the commercial policies, standards, contract templates, reason codes, analytics and controls that let run teams find and remove causes in BAU. The role formulates and recommends policy; final approval sits with the relevant policy owners and governance forums.The role works independently within an agreed frame set by the workstream lead, gathers its own data, forms its own view and brings recommendations rather than questions. Where a Senior Specialist is assigned on the same fragment, it works under their design direction. Decisions are expected to be based on evidence rather than opinion, and every artefact is expected to meet the programme documentation, taxonomy and quality standards, including BPQMS.Analyse commercial terms, contracts and claims performance and baseline the problem — 25%. Document current-state credit, claims and pricing policies, commercial standards, contract lifecycle and claims processes across markets and identify variation from the global standard. Build the process, trade-terms and claim-type taxonomy and interrogate the data directly at portfolio level — customer agreements and terms, pricing and promotion conditions, accruals versus actuals, claims volume, value, ageing and rejection rates, invalid deductions, write-offs and trade-spend leakage — to baseline the problem per market and size the opportunity. Perform gap analysis between current process, commercial policy, contract terms, platform capability, controls and the target operating model, separating structural design issues from operational backlog. Support business-rule validation, master-data requirements and policy analysis. Aim for validated current-state documentation and a defensible baseline that will stand up to audit.Formulate commercial policies and standards, and design claims out at source — 25%. Support future-state design aligned to the global standard, always designing for the cause rather than the symptom. Formulate, document and maintain the global commercial policies the design depends on — credit policy (credit limits and risk categorisation, payment terms, credit blocks and release authority), claims policy (claim eligibility, evidence and proof-of-performance requirements, submission time limits, validation, approval and write-off thresholds) and pricing governance (price-setting and approval, discount, rebate and promotion guardrails, price-change control and margin protection) — with a clear policy-exception and delegation-of-authority framework, and take them through the governance forums for approval. Translate policy into the standards that operationalise it: standard trade-terms structures, contract and agreement templates, clause libraries, deal approval and delegation-of-authority rules, and the minimum data a contract must carry to be executed correctly in the systems. Use the baseline to show where claims are created — contract ambiguity, non-standard terms, pricing and promotion setup, accruals, proof of performance, master data — and design the fix upstream. Design the interventions: standard contract-to-condition setup, automated accruals and settlement, validated claim intake, reason-code frameworks and claims workflow. Prepare business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, business rules and user stories. Facilitate design workshops and document outcomes and decisions. Assess process, policy, financial and control impacts, and define how policy compliance will be monitored.Deliver the outcome: standard contracts, fewer claims and <1 Day Resolution — 20%. Design for, and evidence, policy adoption and compliance across markets, an increase in contracts on standard terms and templates, fewer policy exceptions, a reduction in claims volume, aged claims, invalid deductions and trade-spend leakage, and movement toward <1 Day Resolution for appropriate claims and queries. Shape the build-out of SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, Control Tower claims and deduction functionality, and contract and trade promotion management tooling as the primary levers on the outcome. Define the measures with the business owner, monitor post-go-live performance against the baseline, and recommend and, where owned, implement continuous improvements to the design. This is the accountability every other accountability serves.Own testing, deployment and adoption through the value drops — 20%. Translate requirements into working design on SAP, Control Tower and the contract and trade promotion management toolset with D&T, system integrators and vendors. Define and review test scenarios, support SIT and UAT, and manage defect resolution with business users. Break the work into fragments that can be delivered on the value drop cadence, and own the backlog, dependencies and risks for the fragment. Support deployment, hypercare and business readiness, and hand over up-to-date commercial standards, contract templates, process documentation, SOPs, controls and training materials to the run teams. Aim for SIT and UAT completed with minimal post-go-live defects and a clean handover into run.Manage delivery discipline and enable across the programme — 10%. Track requirements, risks, assumptions, dependencies and decisions throughout the lifecycle, and escalate early and precisely when the frame is wrong. Act as a trusted partner to market Commercial, Revenue Growth Management, Sales Finance, Credit, Legal, Internal Control, Customer Service, GBO, D&T and vendors, and coach business users through testing, deployment and adoption. Enable the adjacent workstreams — Order-to-Invoice, Collections, Claims & Receivables, Customer Service and Supply — by surfacing cross-boundary impact before it becomes a deployment defect, and by handing design-level root causes to the workstream that owns them. Commercial Standards, Claims & Contracts domain depth and business analysis, on a broad Customer Operations base. Real SME depth in commercial policy and customer contracts — credit policy and credit risk, claims policy, pricing governance, trade-terms structures, rebates, discounts and promotions, contract lifecycle management, accruals, and claims validation and settlement — sufficient to act as design authority and to write policy that is clear, enforceable and auditable, combined with strong business-analysis craft: process mapping, requirements gathering, gap analysis, functional-specification writing, user stories and workshop facilitation. Understands how claims and deductions are created across the commercial and Order to Cash process, and how contract wording, deal approval, pricing and promotion setup, master data and accruals drive them. Built on a general understanding of Customer Operations end-to-end (Order to Cash, Commercial and Supply) and of how markets actually work, including upstream and downstream impact. Knows Consumer Products industry standards and the realities of Beer, Wine & Spirits — distributor and wholesaler concentration, complex customer agreements, promotional and trade-spend claims, and route-to-market and regulatory constraints on trade terms. Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards. Data, technology and delivery discipline. Comfortable interrogating contract, trade-terms, accrual, claims and deduction data directly, and translating requirements into working design on SAP pricing, condition contracts and settlement management, the Control Tower claims and deduction platform, and the supporting contract and trade promotion management toolset. Understands the platform, the data model, the business rules, workflow and approval logic, and the operating model — retained, GBO and BPO — beneath the process. Strong on test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT), business readiness and hypercare, and on risk, issue and dependency management. Data-driven by instinct — baselines the problem, quantifies the opportunity and lets the evidence settle the argument. Able to prioritise across concurrent workstreams and deadlines. Design-for-prevention rigour, stakeholder influence and adaptability. Relentless about cause over symptom in design — not satisfied with automating a workaround when the claim could be designed out through a clearer standard, contract or setup. Strong stakeholder management and influencing across a global and local matrix, including senior Commercial, Finance and Legal stakeholders and policy governance forums, and consultative by default: frames the problem before prescribing and drives stakeholders toward aligned design decisions. Clear communicator, and able to manage conflict to a resolution rather than let it stall a decision. Comfortable being redeployed: arrives in an unfamiliar market or process, orients fast, and adds value quickly. Resilient, collaborative, and a visible role model for Diageo’s values.QualificationsBachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Finance, Business, Commercial, Law, Operations, IT or a related discipline.Working knowledge of Diageo BPQMS standards. Business-analysis, Agile / Scrum or Lean Six Sigma credentials are an advantage; familiarity with SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower or similar claims and deduction platforms, or contract lifecycle or trade promotion management tools is a plus.Experience — EssentialOverall. 10+ years spanning transformation, business analysis and consultative experience, with a strong core of business analysis and SME design work in large-scale process transformation.Subject matter expertise. Deep functional understanding of credit, claims and pricing policy, commercial terms, customer contracts and agreements, trade promotions and claims within a Commercial and Order-to-Cash environment — someone who knows how claims and deductions are created by contract terms and commercial setup, and how standards and process should be designed to prevent them, not only the tooling. Operational exposure is useful context; the requirement is designing the process, not running it.Transformation. Experience in business process transformation, including current-state assessment and future-state operating model design, across the full lifecycle from design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation. Evidence of reducing claims, deductions, trade-spend leakage, cycle time or manual effort against a defensible baseline.Consultative. A track record of acting as a trusted business partner — framing the real problem, facilitating design decisions, aligning global and local stakeholders — and being measured on whether the business changed, not only on whether the deliverable shipped.Technology. Experience translating business requirements into functional specifications and solution design with D&T, system integrators and vendors, including test planning and defect management (SIT / UAT). SAP pricing, condition contracts or settlement management, Control Tower, or comparable contract, trade promotion or claims platform exposure is an advantage.Industry. FMCG or Consumer Products experience is essential. Beer, Wine & Spirits experience is strongly preferred.General understanding of Customer Operations end to end — OTC, Commercial and Supply — and of how markets actually operate, including upstream and downstream impact.Experience — DesirableExperience formulating and governing commercial policy — credit, claims and pricing governance — and the standards beneath it: trade-terms frameworks, contract templates, clause libraries and deal approval policies — across multiple markets.Exposure to contract lifecycle management, trade promotion management, or claims and settlement automation, including AI-led claim validation and matching.Experience designing reason-code frameworks and claims analytics that let run teams identify and remove the causes of claims and deductions.Experience defining what must be global standard versus what requires market localisation.Experience working in a pooled, on-demand or competency-based delivery model across multiple workstreams.Prior experience of a GBO or shared services transition or operating model consolidation.About UsWith over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. As part of our EY-Valuations team, you will help clients understand the value of their business, securities, intellectual property, capital equipment, intangibles and other assets. The group is comprised of several key areas, including business valuation, business modelling, capital equipment and complex securities

We are looking for Analyst with expertise in Quantitative Finance and Complex Securities Valuation to join EY-VME (Valuation, Modelling and Economics). This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a prominent firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development

* Demonstrated an aptitude in the quantitative and qualitative analyses of financial instruments, including options, warrants, fixed income securities, and other derivatives.

* Identify business development opportunities and assist Partners and Senior Managers on proposals and new business opportunities.
* Stay abreast of current business and economic developments relevant to our as well as the client's business.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Excellent thoughtfulness, communication, interpersonal and teaming skills
* Experience in Equity Research, Investment Banking and Corporate Finance
* Experience in financial modelling, including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred
* Knowledge and experience in any of the following sectors will be added advantage – Financial Services, Oil and Gas, Technology, Consumer Products, Power and Utilities and Life Science
* Willingness and ability to travel, when necessary
* Exposure to databases such as Capital IQ, Bloomberg etc
* Experience in analytics tools and techniques like Python, R, VBA, PowerBI etc

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A post graduate degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting (CA) or Business with 1-3 years of related work experience
* A minimum of 1 to 3 years direct experience in utilizing Valuation techniques and methodologies such as Purchase Price Allocations (PPA), Discounted Cash Flow (DCF), Income Approach, market comparable, etc in a business valuation firm or practice or in venture capital, investment banking, commercial banking, financial research, national valuation firm or experience working in a corporate finance role for an organization, preferably for M&A activities Experience in financial modelling including experience building models from scratch in MS Excel and related software preferred
* Preferable achievement in or significant progress towards a CFA, ASA, CPA or related certification

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Project management skills
* Strong communication and presentation skills

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of a market-prominent, multi-disciplinary team of 1400+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with prominent businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

The CRP Services Analyst will support the Civil Aerospace Service Business team in creating accurate financial forecasts for aftermarket service contracts through the Contract Review Pack process. Graduate or engineering degree with 3-7 years of relevant experience in data management, financial analytics, forecasting support, reporting, process operations or supply chain-related analytics. Aerospace, aftermarket services, supply chain or financial analytics experience is desirable.

title: Portfolio Value Realisation Manager
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Portfolio Value Realisation Manager ensures that the investments DPTF makes deliver measurable business value. The role operates the value framework. It defines how benefits are identified, baselined, measured and reported, ensures every funded initiative has a named benefit owner and a measurement schedule, and tracks realised outcomes against what was committed at the point of funding.
  
  
Benefit ownership sits with platform and product domain leadership. This role defines the method, secures the inputs, reports the position, and coaches and challenges benefit owners against the value they committed to. It works closely with the Investment & Portfolio Manager so that measurable outcomes are defined before funding, with the Technology Performance Manager so that value and performance are read together, and with Finance so that reported value reconciles with the financial picture.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Operate the DPTF value framework, defining how benefits are identified, baselined, measured and reported across the portfolio.
* Ensure every funded initiative has a benefit baseline, a named benefit owner in the domain, a measurement schedule and an agreed tracking method before funding is released.
* Define the value KPIs and benefit OKRs against which investments and programmes are assessed, distinct from the delivery and service metrics owned by Technology Performance Management.
* Measure and report realized business outcomes against committed benefits, capturing emergent value as well as variance to the original business case, and recommend the holding or release of funding tranches at stage-gates on the basis of realized value.
* Track benefit delivery through and beyond initiative closure, so that value continues to be measured once delivery has finished.
* Coach and challenge benefit owners in the platform and product domains against the value they committed to, holding them to it through evidence and transparency rather than direct authority.
* Partner with the Investment & Portfolio Manager so that measurable outcomes and benefit profiles are defined at business case stage, not added once delivery is under way.
* Provide value-based insight into portfolio prioritisation and re-prioritisation decisions, including where committed benefits are not being realised.
* Work with Finance and Business Operations to reconcile claimed benefit against the financial position, so that value reporting withstands scrutiny.
* Set the value measurement standards that federated Domain Portfolio Managers apply, so benefit data is consistent and comparable across domains.
* Build value management capability across DPTF through guidance, templates and coaching, so that benefit ownership becomes embedded in the domains over time.
* Use AI and analytics to accelerate benefit measurement, variance analysis and value reporting.

**Experience Required**

* Overall 15+ Years of exp, typically 6-8 years in value or benefits management, portfolio management, investment planning, or business analysis roles within technology or digital functions.
* Experience defining benefit baselines, measurement schedules and tracking methods across a portfolio of investments.
* Demonstrated experience measuring and reporting realised outcomes against committed benefits, including where results fall short.
* Experience defining KPIs and OKRs linked to business value rather than delivery activity.
* Experience working with Finance to reconcile claimed benefit against the financial position.
* Experience building capability in others through guidance, templates and coaching for benefit owners.
* Familiarity with portfolio tooling and with AI-enabled analytics applied to benefit measurement and reporting.

**Skills/Background**

* Strong analytical and financial literacy, able to interpret benefit, cost and value data and test whether claimed value is real.
* Excellent communication skills, able to report an uncomfortable value position clearly and without apportioning blame.
* Ability to coach and challenge senior stakeholders constructively and without formal authority.
* Well organised, able to run recurring measurement cycles across a large portfolio.
* Comfort operating where practice is immature and the method is still being established.

**Skills**
Agile Methodology, Benefits Management, Business Analysis, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Investment Planning, Portfolio Management, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
  
  
**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.
  
  
It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.
  
  
**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

We also provide transfer pricing compliance services to large/mid-sized MNCs.

You would have the opportunity to be involved in the complete lifecycle of each project, from initiating discussions with clients to assisting with the preparation of proposals and eventually delivering the projects.

* Regular participate in client meetings.
* Be part of the team which publishes thought leadership papers.
* Regular interactions with senior leaders as part of project management.
* Participation in knowledge exchange sessions and collaboration across the multifunctional team.
* Contribute to business development initiatives by identifying opportunities and supporting proposal development.
* Leverage technology, data analytics, AI-driven solutions, and automation tools to enhance transfer pricing engagements.

**Qualifications**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) freshers
* Entrepreneurial mindset with passion to handle multiple work streams.
* Good communication and analytical skills.
* Solution oriented approach.
* Enthusiasts in tax and economics related research topics.
* Ability to manage multiple projects while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.

**What FD offers**

* Competitive salary
* Clear career growth path within the firm.

title: Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager
description:
**About Centric Software**
Centric Software® is a global leader, providing an innovative and AI-enabled product-concept-to-commercialization platform for retailers, brands and manufacturers of all sizes. We equip retail, fashion, luxury, footwear, outdoor, home and consumer goods brands with pioneering best-of-breed solutions to plan, design, develop, source, comply, buy, make, price, allocate, sell and replenish products. Our technology powers brands to streamline processes, drive efficiency and operate with confidence in an ever-changing market.
  
  
Our story is one of rapid growth, bold ideas and extraordinary opportunities. We’re here to challenge the status quo—and we’re looking for brilliant people who want to do the same. No matter where you are in the world, this is your chance to be part of something exceptional.
  
  
**Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager**
**Position Summary**
We are seeking a
**Senior Revenue Accountant/Manager**
to join our Accounting team at a fast-growing global software company. This role will play a critical role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition while helping scale the revenue accounting function through process improvement, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
The Senior Revenue Accountant will own key aspects of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, serve as a technical accounting resource for complex customer arrangements under
**ASC 606 and IFRS 15**
, and partner closely with Sales, Legal, Revenue Operations and other stakeholders throughout the quote-to-cash lifecycle.
  
  
This is both an operational and advisory role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting judgment with a practical business mindset, is comfortable evaluating complex and non-standard deal structures, and proactively identifies opportunities to use technology, data, automation, and AI to improve the quality, speed, and scalability of revenue accounting processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Revenue Accounting & Technical Expertise**

* Own key components of the monthly and quarterly revenue close, ensuring accurate and timely revenue recognition, accounting, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Evaluate executed and proposed customer contracts under ASC 606 and IFRS 15, including complex and non-standard arrangements.
* Perform technical accounting assessments involving standalone selling price (SSP), multiple performance obligations, contract modifications, variable consideration, material rights, early renewals, future purchase options, SLA credits, swaps, termination provisions, and other complex contract terms.
* Prepare clear, well-supported technical accounting analyses and memos documenting significant judgments and conclusions.
* Maintain contract review procedures and documentation to support consistent application of company revenue recognition policies.
* Stay current on relevant U.S. GAAP, IFRS, FASB, SEC, and financial reporting developments and assess their impact on company policies and practices.

**Revenue Close & Financial Reporting**

* Prepare and/or review revenue-related journal entries, account reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
* Perform monthly and quarterly reconciliations and fluctuation analyses for revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled accounts receivable, and other revenue-related accounts.
* Investigate unusual trends, discrepancies, and accounting issues and drive timely resolution.
* Develop and monitor relevant revenue accounting KPIs to improve visibility into process performance, data quality, and close execution.
* Support management reporting, financial statement preparation, and ad hoc revenue analyses as required.

**Systems, Automation & AI**

* Manage and review revenue accounting activities within NetSuite ARM or similar revenue recognition systems, including sales order approval, revenue arrangements, allocation and schedule adjustments, order activation, and revenue schedule maintenance.
* Proactively identify opportunities to automate manual and repetitive work across the revenue accounting and quote-to-cash lifecycle.
* Design, prototype, implement, or help deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, and automated workflows that improve efficiency, scalability, analytical capability, and control.
* Apply a clean-sheet mindset to existing processes, challenging legacy workflows and identifying opportunities to simplify or redesign them using generative AI, advanced automation.
* Leverage automation to enhance areas such as contract review, reconciliations, fluctuation analysis, large-dataset analysis, audit support, and management reporting.

**Cross-Functional Business Partnership**

* Partner proactively with Sales, Deal Desk, Legal, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, FP&A, Product, Engineering, and IT to evaluate the accounting implications of proposed transactions.
* Provide accounting guidance before deal execution to help the business structure arrangements in a manner that supports commercial objectives while maintaining accounting compliance.
* Advise on the revenue implications of new products, pricing models, go-to-market initiatives, and changes to commercial practices.
* Translate complex accounting conclusions into clear, actionable guidance for non-accounting stakeholders.
* Identify and resolve contract, system, or process discrepancies and escalate significant matters to revenue accounting leadership as appropriate.
* Consider global implications of accounting conclusions and process changes and support consistent policies and practices across regions.

**Controls, Audit & Process Excellence**

* Maintain high-quality, audit-ready documentation supporting revenue accounting judgments, reconciliations, and controls.
* Own or support key revenue-related internal controls and update control procedures as systems, business processes, products, and policies evolve.
* Perform risk assessments associated with revenue process and system changes and recommend appropriate control enhancements.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during interim and annual audits, including preparation and ownership of PBC schedules and responses to audit inquiries.
* Lead or participate in high-impact revenue accounting projects and process improvement initiatives.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
* CPA or equivalent preferred.
* Approximately 5+ years of progressive accounting experience, with meaningful experience in revenue accounting; Big Four or other public accounting experience is preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and ASC 606, including demonstrated experience evaluating complex customer contracts and revenue recognition judgments.
* Experience with SaaS, software, subscription, or other recurring revenue business models, including multi-element or multiple-performance-obligation arrangements.
* Experience with ERP, billing, and revenue recognition systems; experience with NetSuite and NetSuite ARM is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue close activities and deliver accurate results under tight monthly and quarterly reporting deadlines.
* Advanced Excel skills and strong analytical capabilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical accounting matters effectively to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and cross-functional initiatives with limited supervision.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will:
  
  
Bring strong technical judgment to complex revenue recognition matters.
  
  

* Execute a high-quality, timely, and increasingly automated revenue close.
* Become a trusted advisor to commercial and finance stakeholders on complex transactions and new business models.
* Reduce manual work and improve scalability through thoughtful use of systems, automation, data, and AI.
* Strengthen revenue accounting documentation, controls, and audit readiness as the company grows.
* Take ownership, move with urgency, operate effectively through ambiguity, and continuously raise the standard for the revenue accounting function.

*Centric Software provides equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status or genetic information.*

title: Senior Revenue Accountant
description:
**About The Job**
As a Senior Revenue Accountant at LaunchDarkly, you will play a critical role in ensuring that revenue is recognized accurately and in accordance with US GAAP and ASC 606, while leaning heavily into AI-driven automation to enhance process efficiency and scalability. You will own revenue-related tasks for month end close procedures and partner closely with cross functional teams (like Sales, Deal Desk, Legal) to review customer contracts and non-standard terms. You will also assist with external audits, preparing ad hoc analyses, and be a key point of contact for all revenue recognition activities. This role is ideal for a revenue accounting professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where you can have a direct impact.

* Maintain and reconcile revenue schedules across revenue, accounts receivable, deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, and customer credits
* Develop and maintain revenue accounting workbooks, rollforwards, and supporting documentation that provide clear audit trails from customer contracts and usage data through the general ledger

* Identify opportunities to improve and automate revenue accounting processes, controls, reconciliations, and reporting
* Partner with system administrators and cross-functional teams to improve the integration and data flow among CRM, billing, usage, and ERP systems
* Support development of scalable revenue accounting policies and procedures as the company and its product offerings evolve

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* 8+ years of relevant accounting experience, including meaningful experience with SaaS revenue recognition
* CPA or equivalent is a must

* Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and ASC 606 and experience evaluating customer contracts and revenue arrangements.
* Experience with SaaS, cloud infrastructure, AI, technology, or other consumption-based business models strongly preferred
* Experience working with large datasets and reconciling information across multiple systems

**Overview**
The Product Analyst plays a key role in supporting the successful delivery, continuous improvement and adoption of finance systems products by translating business needs into clear, prioritised and actionable requirements. Working closely with Product Leads, Product Owners, business stakeholders, technical teams and support functions, the role helps shape product backlogs, assess enhancement opportunities, analyse process and system impacts, and ensure changes are aligned to business priorities, control requirements and the strategic product roadmap. The Product Analyst provides insight, structure and coordination across the product lifecycle, helping to improve user experience, operational effectiveness, data quality and system performance while supporting robust governance, testing, release readiness and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Your role
  
  

* Partner with Product Leads, Product Owners and business stakeholders to elicit, assess, document and validate business requirements, ensuring requirements are clear, complete, prioritised and aligned to product objectives, control requirements and the wider Finance Systems roadmap.
* Facilitate workshops, process reviews and discovery sessions with finance users, operational teams, technology teams and third-party partners to understand pain points, define business outcomes, map current and future state processes, and identify opportunities for simplification, automation and standardisation.
* Translate business needs into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, functional specifications, process maps and supporting documentation that enable Engineering, Configuration, Data, Integration and Testing teams to design, build and validate effective solutions.
* Support the Product Lead in the management of product backlog items, enhancement requests and demand pipeline activities by assessing business value, urgency, risk, dependencies, effort and impact, and by helping Product Leads maintain a transparent and prioritised view of work.
* Conduct impact assessments across finance processes, controls, data, integrations, reporting, security and user experience to ensure proposed changes are understood, appropriately governed and delivered without compromising operational stability or compliance obligations.
* Adhere to ITS Finance Systems Governance requirements, ensuring all analysis, change, testing, release, support and continuous improvement activities are delivered in line with the defined ITIL processes, governance controls, approval routes and operational standards.
* Ensure compliance with IT General Controls (ITGC) by supporting effective control operation, maintaining appropriate evidence, identifying control impacts from proposed changes, and escalating risks or exceptions in line with Finance Systems governance and audit requirements.
* Support testing activities by preparing test scenarios, reviewing test scripts, coordinating user acceptance testing, triaging defects, validating fixes and ensuring appropriate evidence is captured to support release readiness and governance approvals.
* Contribute to release and deployment activities by supporting cutover planning, business readiness assessments, communications, training materials, stakeholder engagement and post-deployment validation to drive successful adoption and minimise disruption.
* Investigate incidents, service issues and recurring problems by analysing symptoms, data, process impacts and system behaviour, working with support and technical teams to identify root causes, define corrective actions and reduce repeat failures.
* Monitor product performance, user feedback, support trends and operational metrics to identify continuous improvement opportunities that enhance user experience, data quality, process efficiency, compliance and service resilience.
* Continuously grow product, process and technology knowledge across the Finance Systems ecosystem, using insights from users, vendors, industry practices and emerging capabilities to drive innovation, improve product outcomes and identify opportunities for simplification, automation and enhanced business value.
* Maintain high-quality product documentation, including functional specifications, decision records, process maps, knowledge articles, release notes and user guidance, ensuring information remains accurate, accessible and aligned to governance standards.

**About You**

* Experience supporting Oracle ERP or enterprise finance systems and delivering business enhancements Deep expertise within one or more Finance process domains.
* Proven experience leading complex business analysis and transformation activities.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and driving organisational change.
* Strong understanding of ERP delivery lifecycles and product management principles.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Oracle Ebusiness suite and Oracle Fusion implementation experience

* Perform sensitivity, attribution, and assumption analysis to support balance sheet and interest rate risk management.
* Validate the accuracy, reasonableness, and consistency of data, assumptions, models, and outputs; maintain strong data quality and controls.
* Deliver recurring analyses accurately and in compliance with treasury risk management, regulatory, model governance, and audit requirements. Enhance forecasting, valuation, and analytics capabilities by documenting business requirements, conducting analytical testing, strengthening controls, and supporting new investment strategies.
* Improve processes through automation, Power BI, Python, AI, and other approved efficiency-enhancing solutions; provide recommendations to senior team members and management
* Act as Lead Consultant to finance, accounting and Business Line management on matters related to corporate treasury and related financial management

* Ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and exercise independent judgment in a complex, changing organization.

title: Associate Strategist
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 3–5 years of experience in strategy, customer analytics, or business intelligence, ideally within the banking industry
* Strong, hands-on proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint is essential; working knowledge of Power BI, Alteryx, or SQL is a strong plus
* Working knowledge of CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce/ SFDC) for generating reports and building, maintaining, and monitoring dashboards
* Comfortable handling large sets of sparse and multi-source data (quantitative and qualitative); translating raw data into forecasts, ARR/ retention analysis, and portfolio-level insight that supports business decisions
* Demonstrated analytical thinking — able to identify patterns in data and draw sound business inferences, not simply produce reports
* Curious and self-directed; picks up new tools, datasets, or business questions with minimal handholding. Quick learner
* Comfortable adapting across strategy execution, analytics, and reporting priorities as team needs shift

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field required; MBA or postgraduate degree preferred but not required at this level

**Responsibilities**

* Support Banking's Commercial Strategy team with pricing, customer, and portfolio analytics that inform deal-desk decisions and broader strategic initiatives
* Build and maintain customer and market analytics, deal-desk support models, and ARR/ retention dashboards for the Banking business
* Develop forecasting models, segmentation analysis and portfolio-level analysis to support strategic decisions
* Support execution monitoring and process governance cadences for key strategic initiatives, coordinating with senior strategists as needed
* Maintain and evolve data models and automation/ AI-enabled workflows that improve the speed and accuracy of recurring analysis
* Support ongoing initiatives such as the Banking Hub and OKR monitoring with foundational data and reporting
* Translate analysis into clear, decision-ready recommendations for senior strategists — not just status updates
* Adapt across strategy execution and analytics support as priorities shift across the team

**About The Team**
The Banking Commercial Strategy team drives strategic growth across Moody's Banking solutions through deep customer and market analytics. We deliver data-driven insights that inform market led strategy — helping shape Moody's long-term vision for the Banking business
  
  
Our work sits at the center of Moody's efforts to deliver differentiated value to commercial banking clients. By joining us, you will contribute to impactful initiatives spanning strategy formulation, market intelligence, pricing, and customer analytics — while collaborating closely with product, sales, finance, senior leadership, and product/domain and central strategy teams
  
  
Moody’s is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Candidates for Moody's Corporation may be asked to disclose securities holdings pursuant to Moody’s Policy for Securities Trading and the requirements of the position. Employment is contingent upon compliance with the Policy, including remediation of positions in those holdings as necessary.

title: General Manager- Business Finance
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore

**Way of working:**
In-office, full-time from the Bangalore base location

**Experience:**
7–10 years post-qualification

**About Swiggy Instamart**

Swiggy Instamart is pioneering quick-commerce grocery delivery across India, fulfilling over 30,000 SKUs to consumers in just 10–15 minutes. Dedicated to redefining modern shopping through seamless instant delivery, Instamart currently spans more than 100 Indian cities and maintains a strong trajectory of rapid expansion.

**The Role**

As GM – Business Finance for Instamart, you will be the finance partner to the business leadership team, owning planning, P&L performance, commercials and cost efficiency for a high-growth quick commerce business. The role calls for a strategic, analytical leader who can manage the finances of a fast-scaling business and influence decisions across categories, operations and growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Planning & Forecasting**

• Own long-term strategic planning, quarterly and annual operating plans, budgeting and forecasting for the business.

• Lead planning, execution tracking and delivery for festive and event-led peaks.

**P&L Ownership & Business Partnering**

• Act as a co-pilot to business leaders, owning outcomes and driving decisions amid uncertainty.

• Manage the P&L day to day, using data-driven trend analysis of revenue and P&L metrics to improve the shape of the P&L and surface key insights for leadership.

• Build a deep understanding of Instamart’s consumers, categories and cross-functional levers, including the drivers of revenue and the impact of pricing on growth.

• Set and drive targets with business teams, leading gap analysis and improvement plans.

• Run weekly business and financial reviews, providing data-backed recommendations and ensuring follow-through with business leaders.

**Commercials & Category Partnership**

• Partner with category teams on category development and growth.

• Evaluate and structure commercial proposals for category margins, and lead negotiations.

**Cost Optimisation & Governance**

• Work with operations leaders to eliminate inefficient costs and build processes for a sustainable, steady-state cost structure.

• Design processes for new initiatives and strengthen existing ones, with a focus on governance and plugging cost leakage.

**Working Capital**

• Drive working capital management, including inventory and return per square foot, to improve returns and support top-line growth.

**Reporting, Analytics & Automation**

• Own financial reporting, financial modelling and ad-hoc business analysis built on key business input levers.

• Automate reporting using Business Intelligence tools.

**What We’re Looking For**

• CA or MBA (Finance/Strategy) preferred, with 7–10 years of post-qualification experience.

• Strong grounding in Business Finance/ FP&A, P&L management, financial modelling and commercial negotiations.

• Ability to work with and influence senior, cross-functional stakeholders.

• Self-starter who takes ownership with minimal direction and brings fresh approaches to business problems.

• Continuous-improvement mindset and the ability to learn fast.

• Excellent verbal and written communication.

*We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Financial Market Analyst Intern
description:
Job Title: Financial Market Analyst Intern
  
Location: Remote
  
Organization: PipRaisers
  
Stipend: Up to ₹20,000/month (Performance Based)
  
Duration: 2 Months
  
Opportunities: Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) & Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
  
  
About PipRaisers
  
PipRaisers is a market intelligence and proprietary trading research firm that empowers trading talent with robust analytical tools, structured insights, and strategic thinking. We focus on high-impact trading in global markets—spanning currencies, commodities, indices, and digital assets. Our mission is to cultivate sharp market minds through research-backed execution frameworks.
  
  
Role Overview
  
As a Financial Market Analyst Intern at PipRaisers, you will work at the intersection of macro research and market strategy. You will be responsible for decoding market-moving data, identifying trading opportunities, and crafting actionable insights that directly influence trade setups and risk positioning across asset classes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Conduct macroeconomic and geopolitical research to understand global market trends
  
2. Track and interpret central bank policies, inflation data, and global risk factors
  
3. Analyze key drivers of asset classes like forex, commodities, indices, and crypto
  
4. Support the creation of daily/weekly market commentary, sector outlooks, and research decks
  
5. Combine technical indicators and fundamental narratives to propose trade-worthy ideas
  
6. Align analysis with proprietary strategies and execution goals
  
7. Participate in research calls, idea generation sessions, and post-event briefings
  
  
Who Should Apply?
  
1. Final-year students or graduates in Economics, Finance, or Business Analytics
  
2. Passion for global markets, monetary policy, and cross-asset research
  
3. Proficiency in using charting platforms, data portals, and economic calendars
  
4. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and written communication
  
5. Bonus: Previous experience with investment research, blogs, trading journals, or macro commentary
  
  
What You’ll Gain
  
1. Real-time exposure to global market analysis and trading desk collaboration
  
2. Training in multi-asset research frameworks and real-world market interpretation
  
3. Stipend of up to ₹20,000/month based on research quality and involvement
  
4. Internship Certificate and Letter of Recommendation (LOR)
  
5. PPO opportunity for outstanding contributors and long-term analysts
  
6. Weekly mentorship from experienced market strategists and trading professionals
  
  
  
Start Date: Immediate preferred
