title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
**Senior Financial Analyst**
**Hybrid, Bangalore or Pune, India**
**JOB OVERVIEW**
Legion is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to help drive disciplined planning, forecasting and decision support across a growing SaaS business. This role will own assigned forecasts and reporting, build scalable financial models, analyze financial and operating performance, and translate findings into clear recommendations for leaders.
  
  
The successful candidate combines strong FP&A fundamentals with commercial judgment, comfort working with SaaS metrics and systems, and the ability to partner effectively with both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  
  
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist Financial Planning and Analysis Director in managing the strategic planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes.
* Own designated components of the annual budget, periodic forecasts and long-range plan, including assumptions, scenario analysis and consolidation support.
* Develop and maintain driver-based financial models for revenue, headcount, operating expenses, pricing, investments and strategic initiatives
* Deep understanding of SaaS financial and operational KPIs, a strong ability to analyze data to identify trends, actual performance against budget, forecast, prior periods risks, opportunities for growth. Monitor key KPIs and recommend corrective actions.
* Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly management reporting, dashboards, executive presentations and decision-support materials.
* Investigate revenue, cost, margin, and operational variances and explain key business drivers.
* Partner with business functions to evaluate performance and support commercial decisions.
* Perform profitability, pricing, cost-benefit, ROI, sensitivity and ad hoc analyses to support business cases and investment decisions.
* Support month-end and quarter-end closing activities in coordination with accounting teams by reviewing results, validating data and resolving reporting discrepancies.
* Ensure the accuracy, consistency, integrity of financial data and reports through standardization, automation and effective use of finance systems.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls, documentation and data integrity, and support audit or compliance requests related to assigned work.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related field. MBA is required or relevant professional qualification is preferred
* 5+ years of experience in in FP&A, strategic finance, business finance or a closely related analytical finance role in a SaaS, enterprise-software company
* Proficiency with NetSuite required;
* Advanced financial modelling skills, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, and management accounting , financial statement and operation analysis.
* Ability to synthesize complex financial and operational data into concise insights and practical recommendations.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a results-driven mindset.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively across functions.
* Demonstrated commitment to confidentiality, integrity, and professional ethics.
* Experience with BI or data tools such as Tableau, Power BI or SQL, and an interest in using automation or AI to improve finance workflows

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

* Accuracy and timeliness of budgets, forecasts, and management reports.
* Quality and relevance of financial insights and recommendations.
* Forecast accuracy and variance management.
* Achievement of cost-optimization and profitability-improvement targets.
* Timely completion of financial analyses and strategic projects.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and effectiveness of finance business partnering.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**
At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.
  
  
We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.
  
  
Benefits include, but are not limited to:
  
  

* Health Benefits
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Parental Leave
* Equity
* Monthly Wellness Reimbursement
* Monthly Lunch on Legion

**ABOUT LEGION**
Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. description:
**Title: Sr. Consultant, FP&A Reporting & Data Transformation**

**Contract Duration: 12 Months Contract**

**Onsite: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India**

**Address: KimberlyClark - 7th & 8th Floor, Prestige Saleh Ahmed, No:105, Infantry Rd, Tasker Town, Shivaji Nagar,**

* Work is primarily remote, but there will be critical phases of the projects when they would want the resource to come into the Bangalore office.
* Hours - Contractor must be a bit flexible as the hours can vary based on the phase of the project.
* Initial duration - 12 months, but this is a long-term ongoing project.

**Role**

* The Sr. Consultant will support FP&A reporting, financial data management, reconciliation, and the ongoing modernization of the FP&A reporting landscape. A key focus of the role will be supporting the migration of existing financial reports and data processes to Snowflake and the new data platform, while ensuring financial accuracy and continuity of reporting.
* The role requires a strong understanding of accounting, financial reconciliations, month-end financial close, SAP financial data, and finance master data. The individual should be able to understand financial data flows, reconcile reporting results back to source financial systems, investigate discrepancies, and work with stakeholders to resolve data and reporting issues.
* The position will also be cross-trained as a backup for critical FP&A COE Reporting Delivery activities, particularly month-end data processing, reconciliations, and recurring financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Develop, maintain, and enhance FP&A financial reports and dashboards.
* Support the migration of financial reporting and data processes to Snowflake/new data platforms, including validation and reconciliation of migrated data.
* Perform financial reconciliations between SAP, Snowflake, and other financial reporting systems, investigating and resolving differences.
* Support month-end financial close, including data validation, reconciliation, and reporting activities.
* Understand financial data flows and master data across source and reporting systems.
* Partner with Finance and FP&A stakeholders to troubleshoot reporting, mapping, master-data, and data-quality issues.
* Identify opportunities to standardize, simplify, and improve reporting and reconciliation processes.
* Become cross-trained on designated critical team activities and provide backup coverage when required.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* 7+ years of experience in FP&A, Finance, Accounting, financial reporting, analytics, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of accounting and financial reporting concepts.
* Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with financial reconciliations and data validation.
* Good understanding of month-end financial close processes and associated reporting timelines.
* Working knowledge of SAP financial data and the ability to reconcile reporting results back to SAP/source financial systems.
* Good understanding of finance master data, including GL accounts, cost centers, profit centers, legal entities, hierarchies, and financial mappings.
* Experience supporting financial reporting solutions, preferably Power BI and Excel/Power Query.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate financial data discrepancies and identify root causes.
* Ability to work effectively during critical month-end close and reporting cycles.
* Strong communication, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with Snowflake and financial data/reporting migrations to modern data platforms.
* Experience querying data using SQL for analysis, validation, and reconciliation.
* Experience with Power BI development and financial reporting.
* Exposure to Anaplan, HANA, HFM, Management Reporting, or similar finance and reporting platforms.
* Experience with financial data transformation, master-data mappings, and reporting-system integrations.
* Experience improving or automating financial reporting and reconciliation processes.

Join a dynamic, globally connected team where your expertise will directly shape how we manage and grow one of the most exciting portfolios in Life & Health Reinsurance.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the APAX markets continue to grow in scale and strategic importance, the L&H Operations Insights team sits right at the heart of that momentum. In this role, you will be a key contributor to enhancing client service delivery and strengthening operational efficiency by combining deep data expertise with sharp business acumen to drive decisions that matter. From advanced validation and regulatory reporting to financial monitoring and automation, your work will have real, measurable impact across the Asia Pacific and ANZ regions.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Quality & Risk Management**

* Identify risks and process gaps and recommend monitoring tools and controls to strengthen governance across TA Operations, Operations Insights and Stargate or data-related projects and initiatives
* Drive data quality improvements in collaboration with enabling teams to reduce risk exposure and optimize resource utilization
* Provide audit and regulatory support by coordinating with TA Operations, Regional Relationship Managers and local or branch-level auditors

**Advanced Validation & Reporting**
  
  

* Manage regulatory reporting requirements for APAX and ANZ, including VAT/GST and APRA-related submissions
* Review contractual agreements and perform detailed validations related to premiums, claims and underwriting clauses for APAX and ANZ
* Prepare product-level summaries to generate actionable insights for Operations, Portfolio Management, Actuarial and Product teams

+ Validate new business deals and complex treaties, support actuarial modelling across the Asia region
+ Perform premium rate and complex data validations using Python, SQL, and formula-driven logic to identify variances and provide quality assurance
+ Support automation initiatives by defining validation logic, contributing to coding and data structuring and enhancing end-to-end validation workflows
+ Develop dashboards and insights using Power BI and other visualization tools to communicate findings clearly and effectively

**Financial Monitoring**

* Support Actuarial and Finance teams with financial monitoring for the L&H business
* Conduct financial comparisons including Actuals vs. Estimates, Actuals vs. Actuals and Cash flow variance analysis, collaborating across teams to resolve discrepancies
* Lead quarterly monitoring activities and prepare reports supporting regional closing cycles
* Analyze revenue trends and key statistical metrics during periodic closing
* Perform pre- and post-closing activities and publish control and monitoring reports
* Compare new business volumes with client-reported data to support accurate financial projections
* Conduct simplified lapse studies to identify early warning indicators and highlight business-impacting trends

**About The Team**
The L&H Operations Insights team is an integral part of Life & Health Operations, playing a pivotal role in delivering high-quality operational insights, maintaining robust financial controls and enabling proactive risk mitigation. With the growing scale and complexity of APAX markets, the team ensures agility, client-centricity and proactive performance monitoring across key portfolios. We are a collaborative, multicultural group that values curiosity, accountability and continuous improvement - we take pride in the meaningful contribution we make to the broader L&H business.
  
  
**About You**
You are an analytical thinker and a confident communicator who brings both technical depth and business perspective to everything you do. You are comfortable navigating complexity, challenging the status quo and working across diverse, cross-functional teams in a virtual environment. You take ownership of your work, lead with integrity and are motivated by delivering outcomes that genuinely make a difference for clients and the business.
  
  
**We Are Looking For Candidates Who Meet These Requirements**

* 4–6 years of experience in Life & Health Insurance or Reinsurance, preferably with exposure to Financial Planning and Analysis
* Strong technical proficiency in Excel, SAS/SQL and Stargate, with demonstrated ability to perform complex data validations and financial analysis
* Advanced analytical skills with a solid understanding of L&H concepts and an end-to-end value chain perspective
* Regulatory and audit experience, including familiarity with VAT/GST, APRA submissions, or similar compliance frameworks
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Actuarial Science, Finance, Accounting, Insurance or related field. IFRS 17 knowledge or certification is preferred

**These Are Additional Nice To Haves**

* Experience with Python, Machine Learning or AI tools for data analysis and automation
* Proficiency in Power BI or other data visualization platforms to build dashboards and communicate insights
* Stakeholder management experience across multicultural and cross-functional teams in a virtual or matrixed environment
* Experience in coaching or mentoring team members or prior involvement in project management, stakeholder engagement or training initiatives
* Familiarity with actuarial support or collaboration with Actuarial and Finance teams
* An agile mindset with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a strong sense of accountability and commitment

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.
  
  
**About Swiss Re**
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.
  
  
Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.
  
  
If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
  
  
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

**Description**
We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Finance Manager to join our Finance as a Service (FaaS) team in Bangalore.
  
  
This role is critical to ensure that our accounting processes run smoothly in a highly controlled and compliant environment, delivering exceptional accuracy, efficiency, and insights aligned with Amazon’s leadership principles of Customer Obsession, Deliver Results, and Insist on the Highest Standards.
  
  
You will work closely with customer controllership team, Finance Operations, and account management teams to support month-end close, drive operational excellence, and uphold rigorous financial control standards with technology first mind set. This position plays a pivotal role in closing customer books, preparing reconciliations, managing journal entries, driving reporting, and engaging with leadership on performance reviews.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The candidate would be responsible for financial close and performing related reporting, accruals etc. Additionally, the role would support monthly P&L analysis, perform financial reporting and forecasts, use financial systems and advanced MS Excel functions to work with large data sets, and perform headcount reporting, planning and forecasting. The candidate would also perform ad-hoc business analyses and financial modeling, provide inputs for monthly and quarterly business reviews in a timely manner, facilitate business reviews with data analysis, facilitate financial review meetings with business groups and work with business managers to ensure effective finance and cost management, partner with stakeholders to develop strategic multi-year or long term operating plans, challenge processes, identify and implement solutions to resolve, improve, automate, standardize, or simplify finance processes, and identify incomplete or inaccurate data, root cause of data issues, escalate discrepancies, fix data where possible or partner to deliver a solution.

* 8+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience
* 3+ years of advanced proficiency in Excel (pivots, lookups, etc.) experience
* 6+ years of Accounts Receivable or Account Payable experience
* 6+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
* 6+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
* 6+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
* 5+ years of directly managing and leading a team of 5+ members experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
* 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
* 6+ years of mentoring junior finance and/or business team members experience
* 3+ years of working with senior staff (e.g. c-suite) experience

* Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (i.e. SQL, MSAccess, Essbase or Cognos) and providing recommendations based on results of ad hoc analyses to management for strategic decision-making

title: Senior Analyst - Retail Accounting
description:

We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.
  
  
**Summary Of The Role**
Levi Strauss & Co. is looking for a detail‑oriented Senior Analyst, Retail Accounting to support retail accounting operations and broader record‑to‑report (RTR) activities across the Americas. This role partners Retail Operations, Finance, and upstream teams to ensure accurate accounting, timely close, strong controls/SOX compliance, and audit readiness. The ideal candidate is analytical, hands‑on, and comfortable working in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Own and support monthly, quarterly, and year‑end close activities for retail and general ledger areas (accruals, reclasses, and analysis).
* Prepare and review journal entries, ensuring appropriate support, approvals, and compliance with accounting policies.
* Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations (retail and corporate accounts), ensuring reconciling items are investigated and cleared in line with SOX/internal control requirements.
* Perform checks on retail cash variances (POS, deposits, bank matching) and support bank reconciliations, investigating discrepancies and driving timely resolution.
* Analyze P&L and balance sheet fluctuations, prepare variance commentary, and partner with stakeholders to explain results.

* Collaborate with Retail Operations, Finance, Shared Services, and global teams to resolve issues, align on timelines, and improve end‑to‑end processes.

* Identify opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation (templates, reporting, system enhancements) to improve close accuracy and cycle time.

* Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals, month‑end close, and RTR processes; exposure to retail cash/POS flows is a plus.
* Experience with SAP / S/4HANA (or similar large ERP) and a strong working knowledge of GL, subledger integrations, and reporting
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI (or similar tools) to build/maintain close and reconciliation reporting
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to translate data into clear insights for stakeholders
* Proven ability to thrive in a deadline‑driven environment, manage multiple priorities, and drive work to closure with minimal supervision
* Working knowledge of internal controls/SOX, audit support, and documentation standards
* Comfortable working across global time zones and collaborating with geographically distributed teams

title: Corporate Accounting Analyst (Bangalore)
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
To further this important mission, we're building our Accounting team in Bangalore Finance and are looking for someone to help us scale for the future in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly detail-oriented and tech-forward Corporate Accounting Analyst to join our fast-paced corporate accounting team. In this role, you will play a critical part in managing General Ledger (GL) activities, ensuring accurate close processes, and driving accounting precision across specialized technical areas, including debt, prepaids, intercompany transactions, and lease accounting .
  
  
The ideal candidate holds a Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification, possesses 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, and brings a modern, tech-enabled mindset—specifically the ability to leverage AI tools, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline workflows and solve complex accounting problems in a rapidly evolving environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Own end-to-end accounting schedules, journal entries, and balance sheet reconciliations for corporate accounting areas .
* Manage month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing activities within prescribed timelines.
* Conduct variance analyses on P&L and Balance Sheet line items, investigating unexpected fluctuations and providing actionable commentary to management.
* Support internal and external audit requests by preparing audit schedules, supporting documentation, and clear accounting workpapers.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams (F&S, FinOps, Tax, Operations) to ensure accurate accounting treatment for complex transactions.
* Leverage ERP automation, analytical capabilities and AI-driven tools (e.g., prompt engineering, automated reconciliation workflows, intelligent data extraction) to enhance accuracy and timeliness.
* Identify bottlenecks in the financial close cycle and implement automated solutions or streamlined workflows.
* Utilize advanced data tools to process large volumes of financial data accurately under tight deadliness.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Education & Certification: Chartered Accountant (CA) or equivalent professional accounting designation is mandatory.
* Experience: 4 to 6 years of post-qualification core corporate accounting experience, with strong hands-on expertise in General Ledger operations.
* AI & Tech Proficiency: Demonstrated ability to adopt and operate AI tools (e.g., generative AI for documentation/analysis, workflow automation software, advanced ERP modules) to optimize accounting tasks.

Key Competencies & Soft Skills
  
  

* Fast-Paced Adaptability: Ability to prioritize effectively, meet tight monthly/quarterly closing deadlines, and thrive in an agile, dynamic environment.
* Analytical & Detail-Oriented: Exceptional problem-solving skills with a high degree of precision in numerical and technical accounting work.
* Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with remote teams, management, and external auditors.
* Self-Starter: Strong ownership mindset, able to work independently as a contractor with minimal supervision.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge of (or experience in) the technology or payments industry
* Big4 working experience
* Oracle suite
* Hubble and SQL

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

title: Senior Vendor Management Analyst - Contingent Labor Managed Services
description:
**How You'll Help Us Keep Climbing (Overview & Key Responsibilities)**
**Responsibilities**
The Digital & Technology Vendor Management Office (VMO) is responsible for maximizing value from Delta's largest technology suppliers through governance, performance management, utilization reporting, and cost optimization. The VMO focuses on three core outcomes:
  
  

* Establish outcome-based vendor performance management
* Drive measurable cost reduction and value realization
* Deliver utilization and workforce reporting that improves decision making

As a Senior Vendor Management Analyst, you will support Delta's Professional Services and Consulting portfolio, partnering closely with vendor leaders, Global Delivery Network leaders, Supply Chain Management, Finance, and technology stakeholders.
  
  
This role partners closely with centralized Sourcing on SOW structuring and commercial terms but is not a standalone contract administration function.
  
  
You will operate as an internal consultant focused on identifying opportunities, analyzing vendor performance, building executive-ready recommendations, and helping leaders execute sourcing, consolidation, workforce productivity, and vendor optimization initiatives across a multi-million-dollar supplier portfolio.
  
  
The Senior Vendor Management Analyst supports governance and optimization of Delta's professional services suppliers including GDP providers, consulting firms, and contingent labor partners.
  
  
The role combines analytics, problem solving, financial analysis, executive communications, and vendor governance. You will help identify savings opportunities, validate business cases, develop performance scorecards, track supplier commitments, and support vendor reviews focused on productivity, workforce efficiency, and value realization.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong analytical thinking, curiosity, executive presence, and the ability to convert data into actionable recommendations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Vendor Performance & Governance**

* Support governance of strategic professional services suppliers and consulting partners.
* Develop and maintain vendor scorecards measuring delivery performance, workforce efficiency, value realization, and productivity outcomes.
* Prepare executive-ready materials for vendor governance reviews and business reviews.
* Analyze supplier performance trends and identify risks, issues, and opportunities requiring leadership attention.
* Partner with Delta's centralized Sourcing team and IT stakeholders on deal structuring for consulting services SOWs supporting application development and maintenance work, ensuring commercial terms align with delivery and cost objectives.
* Develop fixed-deliverable SOWs with clearly defined milestones, acceptance criteria, and penalty/remedy clauses for delays or missed expectations.

As a Credit Risk Model Validation Analyst, you will validate and strengthen the models and tools Citi relies on to measure market, credit, and operational risk. This role sits within a team that maintains the analytical foundation behind Citi's risk decisions, offering hands-on exposure to real-world credit risk modeling and data analysis.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Validate credit risk models used to measure obligor risk and support early warning tools for corporate and consumer portfolios.
* Conduct data analysis for Loss Given Default studies and contribute directly to model development.
* Evaluate and apply scoring models to strengthen credit risk policies and decision-making.
* Maintain core risk parameters, including default data, rating migration data, usage given default data, and transition matrices.
* Spot gaps in existing risk policies and help shape new ones to close them.
* Translate data analysis into clear recommendations grounded in credit risk expertise.
* Document models, methods, and validation processes so they are clear, reproducible, and audit-ready.

* Strong communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly to different audiences.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* Background in Quantitative Finance, Risk Management, Analytics, Model Development, or Model Validation.
* Experience building or validating risk measurement models.
* Exposure to credit risk analysis, particularly developing early warning tools.
* Familiarity with industry standards and practices in credit risk management.
* Knowledge of SAS in addition to R or Python for data analysis.

**What We Offer**
You will build deep technical expertise in credit risk modeling while working alongside experienced analysts who shape how Citi measures and manages risk globally.
  
  

* Hands-on development in credit risk model validation, with exposure to real portfolios and real decisions.

* A hybrid work arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely.

Maintain good professional rapport with the internal and external customers.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Job Summary**
The primary responsibilities of the Senior Accountant are to support the timely and accurate preparation of financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, manage complex general ledger and revenue accounting activities, and ensure revenue is properly recognized in accordance with US GAAP and IFRS. This role encompasses the responsibilities of partnering cross-functionally with Sales, FP&A, Legal, and operations, performing technical accounting research, supporting audits and reporting requirements, and maintaining strong internal controls. The Senior Accountant will also identify process improvements, drive automation, use advanced data and reporting tools, and provide guidance to junior accounting team members.
  
  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

* Executes month-end close activities, including the accurate and timely recording of revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, and related journal entries in accordance with IFRS, US GAAP, Company policy, ASC 606, and IFRS 15
* Prepares and reviews complex balance sheet and income statement reconciliations, including revenue, deferred revenue, contract assets and liabilities, billings, accounts receivable, and other technical accounts
* Reviews new and existing customer contracts, addendums, sales orders, and non-standard terms to determine proper revenue recognition treatment and ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards
* Serves as a revenue accounting resource for Sales, FP&A, Legal, and business stakeholders during contract negotiation by evaluating revenue impact, communicating implications, and recommending compliant alternatives
* Prepares specialized reports, monthly balance sheet and income statement analyses, variance explanations, and management reporting to support accurate financial results and business decision-making
* Performs technical accounting research and drafts accounting memorandums for revenue recognition and other complex accounting matters
* Monitors relevant IFRS and US GAAP reporting developments, and recommends updates to policies, procedures, controls, and reporting practices as needed
* Develops, documents, and improves revenue recognition and general accounting processes, including internal controls, system modifications, data flows, reconciliations, and reporting enhancements
* Supports the annual audit by preparing schedules, reconciliations, supporting analyses, and technical accounting memos
* Partners with FP&A and leadership on forecasting, budgeting, trend analyses, and ad-hoc financial analysis
* Uses advanced Excel capabilities and data tools, including Power Query, dynamic arrays, complex formulas, pivot tables, VBA, SQL, Power BI, Power Automate, Python, and similar platforms to improve reporting, automate recurring work, and strengthen analytics
* Provides guidance and mentorship to junior accounting staff, answers technical questions, and reviews work as needed
* Provides and maintains excellent customer service to other departments and stakeholders
* Works with the Controller, Assistant Controller, and Supervisor, Accounting on various initiatives and completes special projects and other ad-hoc requests

Education
  
  

* BS or BA in Accounting or equivalent discipline
* CPA or CA Certification preferred

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of financial and accounting experience
* Revenue recognition experience required, including technical knowledge of ASC 606 and IFRS 15
* Public accounting experience preferred
* Software or SaaS revenue recognition experience preferred
* Experience with accounting systems required; Microsoft D365 Finance experience is a plus

Skills/Knowledge
  
  

* Strong technical accounting background with a thorough knowledge of IFRS and US GAAP, including ASC 606, IFRS 15, technical research, and preparation of accounting memorandums
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition, bookings and billings processes, contract review, deferred revenue, contract assets and liabilities, and related internal controls
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including Power Query, dynamic arrays, complex formulas, pivot tables, data modeling, data validation, and macros/VBA
* Experience with SQL and business intelligence, reporting, and automation tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Python, and similar platforms
* Experience with AI tools is a plus
* Ability to clearly and concisely document and effectively communicate complex accounting and reporting issues to the finance and non-finance teams
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process-improvement skills, including the ability to convert large data sets into actionable insights
* Highly effective communication skills (verbal and written)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, meet deadlines, multitask efficiently, and manage multiple critical projects
* Detail-oriented with a high level of ethics and integrity
* Ability to mentor team members and collaborate cross-functionally to drive accurate reporting and continuous improvement

**Work Environment/Physical Demands**

* While at work, this position is primarily a sedentary job and requires that the associate be able to work in an environment where they will consistently be seated for the majority of the workday
* This role requires that one can sit and regularly type on a keyboard for the majority of their workday
* This position requires the ability to observe a computer screen for long periods of time to observe their own and others' work, as well as incoming and outgoing communications via the computer and/or mobile devices.
* The role necessitates the ability to listen and speak clearly to customers and other associates
* The work environment is an open room with other associates, and noise from others will be part of the regular workday

title: Accounting & Financial Reporting Analyst
description:
**POSITION: Accounting & Financial Reporting Analyst**
**Job Summary**
This role provides accounting and financial analysis support within a centralized Finance Shared Services organization, supporting a portfolio of 500+ extended stay hotels. Reporting to the Finance Shared Services Manager, the position is responsible for preparing journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, financial analyses, and reporting in accordance with U.S. GAAP, company policies, and internal controls.
  
  
The role serves as a key preparer supporting monthly close, audits, budgeting/forecasting support, and ad hoc financial analysis, while partnering closely with U.S.-based accounting, FP&A, and operations teams. This position requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, experience working within a large ERP environment (Oracle preferred), and advanced Excel capabilities.
  
  
**Major / Key Job Duties**
**Accounting & Close**

* Prepare recurring and non‑recurring journal entries in accordance with U.S. GAAP.
* Perform monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities in a timely and accurate manner.
* Prepare BS account reconciliations, investigate variances, and resolve reconciling items.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data prior to submission to corporate finance.
* Maintain supporting documentation for all journal entries and reconciliations in compliance with internal controls.

**Financial Analysis & Reporting Support**

* Prepare standard and ad hoc financial reporting, including trend analysis and variance explanations.
* Support FP&A teams with actuals analysis to inform forecasts, budgets, and long‑range planning.
* Assist in the preparation and validation of data used in management reporting and dashboards.
* Analyze financial data across systems to identify unusual trends, risks, or improvement opportunities.
* Respond to routine analytical requests from finance and operations stakeholders.

**Audit & Compliance Support**

* Prepare audit schedules and supporting documentation for external audits.
* Respond to auditor inquiries and assist in resolution of audit requests.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, procedures, and internal control requirements.

**Process Improvement & Systems Support**

* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and standardization within accounting processes.
* Assist with implementation of process improvements, automation initiatives, and system enhancements, including AI-enabled tools.
* Support testing and validation activities related to system upgrades or process changes.
* Ensure data integrity across ERP and reporting tools.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Support**

* Partner effectively with U.S.-based finance, accounting, and operations teams.
* Communicate clearly regarding close status, issues, and analytical findings.
* Support cross-functional projects and special initiatives as assigned.

**Other Duties**

* Provide backup support to team members as needed during close cycles.
* Assist with special projects, integrations, acquisitions, or transitions.
* Prepare ad hoc reports and analyses for management.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Competencies**

* Accounting & Finance Knowledge: Strong understanding of accrual accounting, general ledger activity, financial analysis concepts, and U.S. GAAP
* Analytical Skills: Ability to research issues, analyze large datasets, identify root causes, and resolve discrepancies.
* Attention to Detail: High level of accuracy in reconciliations, reporting, and documentation.
* Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to work effectively with Finance, Operations, and Field teams.
* Organization & Time Management: Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and operate effectively in a deadline‑driven environment.
* Systems & Tools: Experience working with ERP/PBC systems and Tableau platforms; strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Customer & Service Orientation: Strong internal service mindset when supporting field and corporate stakeholders.

**ENVIRONMENTAL / WORKING CONDITIONS**

* Office‑based or hybrid role in a professional finance environment.
* Primarily sedentary, computer‑based work.
* Periodic overtime may be required during month‑end or peak workload periods

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related field.
* 2-5 years of experience in accounting or finance operations.
* Experience supporting reconciliations, journal entries, and monthly close activities.
* Experience supporting high-volume, multi-entity operations.
* Experience in real estate or retail industry strongly preferred
* Experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, analysis or reporting
* Experience in Oracle, Hotel Key, or Tableau preferred

title: Assistant Director - Assistant Director - Strategic Finance & Business Insights
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Advanced Strategic Insights**
**The opportunity**
As part of the Advanced Strategic Insights team, you will convert complex financial, operational and market information into clear, decision-relevant insights for GDS leadership. The role will support enterprise-wide priorities by identifying performance trends, developing hypotheses, evaluating strategic choices and translating analysis into concise executive narratives. Success requires strong financial acumen, advanced analytical capability and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through evidence-based insights.
  
  
**The role**
This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people-management responsibility. The Assistant Director will independently lead the development of advanced strategic insights across business performance, growth, operating model, workforce and transformation priorities.
  
  
The individual will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to frame ambiguous questions, integrate multiple data sources and deliver recommendations that inform strategic and commercial decisions. The role requires leadership through subject-matter expertise, influence and ownership of complex deliverables rather than through formal team management.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead high-impact strategic insight engagements across growth, financial performance, market expansion, operating model, workforce, location strategy, alliances and transformation priorities.
* Frame business questions, develop hypotheses and structure analytical approaches that move beyond descriptive reporting to explain drivers, implications and potential actions.
* Analyse financial and operational performance, including revenue, cost, margin, productivity, utilization, investment, capacity and other relevant business metrics.
* Build robust financial models, scenario analyses, sensitivity assessments and business cases to evaluate strategic choices and quantify financial impact.
* Synthesise large and complex datasets into clear trends, insights, risks, opportunities and leadership-level recommendations.
* Develop executive-ready PowerPoint presentations with a compelling storyline, message-led headlines and clear articulation of the so what.
* Create and maintain advanced Excel-based analytical models, trackers and decision-support tools with strong data integrity and quality controls.
* Conduct external research, benchmarking and competitive intelligence, triangulating evidence and clearly distinguishing facts, assumptions and hypotheses.
* Partner with Finance, Strategy, Operations, Talent and Service Line stakeholders to validate analysis, align interpretations and shape decision options.
* Present insights to senior leaders, respond to challenge constructively and refine analysis based on leadership priorities.
* Establish repeatable insight frameworks, templates and analytical standards that improve the quality, consistency and speed of decision support.
* Provide subject-matter guidance and constructive review to colleagues where required, without formal line-management accountability.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong financial acumen and the ability to interpret financial statements, management information and business performance metrics.
* Advanced Excel capability, including financial modelling, scenario analysis, complex formulas, pivot tables, data validation and management of large datasets.
* Advanced PowerPoint skills, with demonstrated ability to translate analysis into concise, visually clear and executive-ready narratives.
* Excellent analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect data points, identify root causes and surface decision-relevant implications.
* Strong business writing, communication and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior stakeholders.
* Ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgement and take end-to-end ownership of complex insight deliverables.
* Ability to work through ambiguity, prioritise competing asks and manage multiple insight requirements in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail, intellectual curiosity and a strong commitment to data accuracy and evidence-based conclusions.
* Effective stakeholder management, collaboration and influencing skills across functions and geographies.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in finance, strategy, business planning, commercial finance, management reporting, corporate development, transaction advisory or a related analytical role.
* A professional qualification or postgraduate degree such as CA, CMA, CFA or MBA (Finance), or a comparable qualification supported by relevant experience.
* Substantial hands-on experience in financial analysis, financial modelling, business case development and performance diagnostics.
* Proven experience using Excel and PowerPoint to deliver analysis and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Experience working with large datasets and integrating financial, operational and market information into coherent insights.
* A track record of independently leading complex, cross-functional insight deliverables from problem definition through executive communication.

**Ideally, you will also have**

* A prior finance background, preferably in FP&A, commercial finance, controllership, management reporting, transaction advisory or corporate finance.
* Experience in a global professional services, consulting, shared services or global delivery environment.
* Exposure to strategic planning, workforce planning, operating-model assessment, location strategy or business transformation will be preferred
* Knowledge of data visualisation and business intelligence tools such as Power BI.
* Experience providing analytical guidance, peer review and quality assurance for leadership deliverables.

**What We Look For**
A commercially minded finance professional who can combine analytical depth with strategic perspective. You should be comfortable operating as an individual contributor, moving from detailed numbers to the executive story, challenging assumptions constructively and producing insights that help leaders understand what is changing, why it matters and which options should be evaluated.
  
  
**What Working At EY GDS Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic global delivery network that works with EY teams across service lines, geographies and sectors. The role offers exposure to senior leadership priorities, cross-functional business questions and opportunities to strengthen enterprise-level decision support through advanced strategic insights.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Associate - TAG
description:

Sustainable economic earnings Historical sales and profitability trends Working capital levels Key assumptions used in management’s forecast Key personnel and accounting information systems

title: Analyst
description: symplr is seeking a FP&A Analyst to provide embedded analytical support for the Technology/R&D organization and help build the financial operating system for engineering investment, workforce planning, capitalization discipline, productivity, and technology cost structure.This Bangalore-based role will partner with the Sr. Director, Engineering FP&A, the U.S.-based Engineering FP&A Manager, Engineering leadership, Product & Professional Services FP&A, Accounting, HR, Procurement, and Corporate FP&A to translate engineering activity, capacity, and cost drivers into accurate models, clear reporting, and useful business insight.The right candidate is hands-on, analytically rigorous, highly curious, and comfortable going deep into workforce data, engineering spend, capitalization inputs, contractor/vendor analytics, cloud/tooling costs, and recurring FP&A deliverables.Duties & Responsibilities Key Responsibilities: ENGINEERING FINANCE ANALYTICS & BUSINESS SUPPORT Support Engineering/R&D FP&A with recurring analysis, reporting, and decision support across workforce, capacity, roadmap investment, technical cost structure, and productivity. Translate engineering priorities, product/platform initiatives, security work, technical debt, AI/platform investments, and maintenance activity into clearly structured analysis and model inputs. Prepare monthly Engineering financial review materials, variance analysis, metrics packages, and supporting schedules for review with Engineering and FP&A leadership. Partner with Product & Professional Services FP&A as needed to support analysis of roadmap affordability, product commitments, implementation implications, and build-versus-buy economics. PLANNING, FORECASTING & MODELING Maintain detailed Engineering/R&D planning and forecast models in alignment with Corporate FP&A templates, calendars, definitions, and submission standards. Build and update workforce models by team, location, product/platform area, initiative, employee/contractor mix, hiring status, and forecast period. Support monthly forecasting, annual planning, variance analysis, and scenario analysis for Engineering/R&D spend, headcount, contractors, vendors, cloud/tooling, and other technology-related costs. Prepare accurate, timely, and well-documented forecast inputs that can be reviewed, consolidated, and explained by Engineering FP&A leadership and Corporate FP&A. CAPITALIZATION, COST STRUCTURE & PRODUCTIVITY ANALYSIS Support R&D capitalization and OpEx/CapEx analysis by organizing inputs, tracking activity, maintaining supporting schedules, and partnering with Accounting/CAO under FP&A leadership guidance. Analyze cloud, tooling, vendor, contractor, and technology infrastructure spend tied to engineering productivity and cost efficiency. Maintain reporting and analysis around R&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost by product/platform/initiative, capitalized versus expensed development, innovation versus maintenance capacity, and location mix. Support vendor rationalization, contractor mix, location strategy, and build-versus-buy analysis by preparing clean datasets, trends, comparisons, and scenario outputs. DATA, DASHBOARDS & PROCESS DISCIPLINE Create and maintain repeatable reports, dashboards, and analysis packs that improve visibility into Engineering investment, capacity, productivity, and trade-offs. Ensure Engineering FP&A outputs are accurate, traceable, clearly documented, and consistent with FP&A definitions, KPI standards, model architecture, and version-control expectations. Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring analysis and reporting processes using planning tools, BI tools, and analytical automation. Maintain strong data hygiene across headcount, vendor, contractor, capitalization, cloud/tooling, and cost-center reporting inputs. WAYS OF WORKING & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP Develop deep fluency in Engineering/R&D operations, technology cost drivers, and symplr’s product/platform investment model. Operate as an embedded tower resource rather than a generic shared-services analyst, building enough functional depth to anticipate questions and improve analysis quality over time. Work collaboratively across U.S. and India time zones, balancing responsiveness with high-quality, well-organized analytical output. Bring curiosity, ownership, and continuous-improvement mindset to a growing FP&A function that is being built as an enterprise decision engine. Skills Required Qualifications Required: B com/ MBA in Finance & Accounting Experience & Background 3+ years of progressive finance, FP&A, business finance, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting, analytics, or related experience. Experience supporting Engineering, Technology, Product, R&D, SaaS, enterprise software, healthcare technology, or similarly complex operating environments preferred. Experience with workforce planning, headcount modeling, variance analysis, forecast support, vendor/contractor spend analysis, or management reporting strongly preferred. Exposure to PE-backed, high-growth, scaling, multi-product, or operationally complex businesses is helpful but not required. Technical & Analytical Capabilities Strong financial modeling, Excel, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with ability to manage detail while telling a clear business story. Working knowledge of workforce planning, scenario analysis, variance analysis, cost-center reporting, vendor analytics, and productivity metrics. Familiarity with R&D capitalization, OpEx/CapEx concepts, cloud/tooling cost analysis, and technology cost structures preferred. Comfortable working with planning systems, BI tools, ERP/financial systems, and large datasets; curiosity about automation and AI-enabled analytical improvements. WAYS OF WORKING Hands-on analyst with strong ownership, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to ask why before accepting surface-level answers. High attention to detail, strong documentation habits, and commitment to producing accurate, timely, and explainable work product. Clear communicator who can summarize analysis, risks, and drivers for finance and non-finance stakeholders. Builder mindset with a bias toward practical process improvement, scalable reporting, and continuous learning. The above job description is not intended to be an all-inclusive list of duties and standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as assigned by their supervisor.

title: Senior Accounts Officer – General Accounting & Payroll
description:
Highlights
  
  

* Location Bengaluru, KA
* Start Date Immediately
* Work Location Allows Hybrid Remote Work

**Skills**

* Indian Statutory Requirements
* Accounts Payable
* Financial Reporting
* Accounts Receivable
* Provident Fund Management
* Payroll Processing
* Cash Flow Statements
* Gratuity Calculations
* Vendor Master Data Maintenance
* Statutory Tax Return Filing
* Full And Final Settlements Payroll
* General Ledger Accounting
* Salary Master Data Management
* Gst Payment Coordination
* Payroll Administration
* Vendor Payment Coordination
* Bank Reconciliations
* Leave Encashment Processing
* Taxation Compliance

**Description**
**About MatrixCare**
MatrixCare provides software solutions to more than 15,000 providers supporting skilled nursing, senior living and
  
  
long-term care, life plan communities, and home health and hospice care. A multi-year winner of the Best in KLAS
  
  
award, MatrixCare is trusted by thousands of facility-based and home-based care organizations to improve provider
  
  
efficiencies and promote a better quality of life for the people they serve. For more information, visit
  
  
www.matrixcare.com.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Senior Accounts Officer supports accurate and timely accounting and financial operations for MatrixCare India.
  
  
The role covers general ledger accounting, financial reporting, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and
  
  
taxation in accordance with IGAAP and Indian statutory requirements. The position also supports process
  
  
improvement, effective financial controls, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**General Accounting & Reporting**

* Manage day-to-day General Ledger postings and perform bank and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Maintain Fixed Asset Register (FAR), accruals, prepaid expenses, and other balance sheet schedules,

including monthly depreciation, amortization, and write-off entries.
  
  

* Ensure accurate and timely month-end closing activities.
* Oversee payroll and Full & Final (F&F) settlements, coordinate with payroll vendors, and resolve payroll

related queries.
  
  

* Maintain salary master data and payroll-related schedules, including leave encashment, gratuity, and

Provident Fund (PF), ensuring timely payment of employee statutory dues.
  
  

* Prepare accurate and timely Trial Balance (TB), Profit & Loss (P&L), Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statements,

and MIS reports for MatrixCare India.
  
  

* Prepare annual tax plans, oversee advance tax calculations, and ensure timely filing of statutory tax returns.
* Coordinate with GST consultants to ensure timely GST payments, refunds, and return filings.
* Prepare and submit monthly STPI reports.

**Accounts Payable**

* Ensure accurate and timely processing and updating of Purchase Orders (POs), trade and non-trade

invoices, and supplier advances.
  
  
Company Data
  
  

* Track and follow up on outstanding invoices to ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely vendor payments and resolve payment-related

issues.
  
  

* Manage vendor interactions related to advance payments, balance confirmations, reconciliations, and

settlements.
  
  

* Maintain accurate and updated Vendor Master Data (VMD).

**Accounts Receivable**

* Ensure timely and accurate intercompany invoicing and revenue accounting.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly cross-charge calculations for MatrixCare business verticals.
* Monitor intercompany collections, track trading partner payments, and ensure timely clearance of accounts

receivable balances.
  
  

* Maintain and regularly reconcile Customer Master Data (CMD).

**Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Ensure finance and accounting operations comply with applicable statutory regulations, internal procedures,

and agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Turnaround Times (TAT).
  
  

* Implement process improvement initiatives, policies, and procedures to enhance operational efficiency,

productivity, and service quality.
  
  
**Stakeholder Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure effective coordination and

operational performance.
  
  

* Collaborate with external stakeholders, including auditors and regulatory authorities, to support smooth

business operations.
  
  

* Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for Accounts and Payroll operations at MatrixCare India.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Support the implementation of effective governance, compliance, and risk management frameworks across

MatrixCare India's finance and accounting operations.
  
  

* Proactively identify business risks, recommend preventive measures, and ensure timely resolution of

compliance-related issues.
  
  

* Coordinate with labour compliance vendors to ensure timely statutory filings and maintenance of required

compliance records.
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* B.Com, M.Com, MBA in Finance, CA-Inter, or CMA (preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in Indian accounting.
* Experience in general accounting, payroll, accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and

taxation.
  
  

* Strong accounting knowledge and familiarity with Indian tax and statutory laws.
* Exposure to Tally and Oracle ERP environments.
* Ability to coordinate with internal stakeholders, vendors, auditors, consultants, and authorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CA-Inter or CMA qualification (preferred).
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience supporting process automation and continuous improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**
Timely and accurate month-end close and financial reporting; reliable payroll and employee statutory processing;
  
  
accurate AP/AR records and intercompany reconciliations; effective compliance, stakeholder coordination, and
  
  
continuous process improvement.
  
  
**Why Join MatrixCare?**
At MatrixCare, we are committed to fostering a culture where teammates can grow their careers and make a
  
  
meaningful impact on the healthcare industry. We offer opportunities to contribute to innovative solutions that help
  
  
improve care delivery, while providing a supportive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
Our teammate value proposition includes comprehensive health and wellness benefits, leave benefits, professional
  
  
development opportunities, and a culture built on trust, innovation, and teamwork. By joining MatrixCare, you'll be
  
  
part of a purpose-driven organization dedicated to advancing healthcare technology and creating an exceptional
  
  
experience for both teammates and customers.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity / Legal Statements**
MatrixCare is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every individual is treated
  
  
with respect and dignity. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions based on
  
  
qualifications, merit, business needs, and performance, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual
  
  
orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any
  
  
other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are dedicated to providing equal access to opportunities and
  
  
reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment and employment process, ensuring that all teammates can
  
  
contribute, grow, and succeed in an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and encouraged.

title: Sr. Analyst, Engineering FP&A
description:
symplr is seeking a Senior FP&A Analyst to provide embedded analytical support for the Technology/R&D organization and help build the financial operating system for engineering investment, workforce planning, capitalization discipline, productivity, and technology cost structure.
  
  
This Bangalore-based role will partner with the Sr. Director, Engineering FP&A, the U.S.-based Engineering FP&A Manager, Engineering leadership, Product & Professional Services FP&A, Accounting, HR, Procurement, and Corporate FP&A to translate engineering activity, capacity, and cost drivers into accurate models, clear reporting, and useful business insight.
  
  
The right candidate is hands-on, analytically rigorous, highly curious, and comfortable going deep into workforce data, engineering spend, capitalization inputs, contractor/vendor analytics, cloud/tooling costs, and recurring FP&A deliverables.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**
****Key Responsibilities:****
**ENGINEERING FINANCE ANALYTICS & BUSINESS SUPPORT**

* Support Engineering/R&D FP&A with recurring analysis, reporting, and decision support across workforce, capacity, roadmap investment, technical cost structure, and productivity.
* Translate engineering priorities, product/platform initiatives, security work, technical debt, AI/platform investments, and maintenance activity into clearly structured analysis and model inputs.
* Prepare monthly Engineering financial review materials, variance analysis, metrics packages, and supporting schedules for review with Engineering and FP&A leadership.
* Partner with Product & Professional Services FP&A as needed to support analysis of roadmap affordability, product commitments, implementation implications, and build-versus-buy economics.

**PLANNING, FORECASTING & MODELING**

* Maintain detailed Engineering/R&D planning and forecast models in alignment with Corporate FP&A templates, calendars, definitions, and submission standards.
* Build and update workforce models by team, location, product/platform area, initiative, employee/contractor mix, hiring status, and forecast period.
* Support monthly forecasting, annual planning, variance analysis, and scenario analysis for Engineering/R&D spend, headcount, contractors, vendors, cloud/tooling, and other technology-related costs.
* Prepare accurate, timely, and well-documented forecast inputs that can be reviewed, consolidated, and explained by Engineering FP&A leadership and Corporate FP&A.

**CAPITALIZATION, COST STRUCTURE & PRODUCTIVITY ANALYSIS**

* Support R&D capitalization and OpEx/CapEx analysis by organizing inputs, tracking activity, maintaining supporting schedules, and partnering with Accounting/CAO under FP&A leadership guidance.
* Analyze cloud, tooling, vendor, contractor, and technology infrastructure spend tied to engineering productivity and cost efficiency.
* Maintain reporting and analysis around R&D spend as a percentage of revenue, cost by product/platform/initiative, capitalized versus expensed development, innovation versus maintenance capacity, and location mix.
* Support vendor rationalization, contractor mix, location strategy, and build-versus-buy analysis by preparing clean datasets, trends, comparisons, and scenario outputs.

**DATA, DASHBOARDS & PROCESS DISCIPLINE**

* Create and maintain repeatable reports, dashboards, and analysis packs that improve visibility into Engineering investment, capacity, productivity, and trade-offs.
* Ensure Engineering FP&A outputs are accurate, traceable, clearly documented, and consistent with FP&A definitions, KPI standards, model architecture, and version-control expectations.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve recurring analysis and reporting processes using planning tools, BI tools, and analytical automation.
* Maintain strong data hygiene across headcount, vendor, contractor, capitalization, cloud/tooling, and cost-center reporting inputs.

**WAYS OF WORKING & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP**

* Develop deep fluency in Engineering/R&D operations, technology cost drivers, and symplr’s product/platform investment model.
* Operate as an embedded tower resource rather than a generic shared-services analyst, building enough functional depth to anticipate questions and improve analysis quality over time.
* Work collaboratively across U.S. and India time zones, balancing responsiveness with high-quality, well-organized analytical output.
* Bring curiosity, ownership, and continuous-improvement mindset to a growing FP&A function that is being built as an enterprise decision engine.

**Skills Required**
**Qualifications Required:**

* Bcom/MBA

**Experience & Background**

* 3+ years of progressive finance, FP&A, business finance, investment banking, corporate finance, consulting, analytics, or related experience.
* Experience supporting Engineering, Technology, Product, R&D, SaaS, enterprise software, healthcare technology, or similarly complex operating environments preferred.
* Experience with workforce planning, headcount modeling, variance analysis, forecast support, vendor/contractor spend analysis, or management reporting strongly preferred.
* Exposure to PE-backed, high-growth, scaling, multi-product, or operationally complex businesses is helpful but not required.

**Technical & Analytical Capabilities**

* Strong financial modeling, Excel, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with ability to manage detail while telling a clear business story.
* Working knowledge of workforce planning, scenario analysis, variance analysis, cost-center reporting, vendor analytics, and productivity metrics.
* Familiarity with R&D capitalization, OpEx/CapEx concepts, cloud/tooling cost analysis, and technology cost structures preferred.
* Comfortable working with planning systems, BI tools, ERP/financial systems, and large datasets; curiosity about automation and AI-enabled analytical improvements.

* Clear communicator who can summarize analysis, risks, and drivers for finance and non-finance stakeholders.

description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.

In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an FP&A Analyst for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.
  
  
The FP&A Analyst supports ACC’s financial planning, forecasting, management reporting and portfolio analysis activities as a member of the Bengaluru-based FP&A team. Working under the direction of the Director – FP&A and in close coordination with US-based FP&A leadership, the Analyst is responsible for preparing accurate and timely financial analyses, forecasts, reporting and related deliverables for onshore review.
  
  
The role operates within ACC’s integrated Oracle EPM/Fusion planning environment and supports recurring planning and reporting processes, financial and operating variance analysis, model maintenance and data-quality activities. The FP&A Analyst is expected to develop a strong understanding of ACC’s business and operating drivers, identify meaningful trends and exceptions, and deliver well-supported analysis in accordance with established processes, timelines and review standards.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Prepare recurring forecasts, budgets, financial projections and management reporting in accordance with established FP&A processes, assumptions and timelines and under the direction of the Director – FP&A.
* Perform analysis of portfolio and property-level performance, including actual-to-budget and forecast variances, operating drivers, trends and exceptions, and clearly document findings for review by FP&A leadership.
* Prepare financial and non-financial information for monthly management reporting, ensuring supporting data, calculations and commentary are complete, accurate and consistent with established reporting standards.
* Maintain assigned planning models, assumptions, reports and supporting schedules within Oracle EPM/Fusion, following established model structures, driver logic and governance standards.
* Use Excel and other analytical tools to validate financial information, investigate variances, support ad hoc analysis and provide an effective audit layer for information maintained within Oracle EPM/Fusion.
* Perform data-quality and reconciliation procedures across Oracle EPM/Fusion and relevant operational, leasing and accounting source systems; investigate discrepancies and escalate unresolved issues as appropriate.
* Support recurring budgeting, forecasting and reporting calendars by completing assigned deliverables on time, proactively identifying missing information, dependencies or other risks to timely completion.
* Work closely with US-based FP&A, Operations, Leasing & Marketing, Accounting and other stakeholders to obtain complete and accurate information required for financial planning, reporting and analysis.
* Maintain clear documentation of recurring analyses, model inputs, assumptions and supporting workpapers to ensure consistency, transparency and continuity across the offshore-to-onshore handoff.
* Identify opportunities to improve recurring analyses, reporting and planning processes, including opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve the use of Oracle EPM/Fusion, Excel, AI and other automation capabilities.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of Oracle EPM/Fusion planning functionality, Excel and other analytical tools used by the FP&A function.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during budgeting, forecasting, month-end reporting and other peak planning cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, economics, business administration or a related field is required; MBA, CA, CMA or other relevant advanced qualification is preferred.
* Two to four years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, management reporting or a related finance role; experience within a large, multi-entity organization is preferred.
* Strong understanding of core FP&A concepts, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial statement analysis and management reporting.
* Advanced Excel skills, including experience working with large data sets, financial models, lookups, pivot tables and other analytical functions.
* Experience with Oracle EPM, Hyperion, Anaplan, Workday Adaptive Planning or another enterprise planning platform is preferred; direct Oracle EPM/Fusion experience is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, investigate discrepancies and translate financial data into clear findings.
* High attention to detail and demonstrated ability to produce accurate work within recurring reporting and planning deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively within established processes and review standards while exercising sound judgment regarding when to resolve issues independently and when to escalate.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple recurring deliverables and changing priorities.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills in business English, with the ability to document assumptions, explain financial variances and collaborate effectively with stakeholders across time zones.
* Demonstrated curiosity about business performance and the ability to develop an understanding of operating drivers beyond the financial statements.
* Experience with real estate, property-level financial analysis, student housing or another asset-intensive operating business is preferred but not required.
* Comfortable working in a team environment with a structured offshore-to-onshore handoff model and regular interaction with US-based FP&A leadership and business stakeholders.

* Credit and Receivables Management: Knowledge of credit policies, credit analysis, and accounts receivable management through Quote-to-Cash process analysis and designing strategies to minimize days sales outstanding (DSO).

title: P&F Analyst
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

You will work closely with site finance, supply chain finance and global teams to deliver accurate unit costs, month-end close and clear management reporting. We value clarity, collaboration and practical problem solving.
