Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: - Degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or equivalent. - Professional accounting qualification (for example ACCA, CIMA, ACA, CPA) or actively working toward one. - Minimum 5 years of experience in product costing, production accounting or manufacturing finance. - Practical experience with ERP systems; SAP experience is preferred. - Strong Excel skills and experience preparing clear management reports. - Proven ability to work effectively in a matrix and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: - Experience in supply chain finance and partnering with manufacturing sites in a global company. - Hands-on experience with SAP manufacturing costing modules or specialized costing tools. - Experience delivering process automation, data quality initiatives or reporting improvements. - Experience with financial controls and audits in a manufacturing environment. - Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills focused on delivering outcomes. - Comfortable collaborating across time zones and working in a hybrid model. What you will bring You communicate clearly and make complex topics easy to understand. You take ownership of deliverables and focus on practical solutions. You are curious and ready to learn new systems and techniques. You care about accuracy and helping teams make better decisions. You value inclusion and enjoy working with people across functions and locations. How to apply If this role speaks to you, we would love to hear from you. **Skills**
Business Forecasting, Business Reporting Tools, Critical Thinking, Data Analytics, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Controlling, Financial Reporting and Analysis, Influencing Without Authority, Stakeholder Management
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. description:

In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Analyze and interpret entity, portfolio, and property-level financial data, including historical performance and forecasts, to support valuation and advisory engagements.
* Develop and review Argus Enterprise models and Excel-based valuation models for commercial real estate assets including office, industrial, retail, multifamily, hospitality, self-storage, medical office, senior housing, and data center properties.
* Conduct economic, market, industry, and property-level research to assess factors impacting real estate values and investment decisions. Utilize market research databases including CoStar, Green Street, RCA Analytics, REIS, and other industry resources to support valuation conclusions and market analyses.
* Develop, customize, and maintain valuation models using methodologies such as discounted cash flow, direct capitalization, sales comparison, and cost approaches.
* Perform purchase price allocation analyses under ASC 805 including valuation of tangibles and intangible components. Perform fair value analyses under ASC 820, including assessment of market participant assumptions, highest and best use considerations, and application of income, market, and cost approaches.
* Prepare and review valuation analyses, supporting workpapers, and client deliverables to ensure accuracy, consistency, and compliance with professional standards.
* Perform detailed reviews of third-party appraisals and valuation reports, evaluating assumptions, methodologies, discount rates, capitalization rates, terminal capitalization rates, market data, and compliance with applicable valuation standards and accounting guidance. Provide technical observations, recommendations, and audit support documentation to engagement teams.
* Review work performed by Associates, provide technical guidance and coaching, assist with onboarding and training initiatives, support quality control processes, and contribute to the professional development of junior team members.
* Stay current on valuation methodologies, accounting guidance, and real estate market trends through continuing education, professional development, and independent research.
* Prepare and review audit review memoranda, valuation reports, technical summaries, and client deliverables ensuring consistency between valuation models, supporting documentation, and final conclusions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in real estate valuation, appraisal, audit support reviews, financial reporting valuations, transaction advisory services, real estate consulting, or related valuation disciplines.
* Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving, organizational, interpersonal, project management, and communication skills required
* Ability to provide exceptional client service, demonstrate commitment to continuous learning, display appropriate ethical knowledge and commitment, and exhibit a sense of urgency and commitment to quality and the timely completion of duties
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills are required, along with preferred strong writing abilities and availability to travel for client-related work.
* Experience performing real estate valuations, appraisal reviews, audit support engagements, purchase price allocations, ASC 820 fair value analyses, or real estate advisory engagements preferred.
* Experience with Argus Enterprise, CoStar, and other commercial real estate research and valuation platforms preferred. Ability to develop, review, and analyze property-level cash flow models is highly desirable.

Position Overview

* Investigate, analyze, and respond to billing related queries, discrepancies, and issues.
* Prepare, review, and support standard and ad hoc billing and financial reports as required.
* Support P&L analysis, revenue tracking and reporting activities, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Perform variance analysis by comparing actuals against budgets, forecasts, or prior periods and provide explanations for key deviations.
* Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Business teams to gather input and resolve billing or reporting dependencies.

title: Analyst - Accounting
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
Why This Role Is Different
  
  
This role goes beyond routine journal entry posting. You’ll run the technical core of Accounting — inventory accounting, logistics cost accounting, lease accounting, revenue recognition, investment accounting and European subsidiary controllership — on a modern, automation-ready stack.
  
  

* Full visibility into business operations. You’ll see exactly how marketing spend, logistics costs, lease obligations and investment performance flow into the business’s financial results, not just the entries that summarize them.
* Technical depth. Lease accounting (ASC 842), revenue recognition (ASC 606) and investment accounting (ASC 320 / ASC 321) under US GAAP — real technical ownership across some of the more substantive areas of US GAAP.
* Entity ownership. Act as controller for one of our European subsidiaries — own the comparison of actuals to forecast, and sit in FP&A discussions with business heads to understand what’s driving that entity’s profitability, working alongside the VP of Accounting and the Finance Controller.
* A modern stack, with AI built in. NetSuite, Coupa, Numeric, Brex and Looker, plus access to Claude Enterprise to build your own agents and automate your workflows — with our Engineering team available to support you when you need it.
* Direct visibility. Your reconciliations and MIS are reviewed directly at the VP Accounting level.
* Ownership from day one. You’ll own your GL areas outright within 90 days, not assist indefinitely.

The Ideal Candidate
  
  
We’re looking for a Chartered Accountant with 1 year of experience, strong core accounting fundamentals, and real curiosity about how operational data becomes financial truth. If you’d rather build a reconciliation engine than re-key an invoice — and you want to deepen your grounding in lease accounting, revenue recognition, investment accounting and inventory accounting — this is built for you.
  
  
You’ll work closely with Marketing, Logistics, Operations and external consultants; use NetSuite, Coupa, Numeric, Brex and Looker; and own workstreams with direct VP Accounting visibility, including controllership of a European subsidiary.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  

* Marketing accrual engineering — build and maintain the monthly accrual model across digital, performance, brand and agency spend; reconcile to invoice-level detail using Looker reports, and post journal entries with a clean audit trail.
* Logistics cost modeling — own first-mile, middle-mile and last-mile carrier costs, freight, customs, duty and tariff; build accrual models tied directly to shipment volumes.
* Inventory accounting — own inventory costing, valuation and reconciliation, partnering with Supply Chain and Operations to keep the inventory sub-ledger tied to the GL.
* Lease accounting (ASC 842) — build and maintain lease schedules, ROU asset and lease liability roll-forwards, modifications, terminations and disclosures.
* Revenue recognition (ASC 606) — own revenue recognition schedules and accruals, including review of contracts with multiple performance obligations.
* Investment accounting (ASC 320 / ASC 321) — own investment accounting and reporting under US GAAP for debt securities (ASC 320) and equity securities (ASC 321), including reconciliations against custodian/bank statements and periodic roll-forwards.
* European subsidiary controllership — act as controller for one of our European subsidiaries; own the comparison of actuals to forecasted numbers, and be part of FP&A discussions with business heads to understand what’s impacting that entity’s profitability, working alongside the VP of Accounting and the Finance Controller.
* Close mechanics — use AI to prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaids and reserves for your owned GL areas, with documentation built for audit walkthroughs, not audit scrambles.
* Reconciliation architecture — GL-to-subledger, bank, vendor, lease, inventory and investment schedule reconciliations, built to be self-explanatory to anyone who opens them.
* Cross-functional partnership — work directly with Marketing, Logistics, Operations and FP&A to flag risk, propose accounting treatment, and resolve discrepancies before they become close-day fires.
* Automation ownership — build and ship your own AI agents on Claude Enterprise, using MCP connectors into NetSuite, Coupa, Numeric, Brex and Looker, to automate your workflows — with Engineering support whenever you need it.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA) with 1 year of post-qualification experience.
* Strong conceptual grip on accounting, accruals, controls and US GAAP — exposure to lease accounting, revenue recognition or investment accounting is a plus, not required.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close, reconciliations and multi-entity accounting.
* A genuine systems mindset — interest in how ERPs, BI tools and automation reshape a close, not just comfort operating them.
* Advanced Excel and comfort with large, system-generated datasets.
* Working knowledge of NetSuite preferred; familiarity with Coupa, Numeric or Brex a strong plus.
* Exposure to workflow tools (Jira / Freshservice) a plus.
* Ability to trace a number back through the operational system that produced it — logic over rote process.
* Comfort with, or willingness to learn, forecast-to-actual variance analysis and FP&A-style business partnering — a plus, not required.
* Sharp communication skills — you’ll present numbers and issues directly to senior stakeholders, including the VP of Accounting and business heads.
* Real curiosity about the story behind the numbers, not just posting entries.
* E-commerce, supply chain or operational finance background preferred, not required.

**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
  
  
Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.
  
  
*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*
At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Manager R2R
description:
The R2R Senior Manager is a seasoned finance controller who acts as the business-facing layer of the Record to Report function, sitting between R2R Managers (who run the close) and the R2R Tower Lead (who owns the tower). The role goes beyond core transactional operations to drill into the business: analysing the Balance Sheet and P&L, identifying trend-based issues, policy deviations, exceptions, and financial risks, and converting these into actionable business insights for Financial Controllers and CFO level stakeholders. The role also oversees group consolidation and brings a strong understanding of manufacturing operations and SAP-driven financial data.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Balance Sheet & P&L Analysis**

● Perform in-depth monthly, quarterly, and annual review of the Balance Sheet and P&L across entities, going beyond accuracy checks to assess quality, composition, and sustainability of reported numbers.

● Analyse key P&L drivers (revenue, material cost, conversion cost, overheads, margins) and explain movements against budget, forecast, and prior periods.

● Scrutinise Balance Sheet health, including working capital (inventory, receivables, payables), provisions, accruals, fixed assets, CWIP, and intercompany positions. Challenge unusual, unsupported, or judgment-based balances and ensure appropriate accounting treatment and valuation.

● Present concise, insight-led financial reviews to Financial Controllers and CFO-level leadership.

2.
**Trend-Based Issue Identification & Business Insights**

● Use month-on-month and year-on-year trend analysis to proactively detect anomalies, recurring issues, leakages, and emerging risks before they impact reported results.

● Translate financial data into business insights on profitability, cost behaviour, plant performance, and working capital efficiency.

● Identify root causes of recurring variances and exceptions, and recommend corrective actions to business and finance owners.

● Partner with FP&A and business finance to link accounting outcomes with operational drivers and support business decision-making.

3.
**Consolidation & Group Reporting**

● Oversee group consolidation across entities, including intercompany eliminations, minority interest, foreign currency translation, and consolidation adjustments.

● Review consolidated financial statements and reporting packs for accuracy, consistency, and alignment with group policies and applicable GAAP (IFRS / Ind AS / US GAAP).

● Validate consolidation tool outputs against SAP ledger data and resolve significant differences.

● Provide consolidated-level analysis and commentary on key movements for leadership reporting.

**4. Manufacturing Finance & SAP**

● Apply strong understanding of manufacturing finance – inventory valuation, standard costing, production variances, COGS, capex, and plant-level P&L – to review and interpret financials.

● Leverage SAP (FI/CO, and exposure to MM/PP/SD integration) to drill into transactional data, trace issues to source, and support analysis.

● Identify system-driven or process-driven accounting issues arising from manufacturing operations and drive resolution with plant finance and operations teams.

.5
**Leadership & Governance**

● Provide direction and review oversight to R2R Managers, with month-end close execution delegated to the Manager layer.

● Raise the analytical and business-review capability of the team; coach Managers on financial review, commentary, and risk identification.

● Drive standardization of review frameworks, analytical templates, and exception reporting across the tower.

**Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory, 12 – 15 Years overall, with 10+ years post-CA qualification**

Flexible to align with global stakeholder time zones, as required

* Support the development of acquisition strategies and investment rationales.
* Identify, screen, and evaluate potential acquisition targets.
* Assess strategic fit, business models, competitive positioning, and potential synergies.

**2. Due Diligence and Transaction Advisory**

* Conduct Commercial and Operational Due Diligence, including market, competitor, customer, and financial performance analysis.
* Evaluate business plans, growth assumptions, profitability, and operational improvement opportunities.
* Support transaction-related assessments and coordinate with financial, legal, and other advisers as required.

**3. Post-Merger Integration and Value Creation**

* Support PMI planning, including Day 1 readiness, 100-day plans, and integration priorities.
* Identify opportunities for revenue growth, cost optimization, and operational improvements.
* Support the execution and monitoring of value creation initiatives.

**4. Client and Project Delivery**

* Conduct research, financial and operational analysis, management interviews, and stakeholder discussions.
* Develop client presentations, analytical reports, and actionable recommendations.
* Work directly with Japanese and Indian clients.
* Coordinate project activities and support junior team members.

Qualifications and Experience

**Requirements for Both Positions**

* More than 3 year experience with strategy consulting firms(MBB), Big Four transaction advisory teams, private equity firms, or corporate M&A teams.
* Relevant professional experience in M&A advisory, transaction advisory, due diligence, corporate development, or post-acquisition value creation.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in at least one substantive area of M&A advisory, such as Commercial DD, Operational DD, target evaluation, or PMI.
* Strong analytical skills, including financial and business performance analysis.
* Ability to independently execute assigned analyses and prepare high-quality deliverables.
* Strong communication skills and proficiency in English.
* Willingness to work in small, hands-on project teams.

**Senior Consultant – Additional Expectations (3–5 Years)**

* Ability to independently execute defined workstreams in M&A advisory projects.
* Practical understanding of the M&A process and relevant analytical methodologies.
* Ability to translate analysis into clear findings and recommendations.
* Experience in strategy consulting, hypothesis-driven problem-solving, and structured thinking is
  **desirable but not mandatory**
  .

**Associate Manager – Additional Requirements (5–9 Years)**

* Demonstrated ability to independently structure complex business problems and develop hypothesis-driven analytical approaches.
* Strong strategic problem-solving capabilities, including logical structuring, prioritization, and synthesis of findings.
* Ability to design and manage major M&A advisory workstreams.
* Experience leading client discussions, developing recommendations, and managing junior consultants.
* Ability to connect M&A analysis with broader business strategy and value creation objectives.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in manufacturing, industrial products, automotive, automation, engineering, or B2B sectors.
* Exposure to Japanese or other multinational corporate clients.
* Experience working on cross-border M&A transactions.

Important Information About Position Levels

DI's position grading differs from that of many other consulting and advisory firms.

Based on our experience comparing responsibilities, capabilities, and compensation across firms,
**a candidate holding a Manager title elsewhere may be more appropriately aligned with an Associate Manager position at DI. Similarly, an Associate Manager at another firm may be considered for a Senior Consultant position at DI.**

We assess candidates based on their actual capabilities, relevant experience, responsibilities, and compensation expectations rather than their current job titles.

**We strongly encourage applications from professionals who prioritize the substance of the role, professional development, and career opportunities over job titles.**

Candidates who consider retaining or upgrading their current title a non-negotiable requirement are kindly requested not to apply.

Compensation Structure

* For suitable candidates, the expected increase in fixed CTC is approximately
  **10–20% over their current fixed CTC**
  , excluding variable compensation, depeding on situation.
* In addition, DI offers a performance-linked variable bonus ranging from
  **0% to 25% of fixed CTC**
  , subject to applicable policies and performance assessment.
* Candidates should apply only if this compensation structure is broadly aligned with their expectations.

Why Join DI?

* Work directly with Japanese corporations on strategic investment and business expansion opportunities in India.
* Gain exposure to M&A advisory projects beyond a narrowly defined functional specialization.
* Participate in projects covering M&A strategy, due diligence, PMI, and value creation.
* Take meaningful ownership of client deliverables and work closely with senior management in a relatively small, entrepreneurial consulting team.
* Develop broader strategy consulting capabilities while building on your existing M&A expertise

description:

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

EY is the only professional services firm with a separate business unit (“FSO”) that is dedicated to the financial services marketplace. If you have a passion for rallying together to solve the most complex challenges in the financial services industry, come join our dynamic FSO team!

The Structured Finance Team specializes in addressing varying needs of market participants in the securitization marketplace across asset classes, including asset- backed securities (ABS), commercial mortgage- backed securities (CMBS), residential mortgage- backed securities (RMBS) and collateralized loan obligations (CLO). * Flexibility and willingness to work more than standard hours when necessary to meet client deadlines

Prior structured finance experience
  
  
**What We Look For**

* Individuals who demonstrate in-depth technical capabilities and professional knowledge
* Strong analytical skills with attention to detail & accuracy
* Ability to quickly assimilate to new knowledge and possess good business acumen
* Polished verbal and written communication skills in English

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies, and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills, and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.

title: Executive Associate - Operations & Finance
description:
Executive Associate – Operations & Finance

About the role

We are a finance consulting firm in Bengaluru, currently operated and run by the director alone. We are looking for an Executive Associate to work directly with the Director. You will maintain the books for the company's new ventures, support budgeting and audits, track and manage personal investments of director, and manage travel and personal errands for the Director.

This is a role for a commerce graduate who wants hands-on exposure to accounting and finance operations and open to support director's personal tasks, allowing the director to focus on the core revenue generating activities. Freshers are welcome.

What you will do

1. Venture bookkeeping, budgeting and audit support

- Maintain the books of accounts for each venture: record transactions, file invoices and vouchers, and reconcile bank accounts monthly

- Keep supporting documents organised so every entry can be traced to its source

- Support internal and statutory auditors: prepare schedules and reconciliations, and follow up on their queries until closed

- Coordinate with the CA on bookkeeping, tax and compliance filings.

- Build budgets for new ventures, covering setup costs, operating costs, hiring and a 12–24 month cash runway

- Research costs and gather quotes from vendors, landlords and service providers

- Maintain scenario models and track actual spend against budget

- Keep a project plan per venture and send weekly status updates

2. Investment administration and tracking

- Maintain a consolidated tracker of investments (equities, mutual funds, FDs, bonds, insurance, real estate)

- Monitor maturities, SIPs, dividends and renewals, and send timely reminders

- Execute transactions on written instruction through approved platforms and advisors

- Coordinate with wealth managers, brokers, RMs and the CA; collect statements and capital-gains reports

- Keep KYC, nominations and account documentation up to date

- Prepare monthly or quarterly portfolio snapshots

3. Personal Travel planning

- Plan end-to-end travel: flights, hotels, transfers, itineraries and bookings

- Handle visas, passports, forex, travel insurance and documentation

- Research and present options with costs, and manage changes, cancellations and refunds

4. Personal Expense management

- Track personal and household expenses and recurring payments

- Pay bills, EMIs, premiums and subscriptions on time

- Reconcile bank and credit card statements monthly

5. Vendor and bank liaison

- Act as the point of contact for vendors and service providers; compare quotes and negotiate terms

- Liaise with banks and RMs for account servicing, FDs, loans, cards and documentation

- Follow up on requests and service issues until closed

6. Executive support

- Manage the Director's calendar, reminders and important dates

- Handle errands and administration, draft emails and letters, and keep files organised

What we are looking for

- Graduate in commerce, finance or business administration (B.Com, BBA or equivalent)

- Fresher, or up to 1 year of experience in operations, administration or accounts (internships count)

- Good Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Basic understanding of banking, mutual funds, FDs and insurance, and keen to learn

- Good communication skills

- Trustworthy and discreet with confidential information

- Organised, proactive and detail-oriented

Good to have

- Familiarity with Tally, Zoho Books or similar accounting tools

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to get work done faster: drafting, research, summarising documents and building spreadsheets

What we offer

- CTC: upto 5 LPA, depending on experience

- Direct exposure to a Director's work across finance, operations and new ventures

- A steep learning curve in bookkeeping, audits, budgeting and investment operations

Location: Bengaluru (hybrid)

Employment type: Full-time

title: Manager Product Control
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role
**Manager Product Control.**
**Purpose of the role**
Product Control is part of Controllership. Product Control ensures traded products are fair valued, correctly accounted and disclosed with prudent valuations, reported to our regulators and Management. We also partner with the business to achieve sustainable financial performance. The Product Control Global Service Centre team is responsible for end-to-end product control tasks including but not limited to preparation, analysis, and reporting of Profit & Loss and Profit & Loss attribution, to ensure the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger and balance sheet. The individual will be responsible for handling end-to-end Product Control processes for the European / Middle East Sites.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* To act as an individual contributor delivering Profit & Loss production, analysis & commentaries, Profit & Loss, and Balance Sheet Reconciliations & substantiation, and have sound knowledge of products, valuation, and reporting activities pertaining to Global Markets business.
* Demonstrate a sound understanding of Markets business and processes. Observance to Group policies, audit, controls, and compliance requirements including but not limited to declaration of secrecy, data protection act, health, safety and security, information security, clear desk policy
* Responsible for ensuring that the delivery service of Finance Product Control processes per the standards set out in agreed SLAs within the HSBC Global Resourcing operating framework considering key operational risks and ways to mitigate them and operating a well-defined control environment.
* Responsible for ensuring that the Product Controls are aligned to the Global standards and highlight in case of deviation.
* Continually assess the operational risks inherent in the processes, taking account of changing operating procedures, staff movements, legal and regulatory requirements, management restructures, and the impact of new technology.
* Undertake measures to initiate and implement high-impact quality projects leading to operational efficiency and higher productivity (Within Six Sigma, Lean process improvement methodology)
* Undertake continuous review of processes with the objective of improving the service delivery timeframes and identifying areas of improvement.
* Responsible for ensuring BCP (business continuity plan) is documented, agreed and tested as per agreed timelines.Manage Product control processes in accordance with the group’s reporting requirements

**To Be Successful You Will**

* University degree from a reputable institution with minimum 2 years of experience in related fields (i.e., Product Control, Valuations, etc)
* Experience in partnering with senior stakeholders, and handling conflicts
* Understanding of financial markets products (i.e. debt securities, money markets instruments, Foreign Exchange (FX) swaps, Interest Rates Swaps, Cross Currency Swaps, etc). This entails the understanding of valuation techniques, associated risk sensitivities (i.e. Greeks), and risk factor Profit & Loss analysis
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience in driving project implementation
* Understanding and/or experience in Treasury business
* Understanding and/or experience in Hedge Accounting. Experience with accounting controls for Financial Instruments
* Knowledge and experience with a programming language (i.e. VBA, Python, SQL, C++, etc). Professional qualifications such as MBA, CA, CFA, FRM, etc,

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
**www.hsbc.com/careers**

title: Advisory Services Associate
description:
At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence.
  
  
If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity.
  
  
**Skills And Competencies**

* 1-4 years of exposure to banking, credit and/or financial industry
* Strong quantitative skills and ability to translate analysis into actionable tasks with strong excel skills
* Working knowledge of RDBMS (Relational Database Management Systems) concepts and SSRS, Crystal Reports or JasperReports is a plus
* Working knowledge of SQL (query), VBA, and/or Python is preferred
* Working knowledge with AI tools is preferred
* Ability to prioritize tasks, work on multiple assignments and manage ambiguity and to work both independently and as a part of a team with professionals at all levels

**Education**

* Undergraduate or graduate degree with emphasis in finance, economics, accounting, math, computer science or related quantitative field
* Background in structured finance or consumer loan servicing preferred

**Responsibilities**

* Work in conjunction with other members of the MA Issuer Solution implementation team to implement and configure ABS Suite and related products
* Theoretical understanding of advanced financial concepts, swap payments, reconciliations, caps, floors and participation in the creation cashflow modelling for structured finance

* In conjunction with other team members, participate in client meetings and due diligence sessions with responsibility to document business requirements

The Professional Services team provides for the implementation of Moody’s Analytics’ Issuer tools and Solutions. This may include customization of the solutions, as well as development of bespoke solutions, on-site installation, configuration and training services.

You'll develop SQL, reporting, and financial modeling skills on real client engagements, working closely with clients and senior team members. title: Financial Analyst
description:
**Description \-**
**Job Summary**
 This role is responsible for maintaining the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of the company's financial records and reporting in accordance with GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.
   

  

 It oversees core accounting processes, including general ledger management, journal entries, reconciliations, fixed assets, capital expenditures, revenue recognition, cash flows, and financial close activities, providing timely and reliable financial information to support internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Own assigned reconciliations, journal entries, close tasks and reporting deliverables end\-to\-end, ensuring accuracy, completeness and timeliness.
* Perform and review account reconciliations, investigate open items, identify root causes and drive timely resolution of reconciling differences in line with compliance and control requirements.
* Prepare, review and post journal entries with appropriate supporting documentation and adherence to accounting policies.
* Support month\-end, quarter\-end and year\-end close activities for assigned R2R , P2P or AR processes, ensuring timely and accurate completion of close deliverables.
* Analyze balance sheet accounts, prepare trend commentary, and report exceptions, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* Support accounting and operations for Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Payroll Accounting, Deferred Revenue and Cash Accounting processes.
* Support P2P payment activities by validating payment data, coordinating issue resolution and ensuring timely and accurate processing in alignment with controls.
* Assist with invoicing activities, including invoice review, validation, exception handling and coordination with relevant teams to resolve billing or posting issues.
* Support AR cash application by matching customer receipts, clearing open items, resolving unapplied cash and ensuring accurate customer account updates.
* Support internal and external audit queries by providing clear, complete and timely documentation.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, internal controls, SOX requirements and reporting standards.
* Act as a point of contact for operational issue resolution and cross\-functional coordination with internal stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, recommend improvements and support automation or standardization initiatives within reconciliations, journal entry processes and financial reporting.
* Maintain strong documentation, audit readiness and timely communication of risks, issues, accomplishments and process updates.
* Partners with cross\-functional teams to resolve accounting issues, improve process efficiency, and support operational excellence across the Finance Global Operations tower.
* Contributes to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives within reconciliations, journal entry processes, and financial reporting.
* Maintains strong documentation, audit readiness, and timely communication of risks, issues, accomplishments, and process updates.


**Education \& Experience Recommended**
* Professional qualification preferred: Chartered Accountant (CA) or Cost and Management Accountant (CMA India) or Certified Public Accountant.
* Typically has 2\+ years of experience (post qualification) in general ledger accounting, reconciliations, journal entries, month\-end close, financial analysis, or related finance operations.
* Prior experience in SAP/S4HANA, Cadency reconciliation and SOX\-controlled environments is preferred.


**Knowledge \& Skills**
* General Ledger Accounting
* Account Ownership and Balance Sheet Review
* Accounting Standards and Policies
* Month\-End Close Governance
* Audit Support and Control Documentation
* Internal Controls and SOX Compliance
* Stakeholder Management

**Business Finance**

 ● Support fundraising, due diligence and investor reporting.
 



 ● Assist with financial planning, budgeting and forecasting.
 



 ● Identify financial risks and recommend corrective actions.
 



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 ● CA qualification with 2 to 5 years of relevant experience.
 



 ● Strong understanding of accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting.
 



 ● Excellent command of Excel / Google Sheets and MIS reporting.
 



 ● Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 ● Experience with ERP/accounting software and financial reporting systems.
 



 ● Ability to independently manage finance operations in a fast\-growing company.
 



 ● Strong attention to detail with a high sense of ownership.
 



 ● Comfortable working directly with founders and senior management.
 



 ● Prior experience in a startup, e\-commerce, retail, D2C or high\-growth company
 



 is preferred.
 



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 We are looking for someone who is commercially sharp, highly analytical and
 



 execution\-oriented — not someone who only manages compliance and accounting.
 



 The right person should be able to look at the numbers and answer:
 



 ● Where is our cash going?
 



 ● Why did margins move this month?
 



 ● Which business/channel/customer is profitable?

title: Founder's Team — Take Rate Specialist
description:
**Company Overview** 




 ITILITE is a leading global brand in Business Travel, Expense \& Card Management. We operate a B2B SaaS platform serving customers across the US and India, helping companies simplify travel and expense while making it an enjoyable experience for employees.
 



 We are Series C funded, having raised \~$50M from global Tier 1 investors including Tiger Global, Z47, Greenoaks, and Dharana Capital.
 



  





**Function:** 
 Revenue, Supplier Relations \& Commercial Strategy
 



**Level:** 
 Junior–Mid (1–2 years experience) \|
 



**Reports To:** 
 Founder / CXO
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a sharp, data\-driven and commercially minded professional to join our Founder's Team as a Take Rate Specialist. This is a high\-impact, high\-visibility role at the intersection of revenue analytics, supplier commissions, supplier relations and commercial strategy. You will work directly with the founding team to identify revenue leakage, optimize supplier commissions, strengthen supplier relationships and unlock new commercial opportunities across our supplier and partner ecosystem.
 



 This is not a back\-office role. You will be expected to get hands\-on with data, engage directly with suppliers, support and drive negotiations, solve commercial and operational issues, and make things happen.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Revenue \& Supplier Commission Analysis** 



* Deep\-dive into historical spend patterns, financial reports, transaction data and supplier performance to identify where supplier commission revenue is being missed.
* Build and maintain dashboards and models that surface supplier commission trends, anomalies and optimization opportunities.
* Identify gaps in deal\-code application and commercial\-rule implementation; flag instances where the correct codes or terms are not being applied and work cross\-functionally to fix them.
* Analyze inventory utilization, supplier mix and underperforming categories or routes to identify
* opportunities for revenue and margin improvement.
* Benchmark supplier commissions against industry norms, competitive data and internal performance to identify opportunities to improve commercial outcomes.



  





**Supplier Relations \& Commercial Management** 



* Build and maintain strong working relationships with key suppliers and partners, acting as a commercial and analytical point of contact.
* Track supplier performance, commercial commitments, commission structures, rebates and other
* agreed terms to ensure delivery against expectations.
* Proactively identify supplier issues, revenue leakage, service gaps and commercial opportunities, and drive them to resolution.
* Maintain supplier performance scorecards and use data to identify suppliers that are performing well, require intervention or should be renegotiated or replaced.
* Work closely with internal teams and suppliers to improve content, inventory availability, pricing,
* commercial terms and overall supplier performance.



  





**Supplier Strategy and Negotiation** 



* Research and map potential new supplier and partner relationships that can deliver better commission structures, stronger economics or improved content and inventory.
* Prepare supplier proposals, comparison matrices, business cases and negotiation briefs to support commercial discussions.
* Lead or co\-lead supplier calls and negotiations, working to improve commission rates, rebate structures and other commercial terms.
* Support the founding team in evaluating supplier opportunities and making data\-backed commercial decisions.



  





**Insight \& Reporting** 



* Translate complex data findings into clear, concise recommendations for the founding team and relevant business stakeholders.
* Proactively flag revenue risks, supplier risks and commercial opportunities — do not wait to be asked.
* Prepare regular supplier commission and supplier performance reports, highlighting trends, issues, opportunities and actionable next steps.
* Develop concise executive\-level updates that make commercial performance easy to understand and act upon.



  





**Who You Are** 




  





**Must\-Have** 



* MBA and/or Engineering degree from a top\-tier college or university.
* 1–2 years of work experience in consulting, investment banking, fintech, e\-commerce, travel, revenue operations, commercial strategy or a high\-growth startup.
* Strong analytical mindset — you enjoy digging into numbers, spotting patterns and connecting dots others miss.
* Proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets; exposure to SQL or BI tools such as Tableau, Metabase or Looker is a strong plus.
* Excellent communication skills, including written, verbal and data storytelling.
* Comfortable interacting with suppliers and internal stakeholders and owning end\-to\-end tasks with minimal hand\-holding.
* High ownership mentality, bias for action and willingness to work hands\-on in a fast\-moving
* environment.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Prior exposure to revenue operations, supplier commission management, commercial finance or
* marketplace economics.
* Experience with supplier, vendor or partnership management.
* Familiarity with commission structures, rebates, commercial contracts or marketplace economics.
* Experience working with transaction\-level data or building commercial dashboards.
* Ability to juggle multiple workstreams without dropping the ball.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Supplier commission leakage is identified quickly and reduced through data, process improvements and supplier action.
* Supplier relationships become more structured, proactive and commercially productive.
* Supplier performance and commercial terms are consistently tracked and improved.
* The founding team has clear, reliable visibility into supplier commission performance and commercial opportunities.
* New supplier opportunities are evaluated rigorously and converted into measurable revenue or margin improvement.



  





**Why Join** 



* Direct access to the founding team — your work will be seen, discussed and acted upon quickly.
* A steep learning curve across revenue, supplier relations, analytics, negotiations and commercial
* strategy.
* An opportunity to work directly with external suppliers while developing strong business and negotiation skills.
* A clear path to grow into a senior revenue, supplier strategy, commercial or business strategy role.
* The opportunity to make a measurable, visible impact on company revenue from day one.



  





**Candidates from top\-tier management institutions with a strong analytical foundation, commercial** 




**curiosity and the hunger to move fast are strongly encouraged to apply.**

title: Assistant Vice President - Stress Testing
description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

 **Assistant Vice President – Stress Testing.**

 This role is responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and well\-governed stress testing results and management information end\-to\-end, including running/consolidating balance sheet and P\&L outputs, coordinating stakeholder submissions and regulatory responses, maintaining data and systems and strengthening the control environment through robust documentation, evidence, issue/risk management, and continuous process automation/improvement.

Collaborate with Group to ensure any PRA submissions are completed timely, liaise on Bank of England queries, prepare draft responses relating to unstructured data requests.

Managing stakeholders to ensure timely and complete submissions. Tracking actions, recording key decision points, distributing meeting materials and minutes.

Support the development and maintenance of process flows, controls, documentation etc., embedding HSBC principles and ensure compliance with risk management framework.

* Delivery discipline and control mindset: Strong planning, tracking and reporting capability (run books, RAID, milestones). Understand risk management and control frameworks.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**About BrightCHAMPS** 




**BrightCHAMPS** 
 is a holistic skill\-building and learning platform on a mission to bridge the gap between traditional education and the real\-world skills kids need to thrive, offering expert\-designed courses in Coding, Financial Literacy, Math, Robotics, AI, and Communication. Founded in 2020 by Ravi Bhushan, the company has rapidly expanded to over 30 countries, delivering 200,000\+ live classes every month, and is one of the fastest\-growing EdTech companies in the world, teaching coding, robotics, financial literacy, and STEM skills to over a million children.
 



 BrightCHAMPS is backed by $63M in funding at a $650M valuation, with investors including Premji Invest, GSV Ventures, 021 Capital, Beenext, and Binny Bansal. The company operates across four core learning verticals — CodeCHAMPS (coding), RoboCHAMPS (robotics and artificial intelligence), FinCHAMPS (financial literacy), and LingoCHAMPS (communications) — and has grown to a team of 700\+ employees across five continents.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a proactive and detail\-oriented Finance Controller to join our Finance \& Controllership team. This role is central to strengthening our financial reporting, statutory compliance, and internal control framework as we grow. You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, auditors, and leadership to ensure accurate financial records, timely audit closures, and robust governance — while also contributing to cash flow management, budgeting, and business decision support.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Financial Reporting \& Accounting** 



* Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, ensuring they are accurate, complete, and delivered within defined timelines
* Assist in the consolidation of group financials across multiple entities and geographies, ensuring alignment with group accounting policies
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting records by reviewing ledgers, journal entries, and supporting documentation on an ongoing basis
* Perform periodic account reconciliations and variance analysis, investigating discrepancies and ensuring corrective actions are taken in a timely manner



**Audit \& Compliance** 



* Coordinate with statutory, internal, and tax auditors by acting as the primary point of contact, facilitating data requests, and resolving audit queries
* Ensure timely closure of audits and submission of required documentation, minimizing delays and audit observations
* Monitor compliance with the Companies Act, Income Tax Act, GST, and other applicable regulatory requirements, keeping track of regulatory changes and their impact on the business
* Maintain audit schedules, trackers, and supporting documentation in an organized manner to enable smooth and efficient audit processes



**Taxation** 



* Assist in the timely and accurate filing of GST returns, TDS returns, and Income Tax compliances in line with statutory due dates
* Support tax audit processes and respond to tax queries and notices from authorities, coordinating with consultants where required



**Internal Controls \& Process Improvement** 



* Strengthen internal controls and financial governance by identifying control gaps and implementing corrective measures
* Monitor process adherence across finance operations and proactively highlight gaps, inefficiencies, or risks to management
* Support the implementation of SOPs and automation initiatives (ERP/Zoho, etc.) to improve process efficiency, accuracy, and scalability



**Treasury \& Cash Management** 



* Assist in cash flow planning and preparation to ensure adequate liquidity for business operations
* Track and optimize the utilization of funds, identifying opportunities to improve working capital efficiency
* Support banking operations, payment approvals, and bank reconciliations, ensuring accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies



**Business Support \& Planning** 



* Support the budgeting and forecasting processes by providing accurate inputs, tracking actuals against budgets, and flagging variances
* Provide analysis of P\&L performance and support cost optimization initiatives to improve overall profitability
* Assist in management reporting and business decision support by preparing insightful reports and dashboards for leadership



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 



* Qualified or Semi\-qualified CA / CMA / MBA Finance / CA Inter
* 3–6 years of relevant experience in Finance/Controllership
* Strong understanding of accounting standards, compliance, and audit processes
* Hands\-on experience with ERP systems (Zoho, SAP, Oracle, etc.)
* Good knowledge of GST, Income Tax, and Companies Act compliance
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* High attention to detail and ownership mindset



  





**Preferred Skills** 



* Experience in startup / high\-growth environment
* Exposure to group consolidation \& international reporting
* Understanding of automation tools and finance system integration
* Strong ownership and accountability
* Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight deadlines
* Collaborative approach with cross\-functional teams
* Focus on confidentiality and internal controls

title: Accounts Receivable Manager – EMEA & North America
description:
**Job Summary** 




  





 We are seeking a commercially astute, detail\-driven Accounts Receivable Manager to own the full order\-to\-cash cycle for Demand AI Group’s EMEA and North America entities. A hands\-on individual contributor, this role is the single point of accountability for turning signed client commitments into accurate, compliant invoices and cash in the bank, working across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, regional tax advisors and Finance. Every invoice, collection and reconciliation flows directly into the Group’s cash position, statutory filings and management accounts, so the role demands independent operation across multiple entities, currencies and time zones, sound judgement on escalation, and the ability to hold internal and external stakeholders to account.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Insertion Order (IO) Review \& Billing Determination** 



* Use the global campaign tracker maintained by Customer Success (CS) and Operations to identify all IOs, SOWs and contracts across EMEA and North America due for billing in the period
* Confirm for each IO the correct legal entity, billing contact, PO requirements, currency, payment terms and billing model (upfront on signature, monthly against actualised leads/deliverables, or on contract completion)
* Test\-check billing requirements against the IO/SOW, delivery data and agreed pricing before raising any invoice; flag gaps, inconsistencies or missing documentation
* Raise and resolve queries with CS and Sales promptly, escalating where IO terms, delivery evidence or entity details are unclear or conflicting



  





**Invoicing \& E\-Invoicing Compliance** 



* Issue accurate, timely invoices for all EMEA and North America entities with the correct PO, amounts, taxes, due date and remittance details, sent to the agreed client contact
* Route each invoice through the correct channel – direct from the Group’s accounting software, the client’s procurement/supplier portal, or via local advisors onto government e\-invoicing portals in mandated jurisdictions
* Track portal and advisor\-routed submissions through to customer acceptance, resolving rejections and resubmitting as needed
* Log every invoice in the credit control tracker immediately, with billing model, agreed payment date and portal/advisor status populated



  





**Credit Control \& Collections** 



* Own the end\-to\-end credit control process for EMEA and North America, from customer onboarding and credit checks through to final demand and account hold
* Complete client vendor/supplier onboarding forms and registration requests, providing entity, banking, tax and remittance details; route to the relevant business owners only where forms require detailed operational, data or business\-process information
* Follow the agreed escalation order and maintain the credit control tracker
* Identify and resolve disputes and short payments early, coordinating with CS and Sales to protect account health while securing payment
* Recommend third\-party collection, legal action or credit\-limit reviews to management where accounts remain unpaid



  





**Cash Application \& Bank Reconciliation** 



* Allocate customer receipts to invoices daily across multiple currencies and entities, resolving unidentified or partial receipts
* Complete daily bank reconciliations for all EMEA and North America accounts, clearing reconciling items and escalating anomalies
* Provide daily visibility of cash received and expected receipts to support Treasury and cash\-flow forecasting



  





**Compliance, Controls \& Audit** 



* Ensure invoices and processes meet local statutory and indirect tax requirements (VAT, GST, sales tax, withholding and invoicing rules) in every jurisdiction served
* Maintain strong order\-to\-cash controls aligned with company policy and audit standards, including segregation of duties and approval evidence
* Maintain a complete, auditable trail from each IO through delivery evidence, invoice(s), portal/advisor confirmations, correspondence and receipt to the revenue recognized, so any audit can be supported without rework
* Support internal and external audits, statutory filings and tax inspections across the regions, preparing schedules and answering auditor queries



  





**Month\-End Close \& Management Accounting** 



* Prepare and post month\-end AR, accrual and prepayment journals for the EMEA and North America entities – including accrued/deferred revenue, unbilled receivables, bad\-debt provisions and FX revaluations – with full supporting schedules
* Deliver the AR close to the agreed timetable and contribute to accurate regional management accounts



  





**Process Improvement \& Systems** 



* Standardise AR, billing and credit control processes across EMEA and North America while accommodating local requirements
* Identify and implement automation across IO review, invoicing, portal submission, cash application and collections
* Operate and optimise the Group’s ERP/accounting and AR tools (e.g., Xero, NetSuite, Zoho) and ensure disciplined system usage
* Support system upgrades, integrations and data governance initiatives affecting order\-to\-cash



  





**Qualifications \& Skills** 




  





**Education \& Experience** 



* Part\- or fully\-qualified accountant (CA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) strongly preferred
* 8\+ years in accounts receivable, billing and credit control, including ownership of order\-to\-cash – multi\-currency invoicing, cash application and daily bank reconciliation – across multiple countries, entities and currencies, ideally EMEA and North America
* Hands\-on experience with client procurement portals and government\-mandated e\-invoicing regimes, including working through local advisors
* Experience in multinational, fast\-growing or shared\-services environments strongly preferred



  





**Technical Expertise** 



* Working knowledge of international indirect tax (VAT, sales tax, withholding) as it applies to invoicing across EMEA and North America
* Sound management accounting skills: confident preparing and posting accruals, prepayments, deferred revenue, commission accruals and reconciliations
* Proficient in ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel; comfortable working from trackers and delivery data prepared by other teams



  





**Core Competencies** 



* Self\-starter able to own a full regional cycle independently without day\-to\-day supervision
* Strong stakeholder management: challenges Sales and CS constructively, holds clients to committed payment dates and escalates at the right moment
* Exceptional attention to detail with a test\-and\-check mindset and strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Clear written and verbal English suited to client\-facing collections correspondence; highly organised in maintaining trackers, documentation and audit trails
* Effective across EMEA and North America time zones from Bangalore in a fast\-paced, global environment



  





**Preferred Attributes** 



* B2B demand generation, media, advertising or SaaS experience billing against insertion orders, campaigns or delivered leads
* Exposure to US GAAP and/or IFRS, including revenue recognition
* Process transformation or system implementation experience in an order\-to\-cash function



  





**What We Offer** 




 Competitive compensation and benefits; full ownership of order\-to\-cash for two of the Group’s most significant regions; exposure to international operations, regional advisors and senior finance leadership; and career growth in a fast\-scaling global AI organisation.

 Risk \& Change Management

 Quality, Compliance \& Handover

* Ensure project deliverables meet client specifications, regulatory requirements, and Simpliwork quality standards.

**Skillset required**

* Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, cost control, documentation, procurement, and project governance.
* Experience working with leading PMCs, real estate developers, workplace consultants, or corporate occupiers.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to coordinate clients, consultants, contractors, and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in budgeting, cash flow management, contract administration, and value engineering.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

 15\+ years of experience

 Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, or related discipline.

description:

* Systems and data skills. Working knowledge of Excel and the ability to learn and use ERP systems.

 Nice to have
   

  

* Working knowledge of US GAAP and experience operating within a US\-headquartered multinational organisation.

The role is designed to strengthen processing discipline, improve turnaround times, support audit\-ready documentation, and create a scalable offshore finance capability that can expand over time as the firm’s operational requirements grow. This role is intended to form the foundation for a scalable offshore finance support model. As processes stabilise, the Senior Accountant may take on responsibility for training junior offshore resources, documenting standard operating procedures, monitoring service levels, and supporting the transition of additional transactional finance activities offshore. The long\-term objective is to build a reliable, well\-controlled, and cost\-effective offshore finance capability that complements the onshore team while maintaining Grant Thornton’s quality, responsiveness, and control standards.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




 The Senior Accountant will be expected to operate with discipline, responsiveness, and a strong control mindset. The role requires close coordination with the UAE\-based finance team, timely escalation of issues, and a proactive approach to improving AP and month\-end processes. The individual should be comfortable working in a professional services environment where deadlines, confidentiality, accuracy, and stakeholder service are critical.
 


* Process vendor invoices accurately and in line with internal approval workflows, delegated authority limits, tax requirements, and finance policies.
* Support the Accounts Payable cycle, including invoice booking, payment preparation, vendor statement reconciliations, ageing review, and follow\-up on outstanding items.
* Maintain complete and audit\-ready supporting documentation for invoices, purchase orders, approvals, contracts, payment evidence, and reconciliations.
* Assist with month\-end close activities, including accruals, prepayments, expense analysis, bank reconciliations, intercompany reconciliations, and general ledger review.
* Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring reconciling items are clearly explained, supported, and resolved on a timely basis.
* Support cost analysis and expense coding across business units, departments, and projects to improve accuracy of management reporting.
* Coordinate with onshore finance colleagues, engagement teams, vendors, and internal stakeholders to resolve invoice queries and payment\-related matters.
* Assist with VAT, corporate tax, audit, and statutory information requests by collating schedules, supporting documents, and transaction\-level evidence.
* Contribute to process improvements, standard operating procedures, checklists, and automation opportunities within AP and month\-end processes.
* Provide support for ad hoc finance activities, reporting packs, data clean\-up, and system implementation or enhancement projects as required.



  





**Education / Professional Experience/ Qualifications/Skills:** 



* High attention to detail with the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and control gaps.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage recurring deadlines with limited supervision.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to follow up professionally with stakeholders.
* Good problem\-solving skills and a practical approach to resolving transaction, reconciliation, and process issues.
* Ability to work across time zones and maintain service discipline in an offshore support model.
* Commitment to confidentiality, data integrity, and compliance with internal policies.
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, commerce, or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CA, CMA, or equivalent is preferred.
* Minimum 4 to 6 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, ideally within a professional services, audit, accounting, or consulting environment.
* Strong hands\-on experience in Accounts Payable, month\-end close, reconciliations, general ledger accounting, and financial reporting support.
* Good understanding of accounting principles, internal controls, documentation standards, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience working with ERP systems and finance workflow tools; strong Microsoft Excel capability is essential.
* Experience supporting offshore, shared services, or distributed finance teams would be an advantage.

Demonstrated ability to operate independently, manage relationships across international teams, and make informed decisions in a fast\-paced, multi\-client environment.
