title: Project Finance Analyst I
description:
At Emerald Clinical, we are a global, full\-service Contract Research Organization (CRO) with a rich heritage in the Asia\-Pacific region. We are dedicated to advancing clinical research through scientific expertise and operational excellence, supporting biopharmaceutical, medical device, and diagnostic customers across all trial phases, from registration to post\-marketing.
   

  

 Our therapeutic expertise spans renal, cardiometabolic, and oncology—areas where we make a significant impact on improving global health.
   

  

 At the heart of our success is our ability to combine global reach with local knowledge. Our on\-the\-ground teams work closely with local communities, building trust and ensuring diverse, representative patient recruitment. By prioritizing people, we deliver better engagement, more accurate data, and faster results—bringing therapies to patients in need.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Project Finance Analyst (PFA) I is a member of the financial planning and Analysis group within Emerald Clinical. The group is responsible for supporting project finance aspect of contracted clinical research projects for both internal and external customers across all functional areas and geographies, including project performance analysis, reporting, and forecasting, in line with the company strategy and planning.
   

  

 The PFA I is a role in the Project Finance team and works closely with the Global head of financial planning and analysis, supporting various Project Managers to implement and monitor project financial performance in accordance with contractual obligations and scope of work.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
**Project Specific:**
 Participate in Project Handover from BD to Project Operations to understand contractual arrangements that may impact the financials as well as any subcontractors in use.
   

  

 Project Revenue Management – actively support Project Managers/Project Leads in forecasting hours, monitor revenue recognition throughout life of project and post journal entries. Track forecast to actuals and report trends and anomalies. Review monthly project financial performance and billing status and provide variance explanations.
   

  

 Provide various project cycle finance support including but not limited to:
   

  

 Month end close such as support timely investigator payments, pass\-through expense management, capturing of GC labour, accruals and customer invoicing;
   

  

 Support Project Managers/Project Leads in forecasting contractor hours. Ensure that subcontractor costs have been appropriately accrued based on revenue recognition each month;
   

  

 Assist with reconciliation of billing milestones, foreign exchange fluctuations and inflation.
   

  

 Review monthly AR aging by project and assist finance and project operations with collections as necessary.
   

  

 Support project operations with supporting documentation for annual audit questionnaire.
   

  

 Support Project Manager in resolving project finance related issues and responding to sponsors on project finance related queries.
   

  

 Participate in Project Review meetings.
   

  

 Through monitoring project financial performance and key metrics, identify and escalate opportunities for scope changes timely and following the Scope Change SOP.
   

  

 Prepare and review monthly project profitability report / financials. Identify trends / anomalies in consultation with Project Manager and escalate issues to the line manager.
   

  

**Others**
 Assist quarterly forecasting and annual budgeting processes, ensuring project forecast revenue and subcontractor costs are reflective of project trend.
   

  

 Assist the preparation of monthly management report, articulating revenue and cost trends driven by project activities.
   

  

**Process Improvement**
 Contribute to the development, implementation and centralisation of processes, procedures and systems applicable to Project Finance, including assisting in drafting of manuals and policies.
   

  

 Identify continuous improvement within your areas of responsibility.
   

  

**Quality Management**
 Comply with Emerald Clinical Quality Management Strategy
   

  

 All activities conducted in accordance with project specific documentation, applicable SOPs, and applicable regulatory requirements
   

  

 Participate in audit and inspection activities where applicable
   

  

 Comply with all designated systems relevant to this role
   

  

 Ensure own quality control of all relevant processes and activities performed
   

  

**About You**
 Bachelor’s degree in finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field is required; a master’s degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
   

  

 At least 5 years of relevant experience in project finance—preferably within the Contract Research Organization (CRO), life sciences, or pharmaceutical industries.
   

  

 Strong financial modeling and analytical skills (advanced Excel required; experience with tools like Power BI, SAP, or Oracle is a plus).
   

  

 Solid understanding of project financing structures, including debt and equity instruments.
   

  

 Excellent communication and presentation skills.
   

  

 Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
   

  

 Strong attention to detail and problem\-solving abilities.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 At our core, Emerald Clinical is committed to transforming clinical research by putting people first—both patients and our employees. By joining our team, you’ll be part of a global network of passionate professionals working together to deliver better research and outcomes for millions worldwide.
   

  

**Here’s What Makes Us Stand Out**
* Purpose\-Driven Work: You’ll contribute to clinical trials that genuinely improve lives, with a focus on therapies in renal, cardiometabolic, and oncology.
* Global Reach, Local Expertise: Our teams connect with local communities, building trust and meaningful engagement for every trial.
* Collaboration and Innovation: Work in a culture that values diverse perspectives and creative solutions to solve global health challenges.


**What We Offer**
 We understand that great work happens when people feel valued and supported. That’s why we provide:
   

  

* Competitive Compensation: A tailored salary and benefits package to reflect your skills and experience.
* Flexibility: Enjoy hybrid or remote working arrangements, depending on your location and role.
* Career Growth: Access to a wealth of learning opportunities and a global network of scientific leaders to help you grow and develop in your role.
* Employee Wellbeing: Participate in programs and initiatives designed to promote work\-life balance, health, and team connection, including global engagement surveys, recognition programs, and team\-building events.
* Global Opportunities: Be part of a company with international reach, offering you exposure to diverse projects and clients.


 Interested? Apply now and help us achieve our mission to improve the health of millions worldwide.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Staff**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Risk Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 As part of the financial analysis of the bank’s exposures to a diverse range of public, semi‑public, and private counterparties \- including local authorities and their affiliates, public institutions, sovereigns, public financial institutions, SPVs, corporates, PPP/concession companies, and sponsors \- analysts will support credit‑risk assessments and contribute to internal‑rating activities across France and key international markets (primarily France, Italy, Spain, the UK, and, to a lesser extent, the US).
   

  

**Core Responsibilities:**
* Support the collection, quality review, and analysis of financial statements and key risk data for relevant counterparties.
* Assist in the preparation, structuring, and validation of input files and data flows used in rating processes and engines.
* Contribute to the drafting of financial analysis reports / credit memos, including key drivers, risks/mitigants, and preliminary views on ratings/outlooks, under supervision.
* Perform controls and reconciliations to ensure data quality, completeness, and consistency prior to processing.
* For French public sector entities, support data preprocessing and preparation of inputs for mass processing in the rating engine (as applicable).
* Collaborate with business and IT stakeholders to support day\-to\-day operations and contribute to process improvements and documentation updates.
* Build, review, and validate financial models with strong command of Excel;
* Analyze large datasets and generate comparative insights (experience with Power BI/SQL is an advantage).


**Domain Skills Required:**
* Conduct in‑depth financial analysis, including detailed review of public‑sector and corporate financial statements (IFRS/French GAAP), ratio assessments (leverage, coverage, liquidity), evaluation of working capital requirements, and comprehensive cash‑flow analysis.
* Apply project‑finance principles to assess SPV cash‑flow structures, DSCR/LLCR metrics, debt‑sizing considerations, covenant frameworks, reserve mechanisms, security packages, and risk‑allocation structures across concession and PPP projects.
* Evaluate sovereign and quasi‑sovereign credit risk by analyzing institutional frameworks, governance quality, policy stability, and levels of explicit or implicit government support.
* Perform corporate and sectoral assessments by analyzing business models, industry dynamics, competitive positioning (utilities, transportation, energy, social infrastructure), and conducting sensitivity and benchmarking analyses across markets.
* Review and interpret financing documentation, including term sheets, loan documentation, covenant packages, guarantees, and where applicable key provisions within bond indentures.
* Prepare clear, structured, and analytically sound credit memoranda, including rating recommendations, risk/mitigation assessments, and identification of early‑warning indicators.
* Support and conduct gap assessments, impact analyses, and business‑readiness evaluations related to regulatory change initiatives.
* Demonstrate strong technical expertise and up‑to‑date industry knowledge across financial products, market practices, and risk methodologies.
* Lead key workstreams within large‑scale client engagements or independently manage smaller engagements, ensuring consistent delivery of high‑quality outcomes.
* Review outputs prepared by team members to ensure analytical quality, completeness, and adherence to internal standards.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, regulatory changes, and sector‑specific developments to anticipate client needs and strengthen advisory delivery.
* Monitor project progress, proactively manage risks, and communicate priorities, challenges, and updates effectively to stakeholders.
* Mentor and guide junior consultants, fostering skill development, knowledge sharing, and professional growth within the team.


**Qualifications, Certifications And Education**
**Must\-have:**
* Master’s degree in Business Administration (Finance/Economics) or CA qualification, with 1\-4 years of relevant experience in financial analysis or risk‑related roles.
* Foundational experience (internship/apprenticeship/junior role) in financial analysis, credit risk, audit, or corporate finance.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, core credit risk principles, and familiarity with project finance, corporate, or sovereign risk concepts.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel, with foundational knowledge of Power BI and/or SQL considered a plus.
* Working knowledge of Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and Financial Reporting frameworks.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with business and technical stakeholders, including senior leadership.
* Demonstrated automation and innovation mindset, with willingness to improve processes and tools.
* Strong command of written and spoken professional English.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly.


**Good\-to\-have:**
* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, or PRM.
* Regulatory exposure or experience in areas such as Credit Underwriting, Basel frameworks, and CCAR.
* Familiarity with risk‑management systems, tools, or platforms.
* Willingness to travel based on client or project requirements.
* Previous project management experience
* Proficiency in French is highly advantageous and may be required for certain engagements.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**Summary**
 MathWorks has a hybrid work model that enables staff members to split their time between office and home. The hybrid model provides the advantage of having both in\-person time with colleagues and flexible at\-home life optimizations. Learn More: https://www.mathworks.com/company/jobs/resources/applying\-and\-interviewing.html\#onboarding.
   

  

 MathWorks offers a hybrid work model, blending work\-from\-home and flexibility with in\-office collaboration days.
   

  

 If you have proven experience in accounting, reporting, auditing, US and Indian GAAP, this role is perfect for you. We're looking for innovative thinkers and problem solvers with strong systems aptitude and a track record of leveraging technology.
   

  

 You will manage key accounting areas, including Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, monthly accruals, depreciation, monthly close, financial reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis. You will also interact with the global Financial Accounting and Reporting team in the US.
   

  

 Additionally, you will prepare yearly statutory financials, handle audits, inter\-company reconciliations, bank reconciliations, revenue recognition, and other general ledger tasks.
   

  

 This position offers excellent learning opportunities in a multinational environment. Ready to advance your career? Join us at MathWorks!

**Responsibilities**
* Ensure accuracy and meet deadlines in all tasks, assisting the Finance \& Operations team with daily problem\-solving.
* Perform monthly close of accounting modules, reconciling subledgers to the general ledger.
* Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations and conduct cross\-country reviews.
* Develop processes to ensure expense bookings comply with internal approvals, budgets, and taxation before payout.
* Handle yearly and monthly book closings, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and audits (internal, statutory, and tax).
* Maintain the integrity of financial statements and general ledger accounts, complying with local statutory reporting and internal parent\-company policies using ERP software.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, and international teams to complete audits timely, follow up on action items, and resolve audit points, keeping stakeholders informed.
* Ability to look at the “Big Picture’ and review existing processes, gather team suggestions, identify improvement projects, implement changes, and automate where possible.
* Manage vendor master including onboarding and ensure compliance with MSME and other regulations.
* Prepare purchase orders for vendors, track supply of goods/services, and monitor pending POs.
* Conduct finance induction for new hires, providing the latest information on expense policy and reimbursement systems at MathWorks.
* Support ad\-hoc projects and assist offices outside India as needed.
* Perform other tasks as assigned as required.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* A bachelor's degree and 6 years of professional work experience (or a master's degree and 3 years of professional work experience, or equivalent experience) is required.
* Chartered Accountant


**Additional Qualifications**
* Chartered Accountant with expertise in Finance and Accounting.
* Experience in Hi\-tech companies and related services (consulting, engineering, training), with knowledge of international accounting principles (US GAAP, Ind AS).
* Working knowledge of direct and indirect taxation.
* Ability to work independently in a high\-tech, data\-driven environment.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills at all levels.
* Strong organizational skills, able to multi\-task, work under pressure, and meet deadlines.
* Proficient in using technology and systems, with experience in software and financial tools (Microsoft Office, SharePoint, Oracle Cloud ERP, Anaplan, etc.).
* Interest and experience in automating repetitive data management processes.
* Team\-oriented, problem\-solving attitude, high integrity, and strong work ethics.
* Proficiency in English and local language.
* Experience with inter\-company transactions and charge\-back, preferably in multinational financial reporting and analysis.

**Risk Register \& KRI Management**
 Maintain and periodically update the enterprise Risk Register.
   

  

 Define, review, monitor, and track Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
   

  

 Ensure appropriate management review and sign\-offs for risk assessments, KRIs, and risk mitigation actions.
   

  

 Independently perform KRI assessments and conduct discussions with relevant stakeholders to understand deviations, trends, and underlying risk drivers.
   

  

 Identify trends and potential areas of increased risk and escalate significant observations through appropriate governance channels.
   

  

**Scenario \& Sensitivity Analysis**
 Perform scenario analysis to assess the potential impact of identified enterprise risks.
   

  

 Conduct sensitivity analysis for key business, financial, operational, and strategic risks.
   

  

 Develop risk scenarios based on historical events, emerging trends, macroeconomic conditions, and business\-specific vulnerabilities.
   

  

 Support management in understanding potential risk outcomes and evaluating mitigation strategies.
   

  

**Macroeconomic \& Emerging Risk Monitoring**
 Monitor macroeconomic, geopolitical, regulatory, industry, and emerging\-risk developments.
   

  

 Assess the potential impact of external developments on the organization's business, financial performance, operations, and strategic objectives.
   

  

 Translate external risk developments into relevant enterprise risk considerations for management review.
   

  

**Risk Reporting \& Governance**
 Contribute to the preparation of quarterly Risk Dashboards, risk reports, and management presentations.
   

  

 Support reporting to the Risk Committee, Chief Risk Office, and senior leadership.
   

  

 Present risk trends, KRI movements, emerging risks, scenario analysis, and key observations in a clear and concise manner.
   

  

 Ensure risk reporting is accurate, timely, and supported by appropriate data and stakeholder inputs.
   

  

**Integrated Risk Governance**
 Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, ESG, Finance, Strategy, and other relevant functions to promote an integrated approach to risk governance.
   

  

 Identify areas of overlap or interdependency between enterprise risks, compliance risks, audit observations, ESG risks, and business risks.
   

  

 Support cross\-functional initiatives related to risk governance and control enhancement.
   

  

**Automation \& Digital Enablement**
 Support initiatives to automate risk monitoring, KRI tracking, data collection, dashboards, and reporting.
   

  

 Identify opportunities to improve risk management processes through technology and data\-driven solutions.
   

  

 Demonstrate a basic understanding of AI concepts and their potential application in risk monitoring, analysis, reporting, and decision support.
   

  

 Work with relevant technology/data teams to improve the efficiency and scalability of risk reporting processes.
   

  

**Key Skills**
 Enterprise Risk Management, Risk Analysis, Business \& Process Understanding, External \& Emerging Risk, Risk Governance \& Reporting, Audit, Compliance \& Controls.

**5\. GST \& TDS Compliance Support**

title: Assistant Project Controls
description:
**Job Description**
 As an
 **Assistant Consultant – Project Controls \& Cost Controls** 
 , you will support Project Managers and multidisciplinary project teams in the successful delivery of Projects. The role will be responsible for both project controls and cost controls activities, ensuring projects are delivered on schedule, within budget, and in line with project performance objectives.

* Support project budgeting, cost planning, forecasting, and financial performance monitoring.

* Perform Earned Value Management (EVM) analysis, including EV, PV, AC, CPI, and SPI calculations.
* Support invoice verification, revenue tracking, and project financial reporting.
* Identify cost variances and assist project teams in implementing corrective actions.

* Support project and portfolio\-level financial reviews and forecasting exercises.


**Project Controls**

* Track progress against approved schedules and identify schedule variances and critical path impacts.
* Monitor project milestones, deliverables, and resource utilization.
* Support resource loading, progress measurement, and productivity analysis.
* Prepare weekly and monthly project controls reports, dashboards, and performance metrics.
* Conduct schedule analysis and support mitigation and recovery planning.
* Support project risk management activities, including schedule risk assessments.


**Key Competencies / Skills**
* Strong understanding of Project Controls and Cost Controls practices within Engineering, Energy, and Infrastructure projects.
* Sound knowledge of:
+ Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project
+ Earned Value Management (EVM)
+ Resource Planning, Cost Forecasting and Budget Management
+ Critical Path Method (CPM)

* Proficiency in Advanced Excel and Power BI for reporting and dashboard development.
* Experience with Oracle, SAP, or other ERP/project financial systems preferred.
* Experience with InEight is a great asset.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in multicultural and geographically distributed teams.

title: VP - Business Manager
description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**
 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas. As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C C oE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function. Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
 The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions. Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery. Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities. Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness. Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected. Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR. Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas. Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery. Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team


**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge \& Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions. Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making. Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes. Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation. Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans. Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities. Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders. Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment. Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure

We advise our development team, company leadership, and external clients on optimal resource planning decisions. We contribute to investment decisions in solar, wind, battery storage and hydrogen. We are a data\-driven team that believes in continuous improvement and collaboration. This means that we are always looking to develop better tools, processes, and modeling approaches through learning and knowledge sharing. We are looking for someone who enjoys challenges, works well in a collaborative team environment, and revels in seeking answers through data analytics. title: Collateral Management, Officer
description:
**Job Description**
**Who we are looking for:**
 We are looking for a candidate with deep experience in Collateral Management to reduce credit risk by exchanging cash/securities with counterparties. Should have knowledge in the end to end functions including Onboarding activities ideally.
   

  

**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
 Collateral management main focus is to reduce credit risk by exchanging eligible cash or securities between counterparties. The daily calculations are based on MTM of the underlying trades and results in sending Margin Calls, which in turn lead to agreeing transfers. Based on the agreements between our clients and the counterparties the Collateral team in India ensures that all the exposures are fully collateralized and the agreed collateral transactions settle as agreed. The critical onboarding process is particularly important.
   

  

**What you will be responsible for: As Officer you will:**
* End to End Margin call processing \- Process daily margin calls daily for all agreed clients, who will include banks and fund clients and both cash and security margin calls.
* Reconcile collateral balances, investigate and solve discrepancies; be the main point of contact/ escalations
* Fails investigation \- Checking the cash non\-receipt reports and the custody settlement system (MCH) and initiating correspondence with the client
* Reporting \- Generate a variety of reports, which includes client and internal reporting from an access database and Protocol.
* Portfolio reconciliations \- Completing any daily or ad hoc manual portfolio reconciliations.
* Interest Processing \- Month end interest statement generation, settling interest, updating interest agreements, and updating and validating interest rates.
* Ensure that the team meets accuracy and timeliness criteria.
* Carry out responsibilities fairly and impartially; create and maintain an engaged work environment.
* Assist in developing and implementing new workflow approaches and methods as well as system enhancements
* Collaborate with internal and external groups to identify, analyze and proactively resolve issues
* Be the key point of contact for internal/external clients in a most agile manner
* Provide inputs into hire, discipline, control work and terminate employment for direct reports and broader team as needed
* Provide inputs to promote, increase salary and bonus for direct reports and broader team as needed
* Provide coaching and development opportunities to staff

* Ensure SOPs/Job Aides/regulations are met and escalate as needed

* Identify all risk issues, breaches and suspicious transactions and acts in accordance with the 'risk' escalation chain and operating procedures
* Execute on the risk framework changes and/or escalation chain changes. Ensure all Key controls are identified, implemented and adhered to
* Perform related duties as assigned (Projects \- India and Global)
* Provide back and coverage as required across EMEA/NA shift


**What We Value**
* These skills will help you succeed in this role
* Communicates effectively and accurately in English \- experience in facing clients
* Strong leadership, management, and organizational skills
* Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines
* Ability to work on own initiative and proactive
* Very good management skills
* Self\- motivated, flexible, personable
* Good interpersonal skills and an understanding of the rudimentary aspects of the global financial industry and also to Collateral Management would be advantageous


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce

* Experience on Colline platform is a must

title: Senior Manager Finance Risk Management & Controls
description:
Business Introduction GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
   

  

 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
   

  

 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead finance risk management and controls for projects and change across Global Finance. You will work closely with project teams, global process owners and finance operations to spot risks, design practical controls, and enable safe change. We value clear thinking, practical problem solving, and inclusive collaboration. This role offers growth through exposure to global projects, new technologies, and the chance to shape controls that protect the business and deliver real impact. Join us to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following: \- Act as the risk and controls partner on global finance projects, including system implementations, migrations and process transformations. \- Assess inherent and emerging risks for proposed finance process changes and design proportionate mitigation controls. \- Update process maps, control documentation and standard operating procedures to reflect agreed changes and local variations. \- Embed controls into new tools and processes and support governance approvals and testing. \- Identify opportunities for simplification, automation and data\-driven improvements to reduce risk and increase efficiency. \- Support handover of controls to operations and provide training and guidance to stakeholders. Responsibilities \- Lead risk assessments and control design across finance domains such as source\-to\-pay and record\-to\-report. \- Maintain and apply the internal control framework consistently across impacted processes and locations. \- Provide timely risk reporting and escalate significant control gaps or change requests to governance teams. \- Work with technology and data teams to evaluate digital solutions and their control implications. \- Support audit requests by preparing documentation and evidence for project\-related control changes. \- Build relationships across regions and service locations to influence outcomes and ensure sustainable control ownership. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: \- Qualified accountant or auditor (for example CA, ACCA, CPA, CIMA, or equivalent). \- Minimum 8 years of relevant post\-qualification experience in finance, audit, controls or risk. \- Hands\-on experience with internal control design and compliance frameworks (for example SOX or local equivalents). \- Experience partnering on global process change, ERP implementations or major finance projects. \- Working knowledge of ERP systems, preferably SAP or S/4HANA, and confidence learning new finance systems. \- Strong stakeholder management, clear communication and the ability to influence senior colleagues. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: \- Experience with data analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI, Celonis or Alteryx. \- Experience in automation programs including RPA, AI or ML and assessing their control impacts. \- Prior experience in a global matrix organisation or shared services environment. \- Familiarity with multiple accounting standards such as IFRS and local GAAP. \- Certification in internal controls, risk management or IT audit (for example CISA, CIA). \- Experience preparing materials for governance forums and interacting with external auditors. Working arrangement This role is based in India and is hybrid. You will split your time between an office location and remote working. Regular collaboration with global colleagues is expected. Inclusion We value inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need adjustments during recruitment, please contact the recruitment team. Ready to apply? If you are ready to help shape robust finance controls and partner on transformational projects, we would love to hear from you. Please apply now to take the next step in your career with GSK.
   

  

**Skills**
 Business Forecasting, Business Reporting Tools, Data Storytelling, Data Visualization, Digital Fluency, Financial Modeling, Financial Performance Improvement, Influencing Without Authority, Insight Generation, Problem Solving
   

  

**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
   

  

**Inclusion at GSK:**
 As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
   

  

 Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment\-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.
   

  

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**
 GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

title: VP, Finance
description:
Botsync is Asia's leading robotics solutions provider, automating enterprise supply chains since 2017\. We're a Singapore\-based robotics and automation company building autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) and intelligent orchestration software that transform warehouse and factory operations across APAC. We design, manufacture, and deploy intelligent robots, including our MAG series, that handle material movement at scale so humans can focus on higher\-value work.
   

  

 As Botsync scales deployments, expands internationally, and prepares for Series\-B fundraising, this role builds and owns the company's financial, accounting, legal, and investor\-facing backbone. Twelve months in, success looks like clean, audit\-ready financials across all entities with strong cash runway visibility and improved working capital cycles, smooth execution of Series\-B fundraising and investor diligence, a robust legal and compliance framework with minimal founder dependency, and a finance function built to scale with Botsync's global ambitions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Financial strategy and leadership
+ Own Botsync's financial strategy, budgeting, forecasting, and long\-term financial planning
+ Build and maintain multi\-entity, multi\-country financial models across hardware, software, and services
+ Provide the CEO and Board with clear financial insights, unit economics, and cash runway visibility
+ Drive capital efficiency, margin improvement, and working capital optimization

* Accounting, controls and compliance
+ Own end\-to\-end accounting operations across all entities (Singapore, India, Australia, and others), ensuring monthly, quarterly, and annual closes are accurate and on time
+ Manage statutory audits, tax filings, GST/VAT, transfer pricing, and regulatory compliance
+ Establish and maintain strong internal controls, approval matrices, and financial SOPs and reporting automation

* Legal, governance and fundraising
+ Act as the internal owner of all legal and corporate matters, coordinating with external counsel on shareholder agreements, ESOPs, customer contracts, and vendor agreements
+ Ensure compliance with the Companies Act, cross\-border regulations, and board governance; support board meetings, resolutions, cap tables, and statutory filings
+ Lead financial preparation for Series\-B and future fundraising rounds, owning investor data rooms, financial models, projections, and due diligence coordination
+ Work with the CEO on investor conversations, term sheet analysis and negotiation, cap table and dilution planning, and act as a key point of contact for existing investors, VCs, and strategic partners

* Banking, treasury and team building
+ Manage relationships with banks, lenders, and financial institutions; structure and negotiate working capital lines, bank guarantees, trade finance, LC facilities, and FX hedging
+ Own cash management, treasury operations, and risk mitigation, including monitoring currency exposure across multi\-country operations
+ Build and lead a high\-performing finance and accounting team, mentoring finance managers across regions
+ Implement scalable processes suitable for enterprise customers and global audits, and act as a trusted finance partner to Sales, Operations, and Product teams


**Requirements**
**Essential**
* 10\-15\+ years in finance leadership roles, ideally within VC\-backed startups or hardware \+ SaaS / deep\-tech / industrial companies
* Proven ownership of company\-wide finance and accounting across multi\-entity, multi\-country operations
* Direct experience leading fundraising and investor interactions, including Series\-A / Series\-B rounds
* Strong understanding of revenue recognition for hardware, software, and services, working\-capital\-heavy business models, and cross\-border taxation and compliance
* CA / CPA / CFA or equivalent qualification


**Highly desirable**
* Experience setting up ESOPs, share buy\-backs, and vesting frameworks, and exposure to manufacturing, robotics, or industrial automation


**Benefits**
* Competitive salary
* Comprehensive health benefits package
* Hustle of a young startup, always something to do and something to improve
* Opportunities for professional development and growth into management roles
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment

From supporting and launching homegrown solutions to fostering innovation through its Catalyze platform, Lowe’s India plays a pivotal role in transforming home improvement retail while upholding strong commitment to social impact and sustainability. For more information, visit Lowes India
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Finance Decision Support \& Analytics (FDS\&A)
 **Shared Services** 
 team partners with HR, Finance and Legal to provide financial planning, forecasting, reporting and decision support for complex enterprise expense areas. The team combines financial analysis, business acumen and analytics to improve forecast accuracy, identify risks and opportunities, and enable informed business decisions.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Lead Analyst will own end\-to\-end planning, forecasting and analysis for complex enterprise and non\-departmental expense lines supporting HR, Finance and Legal, with a significant focus on healthcare and related employee benefit costs. The role will develop and strengthen driver\-based forecasts, evaluate scenarios and sensitivities, identify risks and opportunities, and translate financial and operational inputs into clear insights and recommendations for senior leaders. This role requires strong FP\&A judgment, the ability to understand and challenge key business, vendor and actuarial assumptions, and the independence to drive complex workstreams across Lowe's India and U.S. teams. The Lead Analyst will also mentor team members and lead process, automation and forecasting improvements that strengthen accuracy, efficiency and decision support.
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own end\-to\-end planning, forecasting and analysis for complex expense lines across HR, Finance and Legal, including healthcare, risk \& casualty and other non\-departmental expenses.
* Develop and continuously improve driver\-based forecasting approaches, incorporating key cost drivers, historical trends, business changes and relevant vendor or actuarial assumptions.
* Lead variance, scenario and sensitivity analysis; quantify risks and opportunities, explain underlying drivers and recommend forecast or business actions.
* Build, enhance and maintain robust financial models and forecasting tools with clear assumptions, validation checks and documentation.
* Partner with business and Finance stakeholders across Lowe's India and U.S. teams to challenge assumptions, reconcile inputs and align on forecast changes and key business updates.
* Prepare executive\-ready reporting, commentary and insights that clearly communicate performance, drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Lead process improvement, standardization and automation initiatives to improve forecast accuracy, efficiency, scalability and controls.
* Mentor and review the work of team members, providing guidance on forecasting logic, model structure, assumptions and analytical quality.
* Independently manage multiple workstreams and deliver high\-quality outputs with strong attention to detail, ownership and follow\-through.


**Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of experience in Finance, FP\&A or financial decision support, with demonstrated ownership of complex planning and forecasting processes.
* Significant experience in planning, forecasting and analyzing expense lines; experience with healthcare, employee benefits or other complex driver\-based expenses is preferred.
* Experience partnering with cross\-functional business and Finance stakeholders; experience in a GCC, shared services or global operating model is preferred.


**Education Qualification \& Certifications (preferable)**
* Qualified finance professional i.e. CA, CMA, CIMA, CFA or equivalent
* MBA with Finance specialization


**Skill Set Required**
* Strong Finance and FP\&A acumen, including driver\-based forecasting, variance analysis, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and risk \& opportunity assessment.
* Ability to understand complex expense drivers and translate business, operational, vendor and actuarial inputs into reliable forecasts and insights.
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with strong attention to model structure, data validation and accuracy.
* Strong analytical and structured problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity and reach sound conclusions.
* Strong stakeholder management and business partnering capabilities, including the ability to challenge assumptions and influence without authority.
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive\-level commentary, insights and recommendations.
* Proven ability to prioritize multiple workstreams, work independently and maintain high standards of quality and follow\-through.
* Ability to mentor and review others' work, strengthening analytical rigor and team capability.


**Secondary Skills (desired)**
* SQL – basic/ intermediate knowledge
* Experience in Financial Planning tools e.g. IBM Planning Analytics (TM1\)

 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Under general supervision (while working independently most of the time), the Senior Analyst – Credit Risk in Wealth Management is responsible for conducting in\-depth credit analysis of high\-net\-worth individuals (HNWIs), privately held businesses, not\-for\-profit organizations, and commercial real estate clients. The Senior Analyst will analyze financial data using tools such as Moody’s Credit Lens, assess creditworthiness, and develop credit analysis reports to support underwriting and lending decisions.
   

  

 In this role, the Senior Analyst manages complex credit analysis assignments, mentors junior analysts, and ensures the accuracy and quality of credit spreads. The Senior Analyst also works on strategic and special projects identified by management.
   

  

 Collaboration with relationship managers and internal stakeholders is required to structure credit facilities that align with clients’ wealth management goals while adhering to Northern Trust’s risk management. This position offers exposure to sophisticated financial products, a dynamic work environment, and opportunities to develop expertise in credit analysis for the wealth management sector.

title: Financial Controller
description:
**Role Description** 




 We are looking for an experienced Finance Controller to take ownership of the company's
 



 financial planning, reporting, controls, cash flow, and accounting operations.
 



 The role will work closely with the Founder/Management, Operations, Sales, Procurement,
 



 and Project Teams to ensure strong financial controls, healthy cash flows, accurate project
 



 profitability, timely collections, and disciplined vendor payments.
 



 The ideal candidate should have strong experience in a project\-based or
 



 construction/interiors/real\-estate environment, where financial management involves
 



 multiple ongoing projects, customer collections, vendor payments, material procurement,
 



 project\-level costing, and working\-capital management.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 1\. Financial Planning \& MIS
 



 • Own weekly, monthly, and annual financial reporting and MIS.
 



 • Prepare and present financial dashboards covering revenue, collections, expenses,
 



 margins, cash flow, and profitability.
 



 • Develop project\-wise and company\-level P\&L reporting.
 



 • Track actual performance against budgets and forecasts and highlight key variances.
 



 • Provide management with actionable financial insights for business decisions.
 



 • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.
 



 2\. Project Finance \& Profitability
 



 • Establish and monitor project\-wise financial performance and profitability.
 



 • Track project revenue, material costs, labour costs, subcontractor costs, overheads,
 



 and other project expenses.
 



 • Monitor project budgets against actual expenditure and identify cost overruns early.
 



 • Work with Project Managers and Operations to improve project margins and cost
 



 controls.
 



 • Ensure revenue recognition, project billing, and cost allocation are accurate and
 



 timely.
 



 • Develop mechanisms to track contribution margins across projects and locations.
 



 3\. Cash Flow \& Working Capital
 



 • Take ownership of the company's cash\-flow planning and working\-capital
 



 management.
 



 • Prepare weekly and monthly cash\-flow forecasts.
 



 • Closely monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables.
 



 • Work with Sales and Project teams to ensure collections happen as per agreed
 



 payment milestones.
 



 • Plan vendor payments based on cash\-flow requirements and business priorities.
 



 • Maintain healthy working capital while ensuring critical vendors and projects are
 



 adequately supported.
 



 • Identify potential cash\-flow gaps and proactively flag them to management.
 



 4\. Accounts Receivable \& Collections
 



 • Monitor customer receivables, ageing, and overdue payments.
 



 • Establish clear collection processes and escalation mechanisms.
 



 • Track project\-wise billing and collection milestones.
 



 • Coordinate with Sales and Project teams on pending customer payments.
 



 • Ensure customer advances and project payments are accurately accounted for and
 



 reconciled.
 



 5\. Accounts Payable \& Vendor Management
 



 • Oversee vendor and contractor payments and ensure proper documentation and
 



 approvals.
 



 • Establish financial controls around purchase orders, invoices, goods receipts, and
 



 payment approvals.
 



 • Monitor vendor outstanding and ageing.
 



 • Ensure payments are aligned with contractual terms and project cash flows.
 



 • Identify opportunities to improve payment terms and working capital.
 



 6\. Accounting, Compliance \& Controls
 



 • Oversee day\-to\-day accounting and ensure books are maintained accurately and on
 



 time.
 



 • Ensure timely GST, TDS, PF, ESI, and other statutory compliance.
 



 • Coordinate with auditors, tax consultants, and external advisors.
 



 • Manage monthly and annual financial closures.
 



 • Ensure timely bank, ledger, customer, and vendor reconciliations.
 



 • Strengthen internal financial controls and approval processes.
 



 • Identify financial risks, control gaps, and potential leakages and recommend
 



 corrective measures.
 



 7\. Internal Controls \& Process Improvement
 



 • Build robust SOPs and approval workflows for finance\-related processes.
 



 • Establish controls around procurement, project expenses, reimbursements, petty
 



 cash, and payments.
 



 • Implement systems to minimise financial leakages, errors, and unauthorised
 



 expenditure.
 



 • Drive automation and digitisation of finance processes wherever possible.
 



 • Ensure financial data is accurate, timely, and accessible to management.
 



 8\. Business Partnership
 



 • Act as a strategic finance partner to the management team.
 



 • Work closely with Operations, Procurement, Sales, and Project teams to improve
 



 financial performance.
 



 • Evaluate the financial impact of new business initiatives, pricing decisions, vendor
 



 contracts, and operational changes.
 



 • Support management with financial modelling and scenario planning.
 



 • Translate financial data into clear business recommendations.
 



 Qualifications
 



 • CA/CMA preferred; candidates with strong relevant experience and qualifications in
 



 Finance/Accounting may also be considered.
 



 • 1 to 4 years of relevant experience, preferably in interiors, construction, real estate,
 



 architecture, or another project\-based business.
 



 • Strong understanding of project costing and project\-level profitability.
 



 • Strong experience in cash\-flow management, receivables, payables, and working
 



 capital.
 



 • Hands\-on experience with accounting systems/ERP and advanced Excel.
 



 • Strong understanding of GST, TDS, statutory compliance, and financial controls.
 



 • Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills.
 



 • Ability to work independently and build processes in a growing organisation.
 



 • High level of ownership, integrity, attention to detail, and commercial awareness.
 



  





 Compensation: 3\.6 \- 4\.8 LPA
 



  





**Company Description** 




 Reminiscent Interior Design is a fast\-growing interior design start\-up based in Bengaluru,
 



 India, dedicated to transforming client ideas into customized, cost\-effective design solutions.
 



  





 The team combines strong design expertise with cutting\-edge technology to deliver end\-to\-
 



 end interior design and execution for both residential and commercial spaces. The company
 



  





 focuses on tailoring every project to specific client needs through meticulous attention to
 



 detail, even under tight deadlines and limited budgets. Customer experience and satisfaction
 



 are central, with a commitment to exceptional quality at competitive prices. Reminiscent
 



 Interior Design aims to simplify the interior design journey and has successfully completed
 



 numerous projects in a short time.

title: Senior Analyst, Pricing Operations
description:
Our Purpose
   

  

 At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.
   

  

**About Us**
 SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI\-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real\-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.
   

  

 Our teams are builders, problem\-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission\-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.
   

  

**What Are We Looking For?**
 We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.
   

  

 As a Senior Analyst, Pricing Programs \& Analytics
 **,** 
 you will sit at the intersection of commercial program execution and applied pricing analytics. You will own the operational mechanics that keep the Flex program running, the feedback loops and documentation that connect field reality to program design, and the deal\-level intelligence — performance reporting, price realization analysis, and trend identification — that translates data into decisions. You will work closely with Advanced Analytics, Deal Desk, Sales Enablement, and GTM Systems to ensure pricing programs are well\-run, well\-documented, and continuously improving.
   

  

**What Will You Do?**
 Primary responsibilities include
 **:**
* Flex Program Operations \& Administration
* Maintain and administer the day\-to\-day mechanics of the Flex program — including rule documentation, eligibility criteria, CPQ floor configurations, and Deal Desk guidance — ensuring program parameters are accurately reflected in systems and field\-facing materials.
* Own the Flex enhancement roadmap tracker: documenting Fast Follow and Future Enhancement items, tracking owner accountability, sequencing dependencies, and flagging items at risk of slipping across quarters.
* Coordinate cross\-functional follow\-through on approved enhancement items — tracking progress with IT, CPQ, Deal Desk, and Enablement without driving senior stakeholder conversations directly.
* Produce and maintain requirements documentation for CPQ and system changes — translating approved program changes into clear, executable specifications and coordinating Deal Desk validation once changes are built.
* Program Analytics \& Commercial Intelligence
* Consume outputs from the Pricing Guidance Engine to produce program\-level adoption and compliance reporting — tracking how Flex deals align to guidance corridors, where discounting concentrates, and how program participation correlates with deal outcomes such as win rates, deal velocity, and expansion rates.
* Build and maintain program\-specific performance views on top of Advanced Analytics' strategic baselines — including Flex attach rates, deal size distributions, remix frequency, and platform expansion patterns.
* Own price waterfall interpretation at the Flex program level — surfacing how Flex deals flow from list to net pocket price, identifying program\-specific margin leakage patterns, and feeding findings back to Advanced Analytics.
* Produce deal behavior analysis that connects Flex and commercial program participation to measurable field outcomes — equipping leadership with a clear picture of what the program is doing to deal quality, not just deal volume.
* Participate in the price realization process — measuring the gap between intended list pricing and what is actually collected after discounts, concessions, and program incentives are applied.
* Analyze transactional data to identify price realization trends and anomalies — by segment, route to market, geography, or deal type — and produce structured findings that distinguish systematic execution gaps from one\-off exceptions.
* Surface price realization insights that connect to program behavior — identifying how Flex participation and commercial program structures are influencing the spread between list and realized price.
* Field Feedback \& Program Intelligence
* Own the seller and partner feedback collection process — designing and distributing surveys, compiling results, and synthesizing field sentiment into organized summaries that leadership can act on.
* Maintain a running tracker of field feedback across Slack threads, Deal Desk escalations, and stakeholder calls — ensuring patterns are captured and recurring friction points are surfaced with supporting evidence.
* Build and maintain QBR materials for the Pricing Programs team, translating performance data and deal behavior analysis into structured, presentation\-ready assets for leadership review.
* Process Documentation \& Enablement Content
* Own the creation and ongoing maintenance of internal Flex process documentation — including step\-by\-step flows for remixes, debook/rebook migrations, and common field scenarios — published via Highspot with version control.
* Maintain the comprehensive internal Flex guide as the single source of truth for AEs, CSMs, Deal Desk, channel sellers, and new hires — keeping it current as program rules evolve.
* Maintain and refresh field\-facing program materials — including the seller cheat sheet, program one\-pagers, FAQs, and eligibility summaries — as pricing rules, thresholds, and features change.
* Support the development of sales motion\-specific enablement assets — including ICP materials, success story compilations, and deal structuring reference guides — working alongside Enablement and Product Marketing.


**What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?**
 Ideal candidates will have:
   

  

* 4\+ years in pricing programs, revenue operations, sales operations, or a commercial analytics role within a SaaS environment.
* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated ability to build and maintain performance datasets, interpret deal behavior data, and translate outputs into structured, actionable summaries.
* Experience producing and maintaining operational documentation — process flows, program guides, enablement materials — with a track record of keeping content current, version\-controlled, and well\-organized.
* Familiarity with CPQ systems and commercial program mechanics — including eligibility logic, quoting rules, and discount structures — sufficient to write clear system requirements and validate changes.
* Understanding of SaaS commercial models, including subscription, consumption, and hybrid structures, and how commercial vehicles like Flex operate in a field selling context.
* Proficiency with data tools (Excel, SQL, or BI platforms such as Looker or Tableau) to build program scorecards, deal behavior reports, and performance views on top of existing analytical baselines.
* Comfortable working within an established analytical framework — applying and extending existing models and baselines rather than building the intelligence layer independently.
* Excellent cross\-functional communication and coordination skills; able to work effectively with Sales, Deal Desk, Enablement, Advanced Analytics, IT, and Partner teams.
* High attention to detail and strong organizational discipline; able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams without items falling through the cracks.
* Experience in cybersecurity, enterprise software, or platform pricing is a plus.
* Familiarity with tools such as Salesforce or Highspot is a plus.


**Why SentinelOne?**
 AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI\-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add\-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.
   

  

 We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

title: Implementation Lead
description:
**Lead, Enterprise Onboarding** 




  





**ABOUT SHESHI** 




**Bringing Sanctity to Numbers** 




  





 Sheshi is a Financial Operating System, the governed infrastructure layer that converts raw financial data into results that organisations can completely trust. Governed, auditable, period\-locked, and traceable to the source.
 



  





 We are headquartered in Bangalore, building an enterprise\-grade product for the global market.
 



  





 Bringing an enterprise customer onto Sheshi is a complete undertaking, their entities need to be structured correctly, their chart of accounts and reporting hierarchies configured, their consolidation and multi\-currency setup built out, and their financial history brought in accurately where required. Every one of these has to be right, because everything the customer sees afterward is built on this foundation.
 



  





 As Lead, Enterprise Onboarding, you own this foundation end to end. You build the methodology this team runs on, stay hands\-on enough to solve the hardest configuration, consolidation, and reconciliation problems yourself, and lead a team of finance professionals who bring customers live with speed and precision.
 



  





**WHY SHESHI** 




  





**What Makes This Role Worth Doing** 




**Real ownership from day one.** 
 You design the methodology, own the portfolio, and are the final authority on go\-live readiness.
 



**Work that shapes how the customer experiences Sheshi.** 
 How an account is structured and configured determines whether the customer trusts what they see from day one.
 



**A team you build.** 
 You hire, coach, and grow a team of finance professionals, with real say in who joins and how they develop.
 



**Player\-coach by design.** 
 You stay hands\-on in the hardest problems, not just in the management of people who solve them.
 



  





**RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**What You Will Own** 




  





**Account Structuring and Configuration** 



* Own how every enterprise account is structured on Sheshi, entity hierarchies, chart of accounts, reporting structures, and close settings.
* Design and own the configuration methodology for multi\-entity, multi\-GAAP, and multi\-currency customers, ensuring it is built correctly the first time.
* Personally lead structuring and configuration for the largest, most complex, or highest\-risk customer accounts.



**Consolidation Setup** 



* Own the approach to consolidation configuration, intercompany relationships, elimination rules, and group\-level reporting structure.
* Step in directly when a consolidation structure is genuinely complex or a customer's group structure does not fit standard patterns.



**Historical Data Migration and Validation** 



* Own the methodology for migrating historical MIS and statutory financials where a customer requires it — run as a real closing exercise, not a data dump.
* Own final sign\-off on historical data accuracy, entity configuration, and consolidation setup before any customer goes live.



**Portfolio Ownership and Reporting** 



* Maintain visibility across every customer currently onboarding , status, risk, and timeline for each, and report this honestly to the Customer Success Head.
* Decide where the team's effort goes when multiple customers are onboarding simultaneously and priorities compete.



**Team Building and Development** 



* Own hiring for the team, define what you are looking for, run interviews, and make the call on who joins.
* Run direct feedback and coaching with each team member on functional quality, customer handling, and pace.
* Give team members increasing ownership as they demonstrate readiness, there is no fixed ceiling on what a strong team member can grow into.



**Relationship Ownership Across Functions** 



* Be the primary point of contact for Sales and Presales when a deal being scoped will affect onboarding complexity or timeline.
* Own the relationship with Product and Engineering for platform gaps discovered during configuration or migration.
* Ensure a clean, well\-timed handover to Customer Success once a customer is fully live and validated.



  





**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




**Your Background and Strengths** 




  





**Experience** 



* 6\-8 years in financial reporting, accounting, or financial systems implementation, with at least 3 years leading a team.
* Proven experience configuring and structuring financial systems for enterprise customers, chart of accounts, entity hierarchies, and reporting frameworks.
* Strong track record with multi\-entity consolidation and group reporting structures, hands\-on, not just oversight.
* Experience leading complex enterprise customer onboarding or implementation in a B2B SaaS or financial systems environment.
* Experience hiring, developing, and managing a team of finance professionals.



**Functional Depth** 



* Strong command of Indian and international accounting standards — IndAS, IFRS, and multi\-GAAP reporting.
* Deep experience with multi\-entity consolidation, intercompany eliminations, group reporting structures, and multi\-currency translation.
* Comfortable configuring financial system, chart of accounts, reporting hierarchies, and close settings, for complex organisational structures.
* Ability to reconcile complex historical financial data with rigour and precision where migration is required.



**How You Work** 



* You stay hands\-on in the hardest problems, your team and your customers can count on you to solve what others cannot.
* You build systems and methodology, not just manage people through ad hoc work.
* You report honestly and early, no surprises for the Customer Success Head.
* You move at pace, bureaucracy and unnecessary delay have no place in how you run onboarding.



**Nice to Have** 



* Experience with SaaS implementation for enterprise financial or ERP systems.
* Exposure to multiple accounting frameworks across different customer geographies.
* Prior experience building a team or function from an early stage.
