title: Senior Business Systems Analyst - Procurement
description:
**Who are we?**
 Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
   

  

 A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
   

  

 A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Equinix is seeking a highly motivated
 **Senior Business Systems Analyst** 
 to join our Bangalore office. In this role, you will serve as the functional and systems expert for Source to Pay processes and technology solutions, partnering closely with Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain, IT, and other business stakeholders to drive process excellence and digital transformation.
   

  

 You will be responsible for analyzing business requirements, designing scalable P2P solutions, optimizing Source\-to\-Pay (S2P) processes, and supporting global procurement initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong functional expertise in Oracle Fusion with exceptional analytical, stakeholder management, and solution design skills.
   

  

 The successful candidate will play a key role in delivering business value through process standardization, automation, system enhancements, integrations, and adoption of best\-in\-class procurement practices that support Equinix's global operations.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

  Serve as the primary functional SME for Oracle Financials and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) processes across global business units.
   

  

  Partner with Finance, Accounts Payable, Procurement, Supply Chain, Business Operations, and IT stakeholders to gather, analyze, document, and prioritize business requirements.
   

  

  Translate business requirements into functional designs, process improvements, solution architectures, and implementation roadmaps.
   

  

  Lead end\-to\-end Oracle Cloud/EBS functional initiatives spanning Procure\-to\-Pay, Accounts Payable, General Ledger integration points, Supplier Risk Management, Purchasing, and Financial Operations.
   

  

  Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on process optimization, automation, controls, compliance, and operational efficiency.
   

  

  Analyze current\-state business processes and identify opportunities for standardization, simplification, and digital transformation across finance and procurement functions.
   

  

  Facilitate requirements workshops, fit\-gap analyses, solution design sessions, process mapping exercises, and stakeholder reviews.
   

  

  Configure, support, and enhance Oracle Financials and Procurement modules, including system testing, deployment, and post\-production support.
   

  

  Collaborate with technical teams, integration teams, reporting teams, and third\-party vendors to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.
   

  

  Support and coordinate integrations between Oracle ERP and upstream/downstream systems, including banking, supplier, tax, reporting, and other enterprise applications.
   

  

  Lead data conversion, reconciliation, system validation, SIT/UAT testing, defect resolution, and change management activities during implementations and enhancements.
   

  

  Develop and maintain business process documentation, functional specifications, test scripts, training materials, and operational procedures.
   

  

  Design and support reports, dashboards, KPIs, and analytics that provide visibility into financial and operational performance.
   

  

  Partner with business leaders to recommend best\-practice solutions aligned with Oracle capabilities, governance standards, and evolving business needs.
   

  

  Troubleshoot complex production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of functional and process\-related challenges.
   

  

  Support period\-end close activities, financial controls, audit requirements, and compliance initiatives related to P2P processes.
   

  

  Provide mentorship to junior analysts and consultants while contributing to functional competency development across Finance and ERP domains.
   

  

  Stay current with Oracle ERP capabilities, emerging technologies, industry trends, and best practices across Finance, P2P, and enterprise business processes.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
  Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.
   

  

  8\+ years of experience as an Oracle Functional Consultant, Business Systems Analyst, ERP Analyst, or Functional Lead supporting Finance and Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P) business processes.
   

  

  Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle ERP Cloud and/or Oracle E\-Business Suite, including Purchasing, Accounts Payable, Supplier Management, General Ledger integrations, and Procurement modules.
   

  

  Deep understanding of end\-to\-end Procure\-to\-Pay (P2P), Accounts Payable (AP), Supplier Management, Financial Controls, and ERP business processes.
   

  

  Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications, process designs, configuration solutions, and implementation roadmaps.
   

  

  Proven track record leading Oracle ERP implementations, upgrades, enhancements, and business transformation initiatives.
   

  

  Strong knowledge of finance and procurement controls, approval workflows, compliance requirements, audit support, and business governance practices.
   

  

  Experience supporting enterprise application integrations between Oracle ERP, Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, Banking, Tax, and third\-party systems.
   

  

  Hands\-on experience with configuration, testing, SIT/UAT coordination, defect management, production support, and release management activities.
   

  

  Strong understanding of Oracle reporting, analytics, dashboards, and KPI development to support business decision\-making.
   

  

  Experience with data conversion, data migration, reconciliation, and master data management activities.
   

  

  Strong analytical, problem\-solving, stakeholder management, and business process improvement skills.
   

  

  Experience working in Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery environments.
   

  

  Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
   

  

  Ability to work effectively with global teams across multiple regions and time zones.
   

  

  Oracle Cloud certification in Procurement, Financials, or related Oracle ERP modules is preferred.
   

  

  Experience leading or supporting Oracle Cloud ERP implementation and transformation programs.
   

  

  Knowledge of complementary enterprise applications such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Jaggaer, Ivalua, GEP, Concur, BlackLine, or other finance/procurement platforms is a plus.
   

  

  Experience with integrations, APIs, middleware platforms, and enterprise architecture frameworks.
   

  

  Strong understanding of Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, and Shared Services business processes.
   

  

  Experience supporting month\-end close, financial operations, audit readiness, and compliance initiatives.
   

  

  Project management, change management, and stakeholder engagement experience preferred.
   

  

 How You will find success
   

  

* Cultivate a strong sense of curiosity and a product\-focused mindset.
* Collaborate effectively with managers, cross\-functional teams, and teammates to achieve shared goals.
* Demonstrate persistence, creativity, and an unwavering drive to deliver results.
* Take pride in ownership and consistently strive for excellence in every initiative.
* Apply an analytical approach to tackle complex problems, identify root causes, and develop data\-driven, impactful solutions

title: Business & Ops Specialist
description:

* Exposure to invoice processing, Accounts Payable concepts, ERP tools (preferably SAP), and invoice submission tools is an advantage but not mandatory.

 Master's Degree

title: Specialist, Offer Lifecycle Procurement
description:
**Job Summary**
 As Offer Procurement Leader (Specialist, Offer Lifecycle Procurement), you streamline procurement processes to create competitive offers aligned with business objectives. You work closely with product and offer managers to identify procurement needs, source materials and services for new offers, and negotiate cost\-effective contracts with suppliers. Your mission is to ensure the efficient and timely procurement of resources essential for developing compelling offers.
   

  

 The core of the role is fact\-based cost ownership. You develop should\-cost models and detailed cost breakdowns for mechanical components — sheet metal parts, steel tubes, copper tubes, fabricated assemblies, machined parts and welded structures — and use them to support commercial negotiations, supplier cost analysis, value engineering and cost reduction across the offer lifecycle. You give the sourcing team data\-driven insight into manufacturing cost, material cost, labour content and conversion cost.
   

  

 You work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Product Development, Manufacturing and Suppliers to identify cost optimisation opportunities and improve overall supply chain competitiveness.
   

  

 As an individual contributor you execute operational and functional strategies within the procurement discipline, applying specialised knowledge to deliver results that directly impact offer creation. You decide on your own work and priorities within established policies and procedures, guide other professionals on non\-routine procurement issues, and your work is occasionally reviewed for quality against organisational standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Should Costing \& Cost Modelling


 Develop detailed should\-cost models for:
   

  

* Sheet metal components
* Steel tube assemblies
* Copper tube components
* Fabricated and welded structures
* Machined components
* Powder\-coated parts
* Mechanical assemblies
* Manufacturing Process Analysis


 Analyse manufacturing processes and their cost drivers, including:
   

  

* Laser cutting, turret punching and bending
* Welding and brazing
* Tube bending and tube forming
* Machining
* Powder coating
* Cost Estimation


 Build up and estimate:
   

  

* Raw material cost
* Conversion cost
* Labour cost
* Overheads and profit
* Machine hour rates
* Packing and freight cost
* Procurement Support
* Support sourcing teams during supplier negotiations through fact\-based cost analysis.
* Validate supplier quotations and identify cost gaps.
* Share impact analysis arising from commodity fluctuations and currency fluctuations.
* Cost Reduction \& Value Engineering


 Identify opportunities through:
   

  

* Design\-to\-cost initiatives
* Material optimisation
* Manufacturing process improvements
* Standardisation
* Participation in QVE (Quality Value Engineering) workshops
* Offer Lifecycle Ownership
* Collaborate with product and offer managers to identify procurement needs for new offers at the earliest project stage.
* Source and procure the materials and services required to develop new offers, and secure supplier selection against project gates.
* Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure cost\-effective offer creation.
* Ensure the target cost committed at project launch is achieved and maintained through the offer lifecycle.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Production or Industrial Engineering, or a related discipline.
* MBA in Supply Chain / Operations preferred.


**Experience**
 8–15 years of experience across:
   

  

* Strategic sourcing
* Cost engineering
* Manufacturing engineering
* Value engineering


**Technical Knowledge**
* Understanding of material standards, sheet metal fabrication, tube forming, welding and machining processes.
* Expertise in should\-costing methodologies.
* Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, GD\&T, BOMs and process flows.


**Tools**
* Microsoft Excel (advanced)
* Lantek (nesting / material utilisation)
* ERP systems
* CAD drawings
* Power BI

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


The Client Incentive Operations team are responsible for managing Client Incentive and Merchant Acceptance Incentive agreements. We ensure compliance with contractual terms and determine the accounting treatment of each incentive deal and conformity with US GAAP. We use lean/six sigma process methodologies to provide benefits to our stakeholders regarding quality, cost and schedule associated with our work. This role is to support the operations of client incentive teams from all regions worldwide.  

 Essential Functions:

* Manage Incentive contracts for all regions
* Analyze newly executed incentive contract terms to assess Visa contractual obligations and determine appropriate accounting treatment based on Visa policy and procedure
* Review proforma to ensure accuracy of contract interpretation and application of Visa accounting policy respectively
* Setup incentive contracts in Oracle Revenue Management and Billing (ORMB) system per contract terms, ensuring that all key obligations have been accurately addressed. Ensure consistencies in the process especially those to accommodate system limitation
* Manage, track, and process contractual payments per terms of contracts accurately and timely for all regions
* Liaise with Sales, Legal and clients to determine the fulfillment of contractual obligations.
* Review on\-going contract performance and update future performance /amortization schedules, as needed
* Responsible for inquiries and issue resolution related to the assigned contracts
* Coordinate with the bigger Client Incentive Operations team, understand the various deals across regions and ensure a consistent business process applied globally for a similar contract structure
* Support ad\-hoc analysis or project as needed
* Ensure key production metrics for the month are met


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

* 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. CA/CMA/CPA/ICWA)

  

Preferred Qualifications:

* 4 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD)
* 3 \- 5 years of relevant working experience
* Bachelor in Accounting

* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills
* Strong business analysis skills, excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Proficient in advanced Excel skills, familiar with Oracle based application is a plus

 Commercial \& Deal Support

 AI \& Process Improvement

Job Purpose and Impact
   

  

* The Professional, Process Analyst job maps, documents, and analyzes processes in alignment with policies, external requirements and business process management standards and tools. With limited supervision, this job provides valuable insights into process performance to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.


 Key Accountabilities
   

  

* PROCESS DESIGN: Maps, analyzes and updates existing processes applying business process management standards and tools, and performs process modeling to design current and future state business processes to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* TECHNOLOGY ENABLEMENT: Applies practical knowledge of the processes, variations and dependencies to support process deployment and stabilize process after technology deployments.
* PROCESS DOCUMENTATION \& TRAINING: Creates and maintains work instructions, job aids and overall process training material in compliance with the business process management standards, partners to deliver specific training and materials to target audience, and documents processes in official business process management tools.

The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Hiring Team Description
   

  





 We are seeking a Finance AI \& Automation Engineer to design, build, and scale AI\-enabled workflows and internal applications that change how Finance operates. This role is AI\-first and build\-heavy: you will ship production workflows that combine approved AI services with low\-code platforms (Microsoft Power Apps, Power Automate), integrate with enterprise systems including Oracle ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, and Allocadia, and apply automation patterns to eliminate manual work.
   

  





 You will partner closely with stakeholders across Finance \- Strategic Finance, FP\&A, Controllership, Procurement, Marketing Finance, and Collections \- to identify pain points, translate them into product requirements, and ship iterative solutions with strong reliability, governance, and responsible AI practices.
   

  





 Core Responsibilities
   

  





 AI\-Enabled Workflow Design
   

  




* Lead with AI: design and ship Finance workflows that use approved AI services for classification, summarization, anomaly detection, narrative generation, assisted triage, and knowledge search.


* Partner with security, privacy, and platform teams to apply guardrails, prompt patterns, evaluation harnesses, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls.


* Define success metrics (cycle time, accuracy, deflection rate) and instrument solutions so AI value is measurable.



 Low\-Code / No\-Code Application Development
   

  




* Build and deploy production applications using Microsoft Power Apps (canvas / model\-driven) and Power Automate, with user\-friendly interfaces and role\-based experiences.


* Deliver rapid iterations with engineering discipline: versioning, environments, release practices, and quality checks.


* Create reusable components, templates, and patterns to accelerate delivery across multiple Finance use cases.



 Workflow Automation \& Process Orchestration
   

  




* Automate end\-to\-end Finance processes: request intake, approvals, task routing, exception handling, audit trail, and notifications.

* Optimize for scalability, reliability, and maintainability \- reducing manual steps, cycle times, and operational toil.



 Integrations \& Data Connectivity
   

  




* Build and maintain integrations between low\-code apps and enterprise systems (Oracle Fusion ERP, Oracle EPM, GetPaid, Allocadia, and adjacent platforms).


* Implement data validations, lightweight transformations, and robust error handling for accuracy and operational resilience.


* Partner with IT and Data teams on integration standards, authentication, and governance.



 Quality, Operations, and Support
   

  




* Own testing and debugging: functional validation, performance checks, regression testing, and production issue triage.


* Monitor application performance and usage; improve speed, stability, and user experience.


* Provide tier\-2 support, runbooks, and documentation to ensure smooth adoption.



 Product Mindset \& Stakeholder Partnership
   

  




* Run discovery with Finance stakeholders, translate needs into clear user stories, and manage a prioritized backlog.


* Communicate progress, trade\-offs, and decisions; demo iteratively and adapt based on outcomes.



 Governance, Security, and Documentation
   

  




* Ensure applications meet enterprise standards for data protection, access controls, auditability, change management, and AI responsible\-use policies.


* Produce clear technical documentation (solution design, integrations, configuration) and user guides.

 Basic Qualifications

About us :
   

  

 Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is a global powerhouse in online travel, connecting millions of people with unforgettable experiences in over 220 countries and territories. With a market value of approximately $120 billion and a diverse portfolio of brands such as Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com and OpenTable, we’re committed to making it easier to explore everyone to experience the world.
   

  

 Booking Holdings Bangalore is a cutting\-edge Center of Excellence in Bangalore, India and a key arm of Booking Holdings Inc. Top talent from diverse backgrounds converge here to develop innovative solutions that drive Booking Holdings' brands and business units forward. We offer a vibrant and inclusive workplace that fosters creativity, growth and opportunities to make a real difference on a global scale.
   

  

**Role Summary :**
 BKNG Treasury is seeking a proactive, self\-starting professional to drive the execution of global Treasury activities. In this role, you will lead efforts across bank account management, banking administration, and automated TMS static data management. Initially focused on supporting one of the verticals in our global banking structure, the role will evolve to encompass broader TMS data ownership and operational leadership within our maturing treasury framework.
   

  

 As a vital member of the BKNG Treasury team, you will collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Banking, Technology, Legal, and Risk. This position demands exceptional coordination, disciplined execution, and a passion for process standardization as we transition key operations to our Bangalore Center of Excellence (CoE).
   

  

 You will be expected to champion continuous improvement by identifying opportunities for process optimization, strengthening internal controls, and enhancing data governance across our global banking partnerships and treasury platforms.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities :**
* Bank Account Management
* Manage and optimize the global bank account inventory, ensuring rigorous oversight for in\-scope entities.
* Facilitate end\-to\-end bank account lifecycles, including openings, modifications, and closures, by coordinating internal approvals and external partner requirements.
* Ensure bank account records, account attributes, signer information, and related supporting documentation remain complete and accurate.
* Track account lifecycle events and ensure timely follow\-up on pending requests with internal stakeholders and external banking partners.
* Support the maintenance of centralized repositories for bank account documentation, agreements, and supporting records.


 Banking Administration
   

  

* Execute core banking administration activities including KYC support, signatory management, bank form administration, and documentation handling for in\-scope entities.
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, Tax, Finance, and business stakeholders to collect and validate required documentation for bank requests and periodic reviews.
* Manage updates to mandates, signer structures, bank contacts, and related documentation across the banking landscape.
* Ensure timely and accurate submission of required information to banking partners in line with regulatory, legal, and internal policy requirements.
* Monitor outstanding bank requests and escalations, and provide clear status updates to stakeholders


 TMS Static Data Management
   

  

* Act as the primary owner for treasury static data within the TMS, overseeing counterparties, settlement instructions, and master data integrity.
* Ensure all static data changes are completed accurately, approved appropriately, and recorded in line with control and governance requirements.
* Support the automation and standardization of static data maintenance processes to reduce manual intervention and improve data quality.
* Perform data quality reviews and reconciliations between the TMS, banking platforms, and supporting source documentation.
* Partner with Treasury Technology and other teams on system enhancements, issue resolution, testing, and process improvements related to static data management.


 Banking Operations
   

  

* Support selected banking operations activities including payment investigations, proof of payment requests, bank query resolution, and follow\-up on operational exceptions.
* Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners to investigate payment issues, confirm transaction status, and resolve operational incidents within agreed timelines.
* Maintain clear tracking of cases, dependencies, and actions required to support smooth operational execution.
* Build end\-to\-end understanding of the transitioning operational scope and contribute to a structured knowledge transfer into the Bangalore CoE.
* Help establish clear process documentation, ownership models, and control points for the operational activities brought into scope.


 Controls, Governance and Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, and policy expectations across all assigned treasury back\-office activities.
* Support periodic reviews, evidence collection, and documentation requests linked to SOX, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Identify process inefficiencies, control gaps, and recurring pain points, and propose practical improvements.
* Contribute to the design of scalable processes and a sustainable operating model for treasury back\-office activities in the CoE.
* Provide cross\-team support where needed to maintain continuity of treasury operations.


**Qualifications :**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or another relevant field.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in treasury operations, banking administration, bank account management, cash operations, or similar roles within global multinational corporations, financial institutions, or complex finance environments.
* Hands\-on experience with bank account lifecycle management, banking documentation, KYC coordination, signatory management, and related treasury administration activities.
* Experience supporting banking operations activities such as payment investigations, transaction confirmations, proof of payment requests, exception management, and operational query resolution.
* Good understanding of treasury systems, static data governance, and process controls, with hands\-on experience in one or more Treasury Management Systems such as SAP, Oracle\-based platforms, or FIS Quantum preferred.
* Experience with major electronic banking platforms such as CitiDirect, J.P. Morgan Access, Straight2Bank, HSBCnet, or similar tools.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications such as Excel and Word and/or Google Workspace tools such as Google Docs and Sheets.
* Ability to work in a complex and dynamic environment, coordinating across Treasury, Legal, Compliance, Risk and Control, FP\&A, FinCrime, Treasury Technology, external counsel, and banking partners.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to conduct technical discussions, align on requirements, and support stakeholders across multiple BKNG brands, countries, and levels of seniority.
* Strong understanding of legal, regulatory, and business requirements relevant to treasury operations, with the ability to assess implications and support practical, controlled solutions.
* Ability to interpret regulatory developments, new regulations, and internal policy changes, identify risk impacts, and support implementation of appropriate controls with internal teams.
* Prior experience working within a SOX control environment, including control adherence, documentation, evidence gathering, and support for testing or audit requests.
* Strong attention to detail and a high degree of accuracy in handling documentation, static data, and operational requests.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously, balancing daily operational execution, process improvement priorities, and project or implementation support.
* Strong process\-improvement mindset, including identifying automation opportunities, reducing manual operational effort, and contributing to optimized and scalable treasury processes.
* Interest in systems and technologies, with the ability to work closely with Treasury Technology teams on process improvements, system enhancements, testing, and operational design.
* Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
   

  

**Job Description:**
**Objectives / Purpose:**
 We are seeking a Principal Analyst to join Takeda's GCC Commercial Analytics \& Insights (CA\&I) organization in India as part of the Forecasting capability supporting International Business Units (IBU). This is a senior individual contributor and technical lead role for analysts who have mastered the full forecasting toolkit and now set the analytical standard for the pod. The Principal Analyst owns the most complex, high\-visibility forecasts across Ex\-US markets \- including patient\-based prevalence and disease\-progression models, demand\-based models, and hybrid launch and long\-range forecasts \- serves as the go\-to methodology expert, and mentors’ junior analysts while remaining hands\-on. The role is accountable for model quality, methodology selection, and the analytical credibility of forecasting output delivered into brand planning, S\&OP, and portfolio cycles.
   

  

**Accountabilities:**
**Advanced Forecast Development and Technical Leadership:**
* Own the design and delivery of the most complex and strategically important forecasts across multiple IBU markets and brands, spanning short\-term tactical, long\-term strategic (10\+ years), in\-line, pipeline and BD forecasts.
* Serve as the pod's methodology expert across the full toolkit \- patient\-based models (prevalence, incidence, disease progression), demand\-based models (trend, time\-series, regression, exponential smoothing), and hybrid approaches \- and set the standard for which method fits each business question and data context.
* Lead sophisticated scenario, sensitivity, and risk analyses for competitive entries, LOEs, pricing and access changes, indication expansions, and cross\-market events, quantifying uncertainty and framing decision options.
* Define and enforce assumption documentation, version control, peer\-review, and audit\-trail standards for the pod, ensuring reproducibility and stakeholder\-ready quality.
* Own forecast accuracy governance \- designing variance\-tracking approaches, diagnosing drivers of deviation, and institutionalizing learnings into improved drivers and assumption libraries.


**Data, Methodology, and Innovation:**
* Establish best practices for working with IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, syndicated subnational data, claims, prescription data, and epidemiology sources to build robust market and patient views across Ex\-US geographies.
* Evaluate and introduce advanced statistical and machine learning techniques \- including ARIMA, exponential smoothing, multivariate regression, Prophet, and other time\-series methods \- to improve forecast accuracy and efficiency.
* Design reusable model templates, assumption libraries, and dashboard frameworks in Excel, Tableau or Power BI, and where applicable Python or R, that raise the productivity and consistency of the entire pod.


**Stakeholder Partnership and Influence:**
* Act as a trusted analytical advisor to affiliate forecasting leads, brand teams, finance, and global IBU stakeholders, shaping how forecasting questions are framed and answered.
* Translate complex model outputs into decision\-grade narratives, slides, and assumption summaries for commercial, finance, and senior leadership audiences.
* Represent the GCC forecasting pod as a subject\-matter expert in brand planning, forecast review, S\&OP, LRP, and ad\-hoc strategic forums.


**Mentorship and Operational Excellence:**
* Mentor Analysts and Senior Analysts through technical coaching, model reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the analytical bar across the pod without formal people\-management responsibility.
* Drive automation and standardization initiatives across recurring forecasting workflows, applying AI and GenAI tools to accelerate assumption research, deviation reasoning, narrative generation, and documentation.
* Contribute to onboarding, best\-practice documentation, and capability\-building programs for the GCC IBU forecasting team.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Experience:**
**Education:**
* Bachelor's Degree required in Statistics, Economics, Data Science, Life Sciences, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced degree (Master's or MBA) in Analytics, Economics, Data Science, Business, or a related quantitative field is strongly preferred.
* Relevant certifications in forecasting, analytics, cloud platforms, or statistical methods are a plus.


**Experience:**
* 5\-6 years of progressive experience in pharmaceutical forecasting or related quantitative areas, with a track record of owning complex forecasts independently.
* Deep hands\-on experience building the full range of forecast types \- including prevalence and disease\-progression (patient\-based) models and demand\-based models, across short\-term and long\-term, in\-line and launch horizons \- across multiple markets.
* Experience supporting Ex\-US markets is required, particularly EU markets; exposure to Asian or Latin American markets is a strong plus.
* Strong working knowledge of pharma data assets such as IQVIA MIDAS, local audit data, prescription and claims data, and epidemiology sources for Ex\-US markets.
* Advanced Excel skills for forecast model construction are required; demonstrated ability to design reusable templates and frameworks.
* Strong experience with Tableau or Power BI for forecast tracking, scenario reporting, and commercial performance dashboard development.
* Familiarity with cloud analytics environments (Databricks, AWS, Azure) and forecasting platforms (e.g., Anaplan, JDA/Blue Yonder, SAP IBP) is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to serve as a methodology reference point and to mentor less experienced analysts.
* Proficiency in coding techniques such as Python, R, or SAS for time\-series analysis, automation, and reproducibility is a nice to have, not a mandatory requirement.


**Skills \& Competencies:**
* **Forecasting Methodology Mastery –:** 
 Recognized expert in selecting and applying patient\-based (prevalence, disease\-progression), demand\-based, and hybrid approaches; sets the methodology standard for the pod.
* **Technical Leadership –:** 
 Elevates the analytical rigor of the team through peer review, template design, and hands\-on problem solving on the hardest forecasts.
* **Pharmaceutical Domain Depth –:** 
 Deep command of demand drivers, patient flow, lifecycle stages, and competitive dynamics across therapy areas and Ex\-US markets.
* **Analytical Rigor –:** 
 Institutionalizes disciplined assumption management, sensitivity analysis, and accuracy governance across deliverables.
* **Stakeholder Influence –:** 
 Shapes how forecasting questions are framed and trusted as an analytical advisor by affiliate, brand, finance, and global partners.
* **Data Storytelling –:** 
 Distils complex forecast outputs, assumptions, and scenarios into clear, decision\-grade narratives.
* **Mentorship –:** 
 Coaches and develops junior analysts' technical skills and forecasting judgment.
* **Cross\-Cultural Communication –:** 
 Fluent communicator across India\-EU\-Asia\-LatAm time zones and organizational levels.


**TAKEDA LEADERSHIP BEHAVIORS:**
 In alignment with Takeda’s Values\-Based Culture, this role requires demonstration of the following leadership behaviours
   

  

* Act with Integrity — Deliver accurate, transparent work and take full responsibility for quality.
* Collaborate Cross\-Functionally — Contribute positively to GCC\-IBU team workflows and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Drive Accountability — Take ownership of all assigned tasks and deliver on commitments.
* Embrace Learning — Continuously build analytical and domain capabilities through feedback and self\-driven development.

title: Senior Financial Planning Advisor
description:
Job Description:
 



 Senior Financial Planning Advisor
 



 Purpose
 



 The Financial Planning Specialist will lead financial planning conversations with prospective clients and drive the advisory\-led acquisition process. This is a consultative financial advisory role where creating high\-quality financial plans, analysing portfolios, and presenting solutions form the core responsibilities. Client acquisition is the natural outcome of a strong planning\-led engagement
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Conduct detailed goal\-setting discussions with prospects and understand their financial profile.
 



 • Prepare, customise, and present Fintoo’s financial plans (cash flows, asset allocation, ESOP strategy, retirement modelling, risk planning).
 



 • Analyse existing portfolios and identify diversification, restructuring, and rebalancing opportunities.
 



 • Recommend investment strategies aligned with the client’s risk appetite and long\-term objectives
 



 • Coordinate with the Core Advisory team for deeper analysis and implementable portfolios where required.
 



 • Explain complex financial concepts in simple language to help clients make informed decisions.
 



 • Build strong rapport with prospective clients through trust\-based advisory conversations. • Handle objections, clarify queries, and guide prospects towards long\-term wealth planning solutions.
 



 • Conduct discovery calls to understand client needs and expectations.
 



 • Convert planning discussions into paid advisory clients through consultative selling, not push\-based selling.
 



 • Engage with referred clients, network\-driven leads, and digital inquiries
 



 • Proactively identify opportunities for new client relationships based on advisory gaps and life events.
 



 • Document all client details, planning notes, and handover information for smooth transition to the Core Advisory team.
 



 • Stay updated on mutual funds, equity markets, ESOP structures, global products, and tax efficient strategies.
 



 • Understand RIA\-compliant advisory processes and explain them confidently to prospects.
 



 • Based on performance and capability, the Senior Financial Planning Advisor may be considered for managing a small team or client cluster.
 



  





 Key Requirements
 



 • Strong understanding of financial planning concepts — cash flow, asset allocation, risk profiling, ESOP management, and tax basics.
 



 • Excellent communication, storytelling, interpersonal, and relationship management skills.
 



 • Ability to simplify and present a financial plan confidently to HNI prospects.
 



 • Good understanding of financial products (mutual funds, ETFs, equity, debt, global products).
 



 • High emotional intelligence, patience, and advisory mindset.
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel \& PowerPoint for plan creation and analysis.
 



 • Strong written and verbal communication in English.
 



  





 Qualification • MBA/Postgraduation (Finance preferred) • NISMXA/XB mandatory; CFP or CWM preferred
 



 • 3\+years’ experience in financial planning, advisory, wealth management, or a hybrid advisory \+ acquisition role

description:
**GLOBAL BANKING \& MARKETS**


We make markets in and clear client transactions on major stock, options and futures exchanges worldwide. Through our global sales force, we maintain relationships with our clients, receiving orders and distributing investment research, trading ideas, market information and analysis.


**OPERATIONS**


Operations is a dynamic, multi\-faceted division that partners with all parts of the firm to provide banking, securities, and asset management services to clients around the world. In addition, Operations provides essential risk management and controls to preserve and enhance the firm's assets and its reputation. For every new product launched and every trade executed, it is Operations that develops and manages the processes and controls that enable business flow.

  

FICC Operations Team is responsible for ensuring the integrity and accuracy of risk undertaken by the FICC Business across the world. Team works very closely with Sales and Trading teams to facilitate all aspects of Operational Risk and Control Framework. The functions involve:


* Matching \& settlement of all trades – Vanilla \& complex
* Facilitating new business \& transformation initiatives
* Confirming economic and legal terms of trades with clients electronically and on paper
  

**YOUR IMPACT**


We are looking for a professional and dynamic individual with a strong interest in Global banking \& market operations The ideal candidate would be able to excel in a high\-profile and fast paced team whose primary responsibilities include (i) partnering with the Sales and Trading Desks to ensure the integrity and accuracy of risks undertaken by such businesses, as well as (ii) driving and implementing change to ensure we are optimally managing and monitoring risks, in an increasingly demanding and complex regulatory environment.

* Daily interaction with Trading \& Sales to ensure discrepancies are resolved immediately

* Team player with a collaborative style and strong interpersonal skills

description:
**The Company**
 PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
   

  

 We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
   

  

 We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
   

  

 Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
   

  

**Job Summary:**
 PayPal seeks an experienced Payroll Accountant to join the Controllership Global Payroll Accounting team supporting the APJ, EMEA, North American and Latin American region. The successful candidate will work well in a fast\-paced environment, learn quickly, and possess strong payroll accounting expertise. The ability to manage relationships cross\-functionally through clear communication of goals and objectives is extremely important.

**Key Responsibilities**
 The successful candidate will execute and manage complex monthly close activities, including:
   

  

* Prepare account fluctuation analysis, identify key drivers, and explain monthly and quarterly activity. Maintain S4 BW account fluctuation reports.
* Reconcile payroll GL accounts including the payroll funding cash clearing account.
* Perform clearing for open item managed accounts.
* Prepare account fluctuation analysis, identify key drivers, and explain monthly and quarterly activity.
* Follow process for clearing payment activity for taxes on stock vesting and other clearing activity processed by payroll. Research offsets and how to clear where needed. Review monthly activity to ensure adherence to regular clearing.
* Monitor and assist in resolving issues with interface activity between payroll and accounting systems. This includes maintaining support for manual correction of interfaces.
* Develop a strong understanding of payroll and GL systems and processes. Maintain documentation of these systems and processes.
* Assist with research and resolution of payroll issues. Communicate and document clearly and concisely results of research or resolutions to issues.
* Assist Payroll Operations Team with changes to GL account mapping, testing, and implementation.
* Provide payroll analysis and documentation for support of audits.
* Process SAP assessments for global fringe benefits. Monitor and validate results from the fringe process.
* Record, prepare, and post numerous recurring and one\-time journal entries.
* Prepare and maintain monthly global close tracker, various payroll and management reports.
* Perform various other duties in support of PayPal’s business objectives.


**Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications:**
**Qualifications**
* CA (India), CPA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent professional accounting qualification
* 8\+ years of relevant accounting experience (knowledge in payroll accounting is preferred). Experience at a large, growth\-focused company a plus.
* Experience in US payroll, US payroll tax compliance is preferred.
* Solid experience with S4 HANA and BW, ADP Global View and ADP Celergo is a plus.
* MS Office proficiency includes advanced Excel capabilities.

* Strong understanding of internal controls and SOX

* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify process improvement opportunities

**Position Summary**
**Strategy \& Transactions \| Valuation \& Modeling \| Modelling \| Senior Consultant**
 Join our team of Strategy \& Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M\&A, and sustainability. **Level: Senior or equivalent**
 As a Senior at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their transactions. You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs, and draft client\-ready deliverables. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
   

  

**The team:**
 Our Valuation \& Modelling team provides a focused set of valuation consulting services to clients across industry segments including energy, technology, life sciences, energy, healthcare, consumer, financial services, and private equity. We perform valuations of business entities, intellectual property, intangible assets, common and preferred stock, and other securities along with partnership interests. Services support clients across M\&A transactions, purchase price allocations, goodwill impairment testing, share\-based compensation, tax planning, and litigation support. These services are provided to assist clients with dispositions; taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards; and strategic planning.

* Perform detailed reviews of financial models, arrive at preliminary conclusions and present the findings in a report
* Manage engagements for modeling transactions (mergers and acquisitions), financial feasibility of projects, corporate and debt restructuring, valuation and corporate strategy
* Interact with internal and external clients and communicate with senior managers, partners/principals, and directors (PPDs) in the United States

* Effectively manage risk associated with engagements

* MBA Finance

* 3\+ years of direct experience in Financial Modeling and Valuation or experience in Corporate Finance role in an organization, preferably in debt raising activities in a finance environment project

title: F&S COE Manager
description:
Who we are
   

  

**About Stripe**
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are building an elite team to drive financial insight and strategy at Stripe. The Finance \& Strategy team brings understanding and predictability to Stripe’s financials, and we work together with our key business partners to accelerate long term growth for Stripe.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with F\&S and Business Leaders to drive the long\-term success of Stripe
* Coach, mentor, and oversee a team of small analysts
* Work cross functionally to identify important strategy questions and answer them with data
* Build financial forecasts and targets, track performance, and understand deviations from actuals to drive strategy and operational rigor
* Gain deep knowledge and understanding of Stripe's business performance across geographies and user segments
* Define metrics and leading indicators of business performance and partner with the Analytics team to develop tools and dashboards to make these metrics widely accessible across Stripe


 Who you are
   

  

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
   

  

**Minimum Requirements**
* 8\+ years of relevant FP\&A, strategic finance, or business\-finance experience with 2\+ years managing a team
* Experience owning planning and forecasting processes across headcount, operating expenses, and/or revenue.
* Strong financial\-analysis fundamentals, including budgeting and forecasting, month\-end close support, and budget\-versus\-actual variance analysis.
* The ability to manage and develop a small team of analysts, including setting priorities, reviewing work, coaching, and creating clear accountability.
* Ability to retain a defined individual\-contributor portfolio alongside people\-management responsibilities. \~50% IC work, 50% Manager responsibilities.
* Strong SQL and/or Python skills, with demonstrated ability to automate recurring analyses and improve finance workflows through AI\-enabled tools and automation.
* Ability to structure ambiguous problems, independently develop a point of view, and drive cross\-functional projects to completion.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills, with a track record of acting as a trusted, objective finance partner to business leaders.
* Experience working effectively across regions, time zones, and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 Experience in a strategic finance function at a high\-growth tech company, preferably in the payments/fintech space
   

  

* Advanced knowledge of SQL or Python
* Advanced knowledge of data visualization tools


 In\-office expectations
   

  

 Office\-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in\-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in\-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
   

  

 Pay and benefits
   

  

 Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

 At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
   

  

 Apply now

 CONTROLLERS
   

  

 Controllers ensure that the firm meets all the financial control and reporting obligations of a global, regulated, and public financial institution. Our professionals measure the profitability of, and risks associated with, every aspect of the firm's business. Controllers also ensure that the firm's activities are conducted in compliance with the regulations governing transactions in the financial markets.

 We're a team of specialists charged with managing the firm’s liquidity, capital, and risk, and providing the overall financial control and reporting functions. Whether assessing the creditworthiness of the firm’s counterparties, monitoring market risks associated with trading activities, or offering analytical and regulatory compliance support, our work contributes directly to the firm’s success. The business is ideal for collaborative individuals who have strong ethics and attention to detail.

 The Controllers group is responsible for safeguarding the firm's assets: to help maintain the integrity of Goldman Sachs' finances and expenditures. Through careful consideration and analyses of firm finances, objectives and strategies, we ensure that the firm's businesses continue to be profitable and efficiently run. Controllers also ensure that all business practices are in compliance with financial and regulatory requirements worldwide. Since contact with virtually every part of the firm is essential to Controllers, professionals in the department experience Goldman Sachs businesses, products, and sophisticated technology systems in depth. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Risk Consulting – EY Comply \- Staff**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Open position for a staff role in fund accounting for one of our Global clients. You will support the fund accounting \& reporting cycle, from NAV production to financial statements, preparing deliverables and reconciliations while working closely with senior team members, liaising with stakeholders, and building strong technical foundations across fund operations.
   

  

 You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
   

  

 You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
   

  

 In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Define new procedures and controls to enhance the overall operational risk process
* Drive high\-quality work products within expected timeframes and budget
* Ability to execute detailed procedures based on knowledge of fund controllership, investment books and records, and/or financial reporting processes
* Perform critical accounting activities, including capital calls, valuations, and transaction processing
* Identify, evaluate, and suggest new technology opportunities that is value\-driven for platform enablement and act as key differentiators for any offerings in WAM/BCM space.
* Facilitate and encourage the necessary conversations between the Business and Technology to determine the what and the how of the product features.
* Work with Technology and business partners in identifying process improvement areas and bring in the culture of automation.
* Collaborate with business, architects to translate business requirements into scalable solution options and provide inputs to product roadmap/strategy.
* Demonstrates a basic understanding of AI concepts and approved AI tools. Uses AI responsibly to support day\-to\-day work while complying with organizational policies.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* 1 \-3 years of experience in Asset management sector, Exposure to US based asset management or fund administration firm will be an addon
* Experience with software tools including document management systems, workflow systems, partnership accounting, investment accounting such as eFront, Investran, Yardi, or other investment sub\-ledger software / Eagle / Geneva
* Experience in financial statement reporting/analysis
* Proficiency in Fund accounting and financial reporting, Investment accounting, financial statement close process, regulatory and statutory reporting, management and financial reporting, consolidation reporting, advanced data readiness and analytics, governance, controls, and regulation.
* Master’s degree in accounting or finance will be an added benefit.
* A Strong understanding of financial industry with fund accounting, expense reporting, tax reporting, asset types and derivatives is mandatory.
* Functional knowledge: good knowledge and understanding of financial instruments and exposure to banking/WAM domains, Exposure to US based asset management or fund administration firm will be an addon.
* An understanding of financial products and services, in particular Private Equity funds, Real Estate Funds, Private Credit Funds.
* Experience related to fund controllership, investment books and records, and/or fund
* General understanding of US GAAP and regulatory requirements is a plus.
* Experience on financial statements is a plus.
* Crisp and effective executive communication skills, including significant experience presenting cross\-functionally and across all levels.
* Understanding of the applications used in the FA or reporting process
* Understanding BRD would be an added advantage.
* Should pay attention to detail, proficient in MS applications (Word, Excel, Power Point), excellent analytical skills and must display effective interaction capabilities with various stakeholders.
* Experience in operational aspects like NAV finalization, reconciliations, management reporting and investor reporting, reconcile investor capital balances and allocation of Profit \& Loss.


**Ideally you will also –**
 Have some exposure to fund structures across real estate, private equity and a genuine curiosity about using AI and automation tools in the reporting cycle.
   

  

**What We Look For \-**
 Candidate should have solid technical foundations and strong attention to detail. Someone eager to learn, comfortable picking up new technology, and keen to explore how AI tools can improve day\-to\-day accuracy and efficiency.
   

  

**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description \- Strategy \& Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)** 
**At Deloitte Strategy \& Transactions (S\&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.** 
**We work with C\-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M\&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high\-stakes moments.** 
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S\&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands\-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.** 
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end\-to\-end M\&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement \& restructuring, to infrastructure \& real estate advisory and sustainability\-driven innovation.** 
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real\-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy \& Transactions is your next move.** 
**The team**
 Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate \& Business Unit Strategy, Technology Strategy \& Insights, Enterprise Model Design, Enterprise Cloud Strategy and Business Transformation.
   

  

 Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data\-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
   

  

**Work you will do**
 Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go\-to\-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
   

  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Maximize the ROI on technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future business strategies


**Required Experience And Skills**
**Strategy\-specific experience:**
**Enterprise and Growth Strategy – Life Sciences**
* Experience working for / with leading companies in the Life Sciences (Pharmaceutical / Biotech), OR Consulting experience serving Life Sciences clients
* Hands\-on exposure of one or more of the following:
* Strategic capabilities: Corporate Strategy, Go\-to\-market (GTM) Strategy, Market Research / Assessment, Business Case Development
* Domain\-specific capabilities: R\&D strategy, Clinical Development strategy, Launch Planning and Readiness, Operating Model Assessment, Market Access Strategy, Pricing and Reimbursement strategy, Vendor Assessment in Life Sciences
* Interest and knowledge about the current trends in Life Sciences, especially pertaining to the US market
* Understanding of niche subject matter (such as cell and gene therapies) will be an added benefit
* Exposure to working in non\-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders is a plus


**Core Consulting Skills**
* Ability to develop understanding of new topics quickly; conduct targeted research and derive insights relevant for client
* Clear and concise communication – ability to articulate thoughts well, ask relevant questions – be able to participate in team discussions (both internally and with clients)
* Good client presence – interact and build relationships with clients and other team members, conduct client interviews, participate in workshops/trainings and present recommendations
* Analytical thinking \- ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary). Synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data.
* Logical structuring \- structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline\-oriented and quality focused \- develop and own development of deliverables. Own and manage specific work\-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources
* Collaboration \- Be able to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels. Be able to prioritize tasks, manage change in scope, work on multiple assignments, and raise concerns/questions where appropriate
* Network \- ability to chart one’s own career and build networks within the organization.


**\#FY27ReferralCampaign**
**Qualifications Required:**
* MBA or other Master’s degree from a premier (Tier\-1\) school in India or abroad
* 4 to 5 years of relevant experience (post MS / MBA), including focus on Pharma/ Life Sciences


**Our purpose**
 Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
   

  

**Our people and culture**
 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
   

  

**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

* Payroll \& incentives accounting.
* Prepayments \& corporate accruals
* Professional \& IT costs
* Advertising \& marketing costs
* Facility costs
* Goods received not invoiced accruals
* Corporate regional and BU allocations


 The position will require extensive business partnering with our business units and effective communication across functions and finance management and global operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 The expense accountant will be responsible for providing accounting services including continuous improvement of processes and internal controls as well as contributing to the overall vision for Company’s shared services evolution.
   

  

* Supporting the Accounting Leader, Expense in the establishment of the expense accounting team in the India Shared Service Center including implementation of standard business processes and governance for identified processes in\-scope as documented in our finance blueprint.
* Deliver successful transition of expense accounting finance processes from the local finance teams in the United States and Ireland (and other locations as required) to the India Shared Service Center.
* Ensure performance to targeted Global Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to align with delivery of desired service level to the business.
* Integrate expense accounting finance processes of new acquisitions into the India Shared Service Center.
* Work closely with teams across the shared services organization and in the business lines to identify and implement opportunities for efficiencies (including the ERP IT team).


**Behavioral Characteristics**
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work with cross\-functional management (operations, sales, etc.) and finance management.
* Ability to build a positive rapport with personnel throughout the global organization.
* High sense of urgency and ability to identify creative solutions to advanced, time sensitive problems by balancing achievement of process objectives with practical considerations.
* Strong customer service focus, with a drive to ensure that we exceed the expectations of our customers.
* Ability to establish \& implement processes and perform in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong ability to pursue best practices in back\-office operations, commitment to delivering quality results and overcoming obstacles and challenges in a time\-sensitive environment.
* Ability to juggle and prioritize multiple responsibilities while remaining calm and effective under pressure.
* Exhibit a positive attitude and maintain poise under pressure.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in accounting/finance with a CPA or Chartered Accountant certification or other similar qualification.
* Minimum of 6 years of relevant experience, including 2 years of experience in global shared service center environment.
* Knowledge of financial systems skills and reporting tools (experience with PeopleSoft a plus).

title: Investment Decisioning -Cards Finance-Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
 As a Cards Finance Analyst within our Finance team, you will define, refine, and deliver financial goals that support our firm's card acquisition strategy. You will collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Marketing, Sales, and Product to align financial objectives with business goals and promote market expansion and customer growth. You will perform detailed financial analyses, including cost\-benefit assessments, ROI and NPV calculations, and performance tracking to inform investment decisions. You will forecast financial results for acquisition initiatives using advanced analytical techniques and scenario\-based modeling to guide resource allocation. You will build comprehensive financial business cases that quantify ROI, payback periods, and sensitivities to key promoters for strategic initiatives. You will design and maintain reports and dashboards that provide timely, accurate financial results and insights to senior leadership. You will prepare and present regular financial reports, forecasts, and executive\-ready presentations that highlight key trends, risks, and opportunities. You will define and monitor KPIs and success metrics to evaluate campaign performance and promote continuous improvement. You will enhance financial controls and streamline processes by introducing automation to reduce cycle times and error rates. You will cultivate strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, providing clear, data\-promoten recommendations that support informed decision\-making.
   

  

 Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Track and evaluate card acquisition campaign performance, leveraging data\-driven insights to optimize strategies and improve outcomes.
* Forecast financial results for acquisition strategies using advanced statistical techniques (e.g., time series modeling, cohort analysis, scenario planning, Monte Carlo simulations) to guide investment decisions.
